chapters.title: Chapter 1: Divine Kingdom Awakening Hidden Talent
paragraphs: “Class 5, Third Year of High School, Li Wu, Divine Kingdom area of 40,000 square kilometers, F-rank Breeding Talent, comprehensive evaluation E.”
Students off the stage looked at the light screen and couldn’t help sighing: “What a pity, the initial Divine Kingdom area is too low. Even with an F-rank Breeding Talent, it cannot make up for it.”
“It’s not bad either. Nearly half of the people don’t have any talent, so Li Wu at least doesn’t have to worry about population issues.”
“When there are too many people, you also need to be able to afford to raise them. Be careful of expenses exceeding income.”
In the corner of the student formation, a young man was full of envy as he said: “Brother Yang Fan, it would be great if I could also awaken the Breeding Talent. Wouldn’t that allow me to take off?”
“The Awakening hasn’t even started yet, and you’re already planning to live off your parents?” Yang Fan couldn’t help laughing and saying.
“My dad has an E-rank Planting Talent; living off your parents is nothing to be ashamed of.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help nodding.
He knew the situation of his best friend, Zhang Pang.
After all, his father was the owner of a grain shop in Mingyue Community, and his monthly Faith Points income was no less than 10,000, which could be considered having a small amount of wealth.
Ever since the divine miracle descended upon Blue Planet, everyone possessed a Divine Kingdom, and all production activities completely stopped.
What about food?
Produced inside the Divine Kingdom.
Where does protein come from?
Animal husbandry inside the Divine Kingdom.
How are houses built?
Built inside the Divine Kingdom.
With the development of the Divine Kingdom, all the needs of people in real society were met.
Those ‘blessings’ of 996 from the ancient times in textbooks could no longer be seen.
Everyone only needed to do one thing well, and that was to exhaust all methods to develop the Divine Kingdom.
“I hope I can also awaken a talent so that the pressure on my Family can be much less.” Yang Fan prayed secretly.

“Class 1, Grade 12, Luo Bing, Divine Kingdom area of 500,000 square kilometers, B-rank Ice Spirit Root Talent, possessing the special building Ice God Temple, B-rank Ice Snow Lotus Spirit Plant, comprehensive evaluation A-.”
Looking at the light screen, the crowd below was silent for a moment, followed by an uproar.
“As expected of the proud daughter of heaven of the Luo Family, she actually received an A- evaluation. This should be enough for a recommendation to a key first-tier university.”

“Nonsense, this is the Ice Spirit Root Talent! With this talent, the descendants of believers in the Divine Kingdom have a huge possibility of Awakening the Ice Spirit Root. You can blindly choose the Cultivation direction; as long as you purchase ice-attribute Cultivation Techniques, the development of the Divine Kingdom will definitely be smooth sailing.”
“Dragons give birth to dragons, phoenixes give birth to phoenixes. As expected of a great Family with a Tier 3 God, the descendants’ talents are truly good.”

The teacher performing the Awakening for the students on stage also nodded with satisfaction: “Not bad. It seems the Luo Family places great hopes on you, actually helping you purchase buildings and Spirit Plants in advance. Once the Ministry of Education distributes resources, you can buy more Breeding Cards.”
“Thank you for your guidance, Teacher.” Luo Bing said in a cool tone.
“Class 5, Third Year of High School, Feng Yu, Divine Kingdom area of 10,000 square kilometers, no talent, comprehensive evaluation F-.”
“Class 2, Third Year of High School...”

“Class 1, Grade 12, Li Tianheng, Divine Kingdom area of 400,000 square kilometers, C-rank Mad Blood Talent, possessing the special building Fountain of Life, B-rank Blood Soul Mushroom Spirit Plant, comprehensive evaluation B.”
With Luo Bing’s exceptional display serving as a precedent, upon seeing geniuses like Li Tianheng, the spectators off the stage didn’t react quite as strongly as just now.
“People from great families really have it good. With people nurturing them in advance, the Ministry of Education’s first evaluation was raised by one rank.”
“It’s unfair! How can they operate like this?”
“Stop complaining. Others have worked hard for so many generations; you can’t compare.”
“Class 7, Grade 12, Zhang Pang, Divine Kingdom area of 70,000 square kilometers, F-rank Planting Talent, comprehensive evaluation F+.”
As Zhang Pang returned to his original position with a somewhat conflicted expression: “Brother Yang, why am I also a Planting Talent? Is our Family’s destiny really just farming?”
“Stop acting like you’ve won and still complaining. As long as you have a talent, there’s a high probability you can enter the key class for the mid-term exam.” Yang Fan complained.
“It’s just F-rank, so I can only take the logistics route. In the future, I’m afraid I’ll have to be an assistant to that old man in my Family.” Zhang Pang sighed softly.
Soon the Awakening reached Yang Fan.
Coming onto the stage and looking at the huge transparent crystal in front of him, Yang Fan couldn’t help feeling nervous.
“Empty your mind and place your hand on the Awakening Stone.” The teacher said softly.
Hearing this voice, Yang Fan only felt his mind clear up for a moment, and subconsciously reached out his right hand.
“Is this the power of a god?” A thought flashed through Yang Fan’s mind.
One must know that the teachers capable of helping high school students awaken had a strength of at least a First-Order God.
The moment Yang Fan’s right hand touched the Awakening Stone, his consciousness seemed to be sucked into a Void Realm.
Time seemed to have passed in an instant, and yet it also seemed like hundreds or thousands of years.
At this moment, Yang Fan only felt that he had established a connection with a distant starry sky.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: 1 million square kilometers”
“Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (all resources within the Divine Kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)”
“SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique Talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden.)”
Just for an instant, Yang Fan woke up.
At this moment, the playground was extremely quiet, and everyone looked at the light screen in a daze.
“Class 7, Grade 12, Yang Fan, Divine Kingdom area of 1 million square kilometers, F-rank Resource Talent, comprehensive evaluation C-.” The teacher announced with a strange look on his face.
“Damn, what’s going on? One million square kilometers, and it’s actually an F-rank Talent? Are you kidding me?!”
“Isn’t it usually the case that the larger the Divine Kingdom area, the better the talent?”
“That’s right, and it’s even that all-purpose talent of resource growth acceleration. It’s too outrageous.”
“From Class 7, Grade 12? Aren’t the students in this class descendants of Divine Beings?”
“That data of 1 million square kilometers seems to be the upper limit for initial Awakening.”
Everyone off the stage was dumbfounded.
Even Luo Bing, who had the best talent, cast a hint of curiosity toward Yang Fan at this moment.

“Quiet. Anything is possible in Divine Kingdom Awakening. Throughout history, there is no lack of deities whose initial Divine Kingdom area was huge, but whose talent potential was limited.” The teacher on stage spoke in a soft tone, their voice seeming to have magic, making everyone quiet down instantly.
Yang Fan lowered his head and walked back to his own position.
SSS-rank Talent!
At this moment, monstrous waves had already churned up in Yang Fan’s heart, but he didn’t dare show the slightest bit of abnormality.

“Old Yang, you’re awesome! One million square kilometers, your initial resources exceed mine by a dozen times. Since your Divine Kingdom area is so big, I’ll send believers to your place to reclaim wasteland and farm later, and we can split the profits fifty-fifty.” Zhang Pang said, resting his arm on Yang Fan’s shoulder.
“Easy to talk about.” Yang Fan squeezed out a natural smile.
An innocent man is guilty only of possessing a treasure.
The methods of deities were bizarre and varied.
Yang Fan had heard from the news that some deities invaded other people’s Divine Kingdoms to seize resources, and even enslaved deities.
“No matter what, I must not expose even a fraction of it.” Yang Fan made a secret decision.
The test ended quickly.
The testing teacher waved his right hand, and the Awakening Stone disappeared into his cuff.

“Before the College Entrance Examination arrives, your remaining time is completely free. You can go home to discuss future development with your elders, and the Ministry of Education will also issue you a development direction proposal best suited for your Divine Kingdom.”

“I know many of you hope your believers can go to the battlefield and take the path of a warlike Divine Kingdom, but what I want to say is that only what suits you best can allow you to go further. Becoming logistics personnel is not shameful; although the treatment is slightly worse, you live longer.”
“The development direction of the Divine Kingdom is extremely important. For most of you, just follow the direction given by the Ministry of Education’s Intelligent Life, and don’t be overly clever.”

chapters.title: Chapter 2: C-rank Building Moon Well
paragraphs: As the words faded, the teacher vanished directly.
“Are these the means of a deity? It would be great if I could have this ability one day.”
“Stop dreaming. Without good talents and resources, we will probably be Divine Beings our whole lives, unable to even achieve a Breakthrough to demigods, let alone true deities.”

“Let us go. Although I do not have much talent, the area of my Divine Kingdom is alright. When the time comes, I can have my dad raise cattle and sheep in my Divine Kingdom, and our family conditions will get better.”
Yang Fan did not join the surrounding discussions.
After greeting Zhang Pang, he quickly left the school and took a vehicle home.
“Please lie down properly in the safety cabin. The nuclear-powered bus is about to start, with a maximum speed of 800 kilometers per hour.”
Yang Fan lived in Mingyue Community in the southernmost part of Yang County, which was a full three hundred kilometers away from Yang County No.
1 Middle School.
This nuclear-powered bus was produced from the Divine Kingdom of a certain Mechanical deity.
Although it was a discarded product from the city, its cost-performance ratio was extremely high for a poor family like that of Yang Fan.
“Arrived at Mingyue Community station. Fare: 100 Faith Points.”
After getting off the bus, Yang Fan quickly went upstairs and returned home.
The father of Yang Fan was named Yang Tiexin, who possessed the F-rank talent excavation, and his mother Sun Rong happened to have a miniature vein in her Divine Kingdom.
Thus, the two hit it off immediately and started living together, and later on, Yang Fan was born.
At this moment, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong were sitting cross-legged in the living room.
Blank cards were placed in front of the two of them; they picked them up, put them down, and then handed them to each other.
Yang Fan was long used to this.
This was the work of his parents.
The father would let his believers with the excavation talent work in the Divine Kingdom of the mother, then store the rare Ore into blank cards, and finally sell them online.
It could be said that the reason Yang Fan could grow up so big and even attend Yang County No.
1 Middle School was entirely due to that miniature vein in his mother’s Divine Kingdom.

“Faner is back. There are fresh steaks and salad in the fridge. Wait until your father and I finish digging out today’s vein output, and then we will talk to you about the matter of Awakening,” said Sun Rong.
Yang Fan nodded, showing understanding.
Their family lived a very tight life.
The tuition fees, living expenses, rent for Mingyue Community, and various taxes of Yang Fan meant that they could not save any Faith Points at all by the end of every month.
It would not be a problem to say that their family had always been living on the execution line, so the most important task every day was to dig out all the vein outputs.
Yang Fan came to the dining table, opened his smart wristwatch, and saw an eye-catching email from the Ministry of Education.
“Student Yang Fan, initial Divine Kingdom area of one million square kilometers, F-rank Resource Talent.”
The Ministry of Education suggests taking the logistics resource transit route.

The reasons are as follows: The Divine Kingdom’s area is large enough, making it suitable as a warehouse, and it possesses F-rank Resource Talent, with resources having a certain value-appreciation and preservation effect.
The training direction for believers should primarily focus on lifestyle directions such as Planting, breeding, mining, hunting, herb gathering, etc.
For the development in the Early Stage of the Divine Kingdom, it is recommended to purchase a Breeding Card.
The Divine Kingdom area is too large, and the initial population is severely insufficient.
Due to the student obtaining a C- grade, the Ministry of Education rewards 100,000 Faith Points.
(Remarks: These Faith Points are tagged and can only be used to develop one’s own Divine Kingdom; they cannot be used for paying taxes, entertainment, and other directions.)
Reward: A random C-grade building card (Remarks: Cannot be sold).
Yang Fan glanced and clicked on the attachment collection at the bottom right corner with his eyes, instantly feeling a strange energy appear in his Divine Kingdom.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources within the Divine Kingdom have their growth accelerated by 10%)
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique Talent, can accelerate the Evolution of the Divine Kingdom)
Faith Points: 100,000
Building: C-grade Building Card (Unused state)”
“As expected of an Awakening reward that only happens once in a lifetime, it is indeed generous,” Yang Fan sighed.
Relying on the miniature vein of his mother Sun Rong, the monthly income of their family was only over 3,000, while this time the Ministry of Education directly rewarded 100,000 Faith Points.
Such a huge amount of wealth naturally tempted people in the past, and there had even been cases of crazily making babies, and after getting this reward, directly severing father-son relationships.
Therefore, the Ministry of Education came out with new regulations stating that the issued rewards could only be used to develop the student’s own Divine Kingdom.
“Faner, during the Divine Kingdom Awakening, did you have any talent?”
I do not know when, but Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong had already finished today’s work and sat down beside Yang Fan.
“F-rank Resource Talent,” Yang Fan said.

“Is that so? It is not bad either. It is considered a jack-of-all-trades talent. In the future, the development of your Divine Kingdom will be much faster than ordinary people, and there are many ways to earn Faith Points.” Yang Tiexin nodded, showing a look of satisfaction.

Sun Rong picked up a steak, placed it in front of Yang Fan, and continued, “Good news, the pressure on our family will be much less in the future. Faner, what did the Ministry of Education reward for the F-rank evaluation today?”
“I do not know.”
“What, could it be that your jack-of-all-trades talent can even obtain an E-rank evaluation?” Yang Tiexin laughed.
“I am C-rank.”
“Pfft—” Yang Tiexin directly spat out the freshly squeezed juice in his mouth and coughed violently.
“You brat, do not brag in front of your old man. C-rank evaluation? Take a look at what kind of family we have. Could a Genius like this be born from my and your mother’s genes?”
“I am serious,” Yang Fan said with a serious expression.
Looking at the expression of their son, the expressions of Yang Tiexin and the other finally turned serious.
They knew very well that their boy was not someone who talked big.
“Could it be that you have dual talents?” said Sun Rong.
“Not really, but my Divine Kingdom has one million square kilometers,” Yang Fan said.
The existence of an SSS-rank Talent was far too important.
Even to his biological parents, Yang Fan was unwilling to mention it.
It was not a lack of trust, but rather to reduce risks.
“One million square kilometers, are you for real!”
Yang Fan did not explain further and directly forwarded the document from the Ministry of Education to his parents.

“Good heavens, how many Divine Kingdom Expansion Cards does this save, plus so many rewards? It is probably enough to match the net income of our family for three or four years.” Yang Tiexin swallowed hard.

Yang Tiexin stood up excitedly and patted Yang Fan’s shoulder, saying, “Hurry up and use the C-grade Building Card! If you can roll a small vein, I will take out a loan to buy a Breeding Card, and our family can move out of Mingyue Community.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan moved a thought and used that C-grade Building Card.
As the consciousness of Yang Fan entered the Divine Kingdom, he found that a crescent-shaped pool of water had appeared in the center of the Divine Kingdom.
“Moon Well: Produces a drop of Moon Dew every ten years.”
“Moon Dew: Possesses weak detoxifying efficacy, weak healing efficacy, and weak body-strengthening efficacy. Long-term consumption can change one’s Physique.”
“How is it? Could you open a resource-type building?” Yang Tiexin and the other asked hopefully in reality.
“It is a Moon Well,” Yang Fan said.
Having studied the basic knowledge of Divine Kingdoms for so many years, he naturally knew about this building.
“It is a pity it is not a mineral vein, otherwise our family could have upgraded our equipment,” Yang Tiexin sighed.

Sun Rong rolled her eyes and said, “Do not be ungrateful. The market price of a Moon Well is about 300,000 Faith Points. For a family like ours, we will probably only have this single opportunity during our initial Awakening to obtain it in our lifetime.”
Moreover, the output of the Moon Well is stable.
One day in reality equals one year in the Divine Kingdom.
It only takes 10 days to get a drop of Moon Dew, which is worth 1,000 Faith Points.

“With this Moon Well, even if Faner does not do anything, he will be among the people with a monthly income of 3,000. In the future, even if he does nothing and chooses to lie flat, it will at least be enough for his livelihood.”

“Your mother is right. The reward from the Ministry of Education only happens once in a lifetime. Fortunately, it did not roll out any consumable or combat-type buildings; because the law dictates they cannot be sold, that would truly be a pitfall.”
“Dad, Mom, with this income, the life of the family can be much easier. Do not excessively exploit the believers either; it is bad for your health,” Yang Fan said with a serious expression.

I do not know when, but Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong had already finished today’s work and sat down beside Yang Fan.
“F-rank Resource Talent,” Yang Fan said.
“Is that so?
It is not bad either.
It is considered a jack-of-all-trades talent.
In the future, the development of your Divine Kingdom will be much faster than ordinary people, and there are many ways to earn Faith Points.” Yang Tiexin nodded, showing a look of satisfaction.
Sun Rong picked up a steak, placed it in front of Yang Fan, and continued, “Good news, the pressure on our family will be much less in the future.
Faner, what did the Ministry of Education reward for the F-rank evaluation today?”
“I do not know.”
“What, could it be that your jack-of-all-trades talent can even obtain an E-rank evaluation?” Yang Tiexin laughed.
“I am C-rank.”
“Pfft—” Yang Tiexin directly spat out the freshly squeezed juice in his mouth and coughed violently.
“You brat, do not brag in front of your old man.
C-rank evaluation?
Take a look at what kind of family we have.
Could a Genius like this be born from my and your mother’s genes?”
“I am serious,” Yang Fan said with a serious expression.
Looking at the expression of their son, the expressions of Yang Tiexin and the other finally turned serious.
They knew very well that their boy was not someone who talked big.
“Could it be that you have dual talents?” said Sun Rong.
“Not really, but my Divine Kingdom has one million square kilometers,” Yang Fan said.
The existence of an SSS-rank Talent was far too important.
Even to his biological parents, Yang Fan was unwilling to mention it.
It was not a lack of trust, but rather to reduce risks.
“One million square kilometers, are you for real!”
Yang Fan did not explain further and directly forwarded the document from the Ministry of Education to his parents.
“Good heavens, how many Divine Kingdom Expansion Cards does this save, plus so many rewards?
It is probably enough to match the net income of our family for three or four years.” Yang Tiexin swallowed hard.
Yang Tiexin stood up excitedly and patted Yang Fan’s shoulder, saying, “Hurry up and use the C-grade Building Card!
If you can roll a small vein, I will take out a loan to buy a Breeding Card, and our family can move out of Mingyue Community.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan moved a thought and used that C-grade Building Card.
As the consciousness of Yang Fan entered the Divine Kingdom, he found that a crescent-shaped pool of water had appeared in the center of the Divine Kingdom.
“Moon Well: Produces a drop of Moon Dew every ten years.”
“Moon Dew: Possesses weak detoxifying efficacy, weak healing efficacy, and weak body-strengthening efficacy.
Long-term consumption can change one’s Physique.”
“How is it?
Could you open a resource-type building?” Yang Tiexin and the other asked hopefully in reality.
“It is a Moon Well,” Yang Fan said.
Having studied the basic knowledge of Divine Kingdoms for so many years, he naturally knew about this building.
“It is a pity it is not a mineral vein, otherwise our family could have upgraded our equipment,” Yang Tiexin sighed.
Sun Rong rolled her eyes and said, “Do not be ungrateful.
The market price of a Moon Well is about 300,000 Faith Points.
For a family like ours, we will probably only have this single opportunity during our initial Awakening to obtain it in our lifetime.”
Moreover, the output of the Moon Well is stable.
One day in reality equals one year in the Divine Kingdom.
It only takes 10 days to get a drop of Moon Dew, which is worth 1,000 Faith Points.
“With this Moon Well, even if Faner does not do anything, he will be among the people with a monthly income of 3,000.
In the future, even if he does nothing and chooses to lie flat, it will at least be enough for his livelihood.”
“Your mother is right.
The reward from the Ministry of Education only happens once in a lifetime.
Fortunately, it did not roll out any consumable or combat-type buildings; because the law dictates they cannot be sold, that would truly be a pitfall.”
“Dad, Mom, with this income, the life of the family can be much easier.
Do not excessively exploit the believers either; it is bad for your health,” Yang Fan said with a serious expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Federal Body Refinement Technique
paragraphs: In this era of universal deities, human lifespans have greatly increased; even the weakest Divine Being can live for around five hundred years.
Upon reaching demigod status, the minimum lifespan is a thousand years.
As for the lifespans of true gods, they are not something Yang Fan can understand at present.

The development of a Divine Kingdom is not only related to the amount of resources acquired; what is truly important is that the Divine Kingdom is linked to each deity’s spirit, physical body, and even Soul.

When the overall strength of the Divine Kingdom increases, a certain proportion of it will feed back into reality, which is why that teacher during the Awakening was able to display such miraculous methods.
If the Divine Kingdom is damaged or the believers become weak, it usually causes the deity to be listless, physically weakened, or even suffer sudden death.

“Got it, you brat don’t need to worry. Your mother and I are still young. The development of a Divine Kingdom is a bottomless pit in itself. We don’t have much ability; to say nothing of helping you much, we certainly won’t hold you back.” Yang Tiexin laughed heartily.
“I just finished Awakening, so I’ll head back to my room first,” Yang Fan said helplessly.
Before having the ability, no matter how much is said, parents won’t believe it.
Right now, the most important thing is to research his SSS-rank Talent.
Returning to his room, Yang Fan sat cross-legged at the head of the bed, his consciousness entering the Divine Kingdom.
Mountains, rivers, deep valleys, verdant vegetation, and towering ancient trees.
The entire Divine Kingdom was filled with a sense of vitality.
Yang Fan had a feeling that he only needed a single thought to change the mountains and topography here.
Soon, Yang Fan’s gaze saw humans constantly kowtowing around the Moon Well.
A total of two hundred people, all of them scantily clad—regardless of gender, they knelt bare on the ground, kowtowing devoutly.
“Believers: Barbarians / Quantity: 200 / Daily Faith Points provided: 0.0001.”
Yang Fan was not surprised by the number of 200 believers; he had already learned the corresponding knowledge in high school theoretical classes.
In the initial state of a Divine Kingdom, believers are mostly only a hundred people.
That he could have more than double the population might be related to his Divine Kingdom’s area reaching the upper limit.
Yang Fan was not complacent about this at all.
For a Divine Kingdom, the number of believers is the easiest thing to obtain.
Investing Breeding Cards, spending Faith Points to lower Divine Decrees allowing believers to breed, or even directly purchasing population from high-Rank Divine Kingdoms.
For those wealthy children who do not lack Faith Points, they wouldn’t worry about the number of believers at all.
The quality of believers far outweighs quantity.
Just like these lowest-Rank Barbarians, even if there were millions or tens of millions of them, the Faith Points provided daily probably wouldn’t compare to a single Tier-1 life form.
“What on earth is the Evolution Talent?” Yang Fan looked at that exceptionally eye-catching SSS-rank Talent, a thoughtful expression on his face.
The Divine Kingdom seemed to perceive its deity’s thoughts, and a short piece of information appeared in Yang Fan’s mind.
“Consume Faith Points to accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution. With the current Divine Kingdom strength, ten-fold Evolution can be activated, consuming 1000 Faith Points daily.”
With the 100,000 Faith Points rewarded by the Ministry of Education, Yang Fan did not hesitate and instantly activated Evolution.
From Yang Fan’s perspective, the time flow of the Divine Kingdom instantly accelerated tenfold, and the believers began to get busy.
The males hunted, the females gathered fruits and vegetables, and at night they randomly mated to reproduce.
Returning to reality, only two hours had passed before Yang Fan entered the Divine Kingdom again and found that the surroundings of the Moon Well had completely changed.
An open space was cordoned off around the Moon Well, and scavenged wood was piled up in a full circle around it, with a simple thatched hut built inside.
One day in reality was one year in the Divine Kingdom.
Under the tenfold accelerated Evolution, it had already begun to take the shape of a tribe.
What concerned Yang Fan the most was the Moon Dew; quite a bit had already condensed.

“A single drop of Moon Dew is worth 1000 Faith Points. Right now, relying solely on a C-Rank building, the Moon Well, can make up for the Evolution consumption. If I had more resource buildings, wouldn’t I make a fortune?” Yang Fan’s eyes lit up; only now did he finally understand the terrifying nature of this SSS-rank Talent.
Ten times the resource acquisition of others—the further development proceeds, the more terrifying the advantage will be.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the palpitation in his heart.
Now that he had figured out the function of the Evolution Talent, the next step was to develop the Divine Kingdom with all his might.
Yang Fan gently tapped his wrist watch with his hand, and a light blue light screen appeared before his eyes.

“Senior high school student of Yang County No. 1 Middle School, Divine Being, identity as a Federal ordinary citizen. Please select a section: News, Chat, Shopping, Entertainment, Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, God Forum...”
Yang Fan lightly tapped the shopping section, and a dazzling array of items instantly surfaced before his eyes.
“Ten thousand unranked antelopes, worth 100 Faith Points.
Provided by Aimian Company, quarantine passed, antelopes are healthy without any infection, buyers bear the data transmission fee themselves, purchasing 100,000 at once waives the transmission fee...
10 tons of ordinary iron Ore, worth 500 Faith Points...
One F-Rank Breeding Card, worth 5000 Faith Points, can guarantee a 50% Breeding bonus within the Divine Kingdom for 10 years, and increase the survival rate of newborn babies by 30%...
1000 ordinary peach trees, worth 100 Faith Points, have ornamental value, excellent varieties, yielding abundant fruit every year, can help believers fill their stomachs...
F-Rank Spiritual Frost Mushrooms × 1000, worth 20,000 Faith Points.
A large amount of information appeared before Yang Fan’s eyes, making him feel dizzy just looking at it.
“After Awakening the Divine Kingdom, the shopping interface has actually become so rich. I still need to do some filtering,” Yang Fan muttered.
“Help me filter out the supplies most needed for my current Divine Kingdom development.”
“Citizen Yang Fan, just awakened the Divine Kingdom, possesses F-Rank talent resources, and the Divine Kingdom’s initial area is 1 million square kilometers.
The Ministry of Education rewards 100,000 Faith Points.
According to big data calculations, the following products are most suitable:
F-Rank Breeding Card: Sufficient resources in the Early Stage of the Divine Kingdom, population needs to be vigorously developed.
Planting technology manual, Elementary herb-gathering knowledge, Elementary hunting skills, basic architecture, 100,000 kilograms of fertile soil...
Citizen Yang Fan is very suitable for logistics personnel; you can choose 1 to 2 directions from the above to develop.
Federal Body Refinement Technique: Strongly recommended to purchase, has Federal preferential policies, extremely high cost-effectiveness.
Please provide a more specific development direction, Citizen Yang Fan, and I can give more specific suggestions.”
With the advent of the deity era, technology is changing with each passing day.
Even ordinary citizens like Yang Fan can enjoy the services of Intelligent Life, searching out the most useful things for themselves from massive amounts of information.
“The Evolution Talent is hidden, and this Federal Intelligent Life actually suggests that I take the logistics route,” Yang Fan gave a wry smile.
Divine Kingdom development directions like Planting, mining, and animal husbandry, even if pushed to the extreme, would only result in being a wealthy old man.
In the end, they would just be doing chores for those Divine Kingdoms with combat capabilities and seeking their protection.
It can be said that life-class deities are generally vassals of combat-class deities.
If the SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution weren’t present, to make life at home easier, Yang Fan would probably have chosen the Ministry of Education’s suggestion as well.
Yang Fan gently tapped the Federal Body Refinement Technique with his right hand, opening its detailed introduction.

“Federal Body Refinement Technique, jointly created by higher-tier deities, has significant bonus effects such as body strengthening and strength enhancement. Long-term Cultivate can change the Aptitude of believers to a certain extent, and it can be inherited by offspring. This method is subsidized by the Federal Government, with an original price of 1,000,000 Faith Points, a 50% discount for social figures, and a 5% discount for students. Remarks: The Federal Body Refinement Technique will greatly improve the foundation of believers, and it encompasses all rivers. Whether choosing Martial Arts, immortal cultivation, or even Mechanical Ascension in the future, there are many benefits. Even if choosing logistics, it can greatly improve the work efficiency of believers. It is strongly recommended for students to purchase. And Cultivating the Federal Body Refinement Technique requires consuming a large amount of meat, so pay attention to supplementing resources to avoid destroying the Divine Kingdom’s ecosystem.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4: A Shopping Spree
paragraphs: Looking at the description of the Federal Body Refinement Technique, Yang Fan couldn’t help but say, “No wonder the teacher once said that after awakening a Divine Kingdom, one should buy a copy of the Federal Body Refinement Technique even if they have to take out a loan. I didn’t expect it could actually change a believer’s aptitude.”
Yang Fan’s performance in high school theory classes was quite good, so he naturally understood how precious something that could alter aptitude and be passed down to the next generation was.
At a 95% discount, it only cost 50,000 Faith Points.
Yang Fan clicked purchase without hesitation.
“Help me search for organisms that can provide a large amount of meat and have a strong Breeding capacity,” Yang Fan said softly.
Currently, his Divine Kingdom only had a few scattered antelopes, rabbits, and tigers—all unranked wild beasts.
Under the current circumstances, they could maintain ecological balance, but if the believers began practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, it probably wouldn’t be enough.
With his Evolution Talent, time passed too quickly within the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan couldn’t keep his eyes on Resource Cards all the time; maintaining a self-sufficient ecological balance was the best choice.
“Searching:
Option 1: 10,000 Red-Eyed Rabbits, ordinary wild beasts, value: 10 Faith Points.
Pros: extremely strong Breeding capacity, herbivorous, no offensive capabilities.
Cons: reproduction is too rapid and easily disrupts the ecology; requires a Divine Decree for believers to cull them regularly to maintain a reasonable number.
Option 2: 10,000 Western Cattle, ordinary wild beasts, value: 200 Faith Points.
Pros: delicious meat, herbivorous, docile temperament.
However, Western Cattle do not like to gather in herds and have no fixed habitat, making hunting efficiency lower.
Option 3: 1,000 Bodhi Precious Snakes, Rank 1 Demonic Beasts, value: 5,000 Faith Points.
Pros: flesh and blood are highly nutritious, very suitable for Federal Body Refinement Technique cultivation.

Cons: average Breeding capacity; if no Divine Decree is issued to restrict hunting, they are easily driven to extinction, and they pose a certain level of danger during the early stages of Divine Kingdom development.
Option 4: 100 Deep Sea Magic Wolves, Rank 2 Demonic Beasts, value: 50,000 Faith Points...
Option 5...”
The Intelligent Life provided over a hundred options, but Yang Fan quickly selected the Bodhi Precious Snake.
Although the Bodhi Precious Snake’s Breeding capacity was weak, he currently had few believers—only 200.
When releasing these 1,000 snakes into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan didn’t even dare to place them too close to the Moon Well to avoid harming the believers.
In the short term, there was no need to worry about them being hunted to extinction.
Once the believers had mastered the basics of the Federal Body Refinement Technique in the future, he could then issue a Divine Decree.
Yang Fan browsed the mall for a while longer, spending 10 Faith Points to buy 10 stone houses.
He spent another 1,000 Faith Points on 100,000 antelopes and picked up some of the cheapest Construction Books, basic tool usage, basic weaving, basic Planting, and basic gathering skills.
In any case, Yang Fan bought whatever was cheap.
With his Evolution Talent, as long as the believers got started, they would naturally summarize their experiences and learn to progress.
There was no need to spend a large amount of Faith Points on high-level skills.
Even if Yang Fan didn’t buy these basic skills, the believers in the Divine Kingdom would eventually figure them out over time.
However, he currently couldn’t bear to look at these scantily clad believers, so he chose to push the progress along slightly.
Altogether, he spent 60,000 Faith Points.
Now, the resources awarded to him by the Ministry of Education were less than 40,000.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and continued, “Help me search for Spirit Plants that are in high demand on the market, easy to cultivate, but have long growth cycles, and are within my budget.”

“Scanning. Found two types of Spirit Plants. Wood Ganoderma seeds, 1,000 in total. Matures once every 100 years, can be harvested repeatedly, but must be planted near fertile soil and requires the roots of a century-old tree. Cost: 30,000 Faith Points. Requires believers to have Intermediate Cultivation Skills, and the century-old tree roots must be purchased. The cost for each sowing is 6,000 Faith Points. If cultivation is successful, at current market prices, 1,000 Wood Ganoderma are worth 11,000 Faith Points. The three-month return on investment is 16.34%.”
“Cultivation is too complex, and the initial investment is too high. Give me the second option.” Yang Fan shook his head directly.

“water lotus x 1,000, F-rank Spirit Plant, value: 20,000 Faith Points. Maturity period is between 100 to 300 years, can be harvested repeatedly. 1,000 Water Lotus Seeds are worth 2,000 Faith Points. Annualized return fluctuates between 10% to 30%. The maturity time for water lotus is too long. As a high school senior who has just awakened a Divine Kingdom, this Intelligent Life does not recommend large-scale cultivation of water lotus as an investment. Please keep this in mind.”
As Yang Fan looked at the description of the water lotus, his eyes brightened considerably.
Aside from the long growth cycle, the water lotus had almost no drawbacks, and it perfectly complemented his Evolution Talent.
Unlike others, he could harvest 2,000 Faith Points in a month at most, and his investment would double in less than a year.
It was absolute profiteering.

“The river area in the Divine Kingdom is quite large; perhaps I can plant them on a large scale. It’s just a pity that the initial investment cost is still too high,” Yang Fan sighed inwardly, then clicked purchase.
20,000 Faith Points was not a small sum.
For his family, it would probably take half a year of saving without eating or drinking.
If not for the Ministry of Education’s reward, Yang Fan likely wouldn’t have been qualified to make this investment.

“Federal Government law stipulates that as long as one does not actively invade another’s Divine Kingdom during school, a student’s Divine Kingdom is protected by law. I have one year of high school left, plus four years of university. I have plenty of time to develop.”

“Use the Evolution Talent to make various Divine Kingdom investments, then use the earned Faith Points to strengthen the believers’ power, and finally push for demigod or even godhood,” Yang Fan planned.

While Yang Fan was thinking, the mechanical synthesized voice of the Intelligent Life came from his watch: “According to the law, the Faith Points currently spent by citizen Yang Fan come from rewards issued by the Ministry of Education. All purchased items must be placed into your own Divine Kingdom for use and cannot be resold or gifted to others. Once discovered, you will face criminal liability. Do you wish to sign the informed consent form?”
“Sign.” Yang Fan wrote his name on the light screen with his finger.
“Purchase successful. Bird Data Same-City Express is at your service. Various Resource Cards will be placed in your inbox within 30 minutes. Please collect them promptly.”
Less than five minutes after placing the order, Yang Fan found dozens of new messages in his inbox.
With a one-click collection, the items in the inbox transformed into streaks of pale blue data, manifesting into reality in the palm of Yang Fan’s hand.

“Is this the method of a high-level god? It’s truly impressive. With the Evolution Talent, perhaps one day I’ll be able to reach that level as well,” Yang Fan remarked with some emotion as he looked at the cards in his hand.
In this day and age, people basically never left their homes.
One could attend classes at home and work at home.
As long as one had Faith Points, one could even enjoy various forms of entertainment at home by projecting their consciousness into another Virtual World.
And virtual items could likewise be manifested into reality through Blank Cards.
This exponential growth in efficiency was all thanks to the emergence of Divine Kingdoms.
Yang Fan projected his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom and first placed the Bodhi Precious Snakes at a location 100 kilometers away from the Moon Well.
Then came those 100,000 antelopes.
50,000 of them were placed on the east and west sides of the Moon Well, while the other 50,000 were placed around the Bodhi Precious Snakes.
The Bodhi Precious Snakes also needed to eat, and these antelopes were the food Yang Fan had prepared for them.
The antelopes themselves also had a certain Breeding capacity.
Primarily, the current base number was large enough that even though they were at the bottom of the food chain, they should be able to reproduce normally.
Next was the water lotus.
Yang Fan placed them in a large river closest to the tribe.
Once they matured, they would still require the believers to harvest them.

Option 5...”
The Intelligent Life provided over a hundred options, but Yang Fan quickly selected the Bodhi Precious Snake.
Although the Bodhi Precious Snake’s Breeding capacity was weak, he currently had few believers—only 200.
When releasing these 1,000 snakes into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan didn’t even dare to place them too close to the Moon Well to avoid harming the believers.
In the short term, there was no need to worry about them being hunted to extinction.
Once the believers had mastered the basics of the Federal Body Refinement Technique in the future, he could then issue a Divine Decree.
Yang Fan browsed the mall for a while longer, spending 10 Faith Points to buy 10 stone houses.
He spent another 1,000 Faith Points on 100,000 antelopes and picked up some of the cheapest Construction Books, basic tool usage, basic weaving, basic Planting, and basic gathering skills.
In any case, Yang Fan bought whatever was cheap.
With his Evolution Talent, as long as the believers got started, they would naturally summarize their experiences and learn to progress.
There was no need to spend a large amount of Faith Points on high-level skills.
Even if Yang Fan didn’t buy these basic skills, the believers in the Divine Kingdom would eventually figure them out over time.
However, he currently couldn’t bear to look at these scantily clad believers, so he chose to push the progress along slightly.
Altogether, he spent 60,000 Faith Points.
Now, the resources awarded to him by the Ministry of Education were less than 40,000.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and continued, “Help me search for Spirit Plants that are in high demand on the market, easy to cultivate, but have long growth cycles, and are within my budget.”
“Scanning.
Found two types of Spirit Plants.
Wood Ganoderma seeds, 1,000 in total.
Matures once every 100 years, can be harvested repeatedly, but must be planted near fertile soil and requires the roots of a century-old tree.
Cost: 30,000 Faith Points.
Requires believers to have Intermediate Cultivation Skills, and the century-old tree roots must be purchased.
The cost for each sowing is 6,000 Faith Points.
If cultivation is successful, at current market prices, 1,000 Wood Ganoderma are worth 11,000 Faith Points.
The three-month return on investment is 16.34%.”
“Cultivation is too complex, and the initial investment is too high.
Give me the second option.” Yang Fan shook his head directly.
“water lotus x 1,000, F-rank Spirit Plant, value: 20,000 Faith Points.
Maturity period is between 100 to 300 years, can be harvested repeatedly.
1,000 Water Lotus Seeds are worth 2,000 Faith Points.
Annualized return fluctuates between 10% to 30%.
The maturity time for water lotus is too long.
As a high school senior who has just awakened a Divine Kingdom, this Intelligent Life does not recommend large-scale cultivation of water lotus as an investment.
Please keep this in mind.”
As Yang Fan looked at the description of the water lotus, his eyes brightened considerably.
Aside from the long growth cycle, the water lotus had almost no drawbacks, and it perfectly complemented his Evolution Talent.
Unlike others, he could harvest 2,000 Faith Points in a month at most, and his investment would double in less than a year.
It was absolute profiteering.
“The river area in the Divine Kingdom is quite large; perhaps I can plant them on a large scale.
It’s just a pity that the initial investment cost is still too high,” Yang Fan sighed inwardly, then clicked purchase.
20,000 Faith Points was not a small sum.
For his family, it would probably take half a year of saving without eating or drinking.
If not for the Ministry of Education’s reward, Yang Fan likely wouldn’t have been qualified to make this investment.
“Federal Government law stipulates that as long as one does not actively invade another’s Divine Kingdom during school, a student’s Divine Kingdom is protected by law.
I have one year of high school left, plus four years of university.
I have plenty of time to develop.”

“Use the Evolution Talent to make various Divine Kingdom investments, then use the earned Faith Points to strengthen the believers’ power, and finally push for demigod or even godhood,” Yang Fan planned.

While Yang Fan was thinking, the mechanical synthesized voice of the Intelligent Life came from his watch: “According to the law, the Faith Points currently spent by citizen Yang Fan come from rewards issued by the Ministry of Education.
All purchased items must be placed into your own Divine Kingdom for use and cannot be resold or gifted to others.
Once discovered, you will face criminal liability.
Do you wish to sign the informed consent form?”
“Sign.” Yang Fan wrote his name on the light screen with his finger.
“Purchase successful.
Bird Data Same-City Express is at your service.
Various Resource Cards will be placed in your inbox within 30 minutes.
Please collect them promptly.”
Less than five minutes after placing the order, Yang Fan found dozens of new messages in his inbox.
With a one-click collection, the items in the inbox transformed into streaks of pale blue data, manifesting into reality in the palm of Yang Fan’s hand.
“Is this the method of a high-level god?
It’s truly impressive.
With the Evolution Talent, perhaps one day I’ll be able to reach that level as well,” Yang Fan remarked with some emotion as he looked at the cards in his hand.
In this day and age, people basically never left their homes.
One could attend classes at home and work at home.
As long as one had Faith Points, one could even enjoy various forms of entertainment at home by projecting their consciousness into another Virtual World.
And virtual items could likewise be manifested into reality through Blank Cards.
This exponential growth in efficiency was all thanks to the emergence of Divine Kingdoms.
Yang Fan projected his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom and first placed the Bodhi Precious Snakes at a location 100 kilometers away from the Moon Well.
Then came those 100,000 antelopes.
50,000 of them were placed on the east and west sides of the Moon Well, while the other 50,000 were placed around the Bodhi Precious Snakes.
The Bodhi Precious Snakes also needed to eat, and these antelopes were the food Yang Fan had prepared for them.
The antelopes themselves also had a certain Breeding capacity.
Primarily, the current base number was large enough that even though they were at the bottom of the food chain, they should be able to reproduce normally.
Next was the water lotus.
Yang Fan placed them in a large river closest to the tribe.
Once they matured, they would still require the believers to harvest them.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Virtual World
paragraphs: After finishing all of this, Yang Fan mobilized his Faith Points to issue a Divine Decree.
At this moment, everyone around the Moon Well in the Divine Kingdom seemed to sense something in the netherworld, and simultaneously knelt on the ground.
“O God, we are your most devout believers. Please descend your Divine Decree, and we are willing to die for you.” All the believers shouted in unison.

Yang Fan’s voice came over, ethereal and sacred: “Your power is still not enough to bear My will. The Divine Kingdom today is merely in its initial Awakening realm, and all living beings are weak, making it difficult to shoulder heavy responsibilities. From today onwards, I shall bestow a cultivation method—the Federal Body Refinement Technique, along with various foundational skills. This is the foundation for your establishment, and also the door to higher levels. Only by diligent cultivation without slack can you undergo a transformation.”
“Many thanks, O God.”
A golden curtain of light descended from the sky, sinking into the center of each believer’s brow.
After receiving the Legacy, Yang Fan’s thoughts stirred slightly, and ten stone houses appeared on both sides of the Moon Well.
“This is the Moon Well.
You can establish a tribe with it to reduce disasters and illnesses.
Every 10 years, a drop of Moon Dew will be conceived in the well.
Without My Divine Decree, it must not be taken privately.
About 100 kilometers away from this place, there is a treasured land nurturing the Bodhi Precious Snake, which is a First-Order Yao Beast.
Once your Federal Body Refinement Technique achieves success, you can team up to hunt it.
This snake is immensely powerful, far beyond what you can touch right now.
Remember this.
On the other side, in the big river, I have placed the water lotus.
Its maturation period is about 100 to 300 years.
You must send people to inspect it at regular intervals, and if it matures, harvest it and put it into the warehouse.”
“We strictly obey the Divine Decree.” Everyone spoke in unison, their eyes devoid of any greed, holding only piety.
These believers were also humans and had worldly desires, but that was when interacting with other living beings in the Divine Kingdom.
Toward Yang Fan, this deity, they did not dare to overstep even a fraction; this seemed like a command carved deep within their Soul.
After explaining everything, the golden light of the Divine Decree slowly disappeared.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers”
“Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)”
“SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique Talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden.)”
“Believers: Barbarians (600)”
“Cultivation Method: Federal Body Refinement Technique”
“Faith Points: 17788 (Provides 0.0005 Faith Points daily)”
“Building: Moon Well (Produces a drop of Moon Dew every ten years)”
“Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X2210, First-Order Yao Beast), water lotus (X1000, F-rank Spirit Plant)”
Looking at the changes in his Divine Kingdom now, Yang Fan showed a look of satisfaction.
Next, he was not prepared to continue purchasing resources; after all, he still needed to save Faith Points to accelerate the Evolution of the Divine Kingdom.
Because of the Awakening, today was the first time in several months that Yang Fan stepped out of his house.
Feeling somewhat exhausted at this moment, he collapsed straight onto the bed and fell into a dream.
Sleeping until dawn, Yang Fan got up and only felt refreshed, his body seeming much sturdier.
Yang Fan had long anticipated this.
Under the Evolution of a tenfold time flow rate, one day in the outside world was ten years in the Divine Kingdom.
Coupled with the fact that it was now a period of rapid development for the Divine Kingdom, there were bound to be significant changes.

Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom and found that the tribal population had reached 600, a full three-fold increase, nearly half of which were infants and youths of seven or eight years old.
This was thanks to Yang Fan placing quite a few antelopes around the tribe, making food very abundant.
Coupled with the presence of the Moon Well, the mortality rate from illness had also decreased significantly.
In addition, due to cultivating the Federal Body Refinement Technique, both adults and children looked much sturdier and more energetic than before.

The Moon Well had also condensed a drop of Moon Dew, but at this moment Yang Fan was not prepared to sell it; the quantity was too small, and the listing network handling fee wear-and-tear was too high.
Besides that, the number of Bodhi Precious Snakes a hundred kilometers away had also doubled, but many were still only one meter long and were still underage baby snakes.
What shocked Yang Fan the most was the number of antelopes.
Under his perception, the antelopes had actually approached 500,000.
However, the surrounding vegetation was consumed rapidly, and many antelopes began to starve to death, which allowed the population to trend toward a dynamic equilibrium.
Yang Fan ignored this; when all was said and done, there were still not enough hunters.

As for the green vegetation, it would continue to grow, and the carcasses of the dead antelopes would further fertilize the land, bringing a hundred benefits to his Divine Kingdom with no harm at all.
The Divine Kingdom was thriving, and Yang Fan was confident that ordinary high school students with similar backgrounds to him definitely had not developed as well as he did.
Of course, he couldn’t compare to a Genius like Luo Bing.
The other party had a big Family supporting her behind the scenes, and those Advanced buildings were probably already deployed in her Divine Kingdom.
The gap in initial resources was too huge; even with the existence of the SSS-rank Talent, the gap between the two remained like a chasm.
The development of the Divine Kingdom took time, and one couldn’t become fat in a single bite.
At this time, Yang Fan had returned to reality.
“It’s almost time for class.” Yang Fan thought to himself, took a helmet out from under the bed, put it on his head, and instantly entered the Virtual World.
“My dad bought me a Breeding Card yesterday. When I woke up today, I found that the believers had increased by 30 people. The effect is really good.”
“Me too, but my initial population is a bit low, only 50 people.”

“What does population count for? As long as resources are sufficient, upon graduating from high school, the minimum is tens of thousands, or even millions of population. What’s truly important is how to make the believers stronger.”
“Speaking of this, I’m not sleepy anymore. My old man transferred 50,000 Faith Points to me yesterday and let me buy the Federal Body Refinement Technique.”
“Me too. My dad said this thing is definitely not a loss, and bought it for me at the very first moment.”
“Let me tell you, the Ministry of Education rewarded me with an E-rank building. Guess what it is...”
As soon as Yang Fan entered the school address in the Virtual World, he felt a bustling atmosphere.
After all, having just awakened to become a Divine Being yesterday, it was inevitable that everyone was so excited.
“Brother Yang, I’ve saved a seat for you.” Zhang Pang waved at Yang Fan from the third row.

Yang Fan had just sat down when Zhang Pang couldn’t help asking: “Brother Yang, you really stole the show yesterday with a C-rank evaluation. In the entire senior grade, apart from those big Family children, you are definitely in the top tier. Hurry up and tell your brother, what did the Ministry of Education reward you with?”
“100,000 Faith Points and a C-rank building.” Yang Fan did not hide it, or rather, there was no need to hide it.
“As expected, you probably purchased quite a few good things yesterday, right?” Zhang Pang was full of envy.
Given his Family conditions, he wouldn’t mind these 100,000 Faith Points, but this was still a considerable amount of funds.
“It’s alright.” Yang Fan smiled indifferently.
“What did the C-rank building yield?”
“A Moon Well.”
“Not bad, bro. You haven’t even graduated from high school yet, and you’re already making 3,000 Faith Points a month.” Zhang Pang gave a thumbs-up.
Everyone was naturally no stranger to a universal-type building like the Moon Well.
Even textbooks had once described how a low-tier deity built tens of thousands of Moon Wells in their Divine Kingdom as a long-term investment.
Just at this moment, a young woman with a graceful figure walked up to the podium.
This person was Li Qingying, the homeroom teacher of Class 7, Grade 12, and a First-Order God.
“Hello, Teacher Li.” All the students of Class 7, Grade 12 stood up and said in unison.
“Hello, students, please sit down.” Li Qingying waved her hand, and a blue light curtain behind her instantly formed a blackboard.
She then wrote down four large characters—Divine Being.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Classroom Divine Beings
paragraphs: “First, congratulations to all students for awakening your Divine Kingdoms yesterday and becoming Divine Beings. I want to specifically praise three people. Yang Fan received a C-grade evaluation, Li Shuhao received a C-grade evaluation, and Wang Zhenyu received a D-grade evaluation. Although the awakening of a Divine Kingdom has a certain degree of randomness, in this world, luck is also a form of strength. Teacher congratulates you all,” Li Qingying said while lightly clapping her hands.
All the students in Class 7, Grade 12 came from ordinary families.
With two C-grades and one D-grade in this awakening, Li Qingying was already very satisfied.
The rest of the students looked at Yang Fan and the other two, their faces also filled with envy.
This wasn’t because of the evaluation itself, but because of the Ministry of Education’s resource allocation that the evaluation represented.

Although the resources rewarded by the Ministry of Education could not be used for other daily expenses, at least they didn’t have to ask their families for investment, which was a disguised way of reducing the burden on their families.

“Since the dawn of the Age of Gods, human lifespan has increased significantly. You are still young; do not fall into the trap of temporary gains and losses and forget your original intentions,” Li Qingying changed the subject.
“We understand, Teacher.”
“Good, let’s start today’s lesson. What do you think a Divine Being is?” Li Qingying pointed to the four large characters on the blackboard.
“Aren’t we exactly that?”
“Gods who possess a Divine Kingdom?”
“Ordinary people who have undergone awakening are Divine Beings.”
The students below were chattering away, all eagerly answering.
Li Qingying gave a light chuckle and looked toward Yang Fan: “Student Yang, what do you think?”
“Ah?” Yang Fan was startled.
Although he always listened attentively in class, he never thought about answering questions.
Why did the teacher take the initiative to ask him today?
“Ahem, my thoughts are about the same as everyone else’s.” Yang Fan scratched his head and gave a silly laugh.
Seeing this scene, a trace of disappointment flashed in the depths of Li Qingying’s eyes.
“Is he just an ordinary student?” Li Qingying sighed inwardly.
Li Qingying then shifted her gaze to Li Shuhao and continued: “What does Student Li think?”

“The core of a Divine Being is not divinity, but the ‘creature’ part. After awakening, we have a Divine Kingdom, and the Divine Kingdom is like a sheepfold, while our believers are the penned-in lambs. Similarly, one can conclude that if one does not become a God, one remains a link in the biological chain. From a certain perspective, we are also lambs now, or a link in the biological chain,” Li Shuhao said his opinion in a flat tone.
As he finished speaking, many gazes turned toward him.
Some were curious, some surprised, some thoughtful, and some speechless.

Yang Fan looked at him, a different glint also flashing in his eyes: “This guy is somewhat interesting. It’s just a pity that even though he knows he’s a lamb, he has to act like a ‘thinking lamb.’ He’s not steady enough.”
Li Qingying’s eyes lit up: “Who did you hear that from?”
“In my spare time, I like to log into the school library to read books.”

“Very good, your insight is quite good. Although it’s a bit unpleasant to hear, the core idea is correct. So-called Divine Beings still haven’t escaped the scope of being human. Aside from your lifespan, your physical bodies are still fragile. You’ll starve to death if you don’t eat for ten days, die of thirst if you don’t drink water for three days, and a minor traffic accident could potentially end your life. Divine Beings are just slightly higher-level biological beings; they are still fragile. I know you’ve just awakened your Divine Kingdoms and are full of high spirits, but I regret to inform you of a statistic: ninety percent of the people in our class won’t even be able to break through to become a Demigod.” Li Qingying’s expression was incredibly serious.
The classroom was very quiet.
Many students looked unhappy.

After all, their parents weren’t Demigods either, just Divine Beings engaged in logistics work, and most of their parents’ expectations for them were to break through to become Demigods and change the family’s destiny.
“Teacher, how can one break through to become a Demigod?” a student raised their hand to ask.

“Work hard to develop your Divine Kingdom and make your believers strong enough. Of course, if you want a quantitative indicator, even if you do nothing every day, you should be able to obtain 1,000 Faith Pointss just from the faith of your believers.”
“Obtaining 1,000 Faith Pointss just through faith alone!” Many students’ mouths hung wide open, their eyes filled with disbelief.
1,000 a day means 30,000 a month.
You have to know that many people’s parents together can’t even earn 5,000 a month.
Moreover, this isn’t from selling Divine Kingdom resources, but the most basic acquisition of Faith Pointss.
“Don’t be surprised. Once you truly become a Demigod, perhaps you won’t even care about this bit of income.”

Yang Fan lowered his head, thinking secretly: “I still have to work hard to raise the life level of my believers. With the strength of the believers in my Divine Kingdom now, even if their population grows to a million, the Faith Pointss they could provide daily would probably only be in the single digits.”
This was also why a Divine Kingdom couldn’t make a God stronger through a ‘human wave’ tactic.
If the population grew without limit, the Divine Kingdom would eventually be unable to support them.
Soldiers should be elite, not just numerous.

“Students, I’m not trying to discourage you, but to let everyone recognize reality. To become a Demigod, you need to make your believers strong enough. I looked at everyone’s Divine Kingdom awakening reports yesterday; 70% of you have no talent, and of the rest who do have talents, most are lifestyle-type talents. Just imagine, if your believers spend most of their time on administrative tasks like mining, farming, and hunting, how can they become stronger?”
Hearing this, everyone looked troubled, and some students even began to look anxious.

“I know your difficulties. Everyone’s family conditions aren’t great, and after becoming Divine Beings, your first thought is to help reduce the burden on your families. However, as your teacher, what I want to say is that if you want to break through to become a Demigod, then from now on, you must try every possible way to work hard to improve the strength of your believers. Buy Resource Cards, Breeding Cards, all sorts of cultivation methods and Spirit Plants, and invest them all into the development of your Divine Kingdom. If conditions allow, have your families provide support. To break through to become a Demigod, the core isn’t talent, but resources.”
At this point, Li Qingying couldn’t help but sigh deeply in her heart.
What the students of Class 7, Grade 12 lacked most were resources.
If they were the top students of Class 1, their teacher would probably have a completely different teaching model.
“Teacher, after promoting to Demigod, does one escape the scope of being human?” Li Shuhao asked curiously.

“Of course. The strength of the believers will feed back into the body of the corresponding God. You’ve only just awakened, so it might not be obvious yet. After a while, once the Divine Kingdom goes through its golden development period, you will gradually feel your constitution changing; even leaping onto roofs and walking on walls will be no problem. As for breaking through to become a Demigod, I can clearly tell everyone that even if you were hit by a supercar traveling at 2,000 kilometers per hour, there would be no danger to your life.”
“Then what about a God?”
“If the Divine Kingdom is not destroyed, the God does not die,” Li Qingying said with a certain tone.
This sentence was meant to encourage everyone.

In fact, she had another sentence she didn’t say: once one truly becomes a God, if there is a life-and-death grudge, they wouldn’t strike in the real world at all, but would instead directly send troops to the Divine Kingdom.
Li Qingying’s class passed quickly.
During the lesson, the students were all actively discussing, and in the blink of an eye, it was time for class to end.
