Teacher congratulates you all,” Li Qingying said while lightly clapping her hands.
All the students in Class 7, Grade 12 came from ordinary families.
With two C-grades and one D-grade in this awakening, Li Qingying was already very satisfied.
The rest of the students looked at Yang Fan and the other two, their faces also filled with envy.
This wasn’t because of the evaluation itself, but because of the Ministry of Education’s resource allocation that the evaluation represented.

Although the resources rewarded by the Ministry of Education could not be used for other daily expenses, at least they didn’t have to ask their families for investment, which was a disguised way of reducing the burden on their families.
“Since the dawn of the Age of Gods, human lifespan has increased significantly.
You are still young; do not fall into the trap of temporary gains and losses and forget your original intentions,” Li Qingying changed the subject.
“We understand, Teacher.”
“Good, let’s start today’s lesson.
What do you think a Divine Being is?” Li Qingying pointed to the four large characters on the blackboard.
“Aren’t we exactly that?”
“Gods who possess a Divine Kingdom?”
“Ordinary people who have undergone awakening are Divine Beings.”
The students below were chattering away, all eagerly answering.
Li Qingying gave a light chuckle and looked toward Yang Fan: “Student Yang, what do you think?”
“Ah?” Yang Fan was startled.
Although he always listened attentively in class, he never thought about answering questions.
Why did the teacher take the initiative to ask him today?
“Ahem, my thoughts are about the same as everyone else’s.” Yang Fan scratched his head and gave a silly laugh.
Seeing this scene, a trace of disappointment flashed in the depths of Li Qingying’s eyes.
“Is he just an ordinary student?” Li Qingying sighed inwardly.
Li Qingying then shifted her gaze to Li Shuhao and continued: “What does Student Li think?”
“The core of a Divine Being is not divinity, but the ‘creature’ part.
After awakening, we have a Divine Kingdom, and the Divine Kingdom is like a sheepfold, while our believers are the penned-in lambs.
Similarly, one can conclude that if one does not become a God, one remains a link in the biological chain.
From a certain perspective, we are also lambs now, or a link in the biological chain,” Li Shuhao said his opinion in a flat tone.
As he finished speaking, many gazes turned toward him.
Some were curious, some surprised, some thoughtful, and some speechless.
Yang Fan looked at him, a different glint also flashing in his eyes: “This guy is somewhat interesting.
It’s just a pity that even though he knows he’s a lamb, he has to act like a ‘thinking lamb.’ He’s not steady enough.”
Li Qingying’s eyes lit up: “Who did you hear that from?”
“In my spare time, I like to log into the school library to read books.”
“Very good, your insight is quite good.
Although it’s a bit unpleasant to hear, the core idea is correct.
So-called Divine Beings still haven’t escaped the scope of being human.
Aside from your lifespan, your physical bodies are still fragile.
You’ll starve to death if you don’t eat for ten days, die of thirst if you don’t drink water for three days, and a minor traffic accident could potentially end your life.
Divine Beings are just slightly higher-level biological beings; they are still fragile.

I know you’ve just awakened your Divine Kingdoms and are full of high spirits, but I regret to inform you of a statistic: ninety percent of the people in our class won’t even be able to break through to become a Demigod.” Li Qingying’s expression was incredibly serious.
The classroom was very quiet.
Many students looked unhappy.

After all, their parents weren’t Demigods either, just Divine Beings engaged in logistics work, and most of their parents’ expectations for them were to break through to become Demigods and change the family’s destiny.
“Teacher, how can one break through to become a Demigod?” a student raised their hand to ask.
“Work hard to develop your Divine Kingdom and make your believers strong enough.
Of course, if you want a quantitative indicator, even if you do nothing every day, you should be able to obtain 1,000 Faith Pointss just from the faith of your believers.”
“Obtaining 1,000 Faith Pointss just through faith alone!” Many students’ mouths hung wide open, their eyes filled with disbelief.
1,000 a day means 30,000 a month.
You have to know that many people’s parents together can’t even earn 5,000 a month.
Moreover, this isn’t from selling Divine Kingdom resources, but the most basic acquisition of Faith Pointss.
“Don’t be surprised.
Once you truly become a Demigod, perhaps you won’t even care about this bit of income.”
Yang Fan lowered his head, thinking secretly: “I still have to work hard to raise the life level of my believers.
With the strength of the believers in my Divine Kingdom now, even if their population grows to a million, the Faith Pointss they could provide daily would probably only be in the single digits.”
This was also why a Divine Kingdom couldn’t make a God stronger through a ‘human wave’ tactic.
If the population grew without limit, the Divine Kingdom would eventually be unable to support them.
Soldiers should be elite, not just numerous.
“Students, I’m not trying to discourage you, but to let everyone recognize reality.
To become a Demigod, you need to make your believers strong enough.
I looked at everyone’s Divine Kingdom awakening reports yesterday; 70% of you have no talent, and of the rest who do have talents, most are lifestyle-type talents.
Just imagine, if your believers spend most of their time on administrative tasks like mining, farming, and hunting, how can they become stronger?”
Hearing this, everyone looked troubled, and some students even began to look anxious.
“I know your difficulties.
Everyone’s family conditions aren’t great, and after becoming Divine Beings, your first thought is to help reduce the burden on your families.

However, as your teacher, what I want to say is that if you want to break through to become a Demigod, then from now on, you must try every possible way to work hard to improve the strength of your believers.
Buy Resource Cards, Breeding Cards, all sorts of cultivation methods and Spirit Plants, and invest them all into the development of your Divine Kingdom.
If conditions allow, have your families provide support.
To break through to become a Demigod, the core isn’t talent, but resources.”
At this point, Li Qingying couldn’t help but sigh deeply in her heart.
What the students of Class 7, Grade 12 lacked most were resources.
If they were the top students of Class 1, their teacher would probably have a completely different teaching model.
“Teacher, after promoting to Demigod, does one escape the scope of being human?” Li Shuhao asked curiously.
“Of course.
The strength of the believers will feed back into the body of the corresponding God.
You’ve only just awakened, so it might not be obvious yet.
After a while, once the Divine Kingdom goes through its golden development period, you will gradually feel your constitution changing; even leaping onto roofs and walking on walls will be no problem.
As for breaking through to become a Demigod, I can clearly tell everyone that even if you were hit by a supercar traveling at 2,000 kilometers per hour, there would be no danger to your life.”
“Then what about a God?”
“If the Divine Kingdom is not destroyed, the God does not die,” Li Qingying said with a certain tone.
This sentence was meant to encourage everyone.

In fact, she had another sentence she didn’t say: once one truly becomes a God, if there is a life-and-death grudge, they wouldn’t strike in the real world at all, but would instead directly send troops to the Divine Kingdom.
Li Qingying’s class passed quickly.
During the lesson, the students were all actively discussing, and in the blink of an eye, it was time for class to end.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: A Century of Development in the Divine Kingdom
paragraphs: After the teacher left, Zhang Pang couldn’t help but say, “Brother Yang, now that we’ve awakened our Divine Kingdoms, the Federal Government has granted us many permissions. Want to go to the entertainment district and have some fun together?”
“Have some fun with what?” Yang Fan’s face showed a look of suspicion.
“I’ll tell you quietly; I visited quite a few places yesterday. There’s a club called Tianxiang Renjian. With our status, we can spend at the first level, and it only costs 2,000 Faith Points...”
“Pardon me, but women will only slow down the speed at which I draw my blade. Let’s talk when you’re free.” Yang Fan hurriedly exited the virtual space, for fear of being tempted by Zhang Pang.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan opened the shopping panel once again.
“Now that my believers are already practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, what methods are there to enhance their strength?” Yang Fan input his requirements.
“Based on the citizen’s requirements, the following solutions are provided:
First, purchasing spiritual plants that can alter aptitude will significantly accelerate the believers’ cultivation progress.
For example: 100 D-rank Blood Lotus Seeds, priced at 10,000 Faith Points.
Believers need long-term consumption, taking one seed per person every month in Divine Kingdom time; results will only show after decades of persistence.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan’s face couldn’t help but twitch: “This is way too expensive.”
He currently had 600 believers.
Taking it once would cost 60,000, and twelve months in a year would be 720,000—and that was only after one day had passed in the outside world.
“Spiritual plants that alter aptitude are all very expensive. This is already the cheapest tier I’ve retrieved.”
“Isn’t there something that slowly changes believer aptitude over time? This is too much of a money sink.”

“You can choose to purchase cultivation techniques to improve believer strength. Considering you have just awakened your Divine Kingdom, for long-term development, the chosen technique should ideally enhance believer aptitude subtly in addition to increasing strength.”
“Give me some recommendations.”
“Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, C-rank technique, worth 2 million Faith Points.
Yi Jin Jing, C-rank technique, worth 5 million Faith Points.
Everlasting Spring Technique, B-rank technique, worth 1 point of Divinity; current status does not have permission to purchase.
The intelligent lifeform recommended over a hundred techniques, but there wasn’t a single one he could afford.
More importantly, it seemed his permissions were insufficient; many of the later ones were censored.
He could only see that such items existed, but he didn’t even know what their names were.
“I’ll just stick to farming, wash up, and go to bed early.” Yang Fan gave a bitter laugh.
In the following days of real life, peace began to return.
Yang Fan entered the Virtual World on time every day for class.
How to develop a Divine Kingdom?
Which resource cards have the highest cost-performance ratio in the early stages?
How to maintain the ecological balance of the Divine Kingdom and sustain healthy evolution?
The diverse directions for cultivating believers.
As the homeroom teacher of Class 7, Li Qingying gave very comprehensive lectures every time.
However, perhaps because the students of Class 7 all came from ordinary backgrounds, she focused more on the logistics direction.
Even so, Yang Fan listened very attentively.
With his Evolution Talent, his Divine Kingdom could fully develop in all aspects.
In the blink of an eye, another 10 days passed.
Under the effect of the Evolution Talent, another century had passed within the Divine Kingdom.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster)
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom evolution, currently hidden.)
Believers: Barbarians (5,230)
Method: Federal Body Refinement Technique
Faith Points: 7,788 (Daily Faith Point provision 0.006)
Building: Moon Well (Produces one drop of Moon Dew every ten years)
Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X5,311, Level 1 Demon Beast), water lotus (X1,000, F-rank Spiritual Plant)”
In a hundred years, the Divine Kingdom had undergone earth-shaking changes.
With the Moon Well as the center, the tribe had built hundreds of stone houses radiating outwards, and the occupied area had reached five thousand square kilometers.
Benefiting from the basic skill cards invested ten days ago, the believers had generally become much smarter.
They had even fenced off a large area to domesticate antelopes for easier slaughter.
Some believers also transplanted the wild fruit trees within the Divine Kingdom to the vicinity of the tribe, centralizing the picking to improve efficiency.
The elderly did odd jobs in the tribe, young women picked wild fruits, adult males formed teams to hunt, teenagers played in the fields, and infants waited to be fed in the rooms.
Under Yang Fan’s gaze, a team of fifty adult males in the mountains and forests was carrying a Bodhi Precious Snake that was a full twenty meters long back to the tribe.
“The hunting team is back! It’s an adult Bodhi Precious Snake!” a half-naked young boy shouted from a high point in the tribe.
Upon hearing this, the entire tribe stirred into action.
“A-Da, why are only you guys back?” an old man stepped forward to ask.

“Lord Village Chief, we used to catch young snakes. Perhaps because we did it too often, these beasts have learned to be clever. Today, an adult Bodhi Precious Snake was actually lying in ambush. Only half of the hundred-man team returned,” the leading man replied calmly.
There was no sadness in his eyes; instead, he was very satisfied with this harvest.

“It is good that you did not return empty-handed. Adult treasure snakes have powerful medicinal effects; dilute it with more water for the children to consume. For the next few months, do not go to the Snake Valley to hunt. Properly digest this harvest. If the tribe can produce another warrior like you, we can take the initiative to hunt adult treasure snakes.”
“Everything for the tribe,” the man said excitedly.
“Everything for the God,” the Village Chief raised his hands with utmost piety.
In the void, Yang Fan watched all this, showing a look of satisfaction.
In a hundred years, the overall strength of the believers had increased by more than ten times.
The number of Bodhi Precious Snakes had also increased greatly.
There were about 1,500 mature treasure snakes, while the rest were mostly juvenile small snakes.
Noticing something, Yang Fan’s brow furrowed slightly.
“Why has the number of antelopes decreased so much? There are less than 200,000 left.”
Since it was Yang Fan’s own Divine Kingdom, he quickly found the reason.
The main reason was that the believers were practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, and coupled with the population explosion, the consumption of meat had grown exponentially.
About thirty years ago, the previous village chief had discovered this problem and began to restrict the villagers’ hunting, even domesticating a portion of them.
The second reason was the reproduction of the Bodhi Precious Snakes.
Their meat consumption was equally terrifying, several times more than that of the entire tribe.
Although they were first-tier demon beasts, these brutes did not have much intelligence and did not understand the principle of not overfishing.
Basically, they ate when hungry, slept after eating, and continued eating when they woke up.
If the tribe hadn’t gone to hunt the young snakes every once in a while, their numbers would only be higher, and they might have already started destroying the ecological chain.
“The biodiversity in the Divine Kingdom is still too low, and the chain is not very stable. In addition, I have to buy some grass seeds so that herbivores like antelopes can have more food.”
Having figured out the shortcomings of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan returned to reality and began shopping.

“Six-Leaf Clover seeds, can cover a hundred thousand square kilometers, grows extremely fast, and requires enough moisture. After the growth density reaches a certain level, they will compete with each other for water, which ensures they won’t grow wildly and destroy the ecology. Price: 200 Faith Points.”
“Buy it.”
“Ten thousand unranked wild boars, price: 300 Faith Points.”
“Buy it.”
“One thousand unranked tigers, price: 400 Faith Points.”
“One hundred thousand hamsters, price: 300 Faith Points.”
“One hundred million earthworms, can fertilize the soil and increase the growth rate of vegetation, price: 100 Faith Points.”
Buy, buy, buy.
With a wave of his hand, Yang Fan spent nearly 3,000 Faith Points to purchase all kinds of unranked wild beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The First Harvest
paragraphs: These beasts were not Yang Fan’s believers; they would only follow their instincts to hunt and breed.
Over decades or centuries, they might even face extinction.
Yang Fan didn’t care about this at all.
For one, the cost of rankless beasts was extremely low, and secondly, this was a necessary process for ecological evolution.
Li Qingying had mentioned in class that gods could invest various resource cards, but they had to be careful with the intensity.
If beings of Rank 2 or higher were introduced in the early stages of a Divine Kingdom, it might bring a devastating disaster.
As for low-level beast species, the more the better.
The god did not need to interfere; if a species went extinct, it only proved it was unsuitable for the Divine Kingdom’s development and was automatically eliminated by the ecological chain.
Natural selection and survival of the fittest—on the path of developing a Divine Kingdom, faster isn’t always better; time is equally important.

“100 Dark Night Vultures, Rank 1 Demonic Beasts, price: 3,000 Faith Points. (Merchant’s Note: Not recommended for purchase within the first century of a Divine Kingdom’s history; these demonic beasts frequently hunt human infants.)”
Yang Fan hesitated slightly but still clicked purchase.
Based on the knowledge learned in class, Yang Fan felt his believers were living a bit too comfortably.
The Bodhi Precious Snakes were relatively lazy and basically wouldn’t leave that valley, while beasts like antelopes couldn’t cause any harm to the tribe.
Pressure provides motivation; Yang Fan felt it was time to introduce some dangerous species into his current Divine Kingdom.
A comfortable environment cannot produce powerful believers.
Upon receiving the cards, Yang Fan immediately placed them all into his Divine Kingdom.
Beams of light flashed, and series of beastly roars echoed from deep within the Divine Kingdom’s dense forests.
Tigers, porcupines, rabbits, hedgehogs, and rats began to emerge like ants.
A loud, clear screech rang out in the sky.
At this moment, within the valley where the Bodhi Precious Snakes resided, an old snake—a full fifty meters long—began to coil its body, taking an offensive stance as if sensing a natural enemy.
With a thought, Yang Fan sent down a divine oracle to the tribe: “My believers, you have performed well over this century. As a reward, I have sent down a miracle to provide you with more food.”
“Thank you, our God.” The believers all knelt and bowed together; even the two and three-year-old infants rolled over and fell to the ground in worship.
“Opportunity comes with risk. A crisis from the sky has already been born; you must be prepared.”
Leaving behind those words, Yang Fan took out three blank cards to collect 11 drops of Moon Dew and all 500 Water Lotus Seeds from the tribe’s warehouse.
He then went to the Snake Valley to collect 500 adult Treasure Snakes and 500 young snakes before returning to reality.
Under conditions where network data could be manifested into reality, everyone could be a buyer and a merchant.
Yang Fan used his student ID to register a Taotao Network account, then connected his transaction account to his Divine Kingdom and began editing his listings.
“11 drops of Moon Dew, price: 11,000 Faith Points.”
“500 Water Lotus Seeds, price: 1,000 Faith Points.”
“Bodhi Precious Snake bundle: 500 adults, 500 juveniles, price: 3,000 Faith Points.”
After editing, Yang Fan clicked submit.
“Taotao Network item review passed, qualification review passed, items listed.”

“Transaction complete. Total income: 15,000 Faith Points. Taotao Network has deducted 10% personal income tax and a 2% platform transaction fee on your behalf. Your total profit is 13,200. Faith Points have been deposited into your Divine Kingdom.”

Hearing the notification from the Taotao Network, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh: “As long as the price is reasonable, transactions are really fast. But the taxes are expensive enough. Besides these, there’s a poll tax to pay every year. The Federal Government is really ruthless.”
In today’s world, everything is digitized and intelligent.
Whether you are an ordinary person or a high-ranking god, you cannot escape taxes.
Only death and taxes are unavoidable.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster)
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom evolution, currently hidden.)
Believers: Barbarians (5230)
Method: Federal Body Refinement Technique
Faith Points: 14988 (Daily Faith Point provision: 0.006)
Buildings: Moon Well (Produces one drop of Moon Dew every ten years)
Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X4311, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Dark Night Vulture (X100, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), water lotus (X1000, F-rank Spiritual Plant)”
Only about ten days had passed in reality, and Yang Fan had already earned 13,200 Faith Points.
If his parents knew, their jaws would probably drop in shock.
Even so, Yang Fan was still not satisfied.
To be precise, he wasn’t fully utilizing his talent right now.
“Still too poor. If I had a background like Luo Bing’s, plus an SSS-rank Talent, I’d be soaring right now.”
“I must find a way to get more initial capital.” A hint of greed flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
With the Evolution Talent, his ability to earn Faith Points was naturally ten times that of others.
Take the Moon Well, for example.
Its market value is 300,000 Faith Points, earning 3,000 Faith Points per month, totaling 36,000 annually—a return rate of only 12%.
Compared to other Divine Kingdom assets, its return rate was extremely low, but for Yang Fan, it was a 120% return rate.
He could recoup the cost in a single year.
Most importantly, there was no need to waste time on cultivation; the believers only needed to practice.

“Unlike others, there’s no need for my believers to waste time on life skills like planting and hunting. Improving their strength is their core task. As for the necessary resources, they can be provided entirely through buildings like the Moon Well,” Yang Fan murmured to himself.
“It’s almost time for class. I’ll think about it more tonight.” Yang Fan stopped thinking, took out his virtual helmet, and put it on.
Virtual World, Class 7, Grade 12.
“Today we will talk about Divine Kingdom prosperity level.” Li Qingying wrote the words ‘prosperity level’ on the blackboard.
Ten days after the Awakening, no one was as fanatical as they were at the beginning.
Although they were all listening to the lecture seriously, there was a hint of exhaustion in their eyes.
To develop their Divine Kingdoms, they had to buy resource cards, send down divine oracles, and find ways to earn Faith Points.
Especially for students from poor families, this period had been exceptionally hard.
Looking at everyone’s state, Li Qingying wasn’t surprised at all.

Instead, she said, “Before this class, I have some good news to announce. Class 7, Third Year will organize a Monthly Exam. Considering you’ve only recently awakened your Divine Kingdoms, this exam will not involve any combat between believers.”
“Instead, an intelligent lifeform will connect to your Divine Kingdoms and rank you based on a comprehensive evaluation of your prosperity level.”

Li Qingying pointed her right finger at the large words on the blackboard, showing a small dimple: “Since this is an internal class exam, the school isn’t providing rewards. However, as your homeroom teacher, I am personally willing to provide the funding.”

“The fourth through tenth place winners will each receive 20,000 Faith Points, third place will get 40,000, second place 60,000, and first place will receive 100,000 Faith Points plus a D-rank building of their choice.”
“Wow!” The classroom instantly became lively as most people’s expressions turned to excitement.

Yang Fan didn’t care about this at all.
For one, the cost of rankless beasts was extremely low, and secondly, this was a necessary process for ecological evolution.
Li Qingying had mentioned in class that gods could invest various resource cards, but they had to be careful with the intensity.
If beings of Rank 2 or higher were introduced in the early stages of a Divine Kingdom, it might bring a devastating disaster.
As for low-level beast species, the more the better.
The god did not need to interfere; if a species went extinct, it only proved it was unsuitable for the Divine Kingdom’s development and was automatically eliminated by the ecological chain.
Natural selection and survival of the fittest—on the path of developing a Divine Kingdom, faster isn’t always better; time is equally important.

“100 Dark Night Vultures, Rank 1 Demonic Beasts, price: 3,000 Faith Points. (Merchant’s Note: Not recommended for purchase within the first century of a Divine Kingdom’s history; these demonic beasts frequently hunt human infants.)”
Yang Fan hesitated slightly but still clicked purchase.
Based on the knowledge learned in class, Yang Fan felt his believers were living a bit too comfortably.
The Bodhi Precious Snakes were relatively lazy and basically wouldn’t leave that valley, while beasts like antelopes couldn’t cause any harm to the tribe.
Pressure provides motivation; Yang Fan felt it was time to introduce some dangerous species into his current Divine Kingdom.
A comfortable environment cannot produce powerful believers.
Upon receiving the cards, Yang Fan immediately placed them all into his Divine Kingdom.
Beams of light flashed, and series of beastly roars echoed from deep within the Divine Kingdom’s dense forests.
Tigers, porcupines, rabbits, hedgehogs, and rats began to emerge like ants.
A loud, clear screech rang out in the sky.
At this moment, within the valley where the Bodhi Precious Snakes resided, an old snake—a full fifty meters long—began to coil its body, taking an offensive stance as if sensing a natural enemy.
With a thought, Yang Fan sent down a divine oracle to the tribe: “My believers, you have performed well over this century.
As a reward, I have sent down a miracle to provide you with more food.”
“Thank you, our God.” The believers all knelt and bowed together; even the two and three-year-old infants rolled over and fell to the ground in worship.
“Opportunity comes with risk.
A crisis from the sky has already been born; you must be prepared.”
Leaving behind those words, Yang Fan took out three blank cards to collect 11 drops of Moon Dew and all 500 Water Lotus Seeds from the tribe’s warehouse.
He then went to the Snake Valley to collect 500 adult Treasure Snakes and 500 young snakes before returning to reality.
Under conditions where network data could be manifested into reality, everyone could be a buyer and a merchant.
Yang Fan used his student ID to register a Taotao Network account, then connected his transaction account to his Divine Kingdom and began editing his listings.
“11 drops of Moon Dew, price: 11,000 Faith Points.”
“500 Water Lotus Seeds, price: 1,000 Faith Points.”
“Bodhi Precious Snake bundle: 500 adults, 500 juveniles, price: 3,000 Faith Points.”
After editing, Yang Fan clicked submit.
“Taotao Network item review passed, qualification review passed, items listed.”
“Transaction complete.
Total income: 15,000 Faith Points.
Taotao Network has deducted 10% personal income tax and a 2% platform transaction fee on your behalf.
Your total profit is 13,200.
Faith Points have been deposited into your Divine Kingdom.”
Hearing the notification from the Taotao Network, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh: “As long as the price is reasonable, transactions are really fast.
But the taxes are expensive enough.
Besides these, there’s a poll tax to pay every year.
The Federal Government is really ruthless.”
In today’s world, everything is digitized and intelligent.
Whether you are an ordinary person or a high-ranking god, you cannot escape taxes.
Only death and taxes are unavoidable.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster)
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom evolution, currently hidden.)
Believers: Barbarians (5230)
Method: Federal Body Refinement Technique
Faith Points: 14988 (Daily Faith Point provision: 0.006)
Buildings: Moon Well (Produces one drop of Moon Dew every ten years)
Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X4311, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Dark Night Vulture (X100, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), water lotus (X1000, F-rank Spiritual Plant)”
Only about ten days had passed in reality, and Yang Fan had already earned 13,200 Faith Points.
If his parents knew, their jaws would probably drop in shock.
Even so, Yang Fan was still not satisfied.
To be precise, he wasn’t fully utilizing his talent right now.
“Still too poor.
If I had a background like Luo Bing’s, plus an SSS-rank Talent, I’d be soaring right now.”
“I must find a way to get more initial capital.” A hint of greed flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
With the Evolution Talent, his ability to earn Faith Points was naturally ten times that of others.
Take the Moon Well, for example.
Its market value is 300,000 Faith Points, earning 3,000 Faith Points per month, totaling 36,000 annually—a return rate of only 12%.
Compared to other Divine Kingdom assets, its return rate was extremely low, but for Yang Fan, it was a 120% return rate.
He could recoup the cost in a single year.
Most importantly, there was no need to waste time on cultivation; the believers only needed to practice.
“Unlike others, there’s no need for my believers to waste time on life skills like planting and hunting.
Improving their strength is their core task.
As for the necessary resources, they can be provided entirely through buildings like the Moon Well,” Yang Fan murmured to himself.
“It’s almost time for class.
I’ll think about it more tonight.” Yang Fan stopped thinking, took out his virtual helmet, and put it on.
Virtual World, Class 7, Grade 12.
“Today we will talk about Divine Kingdom prosperity level.” Li Qingying wrote the words ‘prosperity level’ on the blackboard.
Ten days after the Awakening, no one was as fanatical as they were at the beginning.
Although they were all listening to the lecture seriously, there was a hint of exhaustion in their eyes.
To develop their Divine Kingdoms, they had to buy resource cards, send down divine oracles, and find ways to earn Faith Points.
Especially for students from poor families, this period had been exceptionally hard.
Looking at everyone’s state, Li Qingying wasn’t surprised at all.
Instead, she said, “Before this class, I have some good news to announce.
Class 7, Third Year will organize a Monthly Exam.
Considering you’ve only recently awakened your Divine Kingdoms, this exam will not involve any combat between believers.”
“Instead, an intelligent lifeform will connect to your Divine Kingdoms and rank you based on a comprehensive evaluation of your prosperity level.”
Li Qingying pointed her right finger at the large words on the blackboard, showing a small dimple: “Since this is an internal class exam, the school isn’t providing rewards.
However, as your homeroom teacher, I am personally willing to provide the funding.”

“The fourth through tenth place winners will each receive 20,000 Faith Points, third place will get 40,000, second place 60,000, and first place will receive 100,000 Faith Points plus a D-rank building of their choice.”
“Wow!” The classroom instantly became lively as most people’s expressions turned to excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Federal Fund Loans
paragraphs: Li Qingying was truly a First-Order God; even the tiny wealth leaking from between her fingernails was enough to fill these students with motivation.
Every student sat up straight, fearing they might miss a single important detail of this class.
This wasn’t because they were studious, but because it concerned Faith Points.
Children from poor families learn to manage the household early.
Seeing that a single sentence of hers had mobilized the students’ enthusiasm, a hint of pride appeared at the corner of Li Qingying’s mouth.

“prosperity level involves many aspects, for which the Federal Government has a set of standardized evaluation procedures. It mainly focuses on the population and strength of believers, as well as the value of various resources within the Divine Kingdom, including but not limited to land, spiritual plants, and non-believer organisms.”
“Doesn’t this just mean that whoever invests more gets a higher prosperity level?” a student below the stage countered.

“You’re essentially correct, but not entirely. Besides that, biological diversity, the stability of the food chain, the degree of sustainable development of the Divine Kingdom, and even the cleanliness and aesthetics of the Divine Kingdom’s interior are all included in the assessment criteria.”

Li Qingying smiled and continued, “Don’t think the knowledge learned in school is unimportant. If a ‘rich second generation’ only knows how to mindlessly pile up resources, they might start high, but in the long run, their Divine Kingdom will become bloated and even unable to digest it all. Developing a Divine Kingdom is a science. Resources are important, but for ordinary students like you, you must put more effort into your studies. Only then can you utilize every resource to its absolute limit.”
Everyone listened even more intently upon hearing this, as if grasping a glimmer of hope.
What Li Qingying said was naturally true, but she didn’t mention the real point: in fact, the most important thing for the development of a Divine Kingdom was still resources.
Even if an ordinary person learned everything perfectly and utilized every resource to its limit, how could they possibly compare to those born with a silver spoon?
The resources those people wasted could probably burst their Divine Kingdoms.
Social classes in this world had already solidified; trying to climb up was as difficult as ascending to heaven.

“In addition, I have some good news for you. I have applied to the Ministry of Education, and now everyone in Class 7 has been removed from the Minor Protection Act. You are eligible to apply for loans from the Ministry of Education,” Li Qingying said.
“Loans!” Yang Fan’s eyes also lit up.
According to federal law, until a federal citizen awakens their Divine Kingdom and gains independent capability, they cannot participate in Federal Education Fund loans.
Li Qingying coughed, her expression gradually becoming solemn.

“Outside loan companies generally have annual interest rates above 50%, while the Federal Education Fund loan is 0%. Interest will only start being charged once you lose your student status, and you don’t even need to pay back the principal during this period. This is an investment given by the Federal Government to all students. For the vast majority of people, this might even be the last investment of their lives. This fund is extremely important. Remember to use it for the development of your own Divine Kingdom.”

“As for the loan amount, it is determined by your evaluation at the time of awakening. An F-grade evaluation has a limit of 300,000, E-grade is 1,000,000, D-grade is 2,000,000, and C-grade is 5,000,000.”
“Teacher Li, this isn’t fair. With such a large gap in loan limits, won’t the top three spots already be fixed?” someone below said anxiously.

“There is no absolute fairness in this world. Instead of wasting time complaining, you should think more about how to use limited resources to develop your Divine Kingdom. The assessment starts in ten days; everyone, get ready.”
Leaving those words behind, Li Qingying’s figure instantly vanished, presumably returning to reality.

Zhang Pang nudged Yang Fan’s shoulder and said, “A 5-million-point loan limit with no interest, and there are still four years until university graduation. Any random investment could double that. How is this different from getting it for free? No wonder my dad says being one step ahead means being ahead at every step.”
Even Zhang Pang, who came from a relatively well-off family, looked moved at this moment.
Five million Faith Points could buy out his father’s entire grain warehouse.
“It’s impossible to use all of this capital for investment; the consumption required to nurture believers is also quite significant,” Yang Fan lamented, putting on an act.
Just then, he felt a scrutinizing gaze.
It was Li Shuhao.
He was looking at Yang Fan and slowly stood up.
Seeing Li Shuhao about to walk toward him, Yang Fan hurriedly logged out of the Virtual World.
Seeing this, Li Shuhao was also stunned.
He was certain Yang Fan had seen him, but then he suddenly ran away.
“Li Shuhao, I won’t lose to you in this internal assessment,” Wang Zhenyu said as he stood up nearby.
“So confident? And haven’t you forgotten someone? Yang Fan in our class also received a C-grade evaluation.”

“Five million is a lot, but Yang Fan’s family background is too poor. His parents can’t provide him with any help; this is already his ceiling,” Wang Zhenyu said indifferently, seemingly not taking Yang Fan seriously at all.
“My family background is also average. Unlike you, who has a good father with ten cargo transfer points in Tomorrow Neighborhood,” Li Shuhao sighed.

“Stop being sarcastic. Although you’re from a branch of the Li Family, you received family investment right after getting a C-grade evaluation ten days ago. I’m afraid the prosperity level of everyone else’s Divine Kingdoms in the class combined can’t match yours alone,” Wang Zhenyu rolled his eyes.
“How do you know such a top secret?” Li Shuhao was shocked.

“Screw you! A few days ago, when we were drinking at Tianxiang Renjian, you damn well bragged about it in front of over a dozen people. Now you’re pretending to have forgotten? Would it kill you to stop showing off? Have you been suppressed too much by being a bookworm all these years!” Wang Zhenyu spat.
Without waiting for a reaction, he logged out of the Virtual World.
Li Shuhao stood there, his face turning slightly red.
After an embarrassed cough, he also logged out.
“It’s good to be related to a major family. Just a bit of potential and you get investment.”

“The Li Family and the Luo Family are the two largest families in Yang County. Li Shuhao can be considered to have successfully changed his fate. His current strength could probably get him into Class 1, Third Year.”
“Wang Zhenyu also shouldn’t be underestimated. I saw his father applying for a loan a while ago. It seems he wants to give him a boost before the College Entrance Examination.”
Yang Fan didn’t know what happened afterward, nor was he interested in gossip among classmates.
Now, he only wanted to apply for the loan as quickly as possible to buy resource cards and enrich his Divine Kingdom.
Just as Yang Fan tapped on his smartwatch, he saw a voice call from Zhang Pang.

Picking up the call, Zhang Pang’s boisterous voice came through: “Brother Yang, why did you run so fast? I wanted to ask why you didn’t go to the party Li Shuhao organized a few days ago? That kid has really made it big. He ordered one for each of us brothers without even blinking. That show of wealth was incredibly satisfying.”
“A party?”
“Didn’t you see the group message? All the boys in Class 7, Grade 12 could attend.”
“What about the girls?”
“You really don’t check your messages. We went to Tianxiang Renjian; why would we bring female classmates? There are no male models there.”
“Cough, cough... I didn’t notice,” Yang Fan said awkwardly.
“Back to business. Li Shuhao said he couldn’t reach you, so through me, he wants to invite you to dinner,” Zhang Pang said.
“Why is he inviting me to dinner?” Yang Fan looked puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 10: soul nourishing wood Seedlings
paragraphs: Although they had been high school classmates for three years, both he and Li Shuhao were quiet by nature, so they weren’t close.

“Li Shuhao has the C-rank talent Steel Body, so he’s bound to take the path of a Combat God Kingdom. Thus, he needs a Subordinate God Kingdom to help stabilize his rear supply. He’s invited several people in our class with decent talent and offered very high prices.”

“I think you could consider it. Li Shuhao is now recognized as a genius by the Li family, and his future development is beyond what we can compare to. Clinging to such a big shot will make your God Kingdom safer in the future.”
“My dad also joined his classmate back then; everyone has known each other since childhood, so there’s more trust,” Zhang Pang explained patiently.
“I see, but I’ve been busy lately. Let’s talk about it when I have time,” Yang Fan replied.
Yang Fan didn’t want to refuse directly.
Li Shuhao’s recruitment was seen as an opportunity by others.
If he refused too obviously, it wouldn’t align with his principle of keeping a low profile.

“Alright, you also have a C-rank evaluation, so you can indeed look around more. Maybe those favored ones in Class One will also extend an olive branch to you. Anyway, I’ve passed on the message. Oh, right, come out and hang out when you have time—not in the Virtual World, but at my house for dinner.”
“Sure,” Yang Fan agreed.
Zhang Pang’s father did business in Mingyue Community, and they often visited each other as children, which was why the two were so close.
After ending the call, Yang Fan clicked on his watch to enter the Federal Fund Loan page.
“Citizen Yang Fan, your current loan limit is 5 million Faith Points. Please sign the informed consent form.”
Yang Fan opened the informed consent form.
There were dozens of pages of terms.
To make it easier for students to grasp the main points, the Federal Government had highlighted the core issues.
Among them was the price of failing to repay: one would be forcibly sent to the front lines to produce resources for the front-line God Kingdoms with zero pay until all debts were cleared.
Once the countdown ended, Yang Fan decisively clicked to sign.
With his Evolution Talent, Yang Fan was confident he could double the principal in less than a year.
Risk didn’t exist at all.

“Loan successful. The Federal Government suggests that this startup capital be used entirely for the development of your personal God Kingdom. Do not indulge in pleasure or give it to others. In case of fraud, please call the official Federal Fund Loan number.”
Unlike the rewards issued by the Ministry of Education, Yang Fan could freely use the loaned Faith Points.
“Faith Points: 5,014,988 (Daily Faith Points provided: 0.006)”
Looking at the sudden surge in Faith Points, Yang Fan didn’t hesitate and immediately opened the shopping mall.

“Help me search for buildings similar to the Moon Well. Requirements: It shouldn’t consume the believers’ energy, it should generate fixed income through the natural passage of time in the God Kingdom, and ideally, it should slowly affect the believers’ bodies to improve their aptitude.”
Yang Fan entered his requirements into the search box.
“Searching...”

“C-rank building: Sun Spring. Every 10 years, it can produce one drop of Sun Essence, which has effects such as strengthening the body, increasing strength, and detoxification. The essence is worth 1,000 Faith Points, and the building price is 300,000 Faith Points.”

“C-rank building: Ghost Spring. Every hundred years, it condenses a drop of Ghost Poison, worth 50,000 Faith Points. The building price is 100,000 Faith Points. (Merchant’s note: If the believers are not strong enough, they are prone to chronic poisoning. It must be removed every thousand years in the God Kingdom, otherwise, it easily forms a toxic fog zone.)”

“C-rank building: Skeleton Tower. Input animal remains to produce Skeleton Soldiers. Each Skeleton Soldier is worth 0.1 Faith Points. The building price is 500,000 Faith Points. Based on big data, the average return rate is 36%.”

“B-rank building: Hundred Weapons Tower. Input iron ore to automatically produce hundreds of cold weapons, which can be sold. The building price is 200 million Faith Points. Based on big data, the average return rate is 16%.”
Seeing that B-rank buildings had appeared, Yang Fan hurriedly pressed the pause button.
“I want to make stable God Kingdom investments. With my current funds, I can at most buy C-rank buildings. Recommend the best options.”
“According to big data calculations, the optimal choice is a combination of Moon Wells and Sun Springs.”

“Based on current market value, the return rate of the two is 12%. Moreover, long-term placement will positively affect the surrounding environment, improving the believers’ physique and aiding in the practice of the Federal Body Refinement Technique.”

“When placed together, they will gradually merge over time. After a thousand years in the God Kingdom, there is a one-in-ten-thousand chance of evolving into the special building: Fountain of Life. As long as one appears, the investment return will increase significantly.”
“Help me check the price of the Fountain of Life,” Yang Fan asked curiously.
“Special building: Fountain of Life. The official recommended transaction price is 1 billion Faith Points. It is currently severely out of stock and cannot be purchased.”

“Fountain of Life: Life forms below the fifth rank can quickly recover from injuries when placed in it. Every 10 years, a drop of Water of Life is born, worth 1 million Faith Points. It is also severely out of stock and cannot be purchased.”
Seeing the description of the Fountain of Life, Yang Fan couldn’t help but gasp.
This was practically like buying a lottery ticket; once you hit it, you’d make a fortune.
At this moment, Yang Fan suddenly remembered seeing in a textbook that some people arranged many Moon Wells in their God Kingdoms.
Looking at it now, there were probably Sun Springs among them too.
As long as a single Fountain of Life was born, it could offset all the sunk costs.
Thinking back to the day of awakening, that genius of the Li family, Li Tianheng, had a Fountain of Life in his God Kingdom, which left Yang Fan deeply shocked.
“I wonder to what extent these geniuses with backgrounds have developed their God Kingdoms.” Yang Fan couldn’t help but rub his temples, feeling a sudden surge of pressure.
Having the SSS-rank Evolution Talent, Yang Fan didn’t believe his potential was worse than those geniuses, but the gap between them now was probably much, much larger than he had imagined.
“Others have the accumulation of several generations, while I have a cheat. The future is long; let’s wait and see,” Yang Fan encouraged himself.
“Buy four Moon Wells and five Sun Springs.” Yang Fan pressed the buy button directly.
2.7 million was spent in an instant, but Yang Fan didn’t feel the least bit of heartache.
With these and his Evolution Talent, his net income every month would be 300,000 Faith Points.

“Continue searching for high-yield Spirit Plants. Requirements: They must improve the environment of the God Kingdom, be easy to plant and harvest, not waste the believers’ energy, and the price should be within a million Faith Points.”

“Search successful. Recommended: C-rank Spirit Plant soul nourishing wood. It is extremely easy to keep alive and can be used for alchemy. The older it is, the higher its value. Long-term planting will make the surrounding creatures clear-headed and slightly enhance their comprehension.”

“1,000 soul nourishing wood seedlings, priced at 500,000 Faith Points. (Merchant’s reminder: The growth period of soul nourishing wood is too long, making it easy to attract covetous eyes from others. The investment risk is extremely high. Without a family background or strong power, it’s best not to cultivate them in large quantities.)”

“Retrieving current market prices: 510 Faith Points per ten-year soul nourishing wood, 700 Faith Points per hundred-year soul nourishing wood, 5,000 Faith Points per thousand-year soul nourishing wood, and 1 million Faith Points per ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood.”
Looking at the description of the soul nourishing wood, Yang Fan suppressed the excitement in his heart and continued to ask, “Is it considered a lot if I cultivate 1,000 of them?”
“According to big data surveys, it is not.”
“Then buy them.”
“Transaction successful.”
“Also buy 20,000 water lotus seeds.”
“Transaction successful.”
“Randomly include 1 million unranked herbivores.”
“Transaction successful.”
“Buy an F-rank Breeding Card with a duration of 100 years.”
“Transaction successful.”
In the blink of an eye, Yang Fan spent another million-plus Faith Points.
Unable to think of anything else the God Kingdom needed for now, Yang Fan stopped his shopping.
Once these resources entered the God Kingdom, it would usher in a wave of massive development.
With the God Kingdom developing at such a high speed, Yang Fan, as the god, had to pay attention at all times.
The remaining Faith Points were kept for emergencies.

“My dad also joined his classmate back then; everyone has known each other since childhood, so there’s more trust,” Zhang Pang explained patiently.
“I see, but I’ve been busy lately.
Let’s talk about it when I have time,” Yang Fan replied.
Yang Fan didn’t want to refuse directly.
Li Shuhao’s recruitment was seen as an opportunity by others.
If he refused too obviously, it wouldn’t align with his principle of keeping a low profile.
“Alright, you also have a C-rank evaluation, so you can indeed look around more.
Maybe those favored ones in Class One will also extend an olive branch to you.
Anyway, I’ve passed on the message.
Oh, right, come out and hang out when you have time—not in the Virtual World, but at my house for dinner.”
“Sure,” Yang Fan agreed.
Zhang Pang’s father did business in Mingyue Community, and they often visited each other as children, which was why the two were so close.
After ending the call, Yang Fan clicked on his watch to enter the Federal Fund Loan page.
“Citizen Yang Fan, your current loan limit is 5 million Faith Points.
Please sign the informed consent form.”
Yang Fan opened the informed consent form.
There were dozens of pages of terms.
To make it easier for students to grasp the main points, the Federal Government had highlighted the core issues.
Among them was the price of failing to repay: one would be forcibly sent to the front lines to produce resources for the front-line God Kingdoms with zero pay until all debts were cleared.
Once the countdown ended, Yang Fan decisively clicked to sign.
With his Evolution Talent, Yang Fan was confident he could double the principal in less than a year.
Risk didn’t exist at all.
“Loan successful.
The Federal Government suggests that this startup capital be used entirely for the development of your personal God Kingdom.
Do not indulge in pleasure or give it to others.
In case of fraud, please call the official Federal Fund Loan number.”
Unlike the rewards issued by the Ministry of Education, Yang Fan could freely use the loaned Faith Points.
“Faith Points: 5,014,988 (Daily Faith Points provided: 0.006)”
Looking at the sudden surge in Faith Points, Yang Fan didn’t hesitate and immediately opened the shopping mall.
“Help me search for buildings similar to the Moon Well.

Requirements: It shouldn’t consume the believers’ energy, it should generate fixed income through the natural passage of time in the God Kingdom, and ideally, it should slowly affect the believers’ bodies to improve their aptitude.”
Yang Fan entered his requirements into the search box.
“Searching...”
“C-rank building: Sun Spring.
Every 10 years, it can produce one drop of Sun Essence, which has effects such as strengthening the body, increasing strength, and detoxification.
The essence is worth 1,000 Faith Points, and the building price is 300,000 Faith Points.”
“C-rank building: Ghost Spring.
Every hundred years, it condenses a drop of Ghost Poison, worth 50,000 Faith Points.
The building price is 100,000 Faith Points. (Merchant’s note: If the believers are not strong enough, they are prone to chronic poisoning.
It must be removed every thousand years in the God Kingdom, otherwise, it easily forms a toxic fog zone.)”
“C-rank building: Skeleton Tower.
Input animal remains to produce Skeleton Soldiers.
Each Skeleton Soldier is worth 0.1 Faith Points.
The building price is 500,000 Faith Points.
Based on big data, the average return rate is 36%.”
“B-rank building: Hundred Weapons Tower.
Input iron ore to automatically produce hundreds of cold weapons, which can be sold.
The building price is 200 million Faith Points.
Based on big data, the average return rate is 16%.”
Seeing that B-rank buildings had appeared, Yang Fan hurriedly pressed the pause button.
“I want to make stable God Kingdom investments.
With my current funds, I can at most buy C-rank buildings.
Recommend the best options.”
“According to big data calculations, the optimal choice is a combination of Moon Wells and Sun Springs.”
“Based on current market value, the return rate of the two is 12%.
Moreover, long-term placement will positively affect the surrounding environment, improving the believers’ physique and aiding in the practice of the Federal Body Refinement Technique.”
“When placed together, they will gradually merge over time.
After a thousand years in the God Kingdom, there is a one-in-ten-thousand chance of evolving into the special building: Fountain of Life.
As long as one appears, the investment return will increase significantly.”
“Help me check the price of the Fountain of Life,” Yang Fan asked curiously.
“Special building: Fountain of Life.
The official recommended transaction price is 1 billion Faith Points.
It is currently severely out of stock and cannot be purchased.”
“Fountain of Life: Life forms below the fifth rank can quickly recover from injuries when placed in it.
Every 10 years, a drop of Water of Life is born, worth 1 million Faith Points.
It is also severely out of stock and cannot be purchased.”
Seeing the description of the Fountain of Life, Yang Fan couldn’t help but gasp.
This was practically like buying a lottery ticket; once you hit it, you’d make a fortune.
At this moment, Yang Fan suddenly remembered seeing in a textbook that some people arranged many Moon Wells in their God Kingdoms.
Looking at it now, there were probably Sun Springs among them too.
As long as a single Fountain of Life was born, it could offset all the sunk costs.
Thinking back to the day of awakening, that genius of the Li family, Li Tianheng, had a Fountain of Life in his God Kingdom, which left Yang Fan deeply shocked.
“I wonder to what extent these geniuses with backgrounds have developed their God Kingdoms.” Yang Fan couldn’t help but rub his temples, feeling a sudden surge of pressure.
Having the SSS-rank Evolution Talent, Yang Fan didn’t believe his potential was worse than those geniuses, but the gap between them now was probably much, much larger than he had imagined.
“Others have the accumulation of several generations, while I have a cheat.
The future is long; let’s wait and see,” Yang Fan encouraged himself.
“Buy four Moon Wells and five Sun Springs.” Yang Fan pressed the buy button directly.
2.7 million was spent in an instant, but Yang Fan didn’t feel the least bit of heartache.
With these and his Evolution Talent, his net income every month would be 300,000 Faith Points.
“Continue searching for high-yield Spirit Plants.
Requirements: They must improve the environment of the God Kingdom, be easy to plant and harvest, not waste the believers’ energy, and the price should be within a million Faith Points.”
“Search successful.
Recommended: C-rank Spirit Plant soul nourishing wood.
It is extremely easy to keep alive and can be used for alchemy.
The older it is, the higher its value.
Long-term planting will make the surrounding creatures clear-headed and slightly enhance their comprehension.”

“1,000 soul nourishing wood seedlings, priced at 500,000 Faith Points. (Merchant’s reminder: The growth period of soul nourishing wood is too long, making it easy to attract covetous eyes from others.
The investment risk is extremely high.
Without a family background or strong power, it’s best not to cultivate them in large quantities.)”

“Retrieving current market prices: 510 Faith Points per ten-year soul nourishing wood, 700 Faith Points per hundred-year soul nourishing wood, 5,000 Faith Points per thousand-year soul nourishing wood, and 1 million Faith Points per ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood.”
Looking at the description of the soul nourishing wood, Yang Fan suppressed the excitement in his heart and continued to ask, “Is it considered a lot if I cultivate 1,000 of them?”
“According to big data surveys, it is not.”
“Then buy them.”
“Transaction successful.”
“Also buy 20,000 water lotus seeds.”
“Transaction successful.”
“Randomly include 1 million unranked herbivores.”
“Transaction successful.”
“Buy an F-rank Breeding Card with a duration of 100 years.”
“Transaction successful.”
In the blink of an eye, Yang Fan spent another million-plus Faith Points.
Unable to think of anything else the God Kingdom needed for now, Yang Fan stopped his shopping.
Once these resources entered the God Kingdom, it would usher in a wave of massive development.
With the God Kingdom developing at such a high speed, Yang Fan, as the god, had to pay attention at all times.
The remaining Faith Points were kept for emergencies.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Divine Kingdom Population Explosion
paragraphs: Consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom, and the loading of resources began.
The Moon Well and Sun Spring were placed one-to-one, right in the center of the tribe.
The two forces of yin and yang neutralized each other, and a rich vitality radiated for a hundred miles around.
The believers who perceived this scene all knelt on the ground, grateful for the divine gift.
The seeds of the water lotus fell into the river closest to the tribe, filling the entire river.
And a million animals were placed by Yang Fan evenly throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
Animals would migrate on their own; if they were all placed around the tribe, the density would be too high, and even if he scattered more grass seeds, it would be impossible to support them.
Spreading them out across the entire Divine Kingdom was equivalent to using an area of one million square kilometers to support the tribe and the Bodhi Precious Snake.
The 1,000 seedlings of soul nourishing wood were placed in the tribe’s storehouse.
Subsequently, Yang Fan issued a divine oracle:
“For the next hundred years, focus all efforts on developing the tribe. In addition to practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, you must pay attention to reproduction.”
“There are 1,000 soul nourishing wood seedlings in the storehouse. You must fence off a safe area, plant them all, and then designate that place as a restricted zone; no one is allowed to approach.”
“We obey our God’s decree.” Whether they were inside the tribe or out hunting, all the believers knelt on the ground.
After Yang Fan directly loaded the hundred-year F-rank Breeding Card, his consciousness returned to reality.
“Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 1 million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)
SSS-rank Talent: Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom evolution, hidden.)
Believers: Barbarians (5,230)
Technique: Federal Body Refinement Technique
Faith Points: 1,314,988 (Daily provision: 0.006 Faith Points)
Buildings: Moon Well X5 (Produces one drop of Moon Dew every ten years), Sun Spring X5 (Produces one drop of Sun Essence every ten years)

Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X4,711, Level 1 Demonic Beast), Dark Night Vulture (X100, Level 1 Demonic Beast), water lotus (X21,000, F-rank Spirit Plant), soul nourishing wood (X1,000, C-rank Spirit Plant)”
The Moon Well and Sun Spring provide a fixed 300,000 Faith Points per month.
The water lotus can also produce water lotus seeds worth at least 200,000 Faith Points per month.
In addition to this, there are the Bodhi Precious Snake and the soul nourishing wood, which are long-term investments.

“Now, just our most basic income is 500,000 Faith Points. It truly lives up to being an SSS-rank Talent; this ability to accumulate wealth is perverse.” Yang Fan let out a long breath, his expression somewhat excited.
If not for the ‘Evolution’ Talent, dumping nearly 4 million Faith Points in would only yield at most a 1% return per month, but now it is 10%.
A monthly income of over 10% definitely belongs to the high-risk sector in Divine Kingdom investments, yet Yang Fan has now obtained high-risk returns using a risk-free investment.
“The future is promising.” Yang Fan sighed.
With a rumble, Yang Fan felt his stomach protesting.
He was still a Divine Being, and although he had strengthened his physical fitness by relying on the development of the Divine Kingdom, eating was still necessary.
Arriving in the living room, his parents were eating steak while discussing the sale of iron ore.
“The price of ordinary ore is too low now, and half of it has to be sold at a low price to Lord Lin Lang; the returns are really getting smaller and smaller.” Yang Tiexin sighed.
“The heart-nourishing grass I planted last month has also matured, so it can be sold for 2,000 Faith Points; it counts as a subsidy.”

“Faith Points are needed everywhere. That kid just awakened his Divine Kingdom; although he hasn’t asked, if we don’t support him a bit, I’m afraid his grades will be left behind by other classmates.”

“Fan’er received a C-rank evaluation; we cannot hold him back. How about we take my micro iron mine and use it as collateral so he can push himself before the college entrance exam?” Sun Rong’s face showed a look of hesitation.
The micro iron mine in her own Divine Kingdom was the foundation their family relied on for survival, and the interest on a mortgage loan was not low; this decision was truly hard to make.
Hearing all of this from the stairs, Yang Fan’s heart couldn’t help but ache.
During this time, all his energy had been focused on the development of the Divine Kingdom, and he had neglected his parents.
“Mom, Dad, you don’t need to worry; I don’t need help from home.”
Yang Fan walked to Yang Tiexin’s side, took his left hand, communicated with his Divine Kingdom, and directly transferred 100,000 Faith Points to him.

Perceiving the change in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Tiexin’s expression changed drastically: “What are you doing, kid? Why are you transferring 100,000 Faith Points to me? Shouldn’t I, as your father, be the one transferring to you?”
“I received a federal fund loan; it’s zero interest, for 5 million.” Yang Fan said straightforwardly.
Both Yang Tiexin and his wife were stunned in place.
5 million Faith Points—they had never seen that much in their entire lives.
“Are you serious? Is the federal fund loan limit that high?”
“Of course it’s true. And my Divine Kingdom is developing very well; in the future, I will break through to become a Demigod, and then a God. You don’t need to worry.”

As his mother, Sun Rong waved her hands repeatedly: “Fan’er, you are currently in a critical period of Divine Kingdom development. Even if you have a 5-million interest-free loan, you cannot spend it recklessly. You don’t understand; there is never enough in terms of Faith Points.”
“Mom, you have to believe in me. And do you think your son is the type of person to puff himself up just to look big?” Yang Fan looked at the two of them with a serious expression.
He could not explicitly state the existence of the Evolution Talent.
As for giving the 100,000 Faith Points, it was also to prevent his parents from over-exploiting their believers.
Over these years, Yang Tiexin and his wife’s hair had clearly turned gray, which was a sign of damage to their Divine Kingdoms.

“You have always had your own ideas since you were a child. We will hold onto these Faith Points for you first. If you have any needs before the college entrance exam, just tell us. If you are truly confident about breaking through to become a Demigod, we can go and apply for the mortgage.”
Yang Fan nodded, picked up a piece of marbled beef and a glass of freshly squeezed juice, and returned to his room.
Although he had money now and his monthly income was likely higher than anyone else in Mingyue Community, he did not have the corresponding strength, so it was better to keep a low profile.
In the future, he would naturally let his parents live a good life.
In the time that followed, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom more and more frequently.
Every day, apart from attending classes in the Virtual World, he specifically set an alarm and went in every two hours.
Under the blessing of the Breeding Card, the tribe’s population increased to 8,000 in the first decade within the Divine Kingdom.
In the second decade, it reached 15,000.
In the third decade, 27,000.
Starting from the fourth decade, because the tribe’s population was too large, the new village chief led the expansion of houses.
Men, women, young, and old all acted together, and the population only increased to 30,000.
In the fifth decade, there was a baby boom, and the population exceeded 45,000.
In the sixth decade, the population easily exceeded 50,000.
Because the tribe’s population grew too fast, and combined with practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, the demand for meat was extremely huge.
Those herbivorous animals like antelopes were consumed too quickly and could not keep up with the progress of their cultivation.
The tribe began to organize a team of a thousand people to hunt the Bodhi Precious Snake.
Yang Fan had only slept for a few hours, and the Bodhi Precious Snakes in the Divine Kingdom were almost hunted to extinction.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan was frightened, waved his hand, purchased another 10,000 Bodhi Precious Snakes, and issued a divine oracle that they must not be over-hunted.
