chapters.title: Chapter 12: Risks of Divine Kingdom Development
paragraphs: “Suddenly investing so many resources, combined with a tenfold evolution efficiency, has caused some imbalance in the food chain. If the tribe continues to develop like this, even a million herbivores won’t be enough for them to eat. The frequency of the alarm clock needs to be higher, and I must be ready to invest resources at any time,” Yang Fan thought to himself.
Afterward, Yang Fan bought a large quantity of grass seeds in the mall, such as Horse-Holding Flower, Earthy-Smelling Grass, Green Vine, and others.
These green plants covered the entire Divine Kingdom in just one year.
In the seventh decade, the elders within the tribe discovered that the population was simply too large.
Everyone living together caused massive destruction to the surrounding resources, and waste could not be processed quickly.
The surroundings were stinking and it was very easy to fall ill.
The tribe held a grand meeting, preparing to establish more tribes to disperse the population.
The final decision was to open four branch tribes, located about five hundred kilometers away from the main tribe.
As for who would be sent out, it was determined entirely by strength; only the strong were fit to live in the main tribe.
The tribal chief issued an order: if a child with high talent appeared among the descendants of the branch tribes, the family of three could move back to the main tribe.
Yang Fan did not actively interfere with the development within the Divine Kingdom.

After they reached their conclusion, he once again purchased low-level knowledge such as road building and bridge construction from the mall and invested it into the Divine Kingdom to help his believers avoid detours.
In the eighth decade, the believer population had reached a high of one hundred thousand, and the new tribes were fully formed.
They were named Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermilion Bird, while the main tribe was renamed ‘God’s Revelation’, signifying the place where the God delivered divine oracles.
On this day, Yang Fan once again felt the pressure coming from within the Divine Kingdom.
With the population explosion and everyone practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, the consumption of food was simply too great.
Relying solely on those herbivores was fundamentally insufficient to sustain them.
Yang Fan could feel that the growth speed of the vegetation had reached its limit.
Furthermore, the Divine Kingdom also had four seasons.
Once winter arrived, dried meat alone would not be enough to sustain them.
If he didn’t intervene, many believers would starve to death.
During this period, Yang Fan had also invested several food resource cards, which barely managed to maintain the balance.
While Yang Fan was browsing the mall to research solutions, he received a call from his best friend, Zhang Pang.
“Brother Yang, I’m waiting for you downstairs. Come to my house for dinner,” a voice came from the other end of the phone.
Yang Fan rubbed his temples, feeling a bit groggy.
Although he felt his body had become much stronger due to the rapid development of the Divine Kingdom during this time, his mental fatigue had not been eliminated.
In these eight or nine days, he hadn’t had a single day of peaceful sleep.
“A Great Leap Forward style of development is still undesirable,” Yang Fan sighed, stood up, and went downstairs.
The Divine Kingdom was developing too quickly.
Over the past few days, Yang Fan had successively invested over a hundred thousand faith points.
Now, the Divine Kingdom looked thriving, but it was actually quite dangerous.
If he wasn’t careful and the ecology was destroyed, the Divine Kingdom would turn into a desert.
“Brother Yang, how is your Divine Kingdom doing? With 5 million in resources smashed into it, I bet it’s completely transformed,” Zhang Pang said, coming up to put his arm around Yang Fan’s neck.
“It’s transformed a bit too aggressively.”
“Give you an inch and you take a mile. Just wait for this month’s class exam; I’ll definitely blind your titanium alloy dog eyes,” Zhang Pang said, tilting his head proudly with a mysterious tone.
Yang Fan just smiled at this.
Barring any accidents, the one whose eyes would likely be blinded was the other party.

“Hearing that you were coming to dinner, my dad specifically cooked spirit rice and Blood Python meat. Seeing how you look like you haven’t woken up, this should nourish you,” Zhang Pang’s father was named Zhang Wanshan, a well-known figure throughout the streets of Mingyue Community.
The quality of the crops Zhang Wanshan grew was quite good.
Combined with being cheaper than food in the mall and having no delivery fees, nearly thirty percent of the community were his customers.
Yang Fan’s parents often bought grain from Zhang Wanshan for their believers, and in return, he would buy some of their family’s iron ore—it was a way of looking out for each other’s business.

“Xiao Fan is here! I heard you got a C-rank evaluation. You’re the genius of our Mingyue Community. Why haven’t you been out for a stroll lately? I haven’t even had a chance to congratulate you,” Zhang Wanshan, who had a square face, gave Yang Fan a standard smile.
“Greetings, Uncle Zhang.”
“Don’t be so formal. You two go wash your hands first; the Blood Python meat in the pot is almost ready,” Zhang Wanshan said before hurrying back to the kitchen.
Zhang Pang was from a single-parent family.
It was said that when he was very young, while the family of three was eating, his mother’s Divine Kingdom was suddenly breached by an unknown person and vanished into thin air right before his eyes.
In this era, transportation was convenient, housing was cheap, food and clothing were not a worry, and information exchange was smooth.
It seemed thriving on the surface, but there were also infinite risks hidden in the shadows.
If your Divine Kingdom wasn’t strong enough, you might vanish into thin air while eating, using the toilet, or taking a walk.
Zhang Wanshan had prepared a large table of dishes, mostly F-rank demon beast meat, with the main dish, Blood Python, being a D-rank demon beast.
From this, one could see that their family’s conditions were quite good.
After all, Yang Fan usually ate unranked beef, which naturally couldn’t compare to this in terms of nutrition.

“Xiao Fan, although the physical changes in us Divine Beings mainly come from the development of our Divine Kingdoms, eating more food with high nutritional value also has its benefits. Eat more of this Blood Python meat,” Zhang Wanshan placed a large piece of meat in Yang Fan’s bowl.
“Thank you, Uncle Zhang.”

Zhang Wanshan nodded and continued, “You’ve been quiet since you were a child, but don’t work behind closed doors when developing your Divine Kingdom. Communicating more with your classmates will be beneficial.”
Yang Fan nodded gratefully.

“Uncle Zhang, if the believers need too much food after practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, what’s a good solution? One that’s once and for all, where I don’t have to keep putting in resources later on.”
“What’s so hard about that? Just buy some livestock to put in the Divine Kingdom and scatter some grass seeds, isn’t that enough?”
“What if that’s still not enough?”
“You’ve only awakened your Divine Kingdom for less than a month, why are you asking this? How many believers could you possibly have?” Zhang Wanshan looked puzzled.
“It’s a question I saw on the God Forum. I’m just curious, since I might encounter it in the future,” Yang Fan found an excuse.

“This kind of low-level resource problem is only encountered by Divine Beings. If the population develops too quickly and the area of the Divine Kingdom is insufficient, the ecosystem indeed cannot be maintained by relying solely on herbivores as a food source. At that time, you can issue a divine oracle to clear some wasteland near the towns, then buy seeds for corn, rice, and the like. Basically, plant whatever has the highest yield. If there’s not enough meat, give the believers some carbohydrate staples. They don’t have much nutritional value, but they’ll fill their bellies.”
“Wouldn’t planting, nurturing, and harvesting take too much time?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Yang Fan had considered these things, but most of his believers didn’t have a talent for farming.
Relying on skill cards could only give them a basic understanding of planting, but the whole process was still too much of a waste of time.
Yang Fan hoped his believers could spend all their time on cultivation.

sentences.text: “Suddenly investing so many resources, combined with a tenfold evolution efficiency, has caused some imbalance in the food chain.
If the tribe continues to develop like this, even a million herbivores won’t be enough for them to eat.
The frequency of the alarm clock needs to be higher, and I must be ready to invest resources at any time,” Yang Fan thought to himself.
Afterward, Yang Fan bought a large quantity of grass seeds in the mall, such as Horse-Holding Flower, Earthy-Smelling Grass, Green Vine, and others.
These green plants covered the entire Divine Kingdom in just one year.
In the seventh decade, the elders within the tribe discovered that the population was simply too large.
Everyone living together caused massive destruction to the surrounding resources, and waste could not be processed quickly.
The surroundings were stinking and it was very easy to fall ill.
The tribe held a grand meeting, preparing to establish more tribes to disperse the population.
The final decision was to open four branch tribes, located about five hundred kilometers away from the main tribe.
As for who would be sent out, it was determined entirely by strength; only the strong were fit to live in the main tribe.
The tribal chief issued an order: if a child with high talent appeared among the descendants of the branch tribes, the family of three could move back to the main tribe.
Yang Fan did not actively interfere with the development within the Divine Kingdom.

After they reached their conclusion, he once again purchased low-level knowledge such as road building and bridge construction from the mall and invested it into the Divine Kingdom to help his believers avoid detours.
In the eighth decade, the believer population had reached a high of one hundred thousand, and the new tribes were fully formed.
They were named Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermilion Bird, while the main tribe was renamed ‘God’s Revelation’, signifying the place where the God delivered divine oracles.
On this day, Yang Fan once again felt the pressure coming from within the Divine Kingdom.
With the population explosion and everyone practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, the consumption of food was simply too great.
Relying solely on those herbivores was fundamentally insufficient to sustain them.
Yang Fan could feel that the growth speed of the vegetation had reached its limit.
Furthermore, the Divine Kingdom also had four seasons.
Once winter arrived, dried meat alone would not be enough to sustain them.
If he didn’t intervene, many believers would starve to death.
During this period, Yang Fan had also invested several food resource cards, which barely managed to maintain the balance.
While Yang Fan was browsing the mall to research solutions, he received a call from his best friend, Zhang Pang.
“Brother Yang, I’m waiting for you downstairs.
Come to my house for dinner,” a voice came from the other end of the phone.
Yang Fan rubbed his temples, feeling a bit groggy.
Although he felt his body had become much stronger due to the rapid development of the Divine Kingdom during this time, his mental fatigue had not been eliminated.
In these eight or nine days, he hadn’t had a single day of peaceful sleep.
“A Great Leap Forward style of development is still undesirable,” Yang Fan sighed, stood up, and went downstairs.
The Divine Kingdom was developing too quickly.
Over the past few days, Yang Fan had successively invested over a hundred thousand faith points.
Now, the Divine Kingdom looked thriving, but it was actually quite dangerous.
If he wasn’t careful and the ecology was destroyed, the Divine Kingdom would turn into a desert.
“Brother Yang, how is your Divine Kingdom doing?
With 5 million in resources smashed into it, I bet it’s completely transformed,” Zhang Pang said, coming up to put his arm around Yang Fan’s neck.
“It’s transformed a bit too aggressively.”
“Give you an inch and you take a mile.
Just wait for this month’s class exam; I’ll definitely blind your titanium alloy dog eyes,” Zhang Pang said, tilting his head proudly with a mysterious tone.
Yang Fan just smiled at this.
Barring any accidents, the one whose eyes would likely be blinded was the other party.
“Hearing that you were coming to dinner, my dad specifically cooked spirit rice and Blood Python meat.
Seeing how you look like you haven’t woken up, this should nourish you,” Zhang Pang’s father was named Zhang Wanshan, a well-known figure throughout the streets of Mingyue Community.
The quality of the crops Zhang Wanshan grew was quite good.
Combined with being cheaper than food in the mall and having no delivery fees, nearly thirty percent of the community were his customers.
Yang Fan’s parents often bought grain from Zhang Wanshan for their believers, and in return, he would buy some of their family’s iron ore—it was a way of looking out for each other’s business.
“Xiao Fan is here!
I heard you got a C-rank evaluation.
You’re the genius of our Mingyue Community.
Why haven’t you been out for a stroll lately?
I haven’t even had a chance to congratulate you,” Zhang Wanshan, who had a square face, gave Yang Fan a standard smile.
“Greetings, Uncle Zhang.”
“Don’t be so formal.
You two go wash your hands first; the Blood Python meat in the pot is almost ready,” Zhang Wanshan said before hurrying back to the kitchen.
Zhang Pang was from a single-parent family.
It was said that when he was very young, while the family of three was eating, his mother’s Divine Kingdom was suddenly breached by an unknown person and vanished into thin air right before his eyes.
In this era, transportation was convenient, housing was cheap, food and clothing were not a worry, and information exchange was smooth.
It seemed thriving on the surface, but there were also infinite risks hidden in the shadows.
If your Divine Kingdom wasn’t strong enough, you might vanish into thin air while eating, using the toilet, or taking a walk.
Zhang Wanshan had prepared a large table of dishes, mostly F-rank demon beast meat, with the main dish, Blood Python, being a D-rank demon beast.
From this, one could see that their family’s conditions were quite good.
After all, Yang Fan usually ate unranked beef, which naturally couldn’t compare to this in terms of nutrition.
“Xiao Fan, although the physical changes in us Divine Beings mainly come from the development of our Divine Kingdoms, eating more food with high nutritional value also has its benefits.
Eat more of this Blood Python meat,” Zhang Wanshan placed a large piece of meat in Yang Fan’s bowl.
“Thank you, Uncle Zhang.”
Zhang Wanshan nodded and continued, “You’ve been quiet since you were a child, but don’t work behind closed doors when developing your Divine Kingdom.
Communicating more with your classmates will be beneficial.”
Yang Fan nodded gratefully.
“Uncle Zhang, if the believers need too much food after practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, what’s a good solution?
One that’s once and for all, where I don’t have to keep putting in resources later on.”
“What’s so hard about that?
Just buy some livestock to put in the Divine Kingdom and scatter some grass seeds, isn’t that enough?”
“What if that’s still not enough?”
“You’ve only awakened your Divine Kingdom for less than a month, why are you asking this?
How many believers could you possibly have?” Zhang Wanshan looked puzzled.
“It’s a question I saw on the God Forum.
I’m just curious, since I might encounter it in the future,” Yang Fan found an excuse.
“This kind of low-level resource problem is only encountered by Divine Beings.
If the population develops too quickly and the area of the Divine Kingdom is insufficient, the ecosystem indeed cannot be maintained by relying solely on herbivores as a food source.
At that time, you can issue a divine oracle to clear some wasteland near the towns, then buy seeds for corn, rice, and the like.
Basically, plant whatever has the highest yield.
If there’s not enough meat, give the believers some carbohydrate staples.
They don’t have much nutritional value, but they’ll fill their bellies.”
“Wouldn’t planting, nurturing, and harvesting take too much time?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Yang Fan had considered these things, but most of his believers didn’t have a talent for farming.
Relying on skill cards could only give them a basic understanding of planting, but the whole process was still too much of a waste of time.
Yang Fan hoped his believers could spend all their time on cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Believer Status Ancient Humans
paragraphs: “This is a common misconception among newcomers, thinking that with just a copy of the Federal Body Refinement Technique, every believer can become like a dragon?
In a few more years, your Divine Kingdom will have a population of hundreds of thousands or even millions; surely not everyone can cultivate every day without engaging in production?
Humans are intelligent creatures; they know how to use tools, allocate resources, perform their respective duties, and will subconsciously divide themselves into social classes.
You only need to issue a divine oracle for them to sow seeds; you don’t even need to assign tasks.
Their internal system will naturally make those without talent or strength handle these administrative chores.
Ninety percent of the believers in a Divine Kingdom are consumables.
Their role is twofold: to engage in production to keep the Divine Kingdom running, and to earn Faith Points for us.
Another five percent are talented experts who might later break through to become Rank One, Rank Two, or even higher-order lifeforms through cultivation.
The remaining five percent will become even stronger and live longer lives, helping us manage the entire Divine Kingdom.
Just like in the real world, the population will reproduce, classes will shift, and survival of the fittest will allow this civilization to climb upward bit by bit.
If you intervene too much and make all of them work hard at cultivation, you’re actually destroying this system.
Perhaps your believers will become stronger in the short term, but that’s only because you’ve been spending Faith Points to sustain this system.
Once external blood transfusions stop, the system will collapse even faster.”
After listening to Zhang Wanshan’s explanation, a look of realization appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
In the past few days, the consumption of Faith Points had indeed been increasing.
Those elderly, weak, women, and children who couldn’t obtain food should perhaps be allowed to die naturally.
This was the survival of the fittest in the biological chain; as a god, he shouldn’t interfere in such trivial matters.

Zhang Wanshan took a sip of wine and continued enthusiastically, “These are all minor issues. If you can break through to become Demigods in the future, you can even sign agreements with other Divine Beings to have them grow food and gather resources for you. If you’re strong enough, you can even conquer someone else’s Divine Kingdom and treat the entire place as your granary.”
“Treating someone else’s Divine Kingdom as a granary? Is that legal?” Yang Fan swallowed hard.

“One of my classmates is a First-Order God, and I’m currently his Subordinate God. He’s the one who told me this. This world is like a giant arena where different Divine Kingdoms can wage war against each other. At any moment, tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of believers can be wiped out, and the core of a Divine Kingdom can be plundered. As Divine Beings, we only feel that those Demigods and Gods are high and mighty, but once you actually reach that level, you have to face even greater cruelty. This is all too distant for you. At least before you graduate from university, you don’t have to worry about anyone invading your Divine Kingdom.”
Zhang Wanshan was quite knowledgeable and told Yang Fan and Zhang Pang many stories about Demigods and even Gods, which both of them listened to with great interest.
After returning home, Yang Fan immediately searched for cereal crops in the mall.
“Corn Seeds × 500,000, price: 300 Faith Points.
Drought-resistant, wind-resistant, extremely high yield, strong satiety effect, no planting requirements.
Vegetable Seeds × 500,000, price: 500 Faith Points.
No planting requirements.
Spirit Rice Seeds × 5,000, price: 50,000 Faith Points.
The Divine Kingdom must possess spiritual energy and spiritual soil, and there must be believers who are Spirit Plant Farmers to cultivate them.
Yang Fan directly chose the cheapest corn and vegetable seeds, then introduced them into the Divine Kingdom and issued a divine oracle.
Following Zhang Wanshan’s guidance, Yang Fan did not intend to interfere too much in the life paths of his believers anymore.
If he continued to buy food to feed them, the population would likely keep increasing.
Eventually, the Divine Kingdom wouldn’t be able to support them, leading to mass deaths or even plagues, which would be counterproductive.
With a new food source, the tribe’s consumption of meat finally stopped being so excessive, and the ecology began to balance out.
In the ninth decade, the population reached 110,000.
Even with the boost from the Breeding Card, the tribe no longer expanded frantically, mainly due to environmental constraints; the population density was now too high and reaching saturation.
To continue growing the population, they would need to undertake massive construction projects to expand their settlements outward.
In the hundredth year, the effect of the Breeding Card officially wore off.
Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom.
Now, his believers had developed from a small tribe into something resembling a town.
God’s Revelation City stood in the exact center of the Divine Kingdom.
Due to the Moon Well and the Sun Spring, the aura of life was very dense.
The four cities of Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermilion Bird were situated in the east, west, north, and south, respectively.
Snake Valley in the south was now filled with Bodhi Precious Snakes; because the density was so high, the snake swarms were even beginning to spread outward.
Dark Night Vultures frequently appeared in the sky, looking for an opportunity to strike.
Various flora and fauna filled the mountains, and the roars of beasts echoed one after another.
The current Divine Kingdom had diverse species and a stable ecology.
The believer population had also reached saturation.
Next, using the Federal Body Refinement Technique as a foundation, he would rely on time and resources to strengthen the believers.
The death, reproduction, and cultivation of the believers slowly pushed the entire civilization forward.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster)
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom evolution, currently hidden.)
Believers: Ancient Humans (110,000)
Technique: Federal Body Refinement Technique
Faith Points: 1,070,988 (Daily Faith Points provided: 0.55)
Buildings: Moon Well × 5, Sun Spring × 5

Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (× 27,233, Rank One Demonic Beast), Dark Night Vulture (× 1,345, Rank One Demonic Beast), water lotus (× 21,000, F-rank Spirit Plant), soul nourishing wood (Century-old) (× 1,000, C-rank Spirit Plant)”
After a hundred years of development and various resource investments, not only had the believer population reached 110,000, but their status had also evolved from Barbarians to Ancient Humans.
When a Divine Kingdom is first awakened, everyone’s believers have the status of Barbarians.

As civilization evolves, with stable food, safe dwellings, city structures, the ability to pass down knowledge, and strength breaking through the limits of Barbarians, their status evolves into Ancient Humans.
After Ancient Humans come Mortal.
By then, the believers’ intelligence will have fully developed, forming a small human society with division of labor, trade of goods, and even schools to teach techniques.
Once the believers develop into Mortal, the Divine Kingdom will tend toward stability.
They will slowly form a social system, avoid over-exploiting resources, and allow the entire Divine Kingdom to develop healthily.
Further on, a tiny minority of believers will break through in strength to become Rank One lifeforms.
As for the direction, it varies wildly.
They might enter the Dao through martial arts to become Martial Artists; or practice Qi to become Cultivators; or even undergo mechanical ascension to become Intelligent Lifes.
Only when believers move beyond the realm of Mortal can Divine Beings begin the transformation into Demigods.
That was still too far off for the current Yang Fan.
Right now, none of his believers had even reached the Minor Achievement stage in the Federal Body Refinement Technique.
However, with the Evolution Talent, as believers developed over generations through survival of the fittest and genetic selection, descendants with good natural talent would eventually be born.
Yang Fan was in no hurry.

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Divine Kingdom Prosperity Assessment
paragraphs: Today was the day of the internal monthly exam for Class 7, Grade 12.
Yang Fan took out his virtual helmet and put it on.
In the Virtual World, more than half of the students from Class 7, Grade 12 had already arrived.
It seemed everyone took today very seriously.
Seeing Zhang Pang waving at him, Yang Fan was about to head over when a voice called out to him.
“Brother Yang Fan, after the assessment is over, I’ll treat you to a get-together at Tianxiang Renjian,” Li Shuhao walked over and greeted him.
Seeing this, many students showed expressions of envy.
A genius recognized by the Li family, his future achievements would at the very least be that of a demigod.
To be personally recruited by him meant a starting point much higher than others.
Yang Fan felt a bit helpless inside, but he didn’t show it at all.
“Sure.”
Since it was a public invitation, refusing again would inevitably offend him.
With his Evolution Talent, all he needed was to lay low and develop slowly.
As for the drama of showing off and stepping on geniuses, Yang Fan wasn’t interested.
Showing off in front of others feels great, but if one’s strength isn’t enough, it can be fatal.
“I’ll book a private room right now and send you the coordinates later,” Li Shuhao laughed.
Fifteen minutes before class, Li Qingying, the homeroom teacher, also arrived in the classroom.
“Since everyone is here, let’s get ready to begin.”
Li Qingying snapped her fingers, and the original classroom began to change, instantly transforming into a playground with a giant LCD panel right in front.

“The assessment is simple. An official intelligent lifeform will connect to your Divine Kingdoms and provide a comprehensive evaluation. This intelligent lifeform complies with Privacy Clause No. 1068 of Federal Law. Any high-value buildings of Grade A or above in your Divine Kingdom will not be displayed. The Divine Kingdom Prosperity range for Divine Beings is between 0 and 100. The higher the value, the higher the score.”

After explaining the rules, Li Qingying took out a tablet from her bosom and continued, “The order will follow the comprehensive evaluation from the awakening. The ones with the lowest evaluations will start first. Now, I’ll begin the roll call.”
“Ma Tutu.”
A slightly chubby young girl plucked up her courage and walked up to Li Qingying.
“Relax, the Federal intelligent lifeform is not aggressive. Open up your Divine Kingdom’s restrictions, and it will perform a full-domain scan. The results will be projected onto this large screen.”
Ma Tutu nodded slightly and then closed her eyes.
“God Lord: Ma Tutu
Believer Population: 1,532
Believer Identity: Barbarians
Strength: Shows signs of practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique.
Most believers are physically healthy, though 5% of the population has minor illnesses.
Attention should be paid to the environmental hygiene of the Divine Kingdom.
Buildings: Grade F Building - Plowing Fortress ×3
Assets: Blood Flower Deer (X100, Rank 1 Demon Beast), Three-Flower Spirit Rice (X10,000, Grade F Spirit Plant).
Comprehensive Evaluation: The Divine Kingdom’s ecology is stable with sufficient food.
There are over a hundred types of creatures such as antelopes, tigers, and lions, making for a complex and varied food chain.
However, the overall strength of the believers is too weak, posing a risk if they encounter large carnivores.
Suggestion: Purchase breeding cards to increase the population and purchase various basic skill books to enlighten the believers early.
Prosperity Score: 0.3”
Looking at the text on the screen, Li Qingying couldn’t help but shake her head.
“Go back down. Remember, developing your Divine Kingdom is the most important thing right now.”
Everyone received a Federal Fund loan ten days ago, but this young girl’s Divine Kingdom was too barren.
It was clear she hadn’t made full use of the resources.
There were no legal restrictions on those Faith Points; perhaps she used them for her family or for personal pleasure.
Li Qingying would only offer reminders and wouldn’t interfere further.
She was a teacher, not a nanny.
“God Lord: Sima Yuan
Believer Population: 5,024
Buildings: Grade F Building - Spirit Spring Well ×10
Prosperity Evaluation: 0.8”
“God Lord: Wang Anquan
Prosperity Evaluation: 0.7”
As expected of the Federal Government’s intelligent lifeform, it was extremely efficient.
Almost as soon as it connected to a student’s Divine Kingdom, all the information was projected onto the large screen.
However, the evaluation was indeed strict.
Over fifty people had been tested, and not a single score had even reached 1.
“Next, Zhang Pang.”
Hearing Li Qingying’s voice, Zhang Pang turned and gave Yang Fan a look, as if he were about to start his show-off session.
“God Lord: Zhang Pang
Believer Population: 11,243
Believer Identity: Barbarians
Strength: Has practiced the Federal Body Refinement Technique and the Grade D cultivation method, Iron Body Technique.

Buildings: Grade F Building - Plowing Fortress ×20, Grade F Building - Fertile Soil House ×20, Grade F Building - Natural Spring ×20, Grade D Building - Fully Automatic Seeder ×2, Grade C Building - Moon Well ×1, Grade C Building - Constant Temperature Greenhouse ×15
Assets: Body Strengthening Rice Ears (X10,000, Grade F Spirit Plant), Earth-Digging Earthworms (X1,000, Rank 1 Demon Beast), Wood Ganoderma (X5,000...)
Comprehensive Evaluation: The ecological environment is very stable with a clear direction.
Maintain current progress.
Suggestion: High-level planting talent skill books can be purchased to accelerate the tapping of believers’ potential and improve crop growth efficiency.
Prosperity Evaluation: 1.9”
Looking at Zhang Pang’s dazzling data, especially the building column, many students showed expressions of envy.
“So ruthless. Just how many Faith Points did Zhang Pang dump into this?”
“Old Man Zhang is usually low-key, but he doesn’t hesitate when it’s time to spend money. It really is good to rely on one’s parents.”
Li Qingying also nodded in satisfaction.
“In less than a month, to have a Prosperity Evaluation of 1.9, your family has put in a lot of effort. Keep it up.”
Zhang Pang nodded and returned to his seat, bumping Yang Fan’s arm and whispering, “Looking at my brother’s magnificent data, are your eyes blinded?”
“It’s okay, but compared to me, it’s still a hundred thousand miles away.”
“Damn, I didn’t realize you liked to show off too. It’s just a 5 million limit; what could you possibly have built?” Zhang Pang rolled his eyes.
There were no secrets in the early stages of a Divine Kingdom anyway, which was why Li Qingying organized such a public Prosperity Evaluation assessment.
Bringing up everyone’s Divine Kingdom data for all to see.
Seeing so many buildings and assets in their classmates’ Divine Kingdoms, how could those with weaker strength not feel anxious?
Pressure brings motivation, which would also make her teaching easier in the future.
“God Lord: Wang Zhenyu
Believer Population: 14,223
Believer Identity: Barbarians
Strength: Federal Body Refinement Technique, Grade D cultivation method Body Strengthening Art, Grade C cultivation method Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique.
Buildings: Grade D Building - wine pool and meat forest ×10, Grade D Building - Blood Spring ×10, Grade C Building - Marrow Cleansing Pool ×3, Grade C Building - Shikkotsu Forest ×1
Assets: Rank 1 Automatic Sparring Post ×100, Blood Shadow Wolf (X12,000, Rank 1 Demon Beast), Nether Cat (X20,223, Rank 1 Demon Beast), Bodhi Precious Snake (X11,234, Rank 1 Demon Beast)
Comprehensive Evaluation: The believers’ strength is not weak and is about to reach the limit of Barbarians.
However, there is too little meat in the Divine Kingdom, requiring constant resource investment to maintain ecological balance.
Suggestion: Do not over-pursue believer strength in the early stages of the Divine Kingdom.
Purchase more wine pool and meat forest to maintain consumption balance, or purchase unranked flora and fauna to improve ecological stability.
Prosperity Evaluation: 4.1.”
Looking at Wang Zhenyu’s data, many people showed shocked expressions.
The strength of Wang Zhenyu’s believers was actually about to reach the limit of Barbarians.
Just how many resources had been dumped in?
Moreover, he was definitely planning to take the combat path.
The believers focused only on cultivation, and the necessary resources could only be purchased from the outside.
For students from ordinary families, this was simply ‘inhumanly wealthy’.
Coming down from the stage, Wang Zhenyu looked at Li Shuhao and said, “Well? If you give me another ten days, I am confident I can transform the identity of my believers into Ancients.”

sentences.text: Today was the day of the internal monthly exam for Class 7, Grade 12.
Yang Fan took out his virtual helmet and put it on.
In the Virtual World, more than half of the students from Class 7, Grade 12 had already arrived.
It seemed everyone took today very seriously.
Seeing Zhang Pang waving at him, Yang Fan was about to head over when a voice called out to him.
“Brother Yang Fan, after the assessment is over, I’ll treat you to a get-together at Tianxiang Renjian,” Li Shuhao walked over and greeted him.
Seeing this, many students showed expressions of envy.
A genius recognized by the Li family, his future achievements would at the very least be that of a demigod.
To be personally recruited by him meant a starting point much higher than others.
Yang Fan felt a bit helpless inside, but he didn’t show it at all.
“Sure.”
Since it was a public invitation, refusing again would inevitably offend him.
With his Evolution Talent, all he needed was to lay low and develop slowly.
As for the drama of showing off and stepping on geniuses, Yang Fan wasn’t interested.
Showing off in front of others feels great, but if one’s strength isn’t enough, it can be fatal.
“I’ll book a private room right now and send you the coordinates later,” Li Shuhao laughed.
Fifteen minutes before class, Li Qingying, the homeroom teacher, also arrived in the classroom.
“Since everyone is here, let’s get ready to begin.”
Li Qingying snapped her fingers, and the original classroom began to change, instantly transforming into a playground with a giant LCD panel right in front.
“The assessment is simple.
An official intelligent lifeform will connect to your Divine Kingdoms and provide a comprehensive evaluation.
This intelligent lifeform complies with Privacy Clause No.
1068 of Federal Law.
Any high-value buildings of Grade A or above in your Divine Kingdom will not be displayed.
The Divine Kingdom Prosperity range for Divine Beings is between 0 and 100.
The higher the value, the higher the score.”
After explaining the rules, Li Qingying took out a tablet from her bosom and continued, “The order will follow the comprehensive evaluation from the awakening.
The ones with the lowest evaluations will start first.
Now, I’ll begin the roll call.”
“Ma Tutu.”
A slightly chubby young girl plucked up her courage and walked up to Li Qingying.
“Relax, the Federal intelligent lifeform is not aggressive.
Open up your Divine Kingdom’s restrictions, and it will perform a full-domain scan.
The results will be projected onto this large screen.”
Ma Tutu nodded slightly and then closed her eyes.
“God Lord: Ma Tutu
Believer Population: 1,532
Believer Identity: Barbarians
Strength: Shows signs of practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique.
Most believers are physically healthy, though 5% of the population has minor illnesses.
Attention should be paid to the environmental hygiene of the Divine Kingdom.
Buildings: Grade F Building - Plowing Fortress ×3
Assets: Blood Flower Deer (X100, Rank 1 Demon Beast), Three-Flower Spirit Rice (X10,000, Grade F Spirit Plant).
Comprehensive Evaluation: The Divine Kingdom’s ecology is stable with sufficient food.
There are over a hundred types of creatures such as antelopes, tigers, and lions, making for a complex and varied food chain.
However, the overall strength of the believers is too weak, posing a risk if they encounter large carnivores.
Suggestion: Purchase breeding cards to increase the population and purchase various basic skill books to enlighten the believers early.
Prosperity Score: 0.3”
Looking at the text on the screen, Li Qingying couldn’t help but shake her head.
“Go back down.
Remember, developing your Divine Kingdom is the most important thing right now.”
Everyone received a Federal Fund loan ten days ago, but this young girl’s Divine Kingdom was too barren.
It was clear she hadn’t made full use of the resources.
There were no legal restrictions on those Faith Points; perhaps she used them for her family or for personal pleasure.
Li Qingying would only offer reminders and wouldn’t interfere further.
She was a teacher, not a nanny.
“God Lord: Sima Yuan
Believer Population: 5,024
Buildings: Grade F Building - Spirit Spring Well ×10
Prosperity Evaluation: 0.8”
“God Lord: Wang Anquan
Prosperity Evaluation: 0.7”
As expected of the Federal Government’s intelligent lifeform, it was extremely efficient.
Almost as soon as it connected to a student’s Divine Kingdom, all the information was projected onto the large screen.
However, the evaluation was indeed strict.
Over fifty people had been tested, and not a single score had even reached 1.
“Next, Zhang Pang.”
Hearing Li Qingying’s voice, Zhang Pang turned and gave Yang Fan a look, as if he were about to start his show-off session.
“God Lord: Zhang Pang
Believer Population: 11,243
Believer Identity: Barbarians
Strength: Has practiced the Federal Body Refinement Technique and the Grade D cultivation method, Iron Body Technique.

Buildings: Grade F Building - Plowing Fortress ×20, Grade F Building - Fertile Soil House ×20, Grade F Building - Natural Spring ×20, Grade D Building - Fully Automatic Seeder ×2, Grade C Building - Moon Well ×1, Grade C Building - Constant Temperature Greenhouse ×15
Assets: Body Strengthening Rice Ears (X10,000, Grade F Spirit Plant), Earth-Digging Earthworms (X1,000, Rank 1 Demon Beast), Wood Ganoderma (X5,000...)
Comprehensive Evaluation: The ecological environment is very stable with a clear direction.
Maintain current progress.
Suggestion: High-level planting talent skill books can be purchased to accelerate the tapping of believers’ potential and improve crop growth efficiency.
Prosperity Evaluation: 1.9”
Looking at Zhang Pang’s dazzling data, especially the building column, many students showed expressions of envy.
“So ruthless.
Just how many Faith Points did Zhang Pang dump into this?”
“Old Man Zhang is usually low-key, but he doesn’t hesitate when it’s time to spend money.
It really is good to rely on one’s parents.”
Li Qingying also nodded in satisfaction.
“In less than a month, to have a Prosperity Evaluation of 1.9, your family has put in a lot of effort.
Keep it up.”
Zhang Pang nodded and returned to his seat, bumping Yang Fan’s arm and whispering, “Looking at my brother’s magnificent data, are your eyes blinded?”
“It’s okay, but compared to me, it’s still a hundred thousand miles away.”
“Damn, I didn’t realize you liked to show off too.
It’s just a 5 million limit; what could you possibly have built?” Zhang Pang rolled his eyes.
There were no secrets in the early stages of a Divine Kingdom anyway, which was why Li Qingying organized such a public Prosperity Evaluation assessment.
Bringing up everyone’s Divine Kingdom data for all to see.
Seeing so many buildings and assets in their classmates’ Divine Kingdoms, how could those with weaker strength not feel anxious?
Pressure brings motivation, which would also make her teaching easier in the future.

Comprehensive Evaluation: The believers’ strength is not weak and is about to reach the limit of Barbarians.

chapters.title: Chapter 15: How Lonely It Is to Be Invincible
paragraphs: Seeing Wang Zhenyu’s face full of fighting spirit, Li Shuhao showed a look of embarrassment.
‘Have I been showing off too much lately?
I hope I don’t trigger him in a bit!’ Li Shuhao felt a bit of regret in his heart.
In the past, Li Shuhao was a distant relative of the Li family, someone they wouldn’t even look at.
He didn’t even receive a living allowance, and his parents were merely Divine Beings; his family background wasn’t much better than Yang Fan’s.
In such an environment, he had kept a very low profile at school.
However, ever since he awakened the C-grade talent, Iron Body, he was immediately welcomed back into the Li family fold.
Resources were poured into his Divine Kingdom without regard for the cost.
The geniuses from Class 1, whom he could only watch from afar before, began to take the initiative to greet him.
Li Shuhao was just a young man under twenty.
Such a massive shift in status naturally made him feel a bit lightheaded, and showing off in front of his classmates had become his greatest joy during this period.
After showing off too much, Li Shuhao began to feel it was a bit dull, and had even been reflecting on it lately.
‘One should not worry about scarcity, but about inequality.
Have I gone a bit too far in front of these former friends?’
Li Shuhao coughed and said, “You are indeed impressive, but since I have family investment after all, my Divine Kingdom’s early development should still be a step ahead.”
The test was about to begin.
In front of the Federal Intelligent Life, his Divine Kingdom would have no secrets, so he gave Wang Zhenyu a heads-up to prevent the other party from having a breakdown.
It was no secret that he had been recognized by the Li family.
Using the Li family’s resources as a cover, even if he won the assessment, the other party wouldn’t lose too much face.
‘It’s not that he’s stronger than me, he just has a better life.’ People often comforted themselves this way.
“Next, Li Shuhao,” Li Qingying announced.
Originally, Li Qingying intended to let Li Shuhao be the finale.
In her heart, his Divine Kingdom’s prosperity should be the undisputed number one.
However, according to the Ministry of Education’s rankings for awakening evaluations, Li Shuhao was actually behind Yang Fan, so she couldn’t easily change the order.
As the Intelligent Life entered his Divine Kingdom, the specific data appeared before everyone.
“God Lord: Li Shuhao
Believer Population: 10,323
Believer Status: Ancient People

Strength: Federal Body Refinement Technique, C-grade technique Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, C-grade technique Muscle-Tendon Transformation Classic, D-grade martial art Tiger Roar Fist, D-grade martial art Light Body Art

Buildings: C-grade building wine pool and meat forest ×50, C-grade building Training Room ×5, C-grade building Moon Well ×2, C-grade building Sun Spring ×2, B-grade building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1

Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X100,000, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Flesh Lingzhi (X10,000, C-grade Spiritual Plant), soul nourishing wood (X1,000, C-grade Spiritual Plant), Demon Vine (X1,000,000, E-grade Spiritual Plant)
Comprehensive Evaluation: The Divine Kingdom’s ecology is at a stable critical threshold.
Even with a plant that reproduces as crazily as the Demon Vine, it still cannot provide enough fodder for millions of herbivores.
Suggestion: The number of Bodhi Precious Snakes is too high; they are even forming swarms under high-density living conditions.
Every time believers hunt, there are casualties.
It is recommended to reduce their number to 50,000 and purchase other Rank 1 Demonic Beasts.
Mixing the blood of different demonic beasts will improve the effect of the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.
Prosperity Rating: 12.3”
The scene was quiet for a moment, followed immediately by loud cheers.
“Brother Li is awesome! He even has a B-grade building. As expected of a genius from a great family.”

“While you guys were dazed, I went and searched. This Hundred Spirits Blood Pool can actually extract the flesh and blood of demonic beast corpses to condense into Blood Pills. Not only can they be given to believers to increase their strength, but they can also be sold directly in the mall. The annualized return rate calculated by big data is as high as 54.6%!”
“No wonder Brother Li is raising so many Bodhi Precious Snakes.”

“In less than a month, the believers’ status has already become Ancient People. That’s too exaggerated. Last year, when Yang County No. 1 Middle School graduated, some students’ believers were still Barbarians.”
“Is Brother Li still accepting Subordinate Gods? How about helping a brother out?”
The scene instantly became lively.
After all, the things written on that large screen were truly too luxurious.
Li Shuhao took a deep breath, maintaining his facial expression and trying his best not to look too proud.
He knew clearly in his heart that he could achieve this in such a short time entirely because of the B-grade building, the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.
This was bestowed by the elders of the Li family when he was recognized.
It was precisely because of that large quantity of Blood Pills that his believers’ strength improved so quickly.
“How lonely it is to be invincible,” Li Shuhao lamented in his heart.
In another half a year, the classes would be split.
At that time, he would have to go to Class 1 of the third year to compete with those monsters.
These days of showing off were becoming fewer and fewer.
Below the stage, Wang Zhenyu clenched his fists and then relaxed them.
His expression was no longer conflicted.
A gap that is too large has its benefits; it makes one unable to even harbor the thought of resistance.

“This guy Li Shuhao is right. He has the Li family’s investment. No matter how hard I work, it’s impossible to catch up. It’s not that I’m inferior to him, it’s just that he has a good life,” Wang Zhenyu sighed inwardly, no longer feeling jealousy, only envy.
Yang Fan wasn’t as fanatical as the others, but looking at that B-grade building, his heart was equally envious.
The higher the grade of a building, the more its effects and money-making abilities multiplied exponentially.

“Brother Yang, although that guy Li Shuhao can’t compare to those monsters in the top ten of Class 1, he’s definitely a genius-level figure. Being his Subordinate God wouldn’t be a loss. If possible when the time comes, how about recommending me too?” Zhang Pang said, rubbing his hands together.
Before Yang Fan could reply, he heard Li Qingying’s call.

“Don’t feel pressured. In the early development of a Divine Kingdom, resources have the greatest impact. Even an A-grade talent genius, if born into a commoner family, cannot compare to a piece of trash from a great family. Maintain a calm mind; the development of a Divine Kingdom is a long-term war,” Li Qingying comforted Yang Fan as he stood before her.
A B-grade building—many weak demigods probably didn’t even have one.
It was no wonder the gap was pulled so wide.
Yang Fan nodded slightly, then lifted the restrictions to let the Intelligent Life probe his Divine Kingdom’s data.
Before this, Yang Fan had already stopped the tenfold evolution.
Although he hadn’t heard of Intelligent Life leaking the secrets of a Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan would not take such a risk.
Aside from his SSS-talent, his Divine Kingdom’s development might be shocking, but it definitely wouldn’t exceed the scope of understanding.
There was no need to hide it for now.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Believer Population: 110,000
Believer Status: Ancient People
Strength: Some believers have reached the entry level in Federal Body Refinement Technique
Buildings: Moon Well X5, Sun Spring X5

Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X27,233, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Dark Night Vulture (X1,345, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), water lotus (X21,000, F-grade Spiritual Plant), soul nourishing wood (Century-old) (X1,000, C-grade Spiritual Plant)
Comprehensive Evaluation: Food is abundant, ecology is stable.
As an early-stage Divine Kingdom, the development is extremely excellent.
Suggestion: None
Prosperity Rating: 22.4”
“Am I seeing things? Yang Fan’s believer population is 110,000? That’s more than ten times mine?”
“What’s going on? There must be a mistake.”
“Why is his believers’ status Ancient People? It’s one thing to have a large population, but his strength is also this high.”
“How does he support a population of 110,000? He even got an evaluation of abundant food and stable ecology. This means his Divine Kingdom is self-sufficient.”
The students below all looked at each other, their faces full of question marks.
Zhang Pang’s eyes were wide as copper bells.
He only felt that the display screen was too bright and dazzling, making his eyeballs hurt.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: So He's a Top Student
paragraphs: “Teacher Li, there must be a mistake.” Wang Zhenyu’s face twitched below the stage.
He was perfectly fine with losing to Li Shuhao; after all, the other guy had a B-grade building.
But on what grounds did Yang Fan have such a high prosperity level?
Neither his buildings nor his assets seemed particularly special.
The only thing that was ridiculous was the believer population.
He had only just awakened and used a Breeding Card after going home.
How could there be such a huge gap?
And there were actually believers who had reached the entry level of the Federal Body Refinement Technique.
Was that right?
It was very wrong.
Only twenty-some years had passed in God Kingdom time, and this Federal Body Refinement Technique was created by High-tier Gods, containing infinite mysteries.
How could a bunch of uncivilized Barbarians reach the entry level without a hundred or eighty years?
The more Wang Zhenyu thought about it, the more ridiculous it felt, and he directly questioned the result given by the Intelligent Life.

“Shut up. The computing power of the Federal Government’s Intelligent Life is comparable to that of a High-tier God. How could it make a mistake?” Li Qingying waved her hand and interrupted him, her powerful divine aura suppressing the students present into silence.

Li Qingying turned to look at Yang Fan and said, “The population size is easy to explain, but I’m curious how your believers could reach the entry level of the Federal Body Refinement Technique in such a short time. Your development progress is likely comparable to those geniuses in Class One.”
After all, Li Qingying was a First-Order God, and her experience was naturally beyond what these students could imagine.
It wasn’t actually hard to raise the population from a few hundred to a hundred thousand in twenty years of God Kingdom time.
A C-grade or higher Breeding Card, or certain special buildings, could achieve that.
However, most people wouldn’t choose to do so, as the burden on the God Kingdom would be too severe.
But reaching the entry level of the Federal Body Refinement Technique was very difficult.
When a God Kingdom is first established, the believers’ aptitude is low.
One must either rely on time or use natural treasures or special buildings to improve their aptitude.
If this were in a great family, Li Qingying wouldn’t be surprised at all.
As long as they were willing to invest, even a trash constitution like that of the Barbarians could be forged into a cultivation genius.
But Yang Fan was just a child from an ordinary family, which made it stand out.

“Teacher Li, when my believers reached the third and fourth generations, a few geniuses emerged. Then I descended a Divine Decree for them to focus on cultivation, with plenty of Bodhi Precious Snake flesh provided. Only then did they barely reach the entry level yesterday,” Yang Fan had already prepared his explanation.
The better the believers’ aptitude, the higher the probability of geniuses among their descendants.
But the descendants of believers with ordinary aptitude aren’t necessarily bad either; with a large enough base, one or two geniuses will always be born.
Most importantly, this kind of probability issue was impossible to explain.
“You’re certainly lucky,” Li Qingying chuckled.
Li Qingying didn’t doubt this.
Since the dawn of the Age of God Kingdoms, there had been countless strange occurrences.
Yang Fan’s situation would only shock these students.
Seeing the students trembling under her pressure, Li Qingying withdrew her divine aura and asked, “Do you all think Yang Fan’s prosperity level evaluation is unfair?”

“Exactly. Never mind the others, but Li Shuhao’s God Kingdom is clearly stronger than Yang Fan’s, and he even has a B-grade building like the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool. How could his score be so much lower than Yang Fan’s?” Wang Zhenyu raised his question.
Yang Fan’s believers were Ancient Humans.
Based on that alone, Wang Zhenyu felt inferior, but Li Shuhao wasn’t bad either.
Furthermore, the gap between their data was too large.
In terms of asset value within the God Kingdom alone, Li Shuhao was likely hundreds of times ahead of Yang Fan.

Li Qingying explained, “prosperity level isn’t a competition of the overall strength of the God Kingdom, but rather the stability of its current ecology. Do you think it’s easy to get an ‘Excellent’ comprehensive evaluation from the Federal Intelligent Life?”
Seeing everyone’s confusion, Li Qingying directly called out Wang Zhenyu: “How many Faith Points do you need to invest in your God Kingdom every day now?”
“About 25,000 Faith Points,” Wang Zhenyu replied.
“Your population is only about one-eighth of Yang Fan’s, yet he is self-sufficient while you still have to invest so much every day. Don’t you think there’s a problem?”
“This...” Wang Zhenyu was speechless.
He naturally knew the current flaws of his God Kingdom.
Investing over twenty thousand Faith Points every day—it would be a lie to say he didn’t feel the sting.
But Wang Zhenyu couldn’t figure out how Yang Fan did it.
With such a large population and in the early development stage of the God Kingdom, how could he support them all on his own?
“This is the importance of theoretical knowledge,” Li Qingying said, her gaze looking at Yang Fan with increasing satisfaction.
“Theoretical knowledge is not unimportant.
Do you think you can just throw all kinds of biological resources into the God Kingdom and be done with it?
If it were that simple, all basic education schools except for universities could be demolished.
For example, what kind of environment is suitable for the Bodhi Precious Snake to breed?
Is it a vegetation-rich forest or a damp, dark mountain stream?
Besides the living environment, what is the most suitable food source for it?
If survival conditions are too favorable, will it over-breed?
Should natural enemies be introduced?
How do you control the distance between your believers’ settlements and these food sources?
Do you need to descend a Divine Decree to prevent over-hunting?
What plants are suitable for growing by the river, what are suitable for wasteland, and which ones aren’t afraid of the severe cold?
There is great knowledge even in the most basic plants.
If you had listened carefully in class and frequently studied in the school library after class, you could have planned ahead when you first invested the cards.
This would significantly increase the resource utilization rate of the God Kingdom.
Of course, plants and animals will undergo natural selection.
Animals will migrate if survival conditions are poor, and plants will die naturally.
But all of this takes time.
I can tell you quite responsibly that if all of this relied on the God Kingdom’s self-regulation, it would take at least several hundred years.
In reality, your entire high school years might pass before that happens.”
“Today serves as a very good example. I hope everyone can take the theory classes seriously.”
Everyone showed expressions of realization, and their gazes toward Yang Fan became a bit different now.
Previously, they only knew Yang Fan was low-profile and a man of few words; they didn’t expect him to be a hidden Top Student who frequently spent all his time in the library.
Li Shuhao also looked at Yang Fan curiously, feeling puzzled: “I didn’t see him in the library? Could it be that he borrowed books from the Federal Government’s public library?”

Seeing that her educational goal was met, Li Qingying directly announced the end of class: “The rewards for second to tenth place will be sent directly to your God Kingdoms. Everyone else is dismissed. Yang Fan, come with me.”
Li Qingying grabbed Yang Fan’s left hand, and their bodies turned into pale blue data and vanished before everyone’s eyes.
In an instant, the two appeared in an office.
“Do you feel very proud? That you’ve already surpassed your classmates by hundreds of years?” Li Qingying asked.
“I wouldn’t dare.”
Regarding Li Qingying’s speculation, Yang Fan could only say that his strength was entirely based on others’ wild imaginations.
Yang Fan had learned the God Kingdom theoretical knowledge well, but it was absolutely impossible to consider things so comprehensively.
The reason his prosperity level evaluation was high was entirely due to the two hundred years of self-regulation in his God Kingdom.
It’s just that even if he said it himself, no one would probably believe it.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Delayed Gratification
paragraphs: “You are steady enough, and you indeed deserve praise. I’ve truly never seen a student with theoretical knowledge as solid as yours. However, don’t be too proud. You are only leading those ordinary students, but compared to the descendants of those great families, this is actually a disadvantage.”
“Take the Luo Family and the Li Family, for example; they both have their own Actuaries. These people specifically help the younger generation arrange their Divine Kingdoms.”
“They have been immersed in this path for hundreds or even thousands of years. There are plenty of people in this session whose prosperity is higher than yours,” Li Qingying reminded him.
“Thank you for your guidance, teacher.”
“You took first place in this assessment, and I promised to give you a D-rank building. What type do you want?”
“Is there a building that can slowly improve the aptitude of believers?”

“Not pursuing rapid growth in strength, but focusing more on the foundation of the believers—you are quite good. However, what you want isn’t something a D-rank building can provide. Let me think.” Li Qingying’s eyes narrowed slightly as her consciousness connected to her own Divine Kingdom.
A moment later, she seemed to have found a target.
“The building you want isn’t available, but I have an adult Taisui. Do you want it?”
“A Taisui!” Yang Fan froze on the spot.
Yang Fan had read about it in books before.
A Taisui was not a demon beast, but rather livestock bred by top-tier Animal Husbandry Masters.
Its body was like a small hill and it did not move.
After its flesh was cut off, it would grow back the following month.
The meat of a Taisui indeed had the effect of changing aptitude, but it was very weak.
Most gods merely treated it as a meat-producing machine, similar to the D-rank building, wine pool and meat forest.
However, the value of an adult Taisui was as high as 2 million Faith Points.
Even among C-rank buildings, it would be considered on the more expensive side.
“Teacher Li, isn’t this too valuable?” Yang Fan said.
“I bought this in my early years. Nowadays, even the mortal believers in my Divine Kingdom find its taste too poor. It is of no use to me anymore; consider it an investment in you.”
“In the future, if you have the means, you can also purchase the B-rank building, Hundred Spirits Blood Pool. Placing the Taisui inside it can yield a steady production of Blood Pills.”
“Thank you, teacher.”
A Taisui was of immense help to the current Yang Fan.
Once placed into his Divine Kingdom, his believers could eat meat to their hearts’ content, which would be of great benefit to practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique.
“One more piece of advice before you leave. The artificial intelligence only judged your Divine Kingdom’s prosperity, but what I am giving is investment advice.”

“The investment returns on the Moon Well, Sun Spring, and water lotus are all too low. Your family circumstances aren’t great; you must learn to have your believers learn some crafts and do high-return work.”
“Divine Kingdom development requires massive resource support. After leaving the Virtual World, hurry up and pack these things up to sell them, and find some other investments to make.”
“So young, yet your investment style is more conservative than those old fogies. How can this be?”

“And one more thing: ordinary people shouldn’t even consider trying to produce a Fountain of Life. The probability of that is lower than meeting an old man on the street who takes a liking to you and hands over a hundred million Faith Points.”
“Yes.” Yang Fan’s expression was a bit awkward.
It wasn’t that Yang Fan hadn’t thought about making high-return Divine Kingdom investments, but for him, it was somewhat not worth the effort.
The higher the threshold, the higher the investment return.
This not only required believers to possess corresponding life skills, but Yang Fan would also have to frequently monitor the believers’ work.
Just like his parents, who had to descend divine oracles every day to direct their believers in mining.
If a mine was hollowed out, it would instead damage the foundation of the mineral vein.
Under the tenfold Evolution Talent, this was too energy-consuming.
One day of his own time was worth ten days of others’.
Even low-yield assets would become highly profitable.
His energy should be focused more on improving the strength of his believers.
If it weren’t for the fact that Yang Fan came from an ordinary family and was hardworking and studious, Li Qingying, as a god, would not have given him individual pointers.
After Li Qingying left, Yang Fan didn’t return to reality immediately because he had received an invitation.
“Brother Yang, I’ve booked a private room at the Tianxiang Renjian. The coordinates are ‘369, 110, 1742’. You can teleport here directly by clicking the coordinates.”
Yang Fan tapped the blue coordinates, and his entire being turned into data as he arrived inside a private room.
If he hadn’t known he was in the Virtual World, Yang Fan would have suspected all of this was real at this moment.
The fresh aroma of food, the scent of high-end perfume, and the sandalwood fragrance of the tables and chairs.
It made one feel as if they were physically present, with no sense of abnormality at all.
“How is it? Coming here for the first time, does it feel different from the classroom?” Seeing Yang Fan’s surprised expression, Li Shuhao couldn’t help but say.
“Indeed.”

“This is the entertainment district. If it weren’t made realistically enough, who would come here to spend money? From the perspective of the cerebral cortex secreting dopamine, this place is no different from the real world.”
“Brother Yang, you should still come here to play often when you have time. Staring at the Divine Kingdom’s development with high intensity every day is very stressful.”
“I’m not as wealthy as Student Li. All my Faith Points have been put into Divine Kingdom investments,” Yang Fan said, playing down his situation.
“Brother Yang’s personality really suits me. This seems to be called ‘delayed gratification.’ I used to read Divine Kingdom investment books in the library, and every book would mention this point.”

“The books say that if a god wants to become wealthy, they must learn delayed gratification. The Faith Points we earn must be reinvested into the Divine Kingdom. Compound interest is the number one miracle of Divine Kingdom investment.”
“Even if the annual return on investment is only 10%, as long as you persist for 100 years, your final return will be 13,780 times the original.”

“Brother Yang, don’t you think it’s magical? If an ordinary family could truly achieve delayed gratification, could they also become wealthy one day in the future?” Li Shuhao asked, taking a deep breath.
“I suppose so.”

“A month ago, I thought so too. I even planned that once my Divine Kingdom awakened, I would have my believers learn various life skills and then invest with peace of mind. After a hundred years, I would become rich and could let my parents enjoy their later years in peace.”
Speaking to this point, Li Shuhao stood up, picked up a glass of red wine from the table, and looked out the window.
“Until I awakened the C-rank talent, Steel Body, and the Li Family reached out to me, a disciple from a branch line. At that moment, I realized how laughable my thoughts were.”

“I am a second-tier genius of the Li Family. At that time, I received a reward of one B-rank building and twenty C-rank buildings. If this were in the past, it would be wealth I wouldn’t dare dream of even if I worked hard my entire life.”
“In addition, I have a monthly family subsidy of 2 million Faith Points and can enjoy an annual dividend of 10 million Faith Points from the Li Clan Genius Investment Fund.”
“I’m not afraid of Brother Yang laughing, but when I saw the Li Family’s legal team bring out this contract for me, I almost fainted from happiness.”
“What bullshit compound interest investment, what becoming rich through delayed gratification.”
“In this world, choices are far more important than hard work. Luck often makes reality much more dramatic.”
“Congratulations to Student Li on your meteoric rise,” Yang Fan remarked with emotion.
Yang Fan had truly broadened his horizons today.
He hadn’t expected the wealth of these great families to be so profound.

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Li Shuhao's Recruitment
paragraphs: Li Shuhao turned and stared intently at Yang Fan.
“When the Divine Kingdom first awakens, everyone has grand ambitions, thinking that as long as they work hard, life will keep getting better.”
“But the reality? Look at our parents. They constantly exploit their own believers. Their bodies are hunched, their hair is gray, and yet they must keep working.”
“A Divine Being has a lifespan of five hundred years, but most die of old age at two or three hundred. What are your thoughts, Brother Yang?”
“The Divine Kingdom’s resources are overextended,” Yang Fan said without hesitation.
His mother, Sun Rong, already had physical issues in this regard.

“The Federation has a poll tax. To earn Faith Points, every transaction requires paying personal income tax. Even the online trading platforms charge a 2% transaction fee. You have to realize that with how advanced the network is today, matching trades costs nothing.”
“Once we graduate and lose the protection of Federation law, we either have to become strong enough or find a backer.”

“Taxes on every aspect of life, various hidden expenses... The investment to cultivate believers for the safety of the Divine Kingdom, or simply finding a backer and handing over the lion’s share of the profits to them. All of this makes compound interest nothing more than a beautiful math problem.”

“The profit margin on Divine Kingdom investments is high, but if you truly only invest, then your Divine Kingdom is just a delicious piece of fat meat. One day, you’ll end up handing it over to an enemy along with your own life.”
“Classmate Li, you truly are well-read and possess extraordinary insight,” Yang Fan said admiringly.
Yang Fan’s words were sincere.
He was only in his third year of high school and hadn’t considered things that far ahead at all.
Li Shuhao’s insights and ideas gave him a lot of inspiration and served as a warning.
“Brother Yang, I’ll get straight to the point. I want you to be my Subordinate God.”
“I know that with your conditions, you actually have better choices. Even with a direct descendant genius like Li Tianheng, you’d be qualified to try. But before that, why not listen to my terms?”
“As long as you choose to sign a contract with me, I will subsidize you with 100,000 Faith Points every month. Furthermore, I can provide you with a B-rank building in a year’s time.”
“Most importantly, from now on, I am willing to purchase all resources produced within your Divine Kingdom at market price.”
“Of course, we’ll conduct transactions via transfers to legally avoid taxes.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression turned somewhat puzzled.
To seek protection, a Subordinate God’s resources are generally sold to the protector at 70% or even 50% of the market price.
He didn’t understand the point of Li Shuhao doing this.
Seeing Yang Fan’s expression, Li Shuhao explained, “Before today, I naturally wouldn’t have offered this price. However, this assessment has allowed me to see another value in you.”
“What value?”

“An Actuary. You have the talent of an Actuary. With only five million Faith Points in initial capital, you were able to develop your Divine Kingdom to such an extent within twenty days. I believe your talent as an Actuary is very strong.”
“I won’t take advantage of your Divine Kingdom’s resources, but I hope you can help me plan my Divine Kingdom in the future,” Li Shuhao said bluntly.
Yang Fan finally understood.
After all that, this guy had misunderstood him just like Li Qingying had.
“Doesn’t the Li family have its own Actuaries? Besides, I shouldn’t be able to compare to them right now.”

“For Actuary fees, the Li family’s first-class geniuses have a fund reimbursement service. I, however, have to pay for it myself, and the price is not something I can afford right now.” Li Shuhao’s expression was a bit awkward.
Yang Fan sighed and said, “Can I refuse?”
Seemingly not expecting this answer, Li Shuhao froze for a moment.
“Why?”
Li Shuhao was confident.
His terms involved no loss for Yang Fan; purchasing Divine Kingdom resources at full price plus a monthly subsidy was essentially a windfall from heaven.
“I want to follow the combat path. I don’t want to do logistics work.”
“Ah? But your talent...” Li Shuhao was in disbelief.
“Thank you for the gracious invitation, Classmate Li, but I have my own ideas. Besides, I don’t really have any Actuary talent; my Divine Kingdom’s development involved an element of luck.”
After a moment of silence, Li Shuhao finally set down his wine glass, looked up, and smiled.

“Even if the deal fails, the friendship remains. We are classmates, after all. Perhaps we can even run a Divine Kingdom investment together in the future. Since you’re here, I must play the host. Brother, let me treat you to a good time.”
“In that case, then I’ll thank Classmate Li... Brother Li.”
“Hahaha, follow me. I’ll take you to experience the local customs here.” Li Shuhao laughed loudly and pulled Yang Fan into another private room.
“This is the signature service of Tianxiang Renjian. Now that we’ve awakened our Divine Kingdoms, we’re considered adults and are finally qualified to spend money here. Brother, pick someone first.”
With a wave of Li Shuhao’s hand, a row of photos of female characters floated in mid-air.
“Name: Liu Ruyan”
“Measurements: 85, 58, 90”
“Personality: Open”
“Strength: Divine Being”
“Price: 10,000 Faith Points (Overnight)”
“Name: Bai Ningbing”
The photos were either enchanting, curvaceous, or pure.
Looking at them, Yang Fan couldn’t help but gulp, momentarily unsure of how to choose.
Seeing that Yang Fan hadn’t moved for a long time, Li Shuhao gave a wicked smile.
“Do you need a special type?”
“What are special types?”
“Married women, sisters, mother-daughter pairs... or if Brother Yang has heavy tastes, there are also Elves and Beastkin. If you want something even heavier, there are even beautiful Goblins.”
“Pfft.” Hearing this, Yang Fan almost spat out a mouthful of blood.

“Of course, Tianxiang Renjian also has Demigods and Gods to play with, but they’re all upstairs. We aren’t qualified yet, and with our current consciousness strength, we’d likely be played to death,” Li Shuhao joked.
“This place is way too ‘versatile’,” Yang Fan’s face twitched.

“Network technology is advanced; even if separated by two planets, communication can still happen on a consciousness level. But Brother Yang, rest assured, Tianxiang Renjian has an excellent reputation. The staff here are definitely not virtual characters; they are all real people from reality.”
“Life isn’t easy for anyone; they’re just out here to earn some subsidies. You know how it is.” Li Shuhao gave a look that every man understands.
Yang Fan coughed.
“I’ve never spent money in a place like this before. This is my first time, so...”
“Everyone has a first time. It’s a Virtual World anyway, so it doesn’t count as cheating on a future wife. How about I make the arrangements?”
“Then I’ll trouble you.”
“The day before yesterday, I heard a friend say that those Goblins...”
“Stop right there. I think this one called Liu Ruyan is fine.”
Li Shuhao showed a look of regret upon hearing this.
“In that case, enjoy yourself, Brother Yang. Let’s meet again when you’re free.”
As he spoke, Li Shuhao finished paying the fees and tactfully withdrew from the private room.
Yang Fan’s face twitched as he watched the other’s departing back.
He had a feeling this kid was trying to mess with him because he had just been rejected.
In another private room, Li Shuhao sat in the seat of honor.
A white-haired old man, radiating the aura of a Demigod, stood quietly to the side holding some documents.
“Uncle An, what do you think of this classmate of mine?” Li Shuhao inquired.
“Based on your description, Young Master, his talent is indeed good. However, the terms you offered were too generous.”
“He is a classmate, after all. I just didn’t expect him to refuse such good terms.”
“If the Young Master truly wishes to recruit him, perhaps you could start with his parents.”

“No need. Schemes can conquer a person, but they cannot win a heart. Developing a Divine Kingdom is a marathon. Relying on those underhanded methods will only result in mutual internal friction in the end. It’s always better to have one more friend than one more enemy.”
