chapters.title: Chapter 19: Constructing an Aquatic Ecosystem
paragraphs: Li Shuhao was born into an ordinary family and lacked the arrogance of those children from major clans; he was more willing to discover the shining points in people like Yang Fan.
“Young Master is right to lecture me,” the old man replied expressionlessly.
“How is the family loan proceeding?”

“An application has been made for 50 million Faith Points at an annual interest rate of 11.2%. For the first 5 years, only interest needs to be paid, followed by 20 years of equal principal and interest repayments.”
“Is this the maximum limit?”
“If Young Master demonstrates the value of a first-class genius, it can be increased to 500 million.”

“In that case, take out the full amount. Then spend 20 million to buy ten adult Taisui and put them all into the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool. Excluding the 11.2% capital cost, I can still earn an annual return of about 37.6%.”

“Uncle An, use the remaining 30 million to help me purchase resources, primarily to enhance the strength of my believers. In half a year, there will be the school’s class placement assessment, and I must give it my all. If I can be promoted to a first-class genius of the family, there is a very high probability of getting into a key top-tier university in the college entrance examination.”
“Yes, Young Master.”
After a full night had passed, Yang Fan finally returned to reality.
After all, it was his first time; having tasted the marrow, Yang Fan expressed that it was truly refreshing.
The lady named Liu Ruyan was very talkative, chatting with him for a full hour before getting down to business.
A sick younger brother, a gambling father, a mother who favored boys over girls, and her broken self.
Yang Fan only felt that the other party was a hundred times poorer than himself.
Under the dim lights, faced with such a pitiable beauty, no matter how cold-blooded he was, he couldn’t help but tip a drop of Moon Dew as a small token of his feelings.
Liu Ruyan offered herself on the spot; every posture imaginable was used, and the toys were endless.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but marvel that there were still many mysteries of the human body to be discovered.
Afterward, the two exchanged contact information.
At the critical moment of their ‘exercise,’ Yang Fan stated he would definitely patronize her business again in the future.
The sensations were too realistic.
He had clearly gone to relieve stress, but upon returning to reality, Yang Fan felt utterly exhausted.
“Amitabha. Women only affect the speed at which I draw my blade. It’s better to do less of this’saving people from suffering’ business in the future,” Yang Fan took a deep breath.
Adjusting his mindset, Yang Fan cast his consciousness into his Divine Kingdom.
With a thought, he placed the Taisui given to him by Li Qingying next to God’s Revelation City and handed down a divine oracle.

“My believers, this is god-bestowed meat. It has the effect of changing one’s aptitude. Strip the meat clean, and it will regrow the following month. Stronger believers shall have priority in the distribution.”
“We thank our God for the gift.” The believers knelt and kowtowed.
The moment the Taisui entered the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan perceived its specific information.
With his believers’ current consumption capacity, this single Taisui alone could provide all their food.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but marvel at this; it was indeed a treasure worth 2 million.
He probably wouldn’t have to worry about food for a long time, and even the grains he had planted a while ago felt like they could be abandoned.
When practicing the Federal Body Refinement Technique, eating meat was naturally the best option.
Subsequently, Yang Fan activated his tenfold Evolution Talent and returned to reality.
After witnessing the Li family’s Cultivation of geniuses, the small amount of pride Yang Fan had just developed was crushed.
Even if his resource acquisition ability was ten times that of others, he didn’t dare to be complacent.
“If only I could get more startup capital,” Yang Fan sighed.
Though a person’s heart is only the size of a fist, their desires are infinite.
Just a month ago, Yang Fan’s family’s monthly income wasn’t even 5,000, and now his minimum net income was 500,000, yet he was still unsatisfied.
Standing in different positions, the scenery one sees is different.
Previously, he wasn’t even qualified to come into contact with someone like Li Shuhao, so a sense of urgency naturally wouldn’t have been born.
Right now, he was still a student protected by Federal Law, but what about five years from now?
Never mind five years later—is Federal Law truly foolproof?
Rather than leaving one’s fate to so-called rules, it was better to make oneself strong.
“I must use every means to fill my Divine Kingdom, strengthen my believers, and break through to become a Demigod, or even a God, as soon as possible,” Yang Fan warned himself inwardly.
A call request suddenly came from his wristwatch at an inopportune time; it was Zhang Pang.
When the call connected, there was a burst of wailing and howling.

“Adoptive Father! You kept me in the dark so cruelly! A population of 110,000—how on earth did you do it?! Yesterday was my fault; I shouldn’t have tried to act cool in front of you. My eyes have been blinded by your magnificent radiance. Please, Adoptive Father, grace my humble abode so I may admire your great and glorious image!”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
“I’m not taking in any foster sons.”
“Then how about a biological son?”
“I can have my own, and I don’t need one as big as you. If there’s nothing else, I’m hanging up.”

“Don’t, don’t, don’t! With a brother who has such thick thighs to cling to, it would be against the heavens not to. I don’t ask for much, just give me some simple pointers on the development of my Divine Kingdom,” Zhang Pang said, straightening his voice.
“I’m afraid I can’t give many suggestions. I have things to do, hanging up now,” Yang Fan said and hung up directly.
Over the next few days, Zhang Pang either called or came to harass him in person.
Since he was his best friend, Yang Fan had to find time to offer some advice.
Looking at the development of Zhang Pang’s Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan found that his friend’s theoretical knowledge was ridiculously poor.
Aside from the reclaimed farmland near the tribe, which his father Zhang Wanshan had helped set up...
...the rest of the place was simply an eyesore.
Compared to him, Yang Fan’s theoretical knowledge truly deserved the title of a top student.
In just a few days, he significantly improved the ecosystem of Zhang Pang’s Divine Kingdom, instantly earning the other’s profound gratitude and gaining a little fanboy.
After dealing with his best friend, Yang Fan continued with his daily life.
He attended classes seriously during the day and browsed the mall and God Forum after school to study how to better develop his Divine Kingdom.
Now, the ecosystem within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was stable, and with the Taisui meat-making machine, there was more food than they could eat.
This led to the believers significantly reducing their hunting, and all creatures within the Divine Kingdom began to thrive and multiply.
What Yang Fan needed to do now was research how to enhance his believers’ strength.
Considering his Evolution Talent, he primarily focused his gaze on spiritual plants or demonic beasts that could slowly change one’s aptitude.
Items capable of improving aptitude were extremely expensive; 99% were at prices Yang Fan currently couldn’t afford.
However, if he chose those that took a particularly long time to take effect, the price would be relatively cheaper.
After browsing the mall for a long time, Yang Fan really did find some suitable ones.

“C-grade hundred spirit peach x100, price 100,000 Faith Points. (Merchant’s Note: Long-term consumption can improve believers’ aptitude. If you plan to develop toward Cultivation or Immortal Cultivation in the later stages, buy this without hesitation. There is an extremely low probability of believers’ descendants being born with Spiritual Roots.)”
“Needs to be planted with Resting Soil, and the peach pits after consumption can be replanted, with a 37% probability of sprouting.”
With a wave of his hand, Yang Fan bought them directly, and also purchased 10,000 square meters of Resting Soil.
With Yang Fan’s current believer population, these 100 peach trees weren’t even enough to fill the gaps between their teeth.
Fortunately, they could be cultivated further, which saved him a lot of Faith Points; time was the thing he cared about the least.
“Spirit Fish Baby x10,000, Tier 1 demonic beast, price 60,000 Faith Points. Long-term consumption has the effect of strengthening the physique.”
“Buy.”
Yang Fan also bought some grass carp, sea bass, mandarin fish, and various other aquatic creatures along the way, putting them into the river to serve as food for the Spirit Fish Baby.

To establish a simple aquatic ecosystem, he also bought some aquatic plants like water grass, algae, and water vines, as well as shrimp, pufferfish, and other aquatic creatures; he just bought them all in a bundle.
These unranked animals and plants were very cheap.
With Yang Fan’s current funds, he didn’t even blink.
As for whether these purchased creatures could survive, Yang Fan wasn’t worried at all.
Aside from the Spirit Fish Baby, the other creatures weren’t even considered assets.
Whether they could multiply in this ecosystem would be left to time to decide; time would filter out the best food chain combinations.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Small Circles
paragraphs: “Rank 1 Demonic Beast: Great Roc x 2,000, price 15,000.”
“Rank 1 Demonic Beast: Peregrine Falcon x 2,000, price 15,000.”
Yang Fan purchased them all, wanting to increase the number of aerial predators to prevent the Dark Night Vultures from dominating the skies alone.

After deploying the resources into the God Kingdom, Yang Fan once again sent down a divine oracle to inform them of the planting methods for the hundred spirit peaches and the existence of the Spirit Fish Babies.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
God Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (Accelerates growth of all resources in the God Kingdom by 10%)
SSS-rank Talent: Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate the Evolution of the God Kingdom, currently hidden.)
Believers: Ancients (110,000)
Method: Federal Body Refinement Technique
Faith Points: 970,988 (Daily faith points provided: 0.56)
Buildings: Moon Well x 5, Sun Spring x 5

Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (x 29,343, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Dark Night Vulture (x 1,665, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Spirit Fish Baby (x 10,000, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Great Roc (x 2,000, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Peregrine Falcon (x 2,000, Rank 1 Demonic Beast), Taisui x 1, water lotus (x 21,000, F-rank Spirit Plant), soul nourishing wood (Century-old) (x 1,000, C-rank Spirit Plant), hundred spirit peach (x 100, C-rank Spirit Plant)”
Yang Fan continued his calm life, attending classes on time, regularly browsing malls and forums, and checking for any unexpected situations in the God Kingdom.
In the blink of an eye, twenty days had passed.
In the God Kingdom, this was 200 years.
Exactly one month had passed since he last sold Moon Dew and other supplies, so Yang Fan prepared for another sales wave to replenish his faith points.
However, before he could enter the God Kingdom, he felt a warm current surge through his body.
Powerful energy flooded his limbs and bones; Yang Fan felt that he was more than four or five times stronger than before.
Noticing a massive change in the God Kingdom, Yang Fan hurriedly sent his consciousness inside.
“Believers: Mortal (120,000), daily faith points provided: 1.4.”
During these 200 years, the population of believers in the God Kingdom had actually experienced a peak and then a decline.
Around Year 100 of the God Kingdom Calendar, the population had surpassed 240,000.
At that time, the population density of Shenqi City and the other four cities was extremely high.
Various small tribes began to appear around the five major cities.
At the same time, the supply of taisui meat finally failed to meet the demand.
Believers began hunting to maintain their food supply.
Subsequently, people in the four major cities became dissatisfied with the distribution of taisui meat and initiated negotiations with the main city.
The negotiations failed, and war broke out.
The four cities of Qinglong, Baihu, Zhuque, and Xuanwu besieged Shenqi.
Known in history as the Rebellion of the Four Kings.
All of this happened while Yang Fan was sleeping, but even if he were awake, he would not have actively interfered.
Believers are human too, naturally possessing emotions and desires like greed, anger, and obsession; war only makes a civilization stronger.
As a god, as long as the civilization in his God Kingdom did not face extinction, Yang Fan would never intervene in its development.
The Rebellion of the Four Kings lasted for ten years, and the population plummeted to 80,000.
The final result was a non-aggression pact signed by one emperor and four kings.
Shenqi City would take 40% of the taisui meat, while the remaining 60% would be divided among the other four cities.
This war weeded out a large number of weak believers, leaving mostly the strong.
Thereafter followed nearly a century of peace, and the population soared again to 180,000.
Because the believers practiced the Federal Body Refinement Technique, the stronger they became, the more meat they consumed.
The current population of 180,000 could no longer be fully supported by taisui meat alone.
The population began to fluctuate dynamically.
During this century, Shenqi City nearly doubled in size, and the other four cities also established their own walled cities, significantly reducing population density.
Believers began trading, and those in power began to enact laws and establish rules.
Because of this, Yang Fan’s believers evolved from Ancients into Mortal.
Watching the development of his believers from a god’s-eye view, Yang Fan was very satisfied.
Perhaps it wouldn’t be long before Rank 1 lifeforms appeared among his believers.

“The Federal Body Refinement Technique is only suitable for building a foundation; even at its peak, it only produces Rank 1 lifeforms. Later, I’ll have to buy cultivation techniques and even various weapons. Relying solely on the believers to figure things out and pass them down is too slow. This all requires faith points!” Yang Fan rubbed his head; sometimes, the God Kingdom developing too fast brought its own troubles.
Yang Fan roughly assessed the assets in his God Kingdom.

He directly took out blank cards to withdraw all the Moon Dew and Sun Essence, then took 20,000 Bodhi Precious Snakes, 2,000 Dark Night Vultures, 20,000 Spirit Fish Babies, and 20,000 Water Lotus Seed.
All these resources were sold through the Taotao Network.
“Total income of 810,000 faith points. After deducting 10% personal income tax and 2% platform matching fee, the net income is 712,800 faith points.”
“Faith Points: 1,662,000 (Daily faith points provided: 1.4)”

Feeling that the biological chain in the God Kingdom was very stable, and in order to fully utilize his faith points, Yang Fan decided to spend 1.2 million to buy two more Moon Wells and two more Sun Springs.
“Faith Points: 462,000 (Daily faith points provided: 1.4)
Buildings: Moon Well x 7, Sun Spring x 7.”
With the level of development in network technology in this era, as long as one was willing to put in the effort, basically all knowledge could be obtained from the internet.
Therefore, the weight of knowledge taught by teachers in class was becoming lower, and daytime classes were becoming fewer.
Having a large amount of free time, even someone like Yang Fan, who didn’t enjoy socializing, began to participate in classmate activities.
It wasn’t because of boredom, but mainly because he gradually discovered that these classmates of his really had some redeeming qualities.
Unlike the God Forum, when talking face-to-face in the Virtual World, everyone was more sincere.

What kind of spirit plants can be grown on a large scale for the highest comprehensive return; what treasures can significantly improve a believer’s aptitude; whether there are cheap and powerful cultivation techniques; and how private trading to avoid taxes was actually legal.
Everyone searched for information online, refined and extracted useful bits, and then shared them with each other.
Yang Fan had to admit that humans were indeed social animals; the efficiency of collaborating was far superior to working alone.
Especially for a genius like Li Shuhao with a major family background, his information sources were far beyond what they could compare to.
Often, a single sentence from him would give everyone an epiphany.
A private room in Tianxiang Renjian.
Li Shuhao, Wang Zhenyu, Yang Fan, Zhang Pang, and over a dozen other male students from Class 7, Grade 12 gathered together.
With Li Shuhao, the big shot on the surface, present, many female students also wanted to participate.
However, the Tianxiang Renjian was a bit of an awkward place; with girls they knew in real life present, they couldn’t really let loose, so they stopped inviting female classmates later on.

“Brother Hao, besides the Federal Body Refinement Technique, my believers also practice the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique. Their meat consumption is simply terrifying. The production speed of the wine pool and meat forest can’t keep up at all. I have to buy meat from the mall every day now.” Wang Zhenyu took a large gulp of wine.
By now, he had moved on and no longer saw Li Shuhao as a rival, but instead followed his lead, calling him ‘Brother Hao’ at every turn.

Before Li Shuhao could speak, a somewhat short classmate raised his hand and said, “I have a livestock talent and have raised many Bodhi Precious Snakes. Especially non-ranked cattle, horses, sheep, and the like—I can produce an extra seventy or eighty thousand a day. Brother Wang, do you want to buy from me? We can bypass the mall taxes. I’ll give you a 5% discount; it’s mutually beneficial.”

“No problem, I’ll take as many Bodhi Precious Snakes as you have. But forget about beef and mutton; my believers are already Ancients and have mastered the basics of the Federal Body Refinement Technique. Ordinary meat simply has no effect anymore; it can only be used to fill their stomachs,” Wang Zhenyu agreed with a nod.

“Rank 1 Demonic Beast: Peregrine Falcon x 2,000, price 15,000.”
Yang Fan purchased them all, wanting to increase the number of aerial predators to prevent the Dark Night Vultures from dominating the skies alone.

After deploying the resources into the God Kingdom, Yang Fan once again sent down a divine oracle to inform them of the planting methods for the hundred spirit peaches and the existence of the Spirit Fish Babies.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array
paragraphs: Now, led by Li Shuhao, the boys of Class 7, Grade 12 had formed a small circle.
Aside from exchanging information, they also traded resources with each other.
Legally avoiding taxes isn’t shameful; after all, the government couldn’t possibly expect friends to pay taxes on transfers between themselves.
“Actually, you could buy an adult taisui,” Li Shuhao suggested.
“A taisui? That thing costs 2 million Faith Points,” Wang Zhenyu exclaimed.

“One taisui is enough to sustain your development for a long time, and eating taisui meat long-term has the effect of slowly enhancing aptitude. Its cost-effectiveness is far higher than a wine pool and meat forest.”

“Since Brother Hao has said so, I’ll go back and ask my dad for more funds to give it a try. The lack of meat is severely limiting the development of my Divine Kingdom,” Wang Zhenyu said, clapping his hands in determination.
Seeing this, Zhang Pang began to promote his own goods: “My dad recently harvested 10 tons of spiritual rice. The price is definitely cheaper than the mall. If any brothers need some, just call me.”
“I’ve raised quite a few fish-type demonic beasts. I’ll trade them all at 95% of the mall price.”
“I have meat lingzhi...”
Everyone had become familiar with each other during this time, and since private trading was mutually beneficial, they naturally spoke freely.
Wang Zhenyu turned to look at Yang Fan and asked, “Old Yang, do you have any more Bodhi Precious Snakes for sale?”
“I can give you another 20,000 adult Bodhi Precious Snakes. That will be 95,000 Credits,” Yang Fan replied straightforwardly.
Private trading was indeed cheaper than the mall, so Yang Fan didn’t mind selling some when the opportunity arose.

“Damn, you guy, how are you even more fierce than that professional snake seller, Wang Mazi? Another 20,000? If I didn’t know better, I’d think you were the one running a breeding farm. Keep them all for me, I’ll take them all,” Wang Zhenyu said with a wave of his hand.
He had no choice; he had been terrified by the meat shortage recently.
Buying from Yang Fan saved him 5,000 Faith Points directly, which was no small sum.
“I won’t have any more after this batch, so I can’t sell any in the short term,” Yang Fan added.
Although there was no shortage of food for the Bodhi Precious Snakes, their breeding speed wasn’t fast.
Plus, with natural predators like the Dark Night Vulture around, if he sold too many, the Bodhi Precious Snakes in his Divine Kingdom might become an endangered species.

“Just let me know when you have more. Ever since I started practicing the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, my efficiency in consuming meat has increased several times over. I don’t know when these hard times will end,” Wang Zhenyu said with a bitter expression.
At this moment, he actually envied Yang Fan for having a Divine Kingdom that could be self-sufficient.
Although the believers’ strength didn’t grow that fast, the god didn’t have to worry.
Wang Zhenyu felt like a nagging mother right now, with tens of thousands of sons waiting to be fed.
If it weren’t for his family’s support, his Divine Kingdom’s ecosystem would have collapsed long ago.
Li Shuhao suddenly changed the subject: “You’ve been working so hard lately; it’s for the school competition in a month, right?”
Everyone looked at Li Shuhao with curiosity.
After interacting with him for a while, they realized that he was always one step ahead of everyone else when it came to information.
“That’s right. My dad took out a loan to fully support me just so I could make a name for myself in the competition,” Wang Zhenyu nodded.
“Brother Wang, is there any inside scoop?” someone asked hurriedly.

“It’s not really classified information. The teachers will probably announce it in the next few days. Every year, in the first quarter after the Divine Kingdom awakening, all third-year high school students must participate in the Divine Kingdom War.”
“Divine Kingdom War! Really? We can participate so soon?”
Many people had heard of this term; after all, there was a lot of discussion on the God Forum, but experiencing it firsthand was a different matter.

Li Shuhao explained, “It’s not a real Divine Kingdom War. It just allows believers to fight against other creatures in a different space. At that time, not only will the school’s top management be there, but major families in Yang County, like our Li Family and the Luo Family, will also come to observe. If one performs well enough, there might even be investment.”
Upon hearing the word ‘investment’, Yang Fan, who had been listening silently on the side, instantly brightened up.
He needed resources too badly right now.

“That’s right, that’s exactly what my dad is thinking. My family background is decent, but that’s only compared to ordinary people. If I can shine in the competition and get noticed by a major family, even the scraps that slip through their fingers could change my destiny,” Wang Zhenyu took a deep breath, his expression somewhat grave.
“Brother Wang, you can definitely do it.”
“That’s right, we’ll all cheer you on then.”

Except for Li Shuhao and Wang Zhenyu, who were confirmed to be following the combat path, and Yang Fan, who was a’sneaky player’, the rest of the students had all chosen the logistics Divine Kingdom path.
Everyone would participate in the assessment, but eighty percent of the students were just going through the motions.
Therefore, after hearing about the content of the assessment, the others just listened to it as gossip.
Li Shuhao gave Yang Fan a meaningful look but didn’t say anything more.
Li Shuhao was the only one present who knew that Yang Fan wanted to pursue the War Divine Kingdom path.
With no talent for combat and no support from a major family, it seemed impossible for an ordinary person to pursue the War Divine Kingdom path in the eyes of outsiders.
However, since this matter involved Yang Fan’s privacy, Li Shuhao didn’t pry.
After becoming a second-tier genius of the Li Family, he had experienced a lot during this time, and his personality had become much more composed than when he first started.
After eating and drinking his fill, Yang Fan walked out of the private room.
Seeing that there was no one around, he hurried to another room, locked the door, and contacted his old friend, ‘Liu Ruyan’.
Now that Yang Fan had a small amount of assets, this 10,000 Faith Point expense didn’t mean much to him, and he often rewarded himself.
Having interacted more, Liu Ruyan also revealed quite a bit of her inner thoughts.
Yang Fan didn’t know whether her tragic family background was true or not, but once, when they were at a critical moment, Liu Ruyan actually answered a phone call.
A man’s voice, sounding like he was in his twenties, came from the other side.
Although Yang Fan felt excited, he still had basic morals.
He hurriedly stopped his actions, fearing that he might destroy someone else’s family.
As it turned out, the word ‘Mom’ that came from the other side was truly shocking.
At that moment, Yang Fan felt—’It’s even more fucking exciting’.
A few more days passed, and Yang Fan attended class as usual.

Li Qingying, standing on the podium, suddenly announced: “In one month, the entire third-year grade will participate in the final examination. The assessment will be conducted within our principal’s Divine Kingdom. Your opponents will be various demonic beasts, and your believers will be transferred to the Divine Kingdom battlefield in their true forms. This will be the first real war you encounter in your lives.”
The boys in the class had already heard this news back at the Tianxiang Renjian, so they didn’t look very surprised, but the girls were much more lively.
“Is it the Divine Kingdom War? We have to participate so soon?”
“I’m a bit excited, but also a bit scared. What’s going on?”

“It is not a real Divine Kingdom War. What you will face are various demonic beasts specifically raised by the Federal Government. While these demonic beasts might be stronger than your believers in terms of individual strength, they do not understand cooperation, nor do they know any formations, so the danger is not high. If you are worried about your believers suffering too many casualties, you can also retreat at any time,” Li Qingying explained.
“Next, please open your inboxes.”
“Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array.” Yang Fan discovered that there was actually a skill card in his inbox.

“This is an F-rank formation card provided free of charge by the Federal Government to all third-year high school students. The market value of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array is as high as 100,000 Faith Points.”

Your opponents will be various demonic beasts, and your believers will be transferred to the Divine Kingdom battlefield in their true forms.
This will be the first real war you encounter in your lives.”
The boys in the class had already heard this news back at the Tianxiang Renjian, so they didn’t look very surprised, but the girls were much more lively.
“Is it the Divine Kingdom War?
We have to participate so soon?”
“I’m a bit excited, but also a bit scared.
What’s going on?”
“It is not a real Divine Kingdom War.
What you will face are various demonic beasts specifically raised by the Federal Government.
While these demonic beasts might be stronger than your believers in terms of individual strength, they do not understand cooperation, nor do they know any formations, so the danger is not high.
If you are worried about your believers suffering too many casualties, you can also retreat at any time,” Li Qingying explained.
“Next, please open your inboxes.”
“Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array.” Yang Fan discovered that there was actually a skill card in his inbox.
“This is an F-rank formation card provided free of charge by the Federal Government to all third-year high school students.
The market value of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array is as high as 100,000 Faith Points.”

chapters.title: Chapter 22: The Relationship Between Gods and Divine Kingdoms
paragraphs: Upon hearing the value of this card, the eyes of many students lit up.

Looking at the expressions of the students ranked lower in the class, Li Qingying sighed softly and said, “With ten thousand believers, one can set up this great array. Practicing with this formation even aids in cultivating the Federal Body Refinement Technique, significantly improving the believers’ physiques. If you haven’t already resolved to follow the Logistics Path, it’s best not to sell this formation card.”
Li Qingying knew in her heart that the assessment in a month’s time wasn’t aimed at all students; the school truly wanted to screen for geniuses with combat capabilities.
“Yay!”
Many students let out excited cheers.
Although the assessment had nothing to do with them, gaining a hundred thousand Faith Points for free to make some investments in their Divine Kingdoms would make life much easier for their families.

“Over the next month, I will teach you how to deploy the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, organize for battle, and even use the array for cultivation. Students determined to follow the Logistics Path do not need to attend. Everyone else, listen carefully. If you perform excellently in this grand exam, you may even have the chance to receive investment from major families.”
“Yes, Teacher!” Many students present still had burning gazes.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan immediately deployed the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array into his Divine Kingdom.

“This is the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array. Ten thousand people shall form one squad. This array can assist you in cultivating the Federal Body Refinement Technique. In three hundred years, there will be a war against foreign races. During this period, you must not kill one another; everyone must cultivate with all their strength,” Yang Fan descended his Divine Decree.
“We obey the Divine Decree!” The entire human race in the Divine Kingdom knelt to the ground.
Under his tenfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan did not immediately exit the Divine Kingdom.
Instead, he silently observed the performance of his believers.
Perhaps it was because their aptitude was too poor, or perhaps the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array was too complex.
After one year in the Divine Kingdom, the best-performing squad from God-Awakened City was still crooked.
After practicing for an entire year, a squad of ten thousand people couldn’t even manage to move in unison.
“Is their aptitude this poor? Their bodies aren’t even coordinated; trying to cooperate is worse than not cooperating at all.” Back in reality, Yang Fan couldn’t help but shake his head and sigh.
As the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array skill card was loaded into the Divine Kingdom, the details of the formation naturally appeared in Yang Fan’s mind.
Although this formation was complex, in Yang Fan’s view, mastering its basic form was quite easy.
Yang Fan opened his smartwatch and typed ‘Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array’ into the search bar of the God Forum.

“OP must be a high schooler, right? Are you about to take the school-wide quarterly grand exam? Here’s a suggestion: don’t be silly and let your believers practice on their own. Their life level is too low right now, they’re dumb as bricks, and letting them figure it out themselves is a waste of time.”

“First floor is right. OP can buy some basic formation knowledge from the mall to load into the Divine Kingdom, but you also need to study the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array yourself. As Gods, our life level is higher. Once you understand the key points of the formation, you can directly descend a Divine Decree so your believers avoid unnecessary detours.”
Furthermore, during the assessment, you’ll have to command the battle yourself.
If you know nothing about formations, you might end up being a hindrance.
It wouldn’t be worth it if your believers are slaughtered en masse by demonic beasts.”

“Stop browsing the God Forum. The school’s teachers are at least First-Order Gods. Make sure to listen well during this time. Once you enter society, the price to hire a God to guide you in formation cultivation is ridiculously high.”
“Good luck, OP. Hope you get good grades.”
Many people were asking on the God Forum, and there were even a large number of posts from previous years.
Yang Fan browsed through them roughly and gained a clear understanding of the direction he should work toward.
The next day in class, only about a third of the students showed up.
The rest had completely given up on the path of a War Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan listened very intently.
Under the teaching of Li Qingying, a First-Order God, his understanding of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array advanced by leaps and bounds.

The transformations of the array, the movement of the formation eye, how to defend, attack, and maneuver—even using the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to assist in cultivation and enhance the strength of the believers.
Li Qingying taught from the simple to the profound.
In just one class, the difficult points he couldn’t figure out yesterday suddenly became clear.
Yang Fan noticed that even Li Shuhao was listening intently; it seemed the forum’s claims were not false.
One day in the outside world meant ten years had passed in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Projecting his consciousness in again, he found that his believers hadn’t made much progress.
Although the squads stood more neatly, many positional details were wrong.
If they participated in the grand exam in this state, the formation would collapse under a single wave of demonic beast attacks.
Yang Fan immediately descended a Divine Decree, transmitting his understanding of the formation and the knowledge taught by Li Qingying in class directly into the minds of his believers.
He let everyone memorize it first; given enough time, they would eventually understand it.
Next, Yang Fan did not return to reality.
Instead, he watched the believers practice the formation.
Whenever he saw a flaw, he would directly descend an oracle to correct it.
Fortunately, only Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom.
In his eyes, the changes within were like a slideshow on fast-forward; while he could clearly perceive every detail, his sense of time remained anchored to reality.
Otherwise, spending ten years just like that would have surely caused Yang Fan’s mind to collapse.
That night, Yang Fan stayed up very late.
It wasn’t until one in the morning that he returned to reality and forced himself to sleep.
Under his guidance, the believers’ comprehension of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array had improved rapidly.
In just one night, he had saved his believers at least several decades of time.
These changes also gave Yang Fan another layer of understanding regarding the development of a Divine Kingdom.
A God should not actively interfere with the survival, reproduction, or evolution of their believers, nor should they destroy a stable ecosystem.
But this didn’t mean the God should do nothing.
Relying solely on the natural evolution of the Divine Kingdom was too slow, and it was even possible for the entire civilization to stagnate.
Therefore, a God must provide appropriate positive guidance.
For example, the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array was purely beneficial to the believers.
In such a situation, he could fully utilize all resources to accelerate this evolution.
Strong believers would in turn nourish the God, and the God should likewise provide resources for the Divine Kingdom to assist the believers’ growth.
On the surface, the Divine Kingdom and the God seemed to have a master-subordinate relationship, but in reality, it was a symbiotic one.
The Divine Kingdom was the God’s wealth, and the God was the Divine Kingdom’s safeguard.
If he completely neglected the Divine Kingdom just because he had the Evolution Talent, he would eventually fade into mediocrity.
Even with ten times the resources of an ordinary person, with the current aptitude of his believers, they wouldn’t be able to comprehend those high-level techniques at all.
If progress itself was zero, it wouldn’t matter if the time flow was multiplied by ten, a hundred, or a thousand—it would still be zero.
In the following days, aside from attending classes, Yang Fan’s consciousness was basically always within his Divine Kingdom, frequently descending Divine Decrees.
With his help, the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array practiced by the believers had now taken its proper form.
By the fiftieth year of practicing the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, Yang Fan felt it was already quite decent.
Now, a squad of ten thousand, relying on the array on a battlefield, would have their overall strength increased by at least threefold.
By the hundredth year, Yang Fan felt he had taught them almost everything he could.
Although there were still minor flaws, there were no obvious weaknesses when the array was deployed.
If it were just mindless demonic beasts, they could never easily break the formation, not even a small-scale beast tide.
By the hundred and fiftieth year, those believers had begun to use the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to assist their cultivation.
The major main cities organized military sparring matches, first to test the array’s true combat power, and second to cultivate the Federal Body Refinement Technique through actual combat.
By the two-hundredth year, the supply of taisui meat alone could no longer support the army’s consumption.
The Emperor of God-Awakened City issued a military order for the Four Kings to send troops to Snake Valley to hunt the Bodhi Precious Snakes.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: The Five Great Armies
paragraphs: This battle between humans and demonic beasts lasted for a full two years.
Nearly fifty thousand adult Bodhi Precious Snakes were hunted and transported back to the major cities in batches.
Knowing all this, Yang Fan naturally felt his heart race; this represented two hundred and fifty thousand Faith Points.
After several centuries of development, the Bodhi Precious Snakes had spread from the original Snake Valley to the entire mountain range, numbering over a hundred thousand.
However, this unorganized combat power remained vulnerable before the human race, which had already mastered the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array.
Perhaps because he had once issued a Sacred Decree, his believers withdrew their troops and returned to their cities after hunting nearly half of the Bodhi Precious Snakes.
Yang Fan did not stop them.
The High School Senior Year-wide Assessment was coming up soon, and he needed to improve his believers’ strength as quickly as possible to make a name for himself and secure investment.
Even without these Bodhi Precious Snakes, Yang Fan would have found ways to invest other meat resources.
“As the believers grow stronger, their resource consumption is truly terrifying. No wonder everyone is living under such pressure,” Yang Fan sighed softly.

Although Yang Fan’s efficiency in earning resources was ten times that of others thanks to his Evolution Talent, if his Divine Kingdom could not be self-sufficient and required external resources, the consumption would also be ten times higher.
Another thirty years passed within the Divine Kingdom, and the believers’ strength grew ever greater.
By now, Yang Fan could no longer guide them regarding the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array; in fact, watching his believers practice the formation provided Yang Fan with many insights.
After all, it was only an F-rank array.
Through over two hundred years of exploration, several generations of the army had passed, but the knowledge had been inherited.
Now, when the believers utilized the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, it possessed not only the form but also a hint of true spirit.
Yang Fan knew this meant his believers had cultivated the array to Minor Achievement.
One day, just after Yang Fan finished class and before he had even exited the Virtual World, he felt a change in his body.
An invisible energy surged through his entire body, and his cells, flesh, and bones all began to undergo a mutation.
Cracking sounds echoed from various parts of his body.
Yang Fan, who forcibly exited the Virtual World, didn’t even have time to take off his helmet before he broke out in a cold sweat from the pain.
A Tier 1 Being had been born within the Divine Kingdom.
As a Divine Being, his ability to accept physical mutations was strong.
Within just a few dozen breaths, the pain vanished.
Yang Fan stood up and threw a punch into the air in front of him.
With a sharp sound, the air rippled from the impact.
“Just the birth of a single Tier 1 Being has made my body this much stronger. To what extent must the bodies of those demigods or even gods be strengthened!” Yang Fan swallowed hard.
His consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom and immediately located that Tier 1 Being—it was the Emperor of Shenqi City.
By crossing into Tier 1 and transcending the level of ordinary mortals, his lifespan would increase by two hundred years.

The increase in lifespan was secondary; the most important thing was that the breakthrough in life tier would have a marrow-cleansing effect, allowing this Emperor to produce more excellent descendants in the future.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster)
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, currently hidden.)
Believers: Tier 1 Being (1), Mortals (150,000)
Methods: Federal Body Refinement Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Minor Achievement)
Faith Points: 833,000 (Daily Faith Points provided: 2.6)
Buildings: Moon Well X7, Sun Spring X7

Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X88,765, Tier 1 Demonic Beast), Dark Night Vulture (X31,222, Tier 1 Demonic Beast), Spirit Fish Baby (X102,620, Tier 1 Demonic Beast), Great Roc (X45,533, Tier 1 Demonic Beast), Peregrine Falcon (X42,332, Tier 1 Demonic Beast), Taisui X1, water lotus (X21,000, F-rank Spiritual Plant), soul nourishing wood (Century-old) (X1,000, C-rank Spiritual Plant), hundred spirit peach (X25,711, C-rank Spiritual Plant)”
Looking at the current state of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan decided to intervene actively.

He sold twenty thousand each of the Dark Night Vultures, Peregrine Falcons, and Great Rocs, and in turn, purchased a full one hundred thousand adult Bodhi Precious Snakes, releasing them around the five major cities.
Currently, the ecosystem within the Divine Kingdom was insufficient to support the believers’ development, and many people had begun hunting herbivores like antelopes for food.
Since it was time for a pre-exam sprint, resources naturally had to be in ample supply.
The reason for selling those flying demonic beasts was primarily because his believers currently lacked anti-air measures.
The weapons in the Divine Kingdom were still in the Stone Age; the only long-range attack method, bows and arrows, were made of wood.
They were fine for shooting antelopes, but trying to hunt Tier 1 flying demonic beasts with them was a pipe dream.
This resulted in these flying demonic beasts having no natural enemies.
In terms of hunting Bodhi Precious Snakes, these beasts were in direct competition with the human race.
The rivers in the Divine Kingdom were large enough, and combined with the believers’ lack of fishing methods, the Spirit Fish Babies were also breeding frantically.

“There are still many detailed issues to resolve in the Divine Kingdom, but for now, I must focus entirely on developing the army’s strength. To grow powerful quickly, I must obtain investment from the Great Families,” Yang Fan murmured to himself.
After coming into contact with Li Shuhao, Yang Fan’s mindset had changed.
Relying solely on his SSS-rank Talent to make a fortune in silence was not feasible.
Divine Beings only had a lifespan of five hundred years, and his starting point was too low.
Compared to the wealth of those Great Families, his startup capital could be said to be infinitely close to zero.
A person needs to be cautious and down-to-earth.
But if a massive opportunity presents itself, one must also exert all their strength to seize that hope.
Sometimes, choice is greater than talent, and the platform is greater than effort; being stuck in one’s ways is just a synonym for cowardice.
As the one hundred thousand Bodhi Precious Snakes were introduced into the Divine Kingdom, the meat supply became sufficient.
An arms race began between the cities, all for the sake of fighting for their God in the upcoming War Against Alien Races.
Seven days passed in a flash, and now a total of six Tier 1 Beings had been born in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
The five major cities each selected their strongest adult males to form five armies.
The Divine Revelation Army consisted of ten thousand elite troops governed by two Tier 1 Beings.
Baihu, Qinglong, Xuanwu, and Zhuque each named their armies after their respective cities, with each ten-thousand-man army led by a Tier 1 Being.
Watching the armies drill, Yang Fan could feel a wave of murderous, bloody aura washing over him.

Due to the one hundred thousand Bodhi Precious Snakes Yang Fan had invested, his believers had spent these years practicing their cultivation while participating in actual combat to hunt the demonic beasts.
Those were Tier 1 Demonic Beasts; even a Tier 1 Being believer might not be a match for one with bare hands.
Every hunt for the Bodhi Precious Snakes resulted in sacrifices, followed by new recruits being added to the army.
Through such high-intensity combat training, they had become a battle-hardened force.
In one month, the comprehensive combat power of his Divine Kingdom had increased by more than tenfold, and Yang Fan was very satisfied with this.
“Faith Points: 422,030”
Due to the resource investment during this period, Yang Fan’s liquid capital was now less than five hundred thousand.
Yang Fan took out a blank card and collected all the Moon Dew, Sun Essence, and Water Lotus Seeds from the warehouse.
Through selling them in the mall, he harvested a total of about eight hundred thousand Faith Points after taxes, bringing his total funds back to 1.2 million.

The rivers in the Divine Kingdom were large enough, and combined with the believers’ lack of fishing methods, the Spirit Fish Babies were also breeding frantically.
“There are still many detailed issues to resolve in the Divine Kingdom, but for now, I must focus entirely on developing the army’s strength.
To grow powerful quickly, I must obtain investment from the Great Families,” Yang Fan murmured to himself.
After coming into contact with Li Shuhao, Yang Fan’s mindset had changed.
Relying solely on his SSS-rank Talent to make a fortune in silence was not feasible.
Divine Beings only had a lifespan of five hundred years, and his starting point was too low.
Compared to the wealth of those Great Families, his startup capital could be said to be infinitely close to zero.
A person needs to be cautious and down-to-earth.
But if a massive opportunity presents itself, one must also exert all their strength to seize that hope.
Sometimes, choice is greater than talent, and the platform is greater than effort; being stuck in one’s ways is just a synonym for cowardice.
As the one hundred thousand Bodhi Precious Snakes were introduced into the Divine Kingdom, the meat supply became sufficient.
An arms race began between the cities, all for the sake of fighting for their God in the upcoming War Against Alien Races.
Seven days passed in a flash, and now a total of six Tier 1 Beings had been born in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
The five major cities each selected their strongest adult males to form five armies.
The Divine Revelation Army consisted of ten thousand elite troops governed by two Tier 1 Beings.
Baihu, Qinglong, Xuanwu, and Zhuque each named their armies after their respective cities, with each ten-thousand-man army led by a Tier 1 Being.
Watching the armies drill, Yang Fan could feel a wave of murderous, bloody aura washing over him.

Due to the one hundred thousand Bodhi Precious Snakes Yang Fan had invested, his believers had spent these years practicing their cultivation while participating in actual combat to hunt the demonic beasts.
Those were Tier 1 Demonic Beasts; even a Tier 1 Being believer might not be a match for one with bare hands.
Every hunt for the Bodhi Precious Snakes resulted in sacrifices, followed by new recruits being added to the army.
Through such high-intensity combat training, they had become a battle-hardened force.
In one month, the comprehensive combat power of his Divine Kingdom had increased by more than tenfold, and Yang Fan was very satisfied with this.
“Faith Points: 422,030”
Due to the resource investment during this period, Yang Fan’s liquid capital was now less than five hundred thousand.
Yang Fan took out a blank card and collected all the Moon Dew, Sun Essence, and Water Lotus Seeds from the warehouse.
Through selling them in the mall, he harvested a total of about eight hundred thousand Faith Points after taxes, bringing his total funds back to 1.2 million.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Purchasing Weapons The Grand Competition Begins
paragraphs: Yang Fan opened the mall and searched for the word ‘weapons’.
“F-grade weapon: Spear.
Price: 10,000 Faith Points.
F-grade weapon: Iron Hammer.
Price: 13,000 Faith Points.
F-grade weapon: Breeze Sword.
Price: 20,000 Faith Points.
Looking at the weapon prices, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“This is a bit too expensive.”
A single weapon cost over ten thousand Faith Points; besides that, there were armor and helmets.
Even for just F-grade equipment, arming a believer from head to toe would cost thirty to forty thousand Faith Points.
His current Divine Kingdom army numbered a full fifty thousand.
If they were all equipped like this, wouldn’t it cost around two billion?
“No wonder those gods who follow the War Path need to recruit so many Subordinate Gods. Just the expenditure on weapons alone is an astronomical figure,” Yang Fan lamented.
With his current financial strength, Yang Fan was simply not qualified for large-scale consumption of graded weapons, and those common soldiers didn’t deserve them either.

“The prices are too high. Help me search for ordinary weapons. I need to equip mortals on a large scale, preferably iron-made. The total price for fifty thousand sets must be within a million,” Yang Fan continued his search through the intelligent lifeform.

“Filtering merchants... Recommended best choice: Ink Iron Mercenary Group Shop. 200,000 sets of ordinary iron weapons. Price: 4,000,000 Faith Points. Merchant is currently online. You may ask if they sell separately.”
Yang Fan clicked on the chat box and typed: “Boss, I want to buy fifty thousand sets. Is that okay?”
“1,000,000 Faith Points. Trade anytime,” the other party replied instantly.
“Can it be a bit cheaper? I’m still a senior in high school.”
“Small business, no haggling.”
At that moment, on a distant planet, a man sat at a workbench smoking dry tobacco.

He spat and said, “Another one playing the pity card. I’ve been a customer service rep for so many years, my ears are practically calloused from hearing these lines. Poor people are always the most troublesome. I still need to find a way to improve product competitiveness and earn money from the rich.”
“Is there really no discount?” Doing such a large business deal for the first time, Yang Fan still wanted to push for it.
“No.” The other party refused decisively.
Having done business for a long time, his heart was as firm as a rock; prices weren’t something easily changed.
“I’m from a single-parent family, and I have two younger sisters to support. I really have no choice...”
“Stop... I’ve sent you the link. Any lower and I won’t be able to explain it to my superiors.”
Yang Fan looked at the pop-up link: fifty thousand sets of ordinary iron weapons for the price of 800,000.
“This... negotiating business is this simple?” Yang Fan’s mind was a bit dazed.
Fearing the other party would regret it, he hurried to transfer the Faith Points.
“Transaction successful.”
At that moment, the other party took two deep drags of his smoke, his eyes looking somewhat melancholy.
Just then, his door was pushed open, and two small heads peeked in.
“Daddy, big brother is calling you to eat,” the twin daughters called out simultaneously.
“I know. How were your classes today? Did the teacher reward you with little red flowers?” The man stood up and picked up a daughter in each arm, speaking tenderly.
“Yes! Today we recited the Biodiversity Research Report in front of the whole class. The teacher rewarded us with one each.”
“Good girls!”
With the procurement of weapons for the ordinary soldiers complete, Yang Fan prepared to equip each of those six Rank 1 Beings with a full set of F-grade weapons.

Finding another private shop, he clicked the chat box and typed: “Boss, can it be a bit cheaper? My parents died when I was young, and I raised ten younger sisters by myself. I really don’t have any extra Faith Points.”
“Get lost.”
“The other party has closed the chat box,” a system prompt from Taotao Network came through.
Yang Fan felt as if a murder of crows had just flown over his head.
In the end, he spent nearly another 200,000 Faith Points to buy exactly six sets of Rank 1 weapons.
His liquid capital hit rock bottom again.
After putting all these resources into his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan stretched and lay down on his bed to fall asleep early.
He had done everything he could.
He only hoped he could stand out tomorrow and secure investments from those bosses.
Early the next morning, Yang Fan got up and headed to school.
This assessment was not in the Virtual World; the entire senior year faculty and students had to gather at Yang County No.
1 Middle School.
Three months had passed since the Day of Awakening, and Yang Fan stepped through the gates of Yang County No.
1 Middle School once again.
The school playground was very lively.
There were over 2,000 students in the entire senior year.
Even though the vast majority were from the Logistics Path, they were required to be present according to the rules.
“I heard Principal Hong Bing will show up today. That’s a Tier 3 God, a big shot who’s usually hard to even get a glimpse of.”

“I heard from my elders that today’s assessment site is a Divine Kingdom that the Principal conquered while fighting against Alien Gods in his youth. To nurture the youth, this Divine Kingdom is specifically used to raise various ranks of demonic beasts, and its coordinates are made public for student assessments.”
“Really? Is an alien’s Divine Kingdom the same as ours?”

“Pretty much, just the believers are different. We are the Human Race, so our believers are humans. The believers of those alien races include all kinds of demonic beasts, undead, and demons—all sorts of bizarre things anyway.”
“Handsome, you know so much!”
“It’s alright. My grandfather is a demigod and a chatterbox, so I’ve heard a lot of stories.”
Yang Fan went to his spot and looked around curiously.
Ever since Rank 1 Beings were born in his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan could feel that his senses had become much sharper.
The aura of Class 7, where he was, was the weakest.
The aura on Li Shuhao, the strongest among them, was like a furnace, while the other students were barely flickering sparks by comparison.
But for Class 1, Grade 12 standing in the very center, even from a great distance, Yang Fan could sense the terrifying aura they emitted.
“Luo Bing, the genius of the Luo Family with a B-grade talent. Has she already reached such a level in just three months?” Yang Fan gazed at her back from afar.
Even though there was no change in the air temperature, an invisible chill made his eyes sting.
The other party’s strength was likely several orders of magnitude greater than his own.
With terrifying talent and the full support of her family, if he was running forward, she was driving a sports car.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and lowered his eyes, trying not to draw attention.
“Brother Yang, how are your preparations?” Li Shuhao greeted him.
“They’re alright.”
“Once this assessment is over, if you want to change your development path, my original proposal still stands.”
Although Yang Fan had impressed him during the last Prosperity Evaluation, he still didn’t think highly of the Divine Kingdom path Yang Fan had chosen.
Without combat-related talent and without family investment, how much could the strength of his believers change in a mere three months?
“Thanks.” Yang Fan nodded gratefully; he knew the other party meant no harm.
The other genius of Class 7, Wang Zhenyu, was very quiet at the moment, constantly taking deep breaths.
It was clear he was very nervous.
“Brother Yang, come to my house for dinner after the exam. It’s been so long since I heard from you, we need to catch up,” Zhang Pang came over and put his arm around Yang Fan’s shoulder.
“We’ll see. I’ve prepared a long time for today; I’m hoping to get investment from those big families.”

“Pfft, give it a rest. We’re in logistics; who would invest in us? My believers only know how to farm. For the exam later, I plan to send a thousand believers into the exam grounds to look around, and if they see a Rank 1 demonic beast, I’ll just pull them right back. This kind of exam usually takes ten days to half a month to finish every year. I’m too lazy to waste time at school,” Zhang Pang rolled his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: The Divine Kingdom of a God
paragraphs: Just then, a figure appeared in the sky above the playground’s high platform and slowly descended.
“I am Yang Wanli, the dean of this school. Students, you will face a total of three major exams throughout your senior year.”
“The Initial Divine Kingdom War, the Mid-term Class Placement Exam, and finally, the College Entrance Examination.”
“Today is the first one, and I believe you all understand its importance.”
“Before the exam, I would like to welcome our guests on behalf of the school.” Yang Wanli snapped his fingers, and soft, melodious light music began to play from all directions.
“Elder of the Luo Family, Luo Chengfeng, welcome to our school.”
“Elder of the Li Family, Li Yuan, welcome to our school.”
“President of the Liangzhou Chamber of Commerce, Mi Cai’er.”
“President of the Blacksmith Association, Tie Wuqing.”
“Owner of Zhongyuan Tower, Wan Sanqian.”
Yang Wanli called out the names quickly.
As each name was read, a person would appear in a seat on the high platform as if teleporting.
As expected of Yang County No.
1 Middle School, the highest institution in the county; many big figures were present for such a large-scale exam.
Yang Fan had only seen these people on the front pages of local news before; this was the first time he had seen them in person.
After the guests were announced, Yang Wanli performed an elegant gentlemanly bow to the people on the stage.

He then turned around, spread his arms, and said with an impassioned tone, “You are students of my Yang County No. 1 Middle School, the pride of Yang County. Today’s exam is the most important opportunity of your lives.”

“The bosses behind me come from various industries and families in Yang County. They will take their precious time to watch the entire exam process. Those with outstanding results may receive investments from major companies.”
“You are the glory of No. 1 Middle School, the future of Yang County, and the flowers of the human race. The future belongs to you.”
“Next, please welcome Principal Hong.”
As his voice fell, a figure suddenly appeared in the main seat at the very top, without any aura fluctuations.
The principal of Yang County No.
1 Middle School was also the deputy county magistrate of Yang County.
Backed by the Federal Government and possessing the strength of a Rank 3 God, he was definitely a figure standing at the very pinnacle of the Yang County pyramid.
Yang Fan looked up at him and found that no matter how hard he tried, he could not see the principal’s face clearly.
“The assessment content is simple. There is no limit on the number of believers or combat methods; you can use any means necessary. You have a total of ten days.”
“A Rank 1 demon beast is worth 100 points, a Rank 2 demon beast is worth 10,000 points, and a Rank 3 demon beast is worth 1,000,000 points. The final ranking will be based on the scores.”

“To show encouragement, the school board has decided that the final exam scores will be converted 1:1 into Faith Pointss and deposited into your Divine Kingdoms.” After Hong Bing finished explaining the rules, he gave a light wave of his right hand, and rows of Nutrient Pods filled with green liquid landed precisely in front of every student.

“Considering that you are still Divine Beings, there is a risk to your lives if you do not eat for a long time. These Nutrient Pods will take the place of food. Lie inside, clear your minds, and your consciousness will enter my Divine Kingdom.”
The exam site was within an Alien Divine Kingdom, which spanned over 100 million square kilometers.
It would be impossible to fully explore it even in ten years within that Divine Kingdom.
However, in the real world, going ten days without water or food would be life-threatening, even for Divine Beings.
Nutrient Pods originated from the Mechanical Civilization Divine Kingdom and were originally used to mass-produce ordinary believers.
No one expected them to be used to provide nutrition for Divine Beings now.
The Nutrient Pods were simple to operate; one just had to open the door and lie inside.
Although it was a green liquid, it did not affect breathing at all.
Yang Fan entered, cleared his mind, and his consciousness soon appeared in an open space.
Looking at the surrounding environment, he subconsciously touched the ground with his hand, only to find that his right hand passed right through it.

“Is it just a pure consciousness projection? However, I can connect to my own Divine Kingdom at any time, and all kinds of resources and believers can be deployed without any restrictions.” Yang Fan subconsciously understood the rules of this place.
“By lifting the restrictions on the Divine Kingdom and making the coordinates public, other gods can enter and exit freely. I see.”

Yang Fan communicated with his Divine Kingdom through his consciousness and summoned the Divine Revelation Army, Azure Dragon Army, White Tiger Army, Vermilion Bird Army, and Black Tortoise Army to this location.
“Greetings, My God.” The army of fifty thousand bowed to Yang Fan in unison.
“This is the place where we will battle the alien races. Divide into five routes and advance in a fan-shaped formation. If you encounter any demon beasts, kill them all.”
“We obey the divine oracle.”
According to the market price, the value of a Rank 1 demon beast was less than 10 Faith Pointss, but this assessment rewarded 100 Faith Pointss per beast.
Since he could both get a high score to attract the attention of the major families and earn resources at the same time, Yang Fan naturally intended to grind as much as possible.
Opportunities to earn Faith Pointss like this were rare.
Furthermore, Yang Fan could feel that no outsiders were spying on his Divine Kingdom, so he directly activated his Evolution Talent.
War would lead to losses, but with the help of the Evolution Talent, his Divine Kingdom could continuously provide soldiers and food.
The students participating in the assessment did not know that at this moment, a huge sky screen had appeared above Yang County No.
1 Middle School, bringing all the students’ performances into full view.
“Is that the genius girl from the Luo Family? She has already given birth to a Rank 3 life form. The first place in the assessment is undoubtedly hers.”
“As expected of the Luo Family, how many resources did they pour into this?”
Under everyone’s gaze, Luo Bing’s soldiers numbered a total of one hundred thousand.
The leading general held a white spear, fully displaying a Rank 3 aura.
Standing behind him were nearly twenty Rank 2 beings, and the number of Rank 1 beings was as high as a thousand.
Not only that, but everyone was well-equipped, with bright silver-white armor stretching as far as the eye could see.
Such combat power was simply leading by a massive margin.

“Elder Luo, congratulations. I didn’t expect the Luo Family to produce such a genius in this generation. Give her a hundred years, and she will likely break through to become a God.” Mi Cai’er said with emotion.
“I appreciate your kind words, President Mi.” Luo Chengfeng showed a professional smile.

“The Li Family’s Li Tianheng is also quite good. Although a Rank 3 being has not yet appeared among his believers, his talent is said to be Mad Blood, which can instantly increase the combat power of his believers by 50%. In terms of true strength, probably only Luo Bing can steadily win against him in the entire senior year.”
“And this one named Li Feng, he’s planning to go with the Mechanical Stream...”
“Yang County No. 1 Middle School is full of talent this year.”
Wan Sanqian, the owner of Zhongyuan Tower, gave a chuckle and said, “I won’t dream about those geniuses from Class 1. I only hope that the ordinary classes can also produce some good sprouts.”
“Owner Wan, I wonder how much weight the contracts you’ve prepared this time carry?” Tie Wuqing asked tentatively.
“As long as they have the ability, I can afford the price.”
“What a grand gesture!”

“It can’t be helped. We encountered an accident during land reclamation last year, and twelve demigod executives died mysteriously. Now the company’s middle management is severely lacking. If we don’t start training new people in advance, there will be a gap in succession.” Wan Sanqian spread his hands, looking somewhat helpless.
On the school playground, less than an hour after the assessment began, some students had already taken the initiative to open their Nutrient Pods and climb out.
More and more people appeared, and in less than half a day, 50% of the students had already given up.
Everyone was used to this.
For students who developed their Divine Kingdoms for the purpose of logistics, this assessment was just a formality.
Those students who finished did not leave immediately.
Instead, they looked at the sky with curiosity, as some of them were their friends.
They took this opportunity to see how far their brothers’ Divine Kingdoms had developed.
