Yang Fan communicated with his Divine Kingdom through his consciousness and summoned the Divine Revelation Army, Azure Dragon Army, White Tiger Army, Vermilion Bird Army, and Black Tortoise Army to this location.
“Greetings, My God.” The army of fifty thousand bowed to Yang Fan in unison.
“This is the place where we will battle the alien races.
Divide into five routes and advance in a fan-shaped formation.
If you encounter any demon beasts, kill them all.”
“We obey the divine oracle.”
According to the market price, the value of a Rank 1 demon beast was less than 10 Faith Pointss, but this assessment rewarded 100 Faith Pointss per beast.
Since he could both get a high score to attract the attention of the major families and earn resources at the same time, Yang Fan naturally intended to grind as much as possible.
Opportunities to earn Faith Pointss like this were rare.
Furthermore, Yang Fan could feel that no outsiders were spying on his Divine Kingdom, so he directly activated his Evolution Talent.
War would lead to losses, but with the help of the Evolution Talent, his Divine Kingdom could continuously provide soldiers and food.
The students participating in the assessment did not know that at this moment, a huge sky screen had appeared above Yang County No.
1 Middle School, bringing all the students’ performances into full view.
“Is that the genius girl from the Luo Family?
She has already given birth to a Rank 3 life form.
The first place in the assessment is undoubtedly hers.”
“As expected of the Luo Family, how many resources did they pour into this?”
Under everyone’s gaze, Luo Bing’s soldiers numbered a total of one hundred thousand.
The leading general held a white spear, fully displaying a Rank 3 aura.
Standing behind him were nearly twenty Rank 2 beings, and the number of Rank 1 beings was as high as a thousand.
Not only that, but everyone was well-equipped, with bright silver-white armor stretching as far as the eye could see.
Such combat power was simply leading by a massive margin.
“Elder Luo, congratulations.
I didn’t expect the Luo Family to produce such a genius in this generation.
Give her a hundred years, and she will likely break through to become a God.” Mi Cai’er said with emotion.
“I appreciate your kind words, President Mi.” Luo Chengfeng showed a professional smile.
“The Li Family’s Li Tianheng is also quite good.
Although a Rank 3 being has not yet appeared among his believers, his talent is said to be Mad Blood, which can instantly increase the combat power of his believers by 50%.
In terms of true strength, probably only Luo Bing can steadily win against him in the entire senior year.”
“And this one named Li Feng, he’s planning to go with the Mechanical Stream...”
“Yang County No.
1 Middle School is full of talent this year.”
Wan Sanqian, the owner of Zhongyuan Tower, gave a chuckle and said, “I won’t dream about those geniuses from Class 1.
I only hope that the ordinary classes can also produce some good sprouts.”
“Owner Wan, I wonder how much weight the contracts you’ve prepared this time carry?” Tie Wuqing asked tentatively.
“As long as they have the ability, I can afford the price.”
“What a grand gesture!”
“It can’t be helped.
We encountered an accident during land reclamation last year, and twelve demigod executives died mysteriously.
Now the company’s middle management is severely lacking.
If we don’t start training new people in advance, there will be a gap in succession.” Wan Sanqian spread his hands, looking somewhat helpless.
On the school playground, less than an hour after the assessment began, some students had already taken the initiative to open their Nutrient Pods and climb out.
More and more people appeared, and in less than half a day, 50% of the students had already given up.
Everyone was used to this.
For students who developed their Divine Kingdoms for the purpose of logistics, this assessment was just a formality.
Those students who finished did not leave immediately.
Instead, they looked at the sky with curiosity, as some of them were their friends.
They took this opportunity to see how far their brothers’ Divine Kingdoms had developed.

chapters.title: Chapter 26: The Array Has Attained Its Spirit
paragraphs: “I... Holy crap, Godfather, what’s going on? So many believers, and they’re all equipped with weapons! Doesn’t Godfather raise Bodhi Precious Snakes?” Zhang Pang rubbed his eyes hard, his heart suffering another ten thousand points of critical damage.
“Who is this person? He’s clearly from Class 7, but his score is almost squeezing into the top 100.”
Although only a few hours had passed in reality, several months had already gone by within the Divine Kingdom.
A massive leaderboard stood right in the center of the playground.
“1st Place, Luo Bing, 1.63 million points
2nd Place, Li Tianheng, 420,000 points
99th Place, Li Shuhao, 180,000 points
105th Place, Yang Fan, 140,000 points
The current rankings did not represent actual strength.
After all, the Divine Kingdom area for this assessment was simply too large.
Most of the believers’ time was spent searching for demon beasts, with very few actual combat opportunities.
Some students who were clearly from Class 1 of the third year were currently ranked beyond eight hundredth place.
“This Yang Fan caused quite a stir when he first awakened. Even though he has the F-grade talent ‘Resources’, his initial Divine Kingdom area was as high as a million square kilometers.”
“I remember now, this guy isn’t simple. He actually has 6 Rank 1 beings. This level of Divine Kingdom development should be enough to qualify for Class 1.”
“Looking at the believers’ strength alone, it’s still a bit of a stretch.”
“This Li Shuhao is also from Class 7. How is he so fierce? Three hundred Rank 1 beings. With this kind of ability, why stay in Class 7?”
“He’s different. After awakening a C-grade talent, he was recognized and brought back into the Li Family. He’s bound to be promoted to Class 1 after the placement exam. Your news is outdated.”
On the high platform, Yang Fan’s sudden surge to around 100th place naturally caught the attention of some important figures.
“This kid is not bad. Since he was assigned to Class 7, I assume he has no background. Being able to develop his believers to this stage in three months isn’t easy,” Wan Sanqian lamented.

“Indeed, his Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array is also very proficient. After killing so many demon beasts, fewer than a hundred believers are injured, and not a single one has died.” Tie Wuqing’s eyes showed quite a bit of appreciation.
“Brother Tie, how about letting this person go to me?”
“That won’t do. We’ll see who offers higher terms when the time comes.”
Nearly a hundred demon wolves covered in green flames dived down from the mountaintop.
“Center army shield-bearers, hold the line! Left and right spearmen, outflank them! Archers in the rear, prepare!” Yang Fan raised his hand and commanded.
Booming sounds of impact echoed at the engagement point.
The skulls of Rank 1 demon beasts were tougher than ordinary fine iron.
With just one wave of impact, those shields were smashed to pieces.
Dozens of believers behind them had their necks bitten through or chests crushed by the demon wolves, flesh and blood flying everywhere.
Facing this scene, Yang Fan’s expression remained unchanged.
Under the Evolution Talent, the believers within the Divine Kingdom reproduced extremely quickly; these dead soldiers could be replenished immediately.
In comparison, Yang Fan felt more distressed about the weapons.
He had only bought fifty thousand sets of Mortal Weapons; losing one meant one less available.
“If I had known these weapons were consumed so quickly, I would have purchased more as spares,” Yang Fan sighed softly.
Participating in a Divine Kingdom war for the first time and without guidance from elders, there were indeed many things he hadn’t considered thoroughly.
A hundred demon wolves were nothing to an army of over ten thousand.
Aside from the first wave of impact that killed or injured dozens of believers, they were immediately surrounded by the thousands-strong force and hacked to death.
Yang Fan looked up toward the depths of the Divine Kingdom and murmured, “The density of demon beasts in this area is still too low. I must continue deeper.”
The assessment only lasted ten days.
If he just hovered around the edges, the efficiency of hunting demon beasts would be too low.
Yang Fan sent down a divine oracle, ordering the other four armies to close in on the Divine Revelation Army, narrowing the distance to twenty li, and continued to push forward.
The real-world large screen leaderboard showed:
“172nd Place, Yang Fan, 3.64 million points.”
Since this was the Divine Kingdom of Hong Bing, a Rank 3 deity, Yang Fan’s initial marching route was very cautious.
In the five years within the Divine Kingdom, he had only encountered Rank 1 demon beasts, and the largest pack had only consisted of 300 wolves.
With such a steady style of conduct, his points were naturally overtaken by other students.
If Yang Fan knew this result, he would certainly be dissatisfied, but his best friend Zhang Pang was currently extremely excited.
“My brother is actually so fierce! I’m following you from now on.” Zhang Pang held his lunch box, continuously shoveling food into his mouth.
During this time, Zhang Pang had not left the school.
When hungry, he ordered takeout, fearing that when his brother came out of the nutrition pod, he wouldn’t be the first person his brother saw.
After three months of Divine Kingdom awakening, the believers already possessed this kind of combat power.
Breaking through to become a demigod in the future was practically a sure thing, and there might even be a chance to become a deity.
It didn’t matter whose Subordinate God he became.
Zhang Pang had already made up his mind; in the future, he would grow grain for Yang Fan.
Since they were brothers, the price couldn’t be squeezed too hard.
Prodigies like Luo Bing and Li Tianheng already had scores exceeding 50 million at this point and had begun hunting Rank 2 demon beasts.
However, the big bosses of Yang County on the high platform did not focus their gaze on them.
The main purpose of coming to Yang County No.
1 Middle School to observe the ceremony was to recruit young talents for their own companies.
Naturally, prodigies from great families like Luo Bing could not be their targets.

“This little fellow Yang Fan is in trouble. He actually encountered a pack of Monitor Lizard Rabbits, nearly three thousand Rank 1 demon beasts. His army is likely to suffer significant losses,” Wan Sanqian said while looking at the light screen in the sky.

“His luck is a bit poor. These fifty thousand believers should be the backbone of his Divine Kingdom. After experiencing this great battle, if there’s no replenishment of troops, I’m afraid he won’t be qualified to go deeper,” Tie Wuqing said regretfully.

Within the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan watched the groups of giant rabbits as tall as two people and instantly issued an order: “Set up defenses! The Azure Dragon and White Tiger armies, close in at full speed!”
Orders were strictly followed.
The two Rank 1 beings of the Divine Revelation Army stood at the eye of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array.
All soldiers pressed their bodies close together, holding their weapons and standing firm.
Nearly three thousand Rank 1 demon beasts—this was the greatest challenge the Divine Revelation Army had ever faced.
Dust billowed as the massive bodies of the Monitor Lizard Rabbits pressed against the shield-bearers, their front claws smashing toward the soldiers’ heads.
With a bang, the heads of hundreds of believers were smashed off, their bodies falling into pools of blood.
“First row, retreat! Second row, vanguard squad, step forward!”
“Archers, suppress them!”
“Soldiers on the left wing, hold the line for this General! Anyone who dares to take a single step back will be executed without mercy!”
“Fight for the God! Fight to the death, no retreat!”

With the support of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, even though they were just ten thousand mortals, they actually blocked the first wave of attack at the cost of only a few hundred sacrifices.
The battle situation within the Divine Kingdom was clearly visible as a projection to the outside world.

A hint of surprise and doubt appeared in Wan Sanqian’s eyes: “The Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array already has a trace of divine spirit. He has actually comprehended it to the Minor Achievement stage. This... this isn’t right.”
Not just him, even the two elders from the Luo and Li families became interested.

“Even if we count from the moment he awakened his Divine Kingdom, it’s only been three months. It’s not easy to practice an F-grade array to such a level.” Luo Chengfeng stroked his beard, a hint of inquiry in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Results of the Grand Competition
paragraphs: The greatest influence in a Divine Kingdom War is the formation; when high-ranking gods launch such a war, they may have billions or even tens of billions of believers forming a massive array.
The difficulty of arrays far exceeds that of cultivation techniques or martial skills.
At least for now, no one else in the entire third year of high school has practiced the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Minor Accomplishment stage.
Li Yuan, an elder of the Li Family, lightly tapped the arm of his seat and turned to ask, “Teacher Li Qingying, this is a student from your class, right?”
A Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Minor Accomplishment stage was already enough to catch the attention of the two great families.
Li Qingying was no less shocked than anyone else, but at this moment, she still maintained an air of nonchalance as if it were to be expected.
“Yang Fan is indeed a promising seed. It is within reason that he could comprehend the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Minor Accomplishment stage.”

Seeing the puzzled looks on everyone’s faces, Li Qingying continued to explain, “Two months ago, I organized a prosperity assessment. His rating was 22.4. You must know this child comes from an ordinary family background; his largest source of funding was a 5 million Faith Point loan from the Federal Fund.”
Hearing this, everyone came to a sudden realization.
“The Actuary talent!”

“So that’s it. Actuaries are generally people with transcendent comprehension. This boy must have relied on his own efforts to grasp the essence of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array and then taught it to his believers.” A strange light flickered in Luo Chengfeng’s eyes.
With such comprehension and the Actuary talent, if he could receive investment, the probability of him becoming a low-rank god would not be low.
Even for great families like the Luo Family and the Li Family, a god is an extremely important foundation.
Looking at the expressions of Li Yuan and Luo Chengfeng, the faces of everyone else showed a hint of regret.
Wan Sanqian was already optimistic about Yang Fan, but now the boy’s performance was too good.
If the two great families stepped in, his Zhongyuan Tower would have no part in it.
“Once the competition is over, I’ll still try my best to fight for him,” Wan Sanqian sighed inwardly.
As Yang Fan’s teacher, the corner of Li Qingying’s mouth couldn’t help but curl into a smile.
“I misjudged you. Although your Divine Kingdom talent is average, I didn’t expect you yourself to have such comprehension.”
Yang Fan, who was currently commanding the encirclement of the demonic beasts, had no idea he had been scouted by big shots.
At this moment, looking at the beast corpses covering the ground, he could only marvel, “These Faith Points are far too easy to earn.”
As the Azure Dragon Army and the White Tiger Army closed the encirclement, the victory was achieved at the cost of only five hundred soldiers.
Three thousand Rank 1 demonic beasts; once the assessment ended, they could be exchanged for an additional 300,000 Faith Points.
As for the losses, they were essentially negligible.
Intense training was currently underway within his Divine Kingdom.
With a thought, Yang Fan mobilized another five hundred adult males to replenish the ranks.
“Next, the five armies will converge and push deeper,” Yang Fan issued a divine oracle.
If he had an army of fifty thousand just now, he could have easily annihilated that small beast pack.
The deeper they went, the stronger the quantity and quality of the demonic beasts encountered became; there was absolutely no need for a wide-area search.
The assessment time was already half over; he had to speed up his progress.
As expected of a Divine Kingdom qualified to be conquered by a god, the area was ridiculously large.
All the students from the entire third year were in this Divine Kingdom, yet after so long, not a single trace of another human had been found.
During this period, Yang Fan’s army experienced over a hundred battles with beast packs of various sizes.
The most brutal encounter was with eight thousand Gale Wolves, led by a Rank 2 Gale Wolf King.
In that battle, nearly fifteen thousand of Yang Fan’s believers died, and even a general who was a Rank 1 being perished.
Yang Fan had long since become numb to this.
Although these people were his believers, watching them reproduce generation after generation made it impossible for him to truly regard them as humans like himself.
A merciful god cannot walk the path of a War Divine Kingdom.
If one truly cannot bear the death of believers, it would be better to just farm like Zhang Pang.
Fortunately, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had a tenfold time acceleration.
Even if the army suffered such heavy losses, the troops could be replenished in time, and the overall strength did not drop significantly.
Three more days passed in real-world time.
Within the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s army of fifty thousand now had only twenty thousand remaining, and every one of them was wounded and weary.
As they pushed into the heartland, the demonic beasts Yang Fan encountered became stronger, and the size of the packs increased geometrically.
Even the packs they met were often led by two or three Rank 2 demonic beasts.

Under the massive gap in basic strength, even with the support of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, the army’s casualties grew larger and larger—so large that the replenishment of soldiers within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom began to fall short.
Facing such a situation, Yang Fan had no choice but to stop his advance and withdraw his troops a thousand miles outward.
His strength was insufficient; continuing deeper would only accelerate the loss of believers.
After a few more battles, he would have to end his competition early.
In that case, it was better to find areas with lower demonic beast density for steady hunting.
Only then could he obtain more points.
The assessment time flew by, and the third-year students still participating in the battle simultaneously heard Principal Hong Bing’s voice.
“The assessment is over. Come out.”
Yang Fan felt a repulsive force.
The remaining twenty to thirty thousand believers were instantly teleported back to his Divine Kingdom, while his consciousness returned to his physical body at the same time.
“1st Place: Luo Bing, 434,000,000 points.
2nd Place: Li Tianheng, 97,000,000 points.
“43rd Place: Li Shuhao, 45,000,000 points.
“64th Place: Yang Fan, 38,000,000 points.
“463rd Place: Wang Zhen Yu, 2,070,000 points.
Climbing out of the nutrient pod, Yang Fan looked at the leaderboard in the center of the playground with a somewhat surprised expression.

“64th place. This result is actually beyond my expectations. It seems those children from great families aren’t as strong as I imagined. As expected of an SSS-rank Talent.” The corner of Yang Fan’s mouth curled into a smile.
Being able to enter the top one hundred, even in Class 1 of the third year, was considered being among the best.
Yang Fan was naturally satisfied with such a result.
Yang Fan could feel that many eyes were currently fixed on him.
Aside from the surrounding classmates, many big shots on the high platform were also scrutinizing him.

“Not bad. I didn’t expect this kid’s Divine Kingdom to have such a foundation. Adding it all up, the total number of troops he deployed for this assessment must have exceeded 200,000.” Wan Sanqian took a deep breath.
“Based on this estimation, the total population of his Divine Kingdom is at least 500,000 to 1,000,000.”
For a god, this population was nothing.
However, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had only been awakened for three months, making this result quite eye-catching.
“However, his tactical arrangements were still too poor. If he had deployed all 200,000 troops from the start, he could have pushed forward at least another two thousand kilometers.”
“He is a young man after all, and it’s his first time participating in a Divine Kingdom War. It’s normal for him not to dare to risk everything on a single throw.”

“With this kid’s comprehension and the development speed of his Divine Kingdom, if he’s willing to join my Zhongyuan Tower, I’m willing to give him a Vice President position once he breaks through to become a god.”
Many big shots on the high platform chatted casually, but their gazes drifted toward Li Yuan and Luo Chengfeng from time to time.
Compared to great families like the Luo and Li families, the companies they represented were far inferior.
Every year, when investing in students of Yang County No.
1 Middle School, the Luo and Li families would pick away the most potential-filled geniuses, while other forces could only have the leftovers.
“This boy Yang Fan, my Li family will fight for him,” Li Yuan stated plainly.
“My Luo Family will do the same. We’ll see who has the better offer when the time comes,” Luo Chengfeng echoed.
Recruiting geniuses was not a matter of forced buying or selling.
Under the protection of Federal Law, even powers as strong as the Luo and Li families had to rely on excellent contracts to make geniuses willingly accept their recruitment.

As for the losses, they were essentially negligible.
Intense training was currently underway within his Divine Kingdom.
With a thought, Yang Fan mobilized another five hundred adult males to replenish the ranks.
“Next, the five armies will converge and push deeper,” Yang Fan issued a divine oracle.
If he had an army of fifty thousand just now, he could have easily annihilated that small beast pack.
The deeper they went, the stronger the quantity and quality of the demonic beasts encountered became; there was absolutely no need for a wide-area search.
The assessment time was already half over; he had to speed up his progress.
As expected of a Divine Kingdom qualified to be conquered by a god, the area was ridiculously large.
All the students from the entire third year were in this Divine Kingdom, yet after so long, not a single trace of another human had been found.
During this period, Yang Fan’s army experienced over a hundred battles with beast packs of various sizes.
The most brutal encounter was with eight thousand Gale Wolves, led by a Rank 2 Gale Wolf King.
In that battle, nearly fifteen thousand of Yang Fan’s believers died, and even a general who was a Rank 1 being perished.
Yang Fan had long since become numb to this.
Although these people were his believers, watching them reproduce generation after generation made it impossible for him to truly regard them as humans like himself.
A merciful god cannot walk the path of a War Divine Kingdom.
If one truly cannot bear the death of believers, it would be better to just farm like Zhang Pang.
Fortunately, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had a tenfold time acceleration.
Even if the army suffered such heavy losses, the troops could be replenished in time, and the overall strength did not drop significantly.
Three more days passed in real-world time.
Within the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s army of fifty thousand now had only twenty thousand remaining, and every one of them was wounded and weary.
As they pushed into the heartland, the demonic beasts Yang Fan encountered became stronger, and the size of the packs increased geometrically.
Even the packs they met were often led by two or three Rank 2 demonic beasts.

Under the massive gap in basic strength, even with the support of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, the army’s casualties grew larger and larger—so large that the replenishment of soldiers within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom began to fall short.
Facing such a situation, Yang Fan had no choice but to stop his advance and withdraw his troops a thousand miles outward.
His strength was insufficient; continuing deeper would only accelerate the loss of believers.
After a few more battles, he would have to end his competition early.
In that case, it was better to find areas with lower demonic beast density for steady hunting.
Only then could he obtain more points.
The assessment time flew by, and the third-year students still participating in the battle simultaneously heard Principal Hong Bing’s voice.
“The assessment is over.
Come out.”
Yang Fan felt a repulsive force.
The remaining twenty to thirty thousand believers were instantly teleported back to his Divine Kingdom, while his consciousness returned to his physical body at the same time.
“1st Place: Luo Bing, 434,000,000 points.
2nd Place: Li Tianheng, 97,000,000 points.
“43rd Place: Li Shuhao, 45,000,000 points.
“64th Place: Yang Fan, 38,000,000 points.
“463rd Place: Wang Zhen Yu, 2,070,000 points.
Climbing out of the nutrient pod, Yang Fan looked at the leaderboard in the center of the playground with a somewhat surprised expression.
“64th place.
This result is actually beyond my expectations.
It seems those children from great families aren’t as strong as I imagined.
As expected of an SSS-rank Talent.” The corner of Yang Fan’s mouth curled into a smile.
Being able to enter the top one hundred, even in Class 1 of the third year, was considered being among the best.
Yang Fan was naturally satisfied with such a result.
Yang Fan could feel that many eyes were currently fixed on him.
Aside from the surrounding classmates, many big shots on the high platform were also scrutinizing him.
“Not bad.
I didn’t expect this kid’s Divine Kingdom to have such a foundation.
Adding it all up, the total number of troops he deployed for this assessment must have exceeded 200,000.” Wan Sanqian took a deep breath.
“Based on this estimation, the total population of his Divine Kingdom is at least 500,000 to 1,000,000.”
For a god, this population was nothing.
However, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had only been awakened for three months, making this result quite eye-catching.
“However, his tactical arrangements were still too poor.
If he had deployed all 200,000 troops from the start, he could have pushed forward at least another two thousand kilometers.”
“He is a young man after all, and it’s his first time participating in a Divine Kingdom War.
It’s normal for him not to dare to risk everything on a single throw.”

“With this kid’s comprehension and the development speed of his Divine Kingdom, if he’s willing to join my Zhongyuan Tower, I’m willing to give him a Vice President position once he breaks through to become a god.”
Many big shots on the high platform chatted casually, but their gazes drifted toward Li Yuan and Luo Chengfeng from time to time.
Compared to great families like the Luo and Li families, the companies they represented were far inferior.
Every year, when investing in students of Yang County No.
1 Middle School, the Luo and Li families would pick away the most potential-filled geniuses, while other forces could only have the leftovers.
“This boy Yang Fan, my Li family will fight for him,” Li Yuan stated plainly.
“My Luo Family will do the same.
We’ll see who has the better offer when the time comes,” Luo Chengfeng echoed.
Recruiting geniuses was not a matter of forced buying or selling.
Under the protection of Federal Law, even powers as strong as the Luo and Li families had to rely on excellent contracts to make geniuses willingly accept their recruitment.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Major Companies Extend Invitations
paragraphs: In the entire Class 7, Grade 12, only Li Shuhao and Yang Fan made it into the top one hundred of the grade level.
At this moment, Li Shuhao watched as Yang Fan had actually obtained 38 million points, and his heart surged with immense shock as well.
Li Shuhao knew all too well how much of a price he had paid to achieve such results.
In order to rapidly increase the strength of his believers, Li Shuhao had utilized the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool to crazily produce blood pellets.
He did not sell these blood pellets, choosing instead to have his believers consume them all.
In just a few months, Li Shuhao’s 50 million genius loan had been almost entirely exhausted.
Only by pouring in so many resources could he achieve his current results in the grand competition.
Yet Yang Fan, what resources did he have?
At this moment, Li Shuhao suddenly realized that Yang Fan’s value was far higher than he had imagined.
If the other party had his conditions, he might even be able to rank in the top thirty.
Thinking of this, the way Li Shuhao looked at Yang Fan changed.
He knew clearly in his heart that even the Li Family, to which he belonged, would likely invest in Yang Fan right now.
This classmate, whom he had once wanted to develop into a Subordinate God, would likely be standing at the same level as him from now on.
Li Shuhao was not jealous of this; after all, the two were classmates who had lived together for three years, and now they were brothers.
With a friend becoming stronger, he might even benefit from it in the future, or at the very least, he had gained a business partner.
“Foster father, do you know how I spent these last ten days? I waited and waited, and finally, I’ve waited for you to come out.”
“Top one hundred in the grade level, why didn’t you say so earlier when you’re this awesome? From now on, I’m going to follow you, brother. Don’t you dare look down on me.”
Zhang Pang came over and hugged Yang Fan tightly, his wailing cries causing a crowd of classmates to look over.
The two had been best friends since the first year of high school, a relationship that most people in Class 7, Grade 12 knew about.
Now, many people looked at Zhang Pang with envy in their eyes.
With such a capable brother around, the future development of his divine kingdom would surely be much easier.
If you become rich, don’t forget your friends.
If you can’t rely on your father, you can rely on your brothers.
Of course, calling him ‘foster father’ was also perfectly fine.
Zhang Pang was currently in a completely laid-back state of mind.
Principal Hong Bing suddenly stood up at this moment, his voice entering everyone’s mind.

“The grand competition has ended. The faith point rewards will be deposited into everyone’s divine kingdom. As for those of you who wish to invest in our school’s students, please go to the Virtual World to contact them individually.”
As his voice fell, Hong Bing’s figure disappeared before everyone’s eyes as if teleporting.
As a Third-Order deity, Hong Bing’s standards were naturally unattainable.
Let alone the likes of Yang Fan, even a heaven’s pride daughter like Luo Bing did not catch his eye.
The many big figures on the high platform stood up simultaneously and bowed to the void.
“Brother Yang, hurry home and enter the Virtual World. I imagine there are quite a few big figures who want to recruit you,” Li Shuhao said as he walked over to remind him.
Yang Fan nodded, turned his head to look at Zhang Pang, and said, “I’m heading back first.”
“Important matters come first. Come over to my place for a meal after you’re done.”
Zhang Pang nodded quickly.
This concerned investments from major families, a shortcut for ordinary people to leap over the dragon gate; he dared not delay Yang Fan.
Arriving outside the school, Yang Fan tapped his wrist-watch, spent four hundred faith points to hail a fast car, and arrived at Mingyue Community in less than ten minutes.
Returning home and going upstairs, Yang Fan immediately put on his helmet and entered the Virtual World.
As soon as he entered, Yang Fan received several invitations.

“Student Yang Fan, I am a lawyer for the Ma Family. My family head saw your outstanding performance in the grand competition and is interested in signing an investment contract with you. Virtual World coordinates: 133, 175, 2068. I hope to meet and discuss in detail.”
Yang Fan looked thoughtful: “The Ma Family, is that the second-hand grain merchant?”
Yang Fan had some impression of the Ma Family.
Although they were not as powerful as the Luo Family and Li Family, they controlled over fifty percent of the grain trading channels in Yang County and had considerable influence.
Yang Fan tapped the coordinates, and his consciousness was transported to an antique-style teahouse.
“This must be Student Yang Fan, right? I am Zhang San, a lawyer for the Ma Family. I am honored that you could come. This is the contract the Ma Family has prepared for you.”
Zhang San took out a stack of documents and respectfully placed them in front of Yang Fan.

“Once the investment contract is signed, the Ma Family is willing to immediately provide you with fifty C-grade buildings valued within 500,000, along with a monthly subsidy of 300,000 faith points. These investments will continue until you graduate from university.”

“In return, after you become a demigod, you must join the Ma Family and work for them. If you become a deity, our Ma Family is also willing to hire you as a guest elder. At that time, you will not only enjoy dividends from the Ma Family’s companies, but there will also be no specific work arrangements.”
Watching Yang Fan carefully read the contract, Zhang San also pointed out the key points and explained them in detail.

Seeing that Yang Fan was still carefully studying the contract content, Zhang San continued: “The Federal Government attaches great importance to investments in students by major families, so it stipulates that the contract signing ceremony must take place in the Virtual World. Apart from what I just mentioned, everything else is a standard contract template, so you don’t need to worry about being deceived.”
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan nodded: “Can I consider it a bit more?”
“Of course, that is your right as a student.” Zhang San smiled, but a trace of imperceptible disappointment flashed across the corner of his mouth.
For a genius student like Yang Fan, there must be many major families who want to recruit him.
To be precise, the Ma Family was barely in the running; they only sent the invitation because they wanted to pick up a bargain.
Zhang San understood in his heart that saying he would consider it was actually a polite way of refusing.
Yang Fan tapped another invitation coordinate, and his consciousness was instantly transported away.
After Yang Fan left, another figure appeared in the room.
“Student Wang Zhenyu, right? I am Zhang San, a lawyer for the Ma Family. Although your results are average, my Ma Family...”
Following the order of the invitations, Yang Fan had already met with six groups of people.

Among them, the one offering the best conditions was a lawyer from the Liangzhou Chamber of Commerce, offering an initial investment of 50 million faith points, a monthly subsidy of 1 million faith points, and a B-grade spiritual plant.
Although Yang Fan was somewhat tempted, he was not in a hurry to agree, deciding it would be better to wait until he had seen all the investors before making a decision.

“Hello, I am a lawyer for Zhongyuan Tower. Our boss is very optimistic about your potential. Our company is willing to provide an initial investment of 50 million faith points, a monthly subsidy of 1.5 million faith points, and our boss is willing to promise that once you break through to a First-Order deity, he will grant you 5% equity in Zhongyuan Tower and the position of Vice President.”
“I will consider it carefully.”
Yang Fan politely returned the bow, then tapped the last two invitations.
The Li Family and the Luo Family, the two most powerful major families in Yang County.

“Congratulations, Student Yang. Elder Li Yuan believes that you have extraordinary potential and might even become a deity in the future. My Li Family is willing to offer you the treatment of a second-tier genius.”

“This includes a monthly subsidy of 2 million faith points and an annual dividend of 10 million faith points from the Li Family Genius Fund. These basic rewards will continue until you graduate from university.”
“In addition, after signing the contract, you will directly receive a short-term investment of 100 million faith points.”
The Li Family lawyer smiled, but his eyes still held a hint of faint arrogance, as if he did not care whether Yang Fan would refuse.
“Can I give you an answer later?” Yang Fan asked carefully.

“Of course, according to the Federal Government regulations, a student receiving an investment has one day to make a choice. After one day, if no contract is signed, the contract template in your hand will automatically disappear,” the other party reminded.
“Thank you.”
On the other side, Yang Fan’s consciousness arrived in a living room.
Looking at the surrounding environment, Yang Fan looked puzzled.
Why did this place where the Luo Family was talking look like a private residence?

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Post-nuptial Agreement
paragraphs: “Are you Yang Fan?” A female voice, as melodious as a lark, appeared behind Yang Fan.
Hearing the voice, he turned around in a hurry, only to see a woman with a withered face.
Her voice was very young, and her eyes were clear, but her skin was cracked in patches, like an old person nearing the end of their lifespan.
“This... young lady, I am indeed Yang Fan.” Yang Fan bowed politely.
The other party looked Yang Fan up and down carefully, then, without saying a word, turned and went upstairs.
Seeing this, Yang Fan was a bit baffled.
“Is this how the Luo Family discusses investments? So unique? Where is my contract?” Yang Fan wondered to himself.
Just as Yang Fan was puzzled, a familiar figure came downstairs.
Seeing the person arriving, Yang Fan hurriedly stood up to salute.
Yang Fan had seen this person before; it was none other than the Luo Family elder, Luo Chengfeng, who had been sitting on the high platform.
This was a true god, and now that he had requested a private meeting, how could Yang Fan dare to be negligent?
“Investment contracts are usually handled by lawyers from major families. Why did this Luo Family elder show up in person? Do they think that highly of me?” Yang Fan wondered inwardly.
Yang Fan still had self-awareness.
Although he had performed well in this grand competition and even caught the eyes of major families, this did not mean he was worth the effort of an elder appearing in person to recruit him.
“Little Yang, may I call you that?” Luo Chengfeng wore a kind expression.
“As you wish, Senior.” Yang Fan felt a bit flattered.
A god was standing right in front of him, yet acting so polite to him—it seemed strange no matter how he looked at it.
“Here are three contracts; you may take a look at all of them.” Luo Chengfeng snapped his fingers, and three documents landed in front of Yang Fan.
Yang Fan opened the first contract.

The content was similar to the terms offered by the Li Family, but the only advantage was that there were fewer restrictions; he only needed to register his name with the Luo Family, and the resources produced in his Divine Kingdom would be sold to the Luo Family at market price as a priority, with no other restrictions.
Yang Fan understood that this was likely the best contract he had seen today, and if there were no surprises, he could sign it.
Although he was puzzled as to why there were two more contracts, Yang Fan picked up the second one and opened it as usual.
A moment later, Yang Fan looked up at Luo Chengfeng in disbelief and said, “Sen... Senior, is this written correctly?”
The terms of the second contract were simply too good to be true.

A monthly subsidy of 5 million Faith Points, a year-end bonus of 30 million from the Luo Family talent fund, and as long as the contract was signed, not only would he immediately receive an initial investment of 100 million Faith Points, but there was even a B-grade building included.
Yang Fan suddenly felt like a pie had fallen from the sky.
Why did it feel like the other party was grooming him like a direct descendant of the family?
“Little Yang, do you want to sign this second contract?”
“I do.” Yang Fan nodded seriously.
A B-grade building had a minimum value of over 500 million, and with his current status, he didn’t even have the authorization to purchase one.

“The first contract is the treatment my Luo Family can offer you under normal conditions, while the second is the treatment offered under my own arrangement. If you want the second contract, you must sign this third supplementary agreement.” Luo Chengfeng pointed to the last document.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, gave the other party a suspicious look, and then opened the document.
The four large characters ‘Post-nuptial Agreement’ came into view.
Yang Fan looked up at Luo Chengfeng, his brain short-circuiting for a moment.
“Do I actually have the fate of a kept man relying on a rich woman?”

Luo Chengfeng sighed softly and said, “The person you just met is my granddaughter, Luo Rou. She is only two years older than you. Last year, while participating in a training assessment at university, she was ambushed by an Alien Demigod. Now, her Divine Kingdom is filled with poisonous miasma, and she does not have long to live.”
“Even with your status, you cannot heal her?” Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask.
“There is no way. To be precise, the cost is too high for me to bear personally, and Luo Rou’s talent is not like that of her cousin, Luo Bing; the family cannot spend such a huge cost for her.”
“So, my marriage partner is Miss Luo Rou?”

“That’s right. This child’s parents also died in the Divine Kingdom war against the alien race. It’s just her and me depending on each other for survival. Now that this has happened, before her Divine Kingdom completely collapses, this girl hopes to have a child.”
“Why me?” Yang Fan pointed to his own nose.

“Although your Divine Kingdom talent is poor, your comprehension is excellent. With this investment, you have a great chance of becoming a true god in the future. This can be considered finding a good father for the future child.” Luo Chengfeng said slowly.
Looking at Yang Fan in front of him, Luo Chengfeng felt rather downcast.
Ever since his granddaughter’s Divine Kingdom was damaged, those former young talents had gradually drifted away.
He had no choice but to find young men with good talent but low status to marry into the family.
Yang Fan fit his requirements perfectly.
Yang Fan turned his gaze to the third post-nuptial agreement and studied it carefully, fearing there might be some traps.
In less than a quarter of an hour, Yang Fan finished reading it.
Although it was called a post-nuptial agreement, it did not restrict the married life between Yang Fan and Luo Rou; instead, it was more like a property division agreement.
As for the content, it had nothing to do with the girl named Luo Rou, but rather the division of property between their future child and him, the father.
The core of it only had two points: first, the child born must have the surname Luo.

Perhaps fearing that Yang Fan would misunderstand, they had even added a specific annotation explaining that only in this way could the child become a member of the Luo Family and enjoy the resources and training of the Luo Family.
The second was that after Luo Rou died, two-thirds of the inheritance in her Divine Kingdom would be inherited by the child, and the remaining one-third would be transferred to Yang Fan.
As for the restrictions on Yang Fan, they were basically non-existent; the only requirement was to have a child within five years.
The agreement even thoughtfully added a supplement: if the male had fertility problems, the two could also pair up through genetic engineering.
After reading the whole thing, Yang Fan felt that it would be unforgivable by heaven to refuse.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and said slowly, “Senior, I don’t seem to have any reason to refuse.”

“Good. Since that is the case, I will arrange for a moving company to bring your parents to the Yang City villa area in a while. In the future, Rou’er will live with you all. You must not let her be wronged.”
“Before that, may I meet Miss Luo Rou alone?” Yang Fan hurriedly interrupted.

“Of course you can. She has not left the Virtual World and is currently upstairs. Keep these two contracts; they will automatically take effect once you sign your name. You young people chat; this old man has things to do, so I will leave first.” Luo Chengfeng smiled slightly and exited the Virtual World directly.
In the era of the Divine Kingdom, resources could buy everything.
Let alone a Divine Being like Yang Fan, if there was a sufficient dowry, one could even marry a god and bring them home.
It was just a contract marriage, and being able to pick up such a huge benefit for nothing, Yang Fan certainly would not let this great opportunity slip away.
Arriving on the second floor, Luo Rou was currently applying makeup in front of the mirror.
Thick powder on her face made her complexion look much better.
“Did you finish talking with my grandfather?” Luo Rou asked, with her back to Yang Fan.
“It’s settled. I can sign at any time.” Yang Fan nodded.
Luo Rou turned around: “Then should I call you husband now?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s face flushed slightly: “We are both young people, there’s no need for that.”
This was not a one-night stand in the Tianxiang Renjian.
Once he signed, the two of them would be in a marriage relationship stipulated by federal law, and even a community of interests that transcended their parents.

Seeing the person arriving, Yang Fan hurriedly stood up to salute.
Yang Fan had seen this person before; it was none other than the Luo Family elder, Luo Chengfeng, who had been sitting on the high platform.
This was a true god, and now that he had requested a private meeting, how could Yang Fan dare to be negligent?
“Investment contracts are usually handled by lawyers from major families.
Why did this Luo Family elder show up in person?
Do they think that highly of me?” Yang Fan wondered inwardly.
Yang Fan still had self-awareness.
Although he had performed well in this grand competition and even caught the eyes of major families, this did not mean he was worth the effort of an elder appearing in person to recruit him.
“Little Yang, may I call you that?” Luo Chengfeng wore a kind expression.
“As you wish, Senior.” Yang Fan felt a bit flattered.
A god was standing right in front of him, yet acting so polite to him—it seemed strange no matter how he looked at it.
“Here are three contracts; you may take a look at all of them.” Luo Chengfeng snapped his fingers, and three documents landed in front of Yang Fan.
Yang Fan opened the first contract.

The content was similar to the terms offered by the Li Family, but the only advantage was that there were fewer restrictions; he only needed to register his name with the Luo Family, and the resources produced in his Divine Kingdom would be sold to the Luo Family at market price as a priority, with no other restrictions.
Yang Fan understood that this was likely the best contract he had seen today, and if there were no surprises, he could sign it.
Although he was puzzled as to why there were two more contracts, Yang Fan picked up the second one and opened it as usual.
A moment later, Yang Fan looked up at Luo Chengfeng in disbelief and said, “Sen...
Senior, is this written correctly?”
The terms of the second contract were simply too good to be true.

A monthly subsidy of 5 million Faith Points, a year-end bonus of 30 million from the Luo Family talent fund, and as long as the contract was signed, not only would he immediately receive an initial investment of 100 million Faith Points, but there was even a B-grade building included.
Yang Fan suddenly felt like a pie had fallen from the sky.
Why did it feel like the other party was grooming him like a direct descendant of the family?
“Little Yang, do you want to sign this second contract?”
“I do.” Yang Fan nodded seriously.
A B-grade building had a minimum value of over 500 million, and with his current status, he didn’t even have the authorization to purchase one.
“The first contract is the treatment my Luo Family can offer you under normal conditions, while the second is the treatment offered under my own arrangement.
If you want the second contract, you must sign this third supplementary agreement.” Luo Chengfeng pointed to the last document.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, gave the other party a suspicious look, and then opened the document.
The four large characters ‘Post-nuptial Agreement’ came into view.
Yang Fan looked up at Luo Chengfeng, his brain short-circuiting for a moment.
“Do I actually have the fate of a kept man relying on a rich woman?”
Luo Chengfeng sighed softly and said, “The person you just met is my granddaughter, Luo Rou.
She is only two years older than you.
Last year, while participating in a training assessment at university, she was ambushed by an Alien Demigod.
Now, her Divine Kingdom is filled with poisonous miasma, and she does not have long to live.”
“Even with your status, you cannot heal her?” Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask.
“There is no way.
To be precise, the cost is too high for me to bear personally, and Luo Rou’s talent is not like that of her cousin, Luo Bing; the family cannot spend such a huge cost for her.”
“So, my marriage partner is Miss Luo Rou?”
“That’s right.
This child’s parents also died in the Divine Kingdom war against the alien race.
It’s just her and me depending on each other for survival.
Now that this has happened, before her Divine Kingdom completely collapses, this girl hopes to have a child.”
“Why me?” Yang Fan pointed to his own nose.
“Although your Divine Kingdom talent is poor, your comprehension is excellent.
With this investment, you have a great chance of becoming a true god in the future.
This can be considered finding a good father for the future child.” Luo Chengfeng said slowly.
Looking at Yang Fan in front of him, Luo Chengfeng felt rather downcast.
Ever since his granddaughter’s Divine Kingdom was damaged, those former young talents had gradually drifted away.
He had no choice but to find young men with good talent but low status to marry into the family.
Yang Fan fit his requirements perfectly.
Yang Fan turned his gaze to the third post-nuptial agreement and studied it carefully, fearing there might be some traps.
In less than a quarter of an hour, Yang Fan finished reading it.
Although it was called a post-nuptial agreement, it did not restrict the married life between Yang Fan and Luo Rou; instead, it was more like a property division agreement.
As for the content, it had nothing to do with the girl named Luo Rou, but rather the division of property between their future child and him, the father.
The core of it only had two points: first, the child born must have the surname Luo.

Perhaps fearing that Yang Fan would misunderstand, they had even added a specific annotation explaining that only in this way could the child become a member of the Luo Family and enjoy the resources and training of the Luo Family.
The second was that after Luo Rou died, two-thirds of the inheritance in her Divine Kingdom would be inherited by the child, and the remaining one-third would be transferred to Yang Fan.
As for the restrictions on Yang Fan, they were basically non-existent; the only requirement was to have a child within five years.
The agreement even thoughtfully added a supplement: if the male had fertility problems, the two could also pair up through genetic engineering.
After reading the whole thing, Yang Fan felt that it would be unforgivable by heaven to refuse.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and said slowly, “Senior, I don’t seem to have any reason to refuse.”
“Good.
Since that is the case, I will arrange for a moving company to bring your parents to the Yang City villa area in a while.
In the future, Rou’er will live with you all.
You must not let her be wronged.”
“Before that, may I meet Miss Luo Rou alone?” Yang Fan hurriedly interrupted.
“Of course you can.
She has not left the Virtual World and is currently upstairs.
Keep these two contracts; they will automatically take effect once you sign your name.
You young people chat; this old man has things to do, so I will leave first.” Luo Chengfeng smiled slightly and exited the Virtual World directly.
In the era of the Divine Kingdom, resources could buy everything.
Let alone a Divine Being like Yang Fan, if there was a sufficient dowry, one could even marry a god and bring them home.
It was just a contract marriage, and being able to pick up such a huge benefit for nothing, Yang Fan certainly would not let this great opportunity slip away.
Arriving on the second floor, Luo Rou was currently applying makeup in front of the mirror.
Thick powder on her face made her complexion look much better.
“Did you finish talking with my grandfather?” Luo Rou asked, with her back to Yang Fan.
“It’s settled.
I can sign at any time.” Yang Fan nodded.
Luo Rou turned around: “Then should I call you husband now?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s face flushed slightly: “We are both young people, there’s no need for that.”
This was not a one-night stand in the Tianxiang Renjian.
Once he signed, the two of them would be in a marriage relationship stipulated by federal law, and even a community of interests that transcended their parents.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: The Feeling of Taking Over a Dying Legacy
paragraphs: Before today, Yang Fan had never considered marriage, but the other party offered too much.
Being a kept man might not sound good, but if it really fell into one’s lap, who wouldn’t thank their lucky stars?
“Luo... Rou’er, may I call you that?” Yang Fan coughed.
After all, she was already his wife; calling her Miss Luo or Luo Rou seemed too distant.
“Whatever you like.” A faint, almost imperceptible smile appeared at the corners of Luo Rou’s mouth.
Compared to those children of large families, Yang Fan’s slightly awkward demeanor actually made her feel a bit amused.

“Husband, you don’t need to be nervous. With the talent you have displayed, if you had been born into the Luo Family like me, your achievements would only be higher than mine were back then. Given my current situation, it is actually I who am not worthy of you.”
“I am ten thousand percent willing to marry into your family.” Yang Fan hurriedly waved his hands.
Are you kidding?
She is a descendant of a god, and the dowry she gave would save him ten years of detours.
Although this wife’s Divine Kingdom was damaged and she looked haggard, it was all the same with the lights off at night.
What mattered was the generous dowry; one wave and he would go straight from a poor peasant to well-off.
How could this be unworthiness?
It was clearly him hitting the jackpot.
Watching Yang Fan’s overwhelmed expression, there was a mix of amusement and sadness in Luo Rou’s eyes.
“This is the coordinate of my Divine Kingdom. Since we have confirmed our relationship, come on in.” Luo Rou invited Yang Fan to enter her Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan tapped the coordinate, and his consciousness was pulled into her Divine Kingdom by an invisible force.
Two milky-white phantoms floated ten thousand meters above the Divine Kingdom; they were the consciousness projections of Luo Rou and Yang Fan.
Facing Yang Fan, Luo Rou opened up the permissions for her Divine Kingdom, allowing Yang Fan to see everything inside.
The Divine Kingdom covered an area of 800,000 square kilometers.

However, apart from the two or three thousand elderly, weak, sick, and disabled mortals living in the very center, the rest of the area had no signs of life and was entirely shrouded in poisonous mist.
Forests, mountains, rivers, and even the air ten thousand meters up were filled with emerald-green gas.
Yang Fan’s expression was grave.
He could feel that this poisonous gas was extremely troublesome; even a trace of it appearing in his own Divine Kingdom would likely be a catastrophic disaster.

“This is the poison of an Alien Demigod, the Death Spider Emperor. Although the amount is not large, the quality is extremely high. If we rely solely on the Divine Kingdom’s own metabolism, it would take at least fifty years in the real world.” Luo Rou sighed softly.
Not to mention fifty years, with her current body, she would struggle to last even five.
“Is university that dangerous?”

“There are always people with bad luck in this world. It was supposed to be just a normal assessment, yet we happened to encounter an Alien Demigod hunting the geniuses of our race. If the team leader hadn’t appeared in time, I wouldn’t even have had the chance to return home.”
“Is there no way to treat it?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
He had a good impression of this woman named Luo Rou.
Although they hadn’t met long ago, she hadn’t hidden anything in their conversation, which showed her sincerity.
“How could there be none? It’s just that the price is too high. It requires a high-level healing god to intervene, costing at least 100 Divinity Points, but I personally am not worth that much.”
At this point, a trace of sorrow flashed in Luo Rou’s eyes.
Who doesn’t want to live well?
But the continuation of a large family doesn’t rely on sentimentality.
Whoever has better talent deserves more resources.
Fairness, justice, and transparency are the core cornerstones of maintaining a family’s long-lasting prosperity.
Since Luo Rou suspended her studies, apart from her grandfather Luo Chengfeng, not a single person in the entire family had spoken up for her.
The elders she once knew, the childhood sweethearts from her youth, all drew a line between themselves and her.
The coldness of the world and the fickleness of human relationships—it doesn’t get more apparent than this.
“Divinity Points?” Yang Fan looked curious.
“It’s normal that you don’t know. This is the currency between gods; one hundred million Faith Points can condense into one Divinity Point.” Luo Rou explained.
Yang Fan gulped.
This treatment cost was indeed outrageous; ten billion Faith Points was simply an astronomical figure.
“Is there any way to alleviate it?”

“The Water of Life can delay the collapse of my Divine Kingdom. However, the Luo Family’s stock of the Water of Life is not large, and purchasing it on the market requires paying a premium. Even my grandfather cannot keep my life hanging by a thread using such strategic resources indefinitely. It doesn’t matter. Although you and I are now husband and wife, don’t waste resources on this. I am now terminally ill; continuing to invest in treatment costs will only end in losing both the person and the money.” Luo Rou calmly stated her view, without a trace of fear of death in her eyes.
“The Water of Life!” Yang Fan muttered to himself.
Yang Fan had once seen an introduction to this item in the mall.
A Fountain of Life could produce one drop every ten years, with an official price of one million Faith Points, but it was always out of stock.
For others, an expenditure of one million Faith Points per month was definitely not a small amount; after all, developing a Divine Kingdom also required investing a large amount of resources.
But Yang Fan was different.
With the Evolution Talent, once he got the Luo Family’s investment, his monthly income would surely skyrocket.
Perhaps he should step in and help this nominal wife.
Although the two of them didn’t have feelings for each other yet, she was, after all, his angel investor.
Helping her within his capabilities was not out of the question.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan cast his gaze toward the center of the Divine Kingdom.
“Why do you have so many Moon Wells and Sun Springs?” Yang Fan asked.
In the center of Luo Rou’s Divine Kingdom, there were two hundred Moon Wells and Sun Springs placed there, with an incredibly rich aura of life.

“This is all the inheritance left after I sold off my Divine Kingdom’s assets. Now my believers are weak and unable to make other Divine Kingdom investments. Only these buildings with fixed output can generate income, which can be considered leaving an inheritance for future children. And if I’m lucky enough to produce a Fountain of Life, I might even be able to accompany the children as they grow up.” Luo Rou explained.
Yang Fan pondered for a moment, his expression somewhat awkward as he said, “Can these buildings be moved to my Divine Kingdom?”
As soon as he finished speaking, Yang Fan began to regret it.
Saying this right now felt just like he was impatiently waiting to take over a dying legacy.
The person wasn’t even dead yet, and he was already trying to empty out her Divine Kingdom’s assets; it was a bit too shameless.
The situation was a bit awkward; even Luo Rou seemed not to have expected Yang Fan to say that.
The two were speechless for a moment.
Luo Rou sighed deeply and said, “Actually, after I die, these Divine Kingdom assets will be handed over to you to manage anyway. I only have a few years left.”
At this moment, there was a trace of sorrow and helplessness in her eyes, along with a hint of confusion.
Looking at her expression, Yang Fan wished he could slap himself across the face.
He didn’t really want to take over a dying legacy; after all, if these assets were placed in his own Divine Kingdom, it would mean ten times the profit.
It was just that his SSS-rank Talent could not be mentioned to others.
“Ahem, I was just joking earlier, don’t...”
“I agree.”
“Ah, you agree?” Yang Fan’s eyes showed some shock.

Luo Rou nodded: “That’s right. I will send these buildings to you in a while, but we still need to sign a legal agreement. You cannot sell them. After our children’s Divine Kingdoms awaken, the income generated by these buildings must be transferred to them every month. I’ll state it beforehand: once the agreement is signed, you won’t be able to go back on it later. Besides being supervised by the Federal Government, if you violate the terms of the agreement, the Luo Family will sue you in the future.”
Luo Rou’s tone was calm and cold, as if she were just discussing a business deal.
