chapters.title: Chapter 31: The Luo Family Guide — Zhan Yunxiao
paragraphs: Children of great families are just that pragmatic.
Even if they feel they have entrusted themselves to the wrong person, they don’t choose to cry or renege immediately, but instead rationally make the optimal choice.
Yang Fan nodded subconsciously.

“My grandfather has arranged for a moving company to go to your community; you will have to explain things to your parents yourself. Please treat me well for the remainder of my short life, my partner — Yang Fan.” Luo Rou said, neither sad nor happy.
Before Yang Fan could reply, a repulsive force acted upon him, instantly returning him to reality.
Taking off his virtual helmet, Yang Fan immediately slapped himself: “How could you say that? You’ve offended her completely now.”
The two hundred Moon Wells and Sun Springs in Luo Rou’s Divine Kingdom had a normal monthly income of 1.2 million, but in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, it would be 12 million.
Because of this, Yang Fan had subconsciously spoken his thoughts; by then, wouldn’t purchasing the Water of Life be more than enough?
It was a win-win.
The idea was beautiful, but the reality was a misunderstanding; this wife he had just met had likely already pegged him as a total scumbag.
On the other side, Luo Rou also returned to her study in the real world.

At this moment, she wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes, looked at her haggard face in the mirror, and said in a sorrowful tone: “Luo Rou, oh Luo Rou, what are you hoping for? Haven’t you seen enough similar things during this time? It was just a partnership to begin with.”
“Girl, are you done talking?” Luo Chengfeng knocked and opened the door.
Luo Rou nodded.
“How do you feel about that kid?”
“Not bad.” Luo Rou chose to hide the last bit of unpleasantness; after all, given her current situation, she wasn’t in a position to be picky.
Continuing to complain would only make things difficult for her grandfather.

“That’s good. I’ve investigated; although Yang Fan’s parents are only Divine Beings, their reputation in Mingyue Community is quite good, and they are not mean or petty people. This villa will be left for you and them to live in; with them helping to take care of you, I can be more at ease. For the next period, I have to go clear land for the family.”
After Luo Chengfeng finished speaking, he took out a card and placed it in Luo Rou’s palm.
Feeling the information on the card, it actually contained five drops of the Water of Life.
“Grandfather, don’t work so hard; there’s no need to continue investing these strategic resources into my Divine Kingdom.”

“I am, after all, a Tier 1 Deity. If it weren’t for the fact that this Water of Life is so scarce, the market price has been hyped up too high, and the Luo Family treasury is out of stock, I would gladly support you for another hundred years,” Luo Chengfeng said.
“Your parents-in-law and Yang Fan will move in today. Use these five drops of the Water of Life together; on your wedding night, my granddaughter must look beautiful.”
“Thank you, Grandfather, your granddaughter understands.” Luo Rou smiled, her cheeks even showing a blush.
“I’m leaving first. You two must work hard so I can hold a grandchild soon.”
After Luo Chengfeng’s aura completely disappeared from the villa, Luo Rou’s expression instantly returned to normal.

Luo Rou threw the card on the table, crossed her arms, and snorted coldly: “Does this scumbag deserve it? A dog who leeches off his wife’s family. Except for my grandfather, not a single man is a good person.”
While saying this, Luo Rou kicked the corner of the table hard, the pain causing her eyes to well up with tears again.
In Mingyue Community, Yang Fan was currently sitting at the dining table with his parents, discussing what had happened.
“Um... Fan’er, is the pressure from your Divine Kingdom’s development too great recently?” Sun Rong asked with a face full of concern.
“How about we mortgage the micro-mineral vein?” Yang Tiexin turned to discuss with Sun Rong.
Seeing his parents not believe him at all, Yang Fan felt helpless in his heart.
“Mom, Dad, can’t you have a little trust in your son?” Yang Fan complained.

“Trust? Of course we trust you, but you can’t make fun of your parents. The Luo Family is recruiting you as a live-in son-in-law; as long as the contract is signed, there’s an initial investment of 100 million Faith Points, plus a B-grade building. This...”

“Son, after your mother and I mortgage the mineral vein, we’ll take you to the psychiatric department of the best hospital in Yang County, the Liujia Hospital. Every year, many students suffer mental breakdowns due to too much pressure. This is not a small matter.” Yang Tiexin said, full of worry.
“I...” Yang Fan was speechless.
Just then, there was a knock at the door.
“Did you ask Old Zhang to buy food?” Sun Rong asked.
“The believers have enough to eat for now; I was planning to buy some next month.”
“Then who is this?”
“I’ll go open the door and see.” Yang Tiexin stood up and walked to the door.
As the door opened, five burly men came into view; the aura emanating from the leader was actually that of a demigod powerhouse.
“This... this senior, have you come to the wrong place?” Yang Tiexin’s tone trembled slightly.
Mingyue Community was the slum of Yang County, and everyone living here was a Divine Being.
How could a demigod-level existence come to visit?
“Is this Young Master Yang Fan’s home?” the leader asked politely.
“Yang Fan, Young Master???” Yang Tiexin was full of question marks.
At this moment, Yang Fan also came to the door: “I am Yang Fan, who are you all?”

“Greetings, Young Master Yang Fan. You are now a second-tier genius of my Luo Family. My name is Zhan Yunxiao, and I am a guest elder of the Luo Family. Until you graduate from university, I will be the one to help you handle internal family affairs. As for these four, they are the moving company personnel arranged by Elder Luo Chengfeng to help you move your things to the villa in Yang City,” Zhan Yunxiao explained.
“Please come in.” Yang Fan pulled Yang Tiexin aside and made a gesture of invitation.
The moving company was very professional, bringing professional packing boxes and stuffing everything in the room into them all at once.
Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong were both stunned at this moment, watching as several rooms were completely emptied in less than a quarter of an hour, unable to react to what had happened.
A demigod powerhouse, the Luo Family, a villa in Yang City.
Everything their son had said just now was true?
Even though Yang Fan’s parents were filled with doubts, they dared not say a word in front of the demigod powerhouse, Zhan Yunxiao.
The moving company drove the truck to lead the way, while Zhan Yunxiao acted as the driver, taking Yang Fan’s family of three to follow behind.
Yang Fan sat in the passenger seat and couldn’t help but say: “Senior.”

“Young Master Yang, there is no need for such formalities. Since you have been rated as a second-tier genius by the family, your future achievements will not be below mine. I am the guide assigned to you by the Luo Family. During your upcoming student days, you may ask me about anything, Young Master,” Zhan Yunxiao explained.
Looking at the other person’s meticulous appearance, Yang Fan was a bit curious: “Do all Luo Family geniuses have demigod powerhouses accompanying them?”
“Only geniuses of the second tier and above have this treatment.”
“Are there many such geniuses?”
“As of now, there are 14 first-tier geniuses who have not yet graduated from university, and 468 second-tier geniuses.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan gasped.
As expected of the Luo Family; just the personnel investment in this aspect alone was nearly five hundred demigod powerhouses.

“However, in your batch, Young Master Yang, there are only two first-tier geniuses: Miss Luo Bing and Luo Hen. There are seventy-six second-tier geniuses, twenty-eight of whom are from Yang County No. 1 Middle School, while most of the others are being trained in the city,” Zhan Yunxiao explained.
Perhaps feeling that the truck in front was moving too slowly, Zhan Yunxiao turned on the autopilot and then took out a thin electronic tablet and handed it to Yang Fan.

sentences.text: Children of great families are just that pragmatic.
Even if they feel they have entrusted themselves to the wrong person, they don’t choose to cry or renege immediately, but instead rationally make the optimal choice.
Yang Fan nodded subconsciously.
“My grandfather has arranged for a moving company to go to your community; you will have to explain things to your parents yourself.
Please treat me well for the remainder of my short life, my partner — Yang Fan.” Luo Rou said, neither sad nor happy.
Before Yang Fan could reply, a repulsive force acted upon him, instantly returning him to reality.
Taking off his virtual helmet, Yang Fan immediately slapped himself: “How could you say that?
You’ve offended her completely now.”
The two hundred Moon Wells and Sun Springs in Luo Rou’s Divine Kingdom had a normal monthly income of 1.2 million, but in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, it would be 12 million.
Because of this, Yang Fan had subconsciously spoken his thoughts; by then, wouldn’t purchasing the Water of Life be more than enough?
It was a win-win.
The idea was beautiful, but the reality was a misunderstanding; this wife he had just met had likely already pegged him as a total scumbag.
On the other side, Luo Rou also returned to her study in the real world.
At this moment, she wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes, looked at her haggard face in the mirror, and said in a sorrowful tone: “Luo Rou, oh Luo Rou, what are you hoping for?
Haven’t you seen enough similar things during this time?
It was just a partnership to begin with.”
“Girl, are you done talking?” Luo Chengfeng knocked and opened the door.
Luo Rou nodded.
“How do you feel about that kid?”
“Not bad.” Luo Rou chose to hide the last bit of unpleasantness; after all, given her current situation, she wasn’t in a position to be picky.
Continuing to complain would only make things difficult for her grandfather.
“That’s good.
I’ve investigated; although Yang Fan’s parents are only Divine Beings, their reputation in Mingyue Community is quite good, and they are not mean or petty people.
This villa will be left for you and them to live in; with them helping to take care of you, I can be more at ease.
For the next period, I have to go clear land for the family.”
After Luo Chengfeng finished speaking, he took out a card and placed it in Luo Rou’s palm.
Feeling the information on the card, it actually contained five drops of the Water of Life.
“Grandfather, don’t work so hard; there’s no need to continue investing these strategic resources into my Divine Kingdom.”
“I am, after all, a Tier 1 Deity.

If it weren’t for the fact that this Water of Life is so scarce, the market price has been hyped up too high, and the Luo Family treasury is out of stock, I would gladly support you for another hundred years,” Luo Chengfeng said.
“Your parents-in-law and Yang Fan will move in today.
Use these five drops of the Water of Life together; on your wedding night, my granddaughter must look beautiful.”
“Thank you, Grandfather, your granddaughter understands.” Luo Rou smiled, her cheeks even showing a blush.
“I’m leaving first.
You two must work hard so I can hold a grandchild soon.”
After Luo Chengfeng’s aura completely disappeared from the villa, Luo Rou’s expression instantly returned to normal.
Luo Rou threw the card on the table, crossed her arms, and snorted coldly: “Does this scumbag deserve it?
A dog who leeches off his wife’s family.
Except for my grandfather, not a single man is a good person.”
While saying this, Luo Rou kicked the corner of the table hard, the pain causing her eyes to well up with tears again.
In Mingyue Community, Yang Fan was currently sitting at the dining table with his parents, discussing what had happened.
Fan’er, is the pressure from your Divine Kingdom’s development too great recently?” Sun Rong asked with a face full of concern.
“How about we mortgage the micro-mineral vein?” Yang Tiexin turned to discuss with Sun Rong.
Seeing his parents not believe him at all, Yang Fan felt helpless in his heart.
“Mom, Dad, can’t you have a little trust in your son?” Yang Fan complained.
“Trust?
Of course we trust you, but you can’t make fun of your parents.
The Luo Family is recruiting you as a live-in son-in-law; as long as the contract is signed, there’s an initial investment of 100 million Faith Points, plus a B-grade building.
This...”
“Son, after your mother and I mortgage the mineral vein, we’ll take you to the psychiatric department of the best hospital in Yang County, the Liujia Hospital.
Every year, many students suffer mental breakdowns due to too much pressure.
This is not a small matter.” Yang Tiexin said, full of worry.
“I...” Yang Fan was speechless.
Just then, there was a knock at the door.
“Did you ask Old Zhang to buy food?” Sun Rong asked.
“The believers have enough to eat for now; I was planning to buy some next month.”
“Then who is this?”
“I’ll go open the door and see.” Yang Tiexin stood up and walked to the door.
As the door opened, five burly men came into view; the aura emanating from the leader was actually that of a demigod powerhouse.
“This... this senior, have you come to the wrong place?” Yang Tiexin’s tone trembled slightly.
Mingyue Community was the slum of Yang County, and everyone living here was a Divine Being.
How could a demigod-level existence come to visit?
“Is this Young Master Yang Fan’s home?” the leader asked politely.
“Yang Fan, Young Master???” Yang Tiexin was full of question marks.
At this moment, Yang Fan also came to the door: “I am Yang Fan, who are you all?”
“Greetings, Young Master Yang Fan.
You are now a second-tier genius of my Luo Family.
My name is Zhan Yunxiao, and I am a guest elder of the Luo Family.
Until you graduate from university, I will be the one to help you handle internal family affairs.
As for these four, they are the moving company personnel arranged by Elder Luo Chengfeng to help you move your things to the villa in Yang City,” Zhan Yunxiao explained.
“Please come in.” Yang Fan pulled Yang Tiexin aside and made a gesture of invitation.
The moving company was very professional, bringing professional packing boxes and stuffing everything in the room into them all at once.
Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong were both stunned at this moment, watching as several rooms were completely emptied in less than a quarter of an hour, unable to react to what had happened.
A demigod powerhouse, the Luo Family, a villa in Yang City.
Everything their son had said just now was true?
Even though Yang Fan’s parents were filled with doubts, they dared not say a word in front of the demigod powerhouse, Zhan Yunxiao.
The moving company drove the truck to lead the way, while Zhan Yunxiao acted as the driver, taking Yang Fan’s family of three to follow behind.
Yang Fan sat in the passenger seat and couldn’t help but say: “Senior.”
“Young Master Yang, there is no need for such formalities.
Since you have been rated as a second-tier genius by the family, your future achievements will not be below mine.
I am the guide assigned to you by the Luo Family.
During your upcoming student days, you may ask me about anything, Young Master,” Zhan Yunxiao explained.
Looking at the other person’s meticulous appearance, Yang Fan was a bit curious: “Do all Luo Family geniuses have demigod powerhouses accompanying them?”
“Only geniuses of the second tier and above have this treatment.”
“Are there many such geniuses?”
“As of now, there are 14 first-tier geniuses who have not yet graduated from university, and 468 second-tier geniuses.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan gasped.
As expected of the Luo Family; just the personnel investment in this aspect alone was nearly five hundred demigod powerhouses.
“However, in your batch, Young Master Yang, there are only two first-tier geniuses: Miss Luo Bing and Luo Hen.
There are seventy-six second-tier geniuses, twenty-eight of whom are from Yang County No.
1 Middle School, while most of the others are being trained in the city,” Zhan Yunxiao explained.
Perhaps feeling that the truck in front was moving too slowly, Zhan Yunxiao turned on the autopilot and then took out a thin electronic tablet and handed it to Yang Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Choosing a B-Rank Building
paragraphs: “Young Master Yang, the monthly stipend and initial Faith Points investment from the family will be deposited into your Divine Kingdom this afternoon. In addition, there is a B-rank building for you to select.”
Yang Fan looked down at the content on the electronic tablet.
“Hundred Spirits Blood Pool: Input flesh and blood to convert into Blood Pills, which can accelerate cultivation; long-term consumption can improve aptitude.”
“Spirit Weapon Workshop: Input ores to automatically generate weapons; the strength of the weapons depends on the grade of the ore itself, capable of mass-producing up to E-rank weapons.”
“Mechanical Heart: Can slowly improve the physical structure of believers, causing their bodies to lean towards a Mechanical Civilization.”
Unlike the mall, the descriptions on the tablet were very concise; besides the building names, the descriptions of their functions were also very simple.
“Senior Zhan, are there only three B-rank buildings to choose from?”
“B-rank buildings are strategic resources. Even for the Luo Family, there aren’t many available for genius disciples to choose from.”

Zhan Yunxiao’s words were a tactful way of saying that Yang Fan was only a genius with an outside surname; although the family promised a B-rank building, it would certainly be of the lowest value tier.
“I wonder what suggestions Senior Zhan might have?”
Zhan Yunxiao was, after all, a demigod powerhouse and was now his guide; Yang Fan naturally wanted to make good use of this network resource.
“It depends on the direction you choose, Young Master. If you plan to develop towards a Mechanical Civilization in the future, then you can just choose the Mechanical Heart directly.”

“If you want to make Divine Kingdom investments to earn a large amount of Faith Points in the early stages, and then feed back into the Divine Kingdom to improve the strength of your believers later, the Spirit Weapon Workshop is a good choice.”

“As for the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool, it is more comprehensive; the Blood Pills it produces can increase the strength of believers, and the annualized return from selling Blood Pills is also not low,” Zhan Yunxiao shared his understanding.
Yang Fan pondered for a moment and then made up his mind to choose the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.
With this investment from the Luo Family and under his Evolution Talent, Yang Fan was confident that his ability to earn resources would far exceed others.
In comparison, the improvement of his believers’ strength was more important.

The school competition this time was a good example; if he had chosen to reinvest all his Faith Points back into the Divine Kingdom to pursue so-called compound interest, he wouldn’t have achieved such excellent results to be invested in by a great family like the Luo Family.
Resources are important in the Era of Divine Kingdoms, but the core is still strength itself.
“I choose the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool,” Yang Fan confirmed.

Zhan Yunxiao nodded: “The application will be approved by this afternoon, and the family will send the resources to your inbox. I have already added you as a friend in the Virtual World; if you have any questions in the future, you can contact me directly. Whether it’s Divine Kingdom resource allocation, family benefit applications, or even trivial life matters, as long as you have a need, I am available.”
“Then, thank you very much.”
“No need to be polite, this is my job,” Zhan Yunxiao said seriously.
Arriving at the Yang City villa, Zhan Yunxiao bowed to Yang Fan and then departed.
He was the guide arranged by the Luo Family for Yang Fan, not a nanny; he had other things to do normally.
Furthermore, with the Virtual World, he could help Yang Fan remotely with any issues.
This Yang City villa was built in the center of Yang County with excellent privacy.
The movers left after placing the items in the front yard.
At this moment, Luo Rou pushed open the door to the living room.
“Husband.” Luo Rou revealed a sweet smile.
Yang Fan looked at her and was momentarily stunned.
Luo Rou’s skin was now fair and tender, as if it would break at a touch.
Her whole being was filled with a rich aura of life, like a young girl in the prime of her youth.
Most importantly, she possessed that noble temperament from a great family, which for a moment made Yang Fan unable to look away.
Yang Fan thought he had developed resistance to beauty after several sessions of Liu Ruyan’s ‘training,’ but at this moment, he realized his state of mind still needed more cultivation.
“Hello, Mother-in-law; hello, Father-in-law.” Before Yang Fan could speak, Luo Rou went to the two elders and bowed respectfully.
Looking at this girl who looked like a princess, Sun Rong felt it was surreal.
“Are you really my daughter-in-law?” Sun Rong rubbed her eyes hard.

“Of course I am. However, my Divine Kingdom is damaged and I don’t have much lifespan left, so I’m actually punching above my weight with my husband. Before I die, I only hope to have children with him; then I will be satisfied.” Luo Rou squeezed out a tear, looking pitiful and eliciting sympathy.
Hearing this, Sun Rong instantly grew anxious.
She turned around and smacked the back of Yang Fan’s head, then grabbed him by the ear and dragged him in front of Luo Rou.

“Daughter-in-law, don’t talk nonsense! Don’t I know what this boy is worth? That you can take a liking to him is a blessing he’s earned over ten lifetimes; how can you say you’re punching above your weight? From now on, you’re the boss of this house. If he dares to bully you, Old Yang and I will break his legs.”
Sun Rong was a simple and honest person.
Being naturally kind-hearted, seeing Luo Rou’s pitiful appearance made her wish the girl were her own biological daughter in that instant.
As for her biological son Yang Fan, he had long been tossed to the back of this loving mother’s mind.

Seeing Yang Fan’s dazed state, a flash of cunning crossed Luo Rou’s eyes, and she couldn’t help but feel smug: “You stinky scumbag. With such kind and reasonable parents, how did they give birth to a guy like you who wants to live off a woman? Hmph, as long as I’m alive, don’t even think about bullying me.”
“Daughter-in-law, the sun is strong outside. Go to your room and rest quickly. Your mother and I will take care of these things,” Yang Tiexin said while carrying a large moving bag.
“Thank you, Dad.” Luo Rou nodded.

Although she had taken the Water of Life, her Divine Kingdom was currently like a room leaking air from all sides; those life energies would slowly dissipate, so as a deity, she also had to reduce her physical exertion.
Yang Fan was about to follow her upstairs when he was called back by his mother, Sun Rong.
“Yang Fan, come over here and help.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression was somewhat confused.
Their family didn’t have many things; there was no need for him to lend a hand.
However, his mother had given an order, and Yang Fan couldn’t very well talk back, so he could only obediently go out to carry furniture.
“You brat, such a good girl, you must treat her well. If I find out you’ve let Little Rou suffer any grievances, I’m not done with you,” Sun Rong whispered an admonishment.
“No, I didn’t...”
“Then why did my daughter-in-law look like she was about to cry just now?”
“How should I know why she looked like that?” Yang Fan’s face twitched.
Although he had said some bastarly things this morning, the aura Luo Rou displayed back then was stronger than his own; she was a completely different person just now.
And now that Luo Rou had restored her original appearance, Yang Fan himself was full of confusion and wanted to go upstairs to ask her about it.

“There’s nothing wrong with being a matrilocal son-in-law, and besides, this is the Luo Family. You’ve gotten such a huge bargain, don’t be ungrateful. From now on, you just stay home and pamper your wife, you hear me?” Yang Tiexin also said with a solemn face.

Having confirmed that Yang Fan had become a matrilocal son-in-law of the Luo Family, Yang Tiexin, as a father, didn’t have the slightest dissatisfaction; his heart was only filled with worry about whether this might be a fleeting happiness.

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Virtual World Luo Family Base
paragraphs: Their family were merely ordinary Divine Beings; compared to a behemoth like the Luo Family, they were not a match in terms of status.
For now, all he could do was urge Yang Fan to cherish Luo Rou well.
“I... I understand.” Yang Fan didn’t want to explain too much and could only go along with what his parents said.
As expected of a villa area, the equipment in the room was extremely complete.
Intelligent robots, massage chairs, temperature and humidity controllers, and all kinds of furniture emitting high-class fragrances.
Looking at this complete arrangement, Yang Tiexin only felt that the things his family had brought over were not presentable.
After studying them for a moment, he packed those pieces of furniture back into his pocket and tossed them into a corner outside the courtyard.
Since their child had hooked up with a wealthy woman, as parents, they shouldn’t force themselves to suffer unnecessarily.
Yang Fan went upstairs alone and pushed open the room door.
At this moment, Luo Rou was already lying half-reclined on the bed in her pajamas, closing her eyes to rest.

Sensing movement, Luo Rou opened her eyes and said in a calm tone, “Drink the medicine on the table; it’s a fertility potion. Then, go take a shower immediately. We’ll get down to business in ten minutes.”
At this moment, there was no trace of the pitiful appearance Luo Rou had earlier.
Her gaze toward Yang Fan was like looking at a stranger—calm and wise.
Having returned to her normal state, Luo Rou was very beautiful.
Due to her damaged Divine Kingdom, she now possessed an added sense of laziness.
Watching her lying on the bed like that, Yang Fan’s body had already reacted.
Yang Fan coughed and asked, “What happened to your body?”
“Taking five drops of the Water of Life at once will temporarily suppress the poison fog, but it won’t last very long,” Luo Rou explained casually.
“Hurry up, don’t dawdle. I want to sleep after we’re done.”
Hearing her distant tone, Yang Fan felt a bit awkward, but he still followed her instructions.
After showering, Yang Fan jumped onto the bed and pinned Luo Rou beneath him.
His movements startled Luo Rou.
“I... I’m not in good health right now, be gentle.” Luo Rou bit her lip lightly.
There was some fear in her eyes, but she refused to show weakness, summoning her courage to stare fixedly into Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Don’t worry, I’m not a scumbag. There was a genuine reason for what happened this morning,” Yang Fan whispered in Luo Rou’s ear.
Feeling the hot breath from Yang Fan’s mouth, Luo Rou hurriedly closed her eyes and urged, “Hurry up. I want to sleep in a bit; I’m very tired, understand?”
“If I hurry up, I won’t be able to be gentle.”
“You deadbeat scumbag, don’t force me to call my parents.”
“Are you sure? Should we call them while we’re in this state?”
“Are you trying to die!”
Luo Rou’s physical condition was indeed very poor, and since it was her first time, even though Yang Fan tried his best to control his movements, she still found it difficult to bear.
Watching Luo Rou lying on the bed with a pale face, having already fallen asleep, Yang Fan couldn’t help but stroke her cheek.
“Don’t worry, I will cure you,” Yang Fan said in a serious tone.
Unlike Liu Ruyan from the Tianxiang Renjian, Luo Rou was truly the first woman in his life.
Yang Fan even had to admit that although they had only met a few times, Luo Rou had truly moved him.
Life is like a journey; those with strong hearts will always stride forward firmly, but this process doesn’t necessarily have to be lonely.
If someone treats me with sincerity, I will surely treat them with sincerity.
Yang Fan wasn’t sleepy yet, so he sat at the desk and opened the inbox on his wristwatch.
“Outsider Second-Class Talent Yang Fan, congratulations on receiving the Luo Family’s Second-Class Talent evaluation. You are now awarded the B-rank building, Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.”
A card containing the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool building fell into Yang Fan’s right hand.
Besides this, there were also buildings given to him by Luo Rou, but they came with a legal document; he could only retrieve these resources after signing his name.
Yang Fan read through it roughly, and after finding no issues, he signed his name.
Afterward, Yang Fan entered his Divine Kingdom and loaded the resources.
A large number of Moon Wells and Sun Springs were deployed inside God-Enlightenment City.
In an instant, a terrifying aura of life spread out, and the surrounding plants began to grow crazily.
Then came the B-rank building, the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.
Its footprint was as large as two hundred square kilometers, and Yang Fan couldn’t even place it within any of his cities.
With a thought from Yang Fan, a giant mountain outside God-Enlightenment City was moved away, and the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool immediately appeared in that location.
The moment the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool appeared, a powerful bloody scent spread out.
This bloody scent was pure yet rich in vitality; even if his believers lived in the surrounding area, they wouldn’t fall ill because of it.
“Faith Points: 143.22 million (daily Faith Points provided: 3.7)”
“Buildings: Moon Well x207, Sun Spring x207, B-rank building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool x1”
The 36 million rewarded by Yang County No.
1 Middle School, plus the 100 million initial investment from the Luo Family, and the monthly subsidy of 5 million had all arrived.
Now, the Faith Points in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had reached an extremely exaggerated level.
At this moment, Yang Fan took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the excitement in his heart.
“With such a large sum of funds, I must be very cautious about how to spend it. It would be better to ask someone for advice.”
Yang Fan put on his helmet and entered the Virtual World.
The moment he entered, Yang Fan received several invitations from his classmates, including Li Shuhao and Zhang Pang.
Yang Fan did not accept the invitations but instead found Zhan Yunxiao’s chat box and politely typed, “Senior Zhan, do you have time now?”
A moment later, a coordinate address popped up in the chat box.
Yang Fan tapped the coordinates, and his consciousness was instantly pulled to a pavilion.
Inside the small room, there were only Yang Fan and Zhan Yunxiao, but outside it was very noisy.
There were sounds of chatting, shouting, the clashing of ironware, and waves of heat.
“Where is this?”

Seeing Yang Fan’s curiosity, Zhan Yunxiao patiently explained, “This is the Luo Family’s base in the Virtual World. In this era, the economic benefits created by the Virtual World have long surpassed reality; it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say this is a mirror of the real world. Every major family has its own base in the Virtual World, where they can trade, study, and even fight.”
Unlike those born into major families, commoners like Yang Fan had less exposure, but Zhan Yunxiao did not look down on him because he, too, had climbed up from the bottom.
“Senior Zhan, the resources from the Luo Family have arrived. I came here now because I wanted to ask for your advice.” Yang Fan bowed respectfully.
“You really don’t need to call me Senior. In the Luo Family, your status is even above mine,” Zhan Yunxiao said with a wry smile.
“This...”
“I am several hundred years your senior! If Young Master Yang is willing, just call me Elder Zhan.”
“Since that is the case, please enlighten me, Elder Zhan.”
“How many Faith Points do you have now?”
“140 million.”
“So many?” Zhan Yunxiao’s eyes showed surprise.
“I obtained 36 million Faith Points in the school competition.”
“So that’s it. With such results, it’s no wonder you were evaluated by the Luo Family as a Second-Class Talent. Have you received the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool?”
“It has already been loaded into my Divine Kingdom.”

“Then I suggest you first buy ten adult Tai Sui to fill the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool to capacity. In reality, it can steadily produce about 10,000 blood pills per month, with each pill priced at 100 Faith Points. Without considering the value of the B-rank building itself, its annualized rate of return is around 50%.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was a bit confused: “Is this return a bit low?”

For now, all he could do was urge Yang Fan to cherish Luo Rou well.
I understand.” Yang Fan didn’t want to explain too much and could only go along with what his parents said.
As expected of a villa area, the equipment in the room was extremely complete.
Intelligent robots, massage chairs, temperature and humidity controllers, and all kinds of furniture emitting high-class fragrances.
Looking at this complete arrangement, Yang Tiexin only felt that the things his family had brought over were not presentable.
After studying them for a moment, he packed those pieces of furniture back into his pocket and tossed them into a corner outside the courtyard.
Since their child had hooked up with a wealthy woman, as parents, they shouldn’t force themselves to suffer unnecessarily.
Yang Fan went upstairs alone and pushed open the room door.
At this moment, Luo Rou was already lying half-reclined on the bed in her pajamas, closing her eyes to rest.
Sensing movement, Luo Rou opened her eyes and said in a calm tone, “Drink the medicine on the table; it’s a fertility potion.
Then, go take a shower immediately.
We’ll get down to business in ten minutes.”
At this moment, there was no trace of the pitiful appearance Luo Rou had earlier.
Her gaze toward Yang Fan was like looking at a stranger—calm and wise.
Having returned to her normal state, Luo Rou was very beautiful.
Due to her damaged Divine Kingdom, she now possessed an added sense of laziness.
Watching her lying on the bed like that, Yang Fan’s body had already reacted.
Yang Fan coughed and asked, “What happened to your body?”
“Taking five drops of the Water of Life at once will temporarily suppress the poison fog, but it won’t last very long,” Luo Rou explained casually.
“Hurry up, don’t dawdle.
I want to sleep after we’re done.”
Hearing her distant tone, Yang Fan felt a bit awkward, but he still followed her instructions.
After showering, Yang Fan jumped onto the bed and pinned Luo Rou beneath him.
His movements startled Luo Rou.
I’m not in good health right now, be gentle.” Luo Rou bit her lip lightly.
There was some fear in her eyes, but she refused to show weakness, summoning her courage to stare fixedly into Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Don’t worry, I’m not a scumbag.
There was a genuine reason for what happened this morning,” Yang Fan whispered in Luo Rou’s ear.
Feeling the hot breath from Yang Fan’s mouth, Luo Rou hurriedly closed her eyes and urged, “Hurry up.
I want to sleep in a bit; I’m very tired, understand?”
“If I hurry up, I won’t be able to be gentle.”
“You deadbeat scumbag, don’t force me to call my parents.”
“Are you sure?
Should we call them while we’re in this state?”
“Are you trying to die!”
Luo Rou’s physical condition was indeed very poor, and since it was her first time, even though Yang Fan tried his best to control his movements, she still found it difficult to bear.
Watching Luo Rou lying on the bed with a pale face, having already fallen asleep, Yang Fan couldn’t help but stroke her cheek.
“Don’t worry, I will cure you,” Yang Fan said in a serious tone.
Unlike Liu Ruyan from the Tianxiang Renjian, Luo Rou was truly the first woman in his life.
Yang Fan even had to admit that although they had only met a few times, Luo Rou had truly moved him.
Life is like a journey; those with strong hearts will always stride forward firmly, but this process doesn’t necessarily have to be lonely.
If someone treats me with sincerity, I will surely treat them with sincerity.
Yang Fan wasn’t sleepy yet, so he sat at the desk and opened the inbox on his wristwatch.
“Outsider Second-Class Talent Yang Fan, congratulations on receiving the Luo Family’s Second-Class Talent evaluation.
You are now awarded the B-rank building, Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.”
A card containing the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool building fell into Yang Fan’s right hand.
Besides this, there were also buildings given to him by Luo Rou, but they came with a legal document; he could only retrieve these resources after signing his name.
Yang Fan read through it roughly, and after finding no issues, he signed his name.
Afterward, Yang Fan entered his Divine Kingdom and loaded the resources.
A large number of Moon Wells and Sun Springs were deployed inside God-Enlightenment City.
In an instant, a terrifying aura of life spread out, and the surrounding plants began to grow crazily.
Then came the B-rank building, the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.
Its footprint was as large as two hundred square kilometers, and Yang Fan couldn’t even place it within any of his cities.
With a thought from Yang Fan, a giant mountain outside God-Enlightenment City was moved away, and the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool immediately appeared in that location.
The moment the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool appeared, a powerful bloody scent spread out.
This bloody scent was pure yet rich in vitality; even if his believers lived in the surrounding area, they wouldn’t fall ill because of it.
“Faith Points: 143.22 million (daily Faith Points provided: 3.7)”
“Buildings: Moon Well x207, Sun Spring x207, B-rank building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool x1”
The 36 million rewarded by Yang County No.
1 Middle School, plus the 100 million initial investment from the Luo Family, and the monthly subsidy of 5 million had all arrived.
Now, the Faith Points in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had reached an extremely exaggerated level.
At this moment, Yang Fan took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the excitement in his heart.
“With such a large sum of funds, I must be very cautious about how to spend it.
It would be better to ask someone for advice.”
Yang Fan put on his helmet and entered the Virtual World.
The moment he entered, Yang Fan received several invitations from his classmates, including Li Shuhao and Zhang Pang.
Yang Fan did not accept the invitations but instead found Zhan Yunxiao’s chat box and politely typed, “Senior Zhan, do you have time now?”
A moment later, a coordinate address popped up in the chat box.
Yang Fan tapped the coordinates, and his consciousness was instantly pulled to a pavilion.
Inside the small room, there were only Yang Fan and Zhan Yunxiao, but outside it was very noisy.
There were sounds of chatting, shouting, the clashing of ironware, and waves of heat.
“Where is this?”

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Zhan Yunxiao's Financial Planning Strategy
paragraphs: If one only considers the input cost of the taisui meat, the rate of return is indeed quite good, but you must know that this is utilizing a B-grade building.
The value of a B-grade building is at least five hundred million and up; looking at it this way, the rate of return is actually very low.

“The Hundred Spirits Blood Pool produces Blood Pills based on the energy of the flesh and blood invested. Ten taisui are far from the limit of a B-grade building. When you become a demigod or even a god in the future, go and slay high-level alien believers, cast their physical bodies into it, and the Blood Pills produced can reach tens or even hundreds of thousands.”
But for now, if you choose to buy corpses from the mall, the cost is too high.

“Given the situation of your Divine Kingdom, this taisui meat is the most cost-effective option. Most importantly, there is no need to instruct believers to constantly cast flesh and blood into the blood pool; it is very convenient,” Zhan Yunxiao explained the reasoning patiently.
A look of realization appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
With his current strength, a B-grade building is indeed too overpowered, so naturally, he cannot utilize it to its fullest extent.
Yang Fan was not anxious about this; after all, he possessed the Evolution Talent.
Once he put the taisui into it, this fixed monthly income would reach as high as ten million.

“If you want to quickly increase the strength of your believers in the short term, I can give you a resource procurement list. You can judge for yourself whether to purchase, after all, everyone’s Divine Kingdom development is different. If you want to consider the ecological stability, species diversity, and resource self-sufficiency rate of your Divine Kingdom, then I suggest you spend money to find an Actuary to help.”
“May I ask how much an Actuary charges?” Yang Fan asked curiously.
“The cheapest is 50 million Faith Points.”
Yang Fan swallowed hard, somewhat shocked by this price.

Seeing Yang Fan’s expression, Zhan Yunxiao laughed: “Don’t think it’s expensive. These Actuaries have real skills. They can help you adjust the species distribution within your Divine Kingdom, establish buffer zones between different organisms, and determine the training methods and directions for your believers. This job is highly sought after; every major family basically recruits them. Hiring an Actuary once can basically allow you to cultivate until you reach the demigod level, without needing to plan the Divine Kingdom again in the meantime. If you have enough Faith Points, there is no need to be stingy, as this can significantly reduce the development time of your Divine Kingdom.”
“Thank you for your guidance, Elder Zhan.” Yang Fan nodded, but in his heart, he had already decided not to spend this wasted money.
After all, for him, the thing with the lowest value was time.

Giving such a large amount of Faith Points to an Actuary would be better spent purchasing massive resources to put into the Divine Kingdom, letting them undergo Evolution on their own, survival of the fittest, while also earning resources on the side.

“I have sent you two documents: one focusing on increasing the strength of believers, and one regarding insights on Divine Kingdom investment. These are all my personal opinions. Your aptitude is better than mine, so use them only for reference and select the best parts.”
Yang Fan said gratefully: “Thank you, Elder Zhan.”
This was the experience of a demigod powerhouse regarding the early development of a Divine Kingdom, and it would certainly be of great help to him now.

“Besides that, a second-class genius of the Luo Family can receive a loan of 50 million Faith Points, with an annual interest rate of only 11.2%. I have already applied for this family benefit for you, and it should be deposited into your Divine Kingdom in a little while.”

“Now that you are a genius of the Luo Family, you can visit the Luo Family’s Virtual World base at any time. There are also various trades within the family, including weapons, medicinal materials, spiritual plants, and various medicinal pills. Although not as complete as the official platform, because there is no tax, the prices are much lower. You can come and take a look when you have time.”
“I understand.”
“Work hard to improve the strength of your believers; the better you perform, the higher the support you will receive,” Zhan Yunxiao instructed as a final piece of advice.
Yang Fan kept these words in his heart, ignored the invitations from other classmates, and exited the Virtual World directly.
Carrying a huge sum of money, Yang Fan felt uncomfortable all over if he didn’t make Divine Kingdom investments as soon as possible.
Before making large-scale purchases, Yang Fan decided to first open the documents that Zhan Yunxiao had sent him to take a look.

“The development of a Divine Kingdom mainly lies in resources. If you want to let resources snowball, the choice of Divine Kingdom investment is extremely important. I, Zhan Yunxiao, am just an ordinary person. Being able to achieve the demigod level relies on excellent investment and financial planning strategies. I have summarized a basic investment philosophy: for ordinary people, any investment with an annualized rate of return lower than 80% should not even be touched.”
Seeing the introduction to one of the documents, a few black lines appeared on Yang Fan’s forehead.
“This Elder Zhan, after all that, is actually a financial whiz, but this seems to contradict my development direction,” Yang Fan couldn’t help but complain.

“Century-old Blood-thirsting Spirit Mushroom: The seed purchase price is extremely low, ten thousand seeds only cost ten thousand Faith Points. Each plant requires a believer to carefully tend to it, watering it with the believer’s blood daily, and it will mature in a hundred years. A single century-old Blood Spirit Mushroom sells for as high as 10 Faith Points, and in reality, the profit margin can increase tenfold in three months. This is the secret to my achievement of the demigod level; I wouldn’t speak of it lightly to anyone I didn’t favor. The disadvantages of this method are also very obvious: it consumes a huge amount of believers. Watering the Blood Spirit Mushroom in this way, believers usually do not live past 30 years old, and over a hundred years, it will consume about fifty thousand believers. Therefore, cultivating century-old Blood Spirit Mushrooms cannot be done on a large scale; five percent of the total believer population is the optimal cultivation quantity. This method needs to be used in conjunction with a D-grade or higher Breeding Card, remember, remember.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan only felt a chill rise up his back.
This seemingly serious demigod Zhan Yunxiao, who would have thought that behind the scenes he was such an evil capitalist?
This is basically selling the blood of his believers.
It wasn’t that Yang Fan had any feelings for those believers, but such an investment model always gave one a chilling feeling.
Although the investment rate of return is terrifying, during that period, the development of the Divine Kingdom’s believers would likely fall into stagnation.

“With the Evolution Talent, I had better not look at these crooked paths.” Yang Fan put the investment-related suggestions aside and began to study how the other party improved the strength of believers.

“Blood Demon Flower: This flower is a C-grade spiritual plant. Planting it in large areas around the city will make believers develop an appetite and an urge to exercise. The believers’ physical bodies will improve significantly in the short term, but at the same time, it will affect the believers’ consciousness, and their comprehension will gradually decrease. In the long term, it damages the believers’ foundation. This method is best used for a sudden boost one month before the assessment.”

“Meat-Swallowing Technique: A C-grade cultivation technique that can make practitioners extremely crave meat. This technique will cause the believers’ bodies to become swollen and their flexibility to decrease, but their defensive and offensive power will significantly increase. One must constantly monitor the living conditions of the believers; if the meat supply is insufficient, the believers will kill each other, trade their children to eat, or even devour each other.”
“This...” Yang Fan tilted his head, seemingly wanting to say something but stopping himself.
For a moment, Yang Fan felt like he didn’t recognize this senior anymore.
He looked so normal, yet who would have thought he was so ruthless to his own believers.
Yang Fan had a hunch that the potential of this senior Zhan Yunxiao’s Divine Kingdom had likely reached its end, and it was impossible for him to break through to the god realm in this lifetime.
“Trying to help the shoots grow by pulling them, short-sighted,” Yang Fan evaluated in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Sooner or Later I'll Fall Out of Favor
paragraphs: If Zhan Yunxiao knew how Yang Fan evaluated him, he would probably be so angry he would start cursing.
For an ordinary person to reach the demigod realm step by step through their own efforts without resorting to these crooked paths, how could it even be possible?
His potential might be exhausted, but out of ten thousand ordinary people like him, could even one demigod emerge?
The experience Zhan Yunxiao taught Yang Fan was also genuinely for his own good; after all, the pros and cons were clearly identified.
As fellow ordinary people, there was naturally a sense of mutual sympathy.
It was just a pity that Yang Fan had the SSS-rank Talent and simply could not feel the other party’s good intentions.
“Zhan Yunxiao’s methods are all too extreme. With the Evolution Talent, there’s no need to take such a path. It was a waste of time to read it.”
Yang Fan muttered, his consciousness entering the Divine Kingdom once again.
At this moment, he discovered that his Faith Points had reached 193.22 million.
The 50 million loan from the Luo Family had also arrived.
Opening the shop, Yang Fan first purchased fourteen adult Taisui.
He threw ten of them directly into the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool, and placed the other five beside the five major cities as fixed channels for providing flesh and blood.
This cost 28 million Faith Points.
To round off the numbers, Yang Fan purchased 193 Moon Wells and Sun Springs each, spending 115.8 million directly.
The Moon Wells and Sun Springs were long-term fixed investments Yang Fan planned to make; he was not prepared to cut corners on this.

As the number of these two buildings in the Divine Kingdom increased, coupled with the Evolution Talent, the probability of his buildings mutating into a Fountain of Life was naturally ten times higher than anyone else’s.

Most importantly, he didn’t need to worry about this investment, allowing him to devote himself entirely to improving the strength of his believers and the ecological development of the Divine Kingdom.
Afterwards, Yang Fan purchased the C-rank technique, the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, spending 2 million Faith Points.
In an instant, Yang Fan’s Faith Points dropped to 47.42 million.
After investing all the resources into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan issued a Divine Decree.
“My believers, to reward you for your outstanding performance in the war against the alien races, I have specially bestowed a miracle. Beside every major city, there is an adult Taisui.”

“Outside the Divine Enlightenment City, there is a Hundred Spirits Blood Pool. Every thirty years, it can produce ten thousand blood pills. Only the strong are worthy of consuming them; these pills can significantly improve physical fitness.”

“This technique is called the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique. When practiced in conjunction with the Federal Body Refinement Technique, it can rapidly improve your strength.”
As the Divine Decree descended, the faces of the believers in each major city showed expressions of fanaticism.
God Lord: Yang Fan.
Divine Kingdom Area: 1 million square kilometers.
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster).
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate the Evolution of the Divine Kingdom, already hidden.).
Believers: First-order beings (5), Mortals (70,000).
Techniques: Federal Body Refinement Technique, Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Minor Success).
Faith Points: 47.42 million (Provides 3.7 Faith Points daily).
Buildings: Moon Well X400, Sun Spring X400, B-rank building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1.
Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X78777, Level 1 monster)...
Taisui X15, water lotus (X21000, F-rank spirit plant), soul nourishing wood (100 years) (X1000, C-rank spirit plant), hundred spirit peach (X35711, C-rank spirit plant).

Yang Fan’s face revealed a look of satisfaction: “Now, under the effect of the Evolution Talent, the Moon Wells and Sun Springs can provide 24 million Faith Points of income every month. With the Taisui’s support, the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool can provide 10 million Faith Points of income. Added to the various monster and spirit plant assets, my actual monthly income is over 35 million. However, since the blood pills are to be used to cultivate believers, there’s no need to sell them.”

Yang Fan had already made a decision in his heart: all blood pills would be invested into his own Divine Kingdom to strengthen his believers, while the earnings from the Moon Dew and Sun Essence could be used for further investment in the Divine Kingdom or to purchase other resources to enrich it.
There were still many Faith Points remaining, and Yang Fan was not in a rush to spend them for the time being.

Now that he had enough Faith Points, he wanted to take advantage of this time to browse the shop properly, research things he couldn’t afford before, or exchange experiences with his classmates to see if there were any buildings or spirit plants more suitable for him.
Faith Points could never be earned in full; he still needed to keep some safety funds for himself.
Moreover, he now had a wife suffering from a terminal illness who also needed money every month to purchase the Water of Life.
After finishing all this, Yang Fan looked at the beautiful woman lying on the bed.
Feeling somewhat exhausted, he went straight to bed, held her in his arms, and drifted into dreamland.
Early the next morning, Yang Fan entered the Divine Kingdom to check on things.
With the support of the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, the believers’ consumption of meat had risen to another level.
However, with five Taisui and the blood pills produced from time to time, this consumption was just a piece of cake.
Even though his Divine Kingdom’s time flow was ten times faster than others, development still required a lot of time.
When not investing resources, staring at it constantly was meaningless.
“Should I buy some Breeding Cards to speed up the Divine Kingdom?” Yang Fan was somewhat conflicted.
The last time he used Breeding Cards, the resource burden on the Divine Kingdom was too heavy, which caused Yang Fan quite a headache.
Moreover, there were no assessments in the short term, so he could completely let the Divine Kingdom develop freely.
Some things, when forced to grow, are counterproductive; too much is as bad as too little.
Yang Fan, whose consciousness was currently in the Divine Kingdom, suddenly felt the person in his arms move and hurriedly returned to reality.
Luo Rou opened her eyes and discovered she was lying in Yang Fan’s arms, and he was looking at her.
Her face flushed red, and she subconsciously wanted to push Yang Fan away, but realized her body was too weak to break free.
“You... you let go of me.”
“Since we’ve already bared all to each other, what are you shy about?”
“Are you shameless?”
“We are husband and wife, is this considered shameless?” Yang Fan teased.
Looking at Luo Rou’s coy and clinging appearance, Yang Fan couldn’t help but tease her a bit.
The once noble daughter of a wealthy family had been cast down to the mortal world, and it was actually his, a country bumpkin’s, good fortune to pick her up.
Just then, Sun Rong’s soft voice came from outside the door: “Yang Fan, Rou’er, are you awake? I’ve prepared the meal.”
“Mom, I’m already awake, I’ll be down in a moment.” Luo Rou answered first.
“Okay, if you feel you haven’t slept enough, you can sleep a bit longer. I’ll have that brat Yang Fan bring the food up, you can eat in bed.”
“No need.”
Hearing the conversation between the two, Yang Fan gave the beautiful woman in his arms a strange look.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but say: “Do you have a split personality?”
“No.”
“Then why is your attitude toward me and my parents so different?”
“When facing good people, I am a good person. When facing bad people, I am a bad person.” Luo Rou explained while putting on her clothes.
“I’ve already explained yesterday’s matter, it’s not what you think.” Yang Fan couldn’t help but rub his temples.
“Instead of listening to what others say, it’s better to watch what they do.”
Leaving this sentence behind, Luo Rou went downstairs alone.
As expected of someone from a wealthy family, the ingredients in the refrigerator were all second and third-order monster meat.
The atmosphere at the dining table was somewhat awkward for a moment.
Except for Yang Fan, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong were both looking at the young lady, Luo Rou, cautiously, and for a moment, they didn’t dare to touch their chopsticks.
Luo Rou picked up a piece of meat and put it into her mouth.
Her face instantly filled with a smile, and she said: “Mom’s cooking is really good, I want to eat it every day from now on.”
Hearing this, Sun Rong breathed a sigh of relief, and the atmosphere at the dining table eased up quite a bit.
Seeing this, Yang Fan was a bit impressed by Luo Rou; his wife’s ability to coax elders was truly superb.
Unlike him, no matter what he said, his parents wouldn’t believe it.
For a moment, Yang Fan actually had the feeling that if things went on like this, he would sooner or later fall out of favor.

sentences.text: If Zhan Yunxiao knew how Yang Fan evaluated him, he would probably be so angry he would start cursing.
For an ordinary person to reach the demigod realm step by step through their own efforts without resorting to these crooked paths, how could it even be possible?
His potential might be exhausted, but out of ten thousand ordinary people like him, could even one demigod emerge?
The experience Zhan Yunxiao taught Yang Fan was also genuinely for his own good; after all, the pros and cons were clearly identified.
As fellow ordinary people, there was naturally a sense of mutual sympathy.
It was just a pity that Yang Fan had the SSS-rank Talent and simply could not feel the other party’s good intentions.
“Zhan Yunxiao’s methods are all too extreme.
With the Evolution Talent, there’s no need to take such a path.
It was a waste of time to read it.”
Yang Fan muttered, his consciousness entering the Divine Kingdom once again.
At this moment, he discovered that his Faith Points had reached 193.22 million.
The 50 million loan from the Luo Family had also arrived.
Opening the shop, Yang Fan first purchased fourteen adult Taisui.
He threw ten of them directly into the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool, and placed the other five beside the five major cities as fixed channels for providing flesh and blood.
This cost 28 million Faith Points.
To round off the numbers, Yang Fan purchased 193 Moon Wells and Sun Springs each, spending 115.8 million directly.
The Moon Wells and Sun Springs were long-term fixed investments Yang Fan planned to make; he was not prepared to cut corners on this.

As the number of these two buildings in the Divine Kingdom increased, coupled with the Evolution Talent, the probability of his buildings mutating into a Fountain of Life was naturally ten times higher than anyone else’s.

Most importantly, he didn’t need to worry about this investment, allowing him to devote himself entirely to improving the strength of his believers and the ecological development of the Divine Kingdom.
Afterwards, Yang Fan purchased the C-rank technique, the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, spending 2 million Faith Points.
In an instant, Yang Fan’s Faith Points dropped to 47.42 million.
After investing all the resources into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan issued a Divine Decree.
“My believers, to reward you for your outstanding performance in the war against the alien races, I have specially bestowed a miracle.
Beside every major city, there is an adult Taisui.”
“Outside the Divine Enlightenment City, there is a Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.
Every thirty years, it can produce ten thousand blood pills.
Only the strong are worthy of consuming them; these pills can significantly improve physical fitness.”
“This technique is called the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique.
When practiced in conjunction with the Federal Body Refinement Technique, it can rapidly improve your strength.”
As the Divine Decree descended, the faces of the believers in each major city showed expressions of fanaticism.

Divine Kingdom Area: 1 million square kilometers.
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster).
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate the Evolution of the Divine Kingdom, already hidden.).
Believers: First-order beings (5), Mortals (70,000).
Techniques: Federal Body Refinement Technique, Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Minor Success).
Faith Points: 47.42 million (Provides 3.7 Faith Points daily).
Buildings: Moon Well X400, Sun Spring X400, B-rank building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1.
Assets: Bodhi Precious Snake (X78777, Level 1 monster)...
Taisui X15, water lotus (X21000, F-rank spirit plant), soul nourishing wood (100 years) (X1000, C-rank spirit plant), hundred spirit peach (X35711, C-rank spirit plant).

Added to the various monster and spirit plant assets, my actual monthly income is over 35 million.
However, since the blood pills are to be used to cultivate believers, there’s no need to sell them.”

Moreover, he now had a wife suffering from a terminal illness who also needed money every month to purchase the Water of Life.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Divine Kingdom Development Paths
paragraphs: After the meal, they went upstairs.
In the room, Yang Fan took Luo Rou’s right hand and directly transferred 5 million Faith Points to her.
Feeling the changes within her Divine Kingdom, Luo Rou looked puzzled and asked, “Why are you transferring 5 million Faith Points to me?”
“I will transfer them to you every month. Before I have the ability to cure you, use the Water of Life to keep yourself stable,” Yang Fan said straightforwardly.
Luo Rou looked at Yang Fan in disbelief; her eyes held confusion, bewilderment, and even a trace of wariness.
Although these 5 million Faith Points were far less than the assets she had given Yang Fan, Luo Rou had never expected Yang Fan to transfer funds to her.
‘Aren’t scumbags supposed to only take and never give?’
Luo Rou felt a bit doubtful in her heart, wondering if she had misunderstood him, or if perhaps Yang Fan was playing the long game to catch a big fish.
However, her Divine Kingdom currently had no assets left; the remaining Faith Points were only for purchasing basic supplies.
There was simply no fish for him to catch.
Right now, her only value was having a grandfather who was a First-Order God, but for a Divine Being to covet the property of a god, wasn’t that just courting death?
“You...” Luo Rou stopped mid-sentence, not knowing what to say.
“What?”
“Nothing. I suggest you only consider the rights and obligations within the contract. If you overthink, be careful that you end up with nothing.”
“What do you mean?”
“Forget it if you don’t understand.” Luo Rou snorted and continued lying on the bed, preparing to rest.
With five drops of the Water of Life helping to suppress the poison in her Divine Kingdom, she had slept very well yesterday and now wanted to catch up on more sleep.
“I’m going to the Virtual World for class. Don’t disturb me unless it’s something important,” Yang Fan instructed before putting on his helmet.
As Yang Fan entered the classroom, everyone’s eyes landed on him.
“Brother Yang.”
“Brother Yang, good morning.”
Many people came up to greet him; by now, Yang Fan’s status in Class 7, Grade 12 was on the same level as Li Shuhao.
“Foster father, over here! I’ve saved a seat for you,” Zhang Pang jumped up and shouted.
Watching the other guy act the clown, Yang Fan smiled knowingly and strode over.
Sitting down beside Zhang Pang, Yang Fan noticed that the other guy appeared somewhat restrained.
“What’s up?” Yang Fan asked.
“Um, foster father.”
“Stop, just call me Brother Yang. That title is fine once, but it’s weird to keep using it,” Yang Fan rolled his eyes.
“Alright, Brother Yang. I heard you married into the Luo Family and are now a second-rate genius of the Luo Family,” Zhang Pang said, his face full of curiosity.
“How did you know?”
Yang Fan was also somewhat surprised.
All of this had only happened yesterday; how did it spread so quickly?

“It’s spread all over the school. There are quite a few direct descendants of the Luo Family in Class 1, Grade 12. This news spread through the chat groups, from ten to a hundred people. By this morning, basically the whole school knew. Yang County is only so big; what secrets could there be?” Zhang Pang explained.
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded, tacitly accepting it.

“Brother Yang, you’re really awesome to run into such a good thing. That’s the Luo Family, one of the two great families. From now on, you’ve flown up the branch to become a real dragon,” Zhang Pang said, full of envy.
Being a son-in-law of the Luo Family isn’t something anyone can just become.
Why did they settle on Yang Fan?
It must be because they saw his potential.
“Brother Yang, when are you coming to my house for a meal? Remember to bring my sister-in-law.”
“Your sister-in-law isn’t in good health and it’s inconvenient for her to go out, so you can come to my place instead.”
“Alright, I’ll come over for a free meal tonight.”
“I’ve moved to a new place. I’ll give you the address when the time comes.”
“You moved so quickly!”
As the two were chatting away, Li Qingying arrived in the classroom.
At that moment, her gaze also lingered on Yang Fan for a moment.

“After the school’s first major assessment ended, some students just went through the motions, while others gained a huge harvest. The matter is in the past, so I won’t be criticizing or praising anyone here.”

“Next, you need to prepare for the midterm exam. Especially those students in our class who are following the war path; for you, this is an important streaming exam. Not only does the school have corresponding rewards, but the factions you belong to will also use this exam as a basis for evaluation to determine your ranking.”
“The midterm exam in three months is a major competition second only to the college entrance exam. You cannot slack off from now on.”
“Yes, teacher,” everyone responded in unison.
“Today we are going to talk about the growth paths of believers. Student Yang Fan, I wonder what your insights are?” Li Qingying called his name directly.
‘Again?’ Yang Fan felt bitter in his heart.
He really didn’t like answering questions in class.
He just wanted to listen attentively and absorb knowledge, so how did he become the student representative?
He didn’t like the pressure of being in class!
“Ahem, Teacher Li, I don’t have any unique insights,” Yang Fan said awkwardly.
“Really?” Li Qingying looked suspicious.
She didn’t believe Yang Fan’s answer at all.
He had scored over twenty points in the first prosperity level assessment.
With such a knowledge reserve, he must have been studying hard in the library frequently; how could he not know this?
Li Qingying, who felt she had been tricked by Yang Fan last time, only felt that he was playing the pig to eat the tiger again.
Li Qingying felt a bit helpless about this; the top student in her class seemed a bit too low-key, making it hard to use him as an example.
“Li Shuhao, you tell us,” Li Qingying said, turning her head.

Li Shuhao stood up and spoke eloquently: “After believers reach the status of mortals, they begin to break through levels, from First-Order creatures to Fifth-Order creatures. After that, the Divine Kingdom must choose a development direction, which is what the teacher calls a path.”
“Currently, there are three most common paths for the development of human Divine Kingdoms.”

“The Cultivation path: Practicing techniques, from the inside out. The spiritual roots of believers are roughly divided into Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth. The realms are Qi Refining, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, etc.”
“The Martial Arts path: Practicing techniques from the outside in. The realms are Martial Disciple, Martial Master, Martial King, Martial Emperor, etc.”

“The Mechanical path: Not focusing on technique Cultivation, but choosing to use technology to modify the body. It is divided into First-Class Intelligent Life, Second-Class Intelligent Life, and so on.”
“Besides the three main paths, there are also the Phantom God path which focuses on the spiritual level, the Zombie path which follows the virus route, and so on.”

“However, there is too little information on other paths. They are often only suitable for specific groups of people, and the development direction is too singular. Unless there are special circumstances, it is not recommended to try them.”

Li Qingying was very satisfied with Li Shuhao’s answer: “Not bad. You are worthy of being the top student in our class. Even after becoming a second-rate genius of the Li Family, you still take the time to learn all kinds of knowledge. Keep it up, and your future achievements will surely be extraordinary.”

“Thank you for the compliment, teacher. I still have a lot to learn in terms of theoretical knowledge, and I dare not show off in front of my classmates.” At this point, Li Shuhao deliberately glanced at Yang Fan.
By now, the default top student in Class 7, Grade 12 was Yang Fan.
Even though he would just answer that he didn’t know when asked questions in class, everyone just assumed he was being low-key.
Watching the admiring gazes everyone directed toward him, Yang Fan felt restless.
He really didn’t know what Li Shuhao had just said.
Why were all these people starting to “overthink” it.

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Brother Yang are you still accepting Subordinate Gods
paragraphs: Everyone listened very attentively during this class, especially those students who believed they had a chance to ascend to Demigod.
Li Qingying explained the development directions, advantages, and disadvantages of each path very clearly.
Yang Fan also pricked up his ears and sat upright.
“That is all for today’s class. For those students who wish to breakthrough to Demigod or even God, you must start preparing from now on.”

“If you choose the Cultivation path, you can start cultivating various spiritual plants and fruits in your Divine Kingdom. If believers consume rare treasures over a long period, the probability of birthing geniuses with spiritual roots will significantly increase.”
“Similarly, the martial path requires cultivating precious medicines that can temper the body; the mechanical path requires family support to purchase a Mechanical Heart as early as possible.”
After saying this, Li Qingying’s figure disappeared from the Virtual World.
After the teacher left, Li Shuhao stood up and said, “Fellow brothers, let’s gather at the usual place! It’s my treat today.”
“Long live Brother Hao.”
“It has to be Brother Hao; you are too good to your brothers.”
The boys in the class instantly became excited, looking foolishly infatuated, completely unconcerned with what the female students thought.
The girls, however, felt a bit awkward.
Now, in Class 7, besides Li Shuhao, there was also the big shot Yang Fan.
If they could exchange experiences on Divine Kingdom development with such people, there would naturally be many benefits.
However, Li Shuhao had a special fondness for the Tianxiang Renjian, and since he hadn’t invited them, the girls couldn’t bring themselves to shamelessly tag along.
“Why are they going to the Tianxiang Renjian again? Can’t they change to another place?”
“This group of boys is so disappointing; I must never marry any of these classmates in the future.”
Many girls complained inwardly.
Arriving at the private room in the Tianxiang Renjian, Yang Fan and Li Shuhao sat in the innermost seats facing the door.
Wang Zhenyu sat on Li Shuhao’s right, and Zhang Pang also sat on Yang Fan’s left due to their relationship.
The other students sat down casually; after all, they were all Gods following the logistics path, and their future achievements would be roughly the same.

“Brother Yang, I’d like to congratulate you here on receiving investment from the Luo Family. In the future, you will surely soar and become a true God.” Li Shuhao raised his glass to congratulate him.
The other students also raised their glasses toward Yang Fan.
Today, Yang Fan was vastly different from a few days ago; he was now a member of a major family.
Barring any accidents, he would surely be an existence that everyone looked up to in the future.
“You’re too kind. Let’s make progress together in the future.” Yang Fan replied politely.
Yang Fan, who possessed an SSS-rank Talent when awakening his Divine Kingdom, hadn’t shown any arrogance, let alone now that he had become a second-tier genius of the Luo Family.
Yang Fan really didn’t feel much about this; he just felt that his future path was a bit smoother, and it couldn’t be counted as a great opportunity.
However, his calm demeanor appeared unfathomable in the eyes of others.
To receive investment from the Luo Family and still maintain such a peaceful mindset—he was truly worthy of being the class’s top student.
With this attitude of not being swayed by material gains or personal losses, he seemed just like someone who had lived for several hundred years.
Li Shuhao gave a thumbs up and said, “I still have a lot to learn from Brother Yang.”
“It is I who should learn from you. The questions you answered in class today really broadened my horizons.” Yang Fan said earnestly.

“Damn, stop playing that ‘playing the pig to eat the tiger’ act with me. There are so many classmates here, don’t be sarcastic with me.” Li Shuhao’s face flushed slightly, and he actually glared at Yang Fan.
Seeing this, Yang Fan was also stunned for a moment.
He had only spoken his true thoughts, so why was the other person angry?
“We’re all classmates, it’s just a joke, don’t be so serious. Come on, everyone, let’s drink.” At this moment, Zhang Pang spoke up to liven up the atmosphere.
“Right, let’s drink. We haven’t gathered for almost half a month since the major exams a while ago.”
“By the way, Wang Zhenyu, I’ve cultivated about 5,000 adult Bodhi Precious Snakes again. Do you want them?”
“Yes, I’ll take as many as you have.”

“My Divine Kingdom has a batch of E-rank spiritual plant Ice Begonia Flowers. Using them in medicine and consuming them over a long period is beneficial for awakening spiritual roots. Brother Hao, Brother Yang, if you are planning to take the Cultivation path, I can help you cultivate them. The price is negotiable.”
“And me, I have three micro-mineral veins in my Divine Kingdom. I wonder if you are still lacking any Subordinate Gods?”
Everyone chatted one after another, but the core content still revolved around Li Shuhao and Yang Fan.
Especially Yang Fan; now that he had flown up to the branches, and no one had heard of him having any Subordinate Gods, other students naturally wanted to cling to such a powerful backer.
“I already have three Subordinate Gods: Mazi, Wei Feng, and Yumo. I don’t have any need for now.” Li Shuhao shook his head.
The three people Li Shuhao mentioned were precisely the three students in Class 7 with the best Divine Kingdom resource-type talents.
One had a Planting Talent, one had an Animal Husbandry Talent, and another had a small mineral vein in their Divine Kingdom.
It is not the more Subordinate Gods, the better.
Once a contract is signed, the Subordinate God’s Divine Kingdom will open to the protector.
Not only do they need to station troops to protect the other party, but if someone invades, they must also send troops to reinforce them, or even launch a Divine Kingdom war.
Benefits and risks are inherently relative.
If someone serves as your Subordinate God, they sell the resources in their Divine Kingdom to you at a low price and must prioritize your needs.
How could one get so many benefits for nothing?

Although there is no risk of war before graduating from university, and the existence of Subordinate Gods is entirely beneficial and harmless to the development of one’s own Divine Kingdom, the benefits obtained now will all have to be returned in the future.
The Subordinate God contract signed is different from federal law; it has higher rule-based restrictions, similar to an oath sworn between Gods.
Once violated, the Divine Kingdom will suffer Heavenly Punishment; in severe cases, the Divine Kingdom core might even shatter.
This is also why many Divine Kingdoms following the logistics path choose to become someone else’s Subordinate God while still in school.
First, everyone is a classmate, so the level of trust is relatively high.
Second, once they enter society and face the pressure of their Divine Kingdoms being invaded, their bargaining chips will be extremely low.
To ensure their own safety, they can only sell their Divine Kingdom resources at a pittance.
Many people’s gazes turned toward Yang Fan.
Currently, in Class 7, Grade 12, only Li Shuhao, Yang Fan, and Wang Zhenyu were qualified to accept Subordinate Gods.
Li Shuhao had no intention of accepting more Subordinate Gods, and anyone with a discerning eye could see that Yang Fan’s potential was far above Wang Zhenyu’s.
If given the chance, everyone hoped to become Yang Fan’s Subordinate God.
The stronger the Main God’s strength, the higher the status of their Subordinate Gods will rise.
Those grain merchants, weapon workshops, and butcher shops in the residential districts—which one of them didn’t rely on a powerful God?
Otherwise, with so many resources just sitting in their Divine Kingdoms, they would have been invaded long ago.
“I haven’t thought that far ahead yet.” Yang Fan said indifferently.
With the Evolution Talent, Yang Fan was not lacking in those basic resources at all, so naturally, he had no motivation to develop Subordinate Gods.
Upon hearing this, everyone’s faces revealed expressions of disappointment.
“Brother Yang, if you change your mind one day, feel free to contact me at any time.”
“Me too. My father is preparing to take out a loan for me to buy another micro-mineral vein. Not to mention anything else, I can provide a lot of weapons for Brother Yang’s student days.”
Yang Fan indicated that he would keep it in mind, but he didn’t care much in his heart.
“Old Wang, your results in this exam were also good. Did you manage to get any investment?” The classmate who had just sold the Bodhi Precious Snakes asked Wang Zhenyu.
Wang Zhenyu nodded: “The Ma Family gave me 20 C-rank buildings, and there is also a subsidy of 100,000 Faith Points every month.”
“The Ma Family? Could it be that big grain merchant from Yang County?”
“Brother Wang, you’re awesome! This investment is quite substantial.”
Many classmates’ faces revealed envious expressions.
A subsidy of 100,000 per month was an astronomical figure for an ordinary family.
“The initial investment can be considered earned back.” Wang Zhenyu smiled slightly; he couldn’t say he was satisfied, but he wasn’t disappointed either.
Compared to Yang Fan, the investment he received wasn’t worth mentioning, but for himself, this could be considered an explanation to his family.
