chapters.title: Chapter 38: Genius Exchange Group
paragraphs: For the rest of the time, everyone began to exchange information about the development of their respective Divine Kingdoms, including Divine Kingdom investments, how to improve the strength of believers, as well as various types of demonic beasts and spiritual plants.
After listening for a while, Yang Fan could not help but frown.

He realized that since receiving the investment from the Luo Family, the things his classmates were discussing seemed to no longer be on the same level as his own, and much of their experience was completely unnecessary to learn from.

For instance, with the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool steadily producing blood pills, there was simply no need to cultivate the low-tier spiritual plants that his classmates mentioned for improving the strength of believers.
Furthermore, regarding Divine Kingdom investments, Yang Fan’s current monthly income was in the tens of millions, so he had absolutely no interest in those small-scale venture investments.
“It seems there is no need to attend these class reunions in the future,” Yang Fan decided in his heart.
People strive for higher ground, just as water flows downward; since these experiences were meaningless to him, he might as well save his time to browse the God Forum more often.
After having their fill of food and drink, Li Shuhao arranged a separate private room for everyone, and soon only he and Yang Fan remained in the room.
“After receiving the Luo Family investment, do you find this gathering boring?” Li Shuhao asked with a smile.
Yang Fan nodded and asked with some curiosity, “You quite enjoy organizing these types of events, don’t you?”
It should be known that Li Shuhao’s circumstances were the same as his; attending gatherings at this level meant he could basically only offer advice to others without gaining any help himself.
Yang Fan could not understand this time-wasting behavior of his.

“The development of a Divine Kingdom mainly relies on its own evolution; pouring resources in and staring at it constantly doesn’t have much meaning. Besides studying in the library, I always have to find some amusement for myself. Don’t you think this feeling of being the center of attention is great!” Li Shuhao said with extreme pride.
Hearing his explanation, Yang Fan felt a headache coming on; it turned out this guy just liked to show off.
“Getting down to business, I received a task from the group leader to invite you to the group, and I have sent you a link.”
“Group leader?”
Yang Fan looked at the message that suddenly popped up, which read: “Yang County Genius Exchange Group (Class of 2026) invites you to join.”
Yang Fan tapped lightly with his right hand, and within a few breaths, the administrator approved it, and group messages began to pop up one after another.
“A newcomer has arrived, is there a red envelope?”
“Welcome, classmate Yang Fan. New members, please change your nickname. This group uses real names: [Affiliation Prefix] + [Personal Name].”

“So it’s Brother Yang Fan. I am Tie Feng from the Blacksmith Association. If your Divine Kingdom’s believers ever need weapons, you can come to me. The prices are favorable, and I guarantee they are cheaper than the mall.”
“Let’s grab a drink sometime; I am Wang Yuan, a member of the Li Family by marriage.”
Li Shuhao said, “Since it’s your first time in the group, you could send a red envelope of 100,000 Faith Points as a gesture.”
Yang Fan nodded; he didn’t care about such a small expenditure at all now.
With the newcomer’s red envelope, many people in the group were drawn out.
Yang Fan opened the red envelope himself and discovered that the “Luckiest One” was actually a familiar name.
“Luo Bing, 30,000.”
“The group leader is amazing. Out of 100 people grabbing it, she snatched 30,000 out of 100,000.” Li Shuhao looked at the 199 Faith Points he had grabbed and nearly coughed up blood in anger.
“Are all the people in this group those geniuses from Class 1?” Yang Fan asked.

“Pretty much. It’s mainly the new generation of the major families in Yang County. Of course, there are also geniuses like us who stood out during the Divine Kingdom awakening and the grand competition. The group leader is Luo Bing, and the vice group leader is Li Tianheng; they are the top two prodigies in our No. 1 High School.”

“Didn’t you just feel that our Class 7 gathering was meaningless? The people in this group are the elite of this year’s No. 1 High School, and most of them were born into major families; their Divine Kingdom heritage, personal insight, and sources of information are all above ours. The things I used to show off at class reunions were actually just things I relayed from them.” Li Shuhao smiled awkwardly.
“No wonder. I thought the Li Family had gods giving lectures.”

“How is that possible? Do you think those gods are that idle? No matter how much of a genius we are, at the end of the day, we are only Divine Beings. In the eyes of those gods, we are still ants. Unless it’s a direct family member, for a second-tier genius like me, those elders wouldn’t even greet me if they met me.” Li Shuhao rolled his eyes.

“Whether it’s Divine Beings, demigods, or gods, everyone needs to trade with each other, cooperate to explore unknown realms, and help one another; that is the norm. If one remains isolated and fights alone, they will eventually be left further and further behind by others. This exchange group is like a small circle of mutual recognition where we can trade resources, share news, and sometimes the group even holds events. After graduating and going to university, members of the group can also become allies for offense and defense. Don’t mute the group messages; this group is truly useful for us,” Li Shuhao said with a serious expression.
Yang Fan nodded.
“Thank you.”
“Let’s not be formal with each other; we are both from Class 7, Grade 12, so our relationship is naturally closer than with the others.”
Just then, a prickly group message suddenly appeared.
“He’s just a live-in son-in-law of my Luo Family; since when did the threshold for entering the group become so low?”
The speaker’s nickname was Luo Mingxuan, a direct descendant of the Luo Family.
Looking at the message in the group, Yang Fan frowned slightly.

Li Shuhao couldn’t help but say, “Yesterday, when we were discussing whether you were qualified to join the group, this guy was already being snide. You just joined the Luo Family; how did you offend this person?”
Yang Fan shook his head.
“I don’t know him.”
“That’s strange. Could he be a troublemaker with a mental problem?” Li Shuhao couldn’t help but complain.
Everyone is a classmate; being able to join this group means one has sufficient potential.
The development of a Divine Kingdom is a long-distance run, and no one knows what the future holds.
Therefore, even if people look down on each other, they still greet each other with a smile on the surface; after all, you never know when you might need to cooperate.
Someone like Luo Mingxuan, who openly mocks others, is definitely an outlier.
“His talent is strong enough, and he is qualified to join the group. Do you have an opinion?” It was the group leader, Luo Bing, who spoke up.
Following Luo Bing’s statement, the entire group went quiet.
Luo Bing was the number one person in the third year of high school in Yang County this year, an absolute boss; since she had spoken, who would dare to talk back?
In the real world, in the Luo Family villa area, Luo Mingxuan slammed his virtual helmet onto the floor.
“A bumpkin actually dares to compete with me; just you wait.”
Luo Mingxuan dared not vent his anger at Luo Bing, so he could only transfer his rage onto Yang Fan, who hadn’t said a word from start to finish.
In the Virtual World, Yang Fan suddenly received a private message from Luo Bing.
“Do not worry about Luo Mingxuan. If he causes trouble, you can contact me. Take good care of my cousin.”
The other party speaking up for him was actually out of consideration for Luo Rou.
“My cheap wife actually knows this ice beauty!” Yang Fan was a bit surprised in his heart.
Now that he had a wife, Yang Fan felt embarrassed to spend the night at Tianxiang Renjian.
Under Li Shuhao’s “I understand you” gaze, Yang Fan returned to reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Signing the Subordinate God Contract
paragraphs: At this moment, Luo Rou had already finished her bath and was lying on the bed.
Looking at Yang Fan, she gave direct instructions: “Take your medicine, take a bath, get in bed, and get to business.”
Her attitude, as if she were arranging work, made Yang Fan unable to help but roll his eyes.
“Do you know Luo Mingxuan?” Yang Fan suddenly asked.
Upon hearing this name, Luo Rou’s expression changed slightly, and a trace of disgust flashed in her eyes: “Did he cause you any trouble?”
Watching the change in Luo Rou’s expression, Yang Fan secretly thought to himself, ‘As I thought.’
He had just joined the Luo Family and hadn’t even met everyone yet, so how could he possibly have offended the other party?
The only possibility was that his wife had a grudge against him.
“Not exactly trouble.” Yang Fan shook his head.

“Luo Mingxuan has average talent, but his parents are both First-Order Gods. I am one year ahead of him. Before my divine kingdom was damaged, he had pursued me, but I rejected him. Later, when my incident happened, Grandfather wanted to take that past relationship into account and offer a larger dowry so that the two of us could unite and have a child. As a result, he felt disdain. Not only did he greedily demand core assets from Grandfather’s divine kingdom, but he also wanted to sign a prenuptial agreement stating that he would not bear any child-rearing expenses in the future. Because of this, the two families had some unpleasantness. It’s probably because of this that he is hostile toward you.”
Luo Rou did not hide anything, and at this moment, there was a trace of apology in her eyes as she looked at Yang Fan.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh at the ability of these members of big families to eat people without spitting out the bones.
Not only did he greedily demand a dowry, but he didn’t even want to raise his own offspring.
‘Who are you?
Are your genes really that valuable?’
No wonder the prenuptial agreement Luo Chengfeng wrote for him was so biased in favor of him, an outsider.
It turns out there was a precedent.
“Don’t worry about it. Rest assured, I will definitely cure you in the future.” Yang Fan gently kissed her, then went to the bathroom to take a shower.
Returning to the bed, Yang Fan directly rolled over and lay on top of Luo Rou.
“It doesn’t hurt as much today. Do whatever you want.” Luo Rou said softly.
Looking at her appearance, as if she were waiting to be plucked, although Yang Fan wanted to show off his prowess, he considered her body and chose to be gentle.
“Rou’er, I plan to have a friend over for breakfast tomorrow,” Yang Fan said after they were finished.
“Mm, that’s fine.” Luo Rou waved her hand; she was too tired to move.
After sending the villa address to Zhang Pang, Yang Fan hugged Luo Rou and drifted off to sleep.
Early the next morning, Sun Rong’s voice came from outside the bedroom door.
“Fan’er, Little Zhang is here. The food is almost ready. You and girl Rou should get up once you’re awake.”
Yang Fan answered, and he and Luo Rou began to get dressed.
“Is this friend very important? Do I need to put on makeup?” Luo Rou asked.
Living in a big family, Luo Rou valued etiquette highly.
Although Yang Fan came from an ordinary background, he was now her husband, so she would try her best to take care of Yang Fan’s face in front of outsiders.

“He’s my best friend. No need to be too formal, just wear casual clothes. Although there is a big gap in our status now, human relationships aren’t just about interests. There are always those childhood friends you had; when you grow up, regardless of whether you are a God or a Divine Being, you can still sit at a roadside stall and eat barbecue.” Yang Fan explained.
Luo Rou looked at Yang Fan with some surprise; her opinion of this interest-first scumbag had changed slightly.
In the living room, Zhang Pang was very casual, knocking and looking around at the high-end furniture.
“Brother Yang, you’ve really made it. Only Gods and their families are qualified to live in these Yang City villas. The living environment is just different.” Zhang Pang was full of envy.

The instant he saw Luo Rou standing beside Yang Fan, Zhang Pang immediately stood straight and gave a standard military salute: “Hello, Sister-in-law. I am Brother Yang’s subordinate. Sorry for the intrusion. If you have any orders in the future, I will go through fire and water without hesitation.”
“You... hello.” Luo Rou said softly.
It was her first time meeting someone like Zhang Pang.
Although his face was full of flattery, his eyes were very clear, as if he would really carry out what he said.
“Time to eat.” Yang Tiexin said while helping Sun Rong in the kitchen.
Zhang Pang was someone he had watched grow up.
After moving to their new residence, having someone from Mingyue Community come to visit made the two elders very happy.
“I originally wanted to come over for a free meal last night, but Li Shuhao invited me out. It would be a waste not to take advantage of that.” Zhang Pang muttered while eating.
“Invited you out? Where?” Yang Tiexin asked casually.
“Tian... Tianyue Teahouse. Yes, the tea there is very good.” Zhang Pang lowered his head, thinking to himself that it was a close call; he almost let it slip.
“I don’t understand young people these days, drinking tea for that long.”
Zhang Pang did not answer.
With Luo Rou on the side, he was afraid that the more he said, the more mistakes he would make.
His big brother was a married man now.
Even if Tianxiang Renjian didn’t involve physical transactions, in the eyes of some women, emotional cheating was still cheating.
You have to know that Brother Yang married into the family.
Zhang Pang wished he could slap himself twice; it was all because his mouth couldn’t stop running.
Yang Fan ate a spiritual fruit from the table and asked: “Is there something you need to discuss in the real world?”
Yang Fan understood his best friend quite well.
When he invited him to dinner yesterday, he had noticed that his expression was a bit off.

“My dad told me to build a relationship with you as soon as possible and become your Subordinate God. You weren’t there when I sent invitations in the Virtual World, and there were too many people during class and parties. If I got rejected, I would lose so much face.”
With Yang Fan leading the way, Zhang Pang directly said what was on his mind.
Seeing this, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong hurriedly stood up and walked to the kitchen.
Over the past few days, they had learned about their son’s performance at school through various channels.
It was reasonable for classmates to want to become his Subordinate God.
The Subordinate God contract was very important.
It was better for the older generation not to listen to the affairs of the younger generation.
“No problem.” Yang Fan agreed directly.

“Really? You’re agreeing just like that? We haven’t even signed the contract yet. My dad said that with your talent, you are highly likely to become a God in the future. As long as the divine kingdom resources aren’t less than a 50% discount, I can agree to it.” Zhang Pang said frankly.
Hearing this, Yang Fan hadn’t reacted yet, but Luo Rou, who was on the side, couldn’t hold it in anymore.
What’s wrong with this person?
We haven’t even discussed the Subordinate God contract, and he’s already stated his bottom line.
“Um... are you two that close? That’s not how you negotiate a Subordinate God contract.” Luo Rou couldn’t help but remind them.
Luo Rou used to have her own Subordinate Gods.
That was done in the Virtual World with 360-degree, dead-angle-free cameras, negotiating seriously bit by bit; it would take hours to finish.
These two, on the other hand, one agreed nonchalantly, and the other stated his bottom line directly.
Luo Rou thought to herself that these country folks were too wild at negotiating; she wanted to go back to the city.
“We are brothers. If my big brother has meat to eat, he won’t leave me without a sip of soup.” Zhang Pang patted his chest, looking completely nonchalant.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Profitable Investment — Blood Clotting Flower
paragraphs: Zhang Pang had already made up his mind; even if he had to sell his Divine Kingdom’s resources at a 50% discount, he wouldn’t care.
At most, it would only limit the development of his Divine Kingdom in the short term.
As long as Yang Fan became a god in the future, he could open a grain shop in Mingyue Community just like his father, and entering the middle class wouldn’t be a dream.
“No need to sell them to me at a discount. Keep the grain grown in your Divine Kingdom for your own development!” Yang Fan shook his head with a smile.
He didn’t think much of the meager resources in Zhang Pang’s Divine Kingdom at all.
Letting the other party become his Subordinate God wasn’t based on benefits either; he just wanted to look after his best friend.
“Brother Yang, isn’t that bad?” Zhang Pang was stunned.

“If you can grow spirit rice or crops that help improve the aptitude of believers, you can sell them to me then. My Divine Kingdom is developing very well; I don’t need to bleed you dry for now,” Yang Fan said in a serious tone.
Yang Fan grabbed the other party’s right hand and connected his consciousness to the Divine Kingdom.
“Let’s go through the process,” Yang Fan said softly.
“God Yang Fan and God Zhang Pang sign a Subordinate God contract. Once the other party’s Divine Kingdom is invaded, troops must be sent to support. Other requirements: None.”
“God Yang Fan agrees.”
“God Zhang Pang agrees.”
A force of rules appeared in both their Divine Kingdoms.
Yang Fan could feel a one-way passage appearing between his Divine Kingdom and Zhang Pang’s Divine Kingdom; he could send troops to station in the other’s Divine Kingdom at any time.
“Foster father, you are truly too good to me.” Zhang Pang was so moved he almost shed tears.
“Get lost. Finish eating and hurry back to class. My house doesn’t have an extra virtual helmet for you to use.”

“Alright. Although this contract is signed, if Brother Yang has any needs, just let me know anytime. My Divine Kingdom can produce 100,000 tons of grain annually, along with some C-grade and D-grade spirit plants. Just say the word if you need anything.”
After Zhang Pang left, Luo Rou looked at Yang Fan with a hint of something inexplicable in her eyes.
“What’s wrong? Why are you looking at me like that?”
“I’m a bit surprised by what you did.”
“I often went to his house to bum meals when I was a kid, so I’m just helping a friend. I don’t think much of his Divine Kingdom’s resources anyway,” Yang Fan explained.
Luo Rou shook her head: “I just feel like you seem different from what I thought.”
Willing to sign such a Subordinate God contract for a friend, he didn’t look like a profit-seeking person at all.
At this moment, Luo Rou felt a sliver of trust in Yang Fan.
Perhaps he wasn’t a scumbag who preyed on the desperate, and there really was a reason for demanding those assets back then.
Returning to the room with Luo Rou, Yang Fan put on his helmet and began today’s study.
In the following days, Yang Fan’s life began to stabilize.
Besides attending classes, he spent his time in the Genius Exchange Group and the God Forum.
After paying the ‘public grain’ at night, he would check on the situation in his Divine Kingdom before resting.
Since being scolded by Luo Bing last time, Luo Mingxuan rarely spoke in the group.
To fully utilize resources, Yang Fan would directly post questions in the group whenever he had doubts about the development of his Divine Kingdom, not caring at all if others said he was ignorant.
By being so humble and eager to learn, Yang Fan actually obtained quite a bit of useful information.
Ten days passed, and a hundred years had already passed within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Supplied with blood pills and a large amount of taisui meat, the believer population was slowly recovering over these hundred years, and there were even several more Tier 1 Beings.
“Believers: Tier 1 Being (14), Mortal (100,000)”
Yang Fan understood that with the current resources in his Divine Kingdom, the believer population would continue to grow, but all of this would take time.
Virtual World, Yang County Genius Exchange Group.

“I received some news. The war with the alien gods on the front line is extremely fierce. The demand for the healing medicine ‘Top-Quality Hemostatic Powder’ is huge, and this medicine requires a D-grade spirit plant, the Blood Clotting Flower. It will be profitable in the short term.”
“Brother Li, where did you get this news? What is the rate of return?”
“My grandfather’s senior brother on the front line told me.”
Yang Fan watched the chat content in the group, already accustomed to it.
Even children of big families were often keen on Divine Kingdom investments; after all, no one ever had enough Faith Points.

“The Blood Clotting Flower is simple to cultivate; it only needs to be planted in fertile soil. It just has a long cycle, requiring 200 years in the Divine Kingdom. I heard from my grandfather that the shortage of this Blood Clotting Flower might not be filled within a year. Once planted, you can harvest at least twice the excess profit. This investment has high returns and low risk; it is definitely worth a try.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan’s expression gradually became serious.
A crop that is simple to cultivate with a long growth cycle—isn’t this just perfect for him?
Thinking of this, Yang Fan immediately went to the mall to check.

“Blood Clotting Flower seeds X10,000, selling price 100,000 Faith Points. Merchant’s note: Simple to sow, but this flower needs sufficient sunlight and water, so the Planting density is extremely sparse. It requires large-scale reclamation of farmland, and the maturity cycle is 200 years in the Divine Kingdom.”
“Mature Blood Clotting Flower X10,000 plants, selling price 300,000 Faith Points, D-grade spirit plant (restocking).”
Seeing this, Yang Fan already believed more than half of what that person said earlier.
200 days in reality, with a profit rate as high as 200%.
With the blessing of his tenfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan only needed 20 days to harvest a round.
Yang Fan’s eyes grew brighter and brighter.
If utilized properly, he might be able to take this opportunity to make a fortune from the war.
At this moment, a message popped up in the exchange group again.
“I just checked, the news is probably true, but the growth cycle of 200 days in the real world is still too long, and it requires large-scale reclamation of wasteland, which is a bit troublesome.”
“Exactly. If you invest too little, it’s pointless. If you plant on a large scale, it might severely damage the Divine Kingdom’s ecological environment. I’m torn.”
“I just placed an order for the seeds. I’m planning to let my Subordinate God plant them. With such a high rate of return, I’ll take 90% of the profits, and he’ll still make money.”
“That makes sense. It’s a pity my Subordinate God’s focus is animal husbandry and forging; I’m afraid I can’t do much with this investment.”
Although this message sparked discussion, the heat passed quickly due to the growth cycle of the Blood Clotting Flower and the trouble of reclaiming the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan didn’t continue to stare at the messages in the group, but instead began to search the God Forum for posts related to Top-Quality Hemostatic Powder and the Blood Clotting Flower.
After verifying the information from multiple sources, Yang Fan no longer hesitated and directly dumped 40 million Faith Points into it.
The first investment was a full 4 million seeds.
After obtaining the resource card, Yang Fan immediately loaded it into his Divine Kingdom and issued a Divine Decree.

“My believers, for the next period, you must send out all adult males to reclaim all suitable flat land into farmland. Then, plant the Blood Clotting Flower seeds. This flower needs sufficient sunlight and water, and it has a huge growth volume, so there must be a minimum distance of 10 meters between each seed.”
“We obey the Divine Decree.”
Even if the believers didn’t understand the god’s actions, they would not disobey.
The environment in the Divine Kingdom was not all suitable for farming.
Besides forests and mountains, there were also large areas of ocean and river basins.
Because Yang Fan hadn’t developed in the direction of Planting, the reclaimed farmland was very scattered.
It took nearly 100,000 believers several years to reclaim enough area to satisfy the Planting of these 4 million seeds.
It was a full 50,000 square kilometers.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh: “I thought this area of 1 million square kilometers was already big enough, but it’s still not enough.”
As a god, Yang Fan naturally knew roughly how much arable land there was in his Divine Kingdom.
If he let the believers continue to reclaim land, they could at most clear out another 50,000 square kilometers.
In that case, he could sow a maximum of 8 million Blood Clotting Flower seeds at one time, which meant 80 million in capital.

Because Yang Fan hadn’t developed in the direction of Planting, the reclaimed farmland was very scattered.
It took nearly 100,000 believers several years to reclaim enough area to satisfy the Planting of these 4 million seeds.
It was a full 50,000 square kilometers.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh: “I thought this area of 1 million square kilometers was already big enough, but it’s still not enough.”
As a god, Yang Fan naturally knew roughly how much arable land there was in his Divine Kingdom.
If he let the believers continue to reclaim land, they could at most clear out another 50,000 square kilometers.
In that case, he could sow a maximum of 8 million Blood Clotting Flower seeds at one time, which meant 80 million in capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Resource Sales
paragraphs: Under the influence of the Evolution Talent, 20 days have passed in the real world, yielding a revenue of 240 million and a gross profit of 160 million.
For a Divine Being like him, the term “profiteering” doesn’t even begin to describe these earnings.
“I’m going to be rich.” Yang Fan was completely overwhelmed with excitement.
This was the benefit brought by his status; because he was a second-tier talent of the Luo Family, he had the opportunity to enter the Genius Exchange Group.
Ordinary Divine Beings could never access such classified information; only descendants of great families with gods standing behind them had the chance to learn of it.
Yang Fan could be considered to have seized this opportunity to soar with the wind.
Yang Fan forcefully suppressed his inner excitement, trying his best to appear as usual.
After Planting the Blood Clotting Flower in his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan issued a Divine Decree to arrange for his believers to cultivate the remaining land.

Three days in the real world equaled 30 years in the Divine Kingdom; his believers had cultivated farmland on a large scale to plant the Blood Clotting Flower, which had already begun to affect the entire ecosystem of the Divine Kingdom.
Those plains had high-quality soil and abundant water resources, making them the best habitat for herbivorous creatures like antelopes, horses, and cattle.
But because of this investment, the creatures were forced to migrate.

After a large influx of other creatures, the living space in areas that had previously achieved ecological balance was drastically reduced, and there were even instances of mass death among the creatures.
Yang Fan didn’t care about this at all.
Compared to the massive profits, this minor loss from ecological damage was insignificant.
He could easily maintain the ecological balance by investing resources from the outside.
As long as his believers didn’t suffer mass casualties, these biological assets weren’t worth worrying about.
Yang Fan only regretted that his Cultivation area was too small; if conditions allowed, he would even want to fill in those rivers.
“Greed makes the snake swallow the elephant. One should only eat as much as one is capable of. I must learn to be content.” Yang Fan took a deep breath and muttered to himself.
Over the next few days, Yang Fan kept an even lower profile, listening attentively in class and selectively participating in class activities, trying his best to blend in.
Twenty days passed in a flash.
Yang Fan entered the Divine Kingdom, retrieved all 4 million Blood Clotting Flowers, the produced Moon Dew, and Sun Essence, and listed them for sale online.
The Blood Clotting Flower was indeed a hot commodity; as soon as Yang Fan listed them, they were snapped up.
“Sale successful. Blood Clotting Flowers sold out completely, revenue 120 million.”
“Sale successful. 20 drops of Moon Dew sold, revenue 20,000.”
“Sale successful. 50 drops of Sun Essence sold, revenue 50,000.”
“Sale successful...”
Notifications from Taotao Network kept coming.
In less than a quarter of an hour, everything he listed was sold out.

“Revenue 144 million Faith Points. After deducting 10% personal income tax and 2% platform transaction fee, the current income is 126.7 million. Faith Points have been deposited into the Divine Kingdom.”
This transaction amount was significant for Yang Fan, but on the entire trading platform, it probably wouldn’t even make a splash.
Moreover, the mall transactions were now all handled by Intelligent Life without human interference.
Coupled with the Federal Government’s personal information protection laws, Yang Fan didn’t worry at all that anyone would know he had earned so much.
Those capable of knowing Yang Fan’s account transaction status wouldn’t be interested in paying attention, and ordinary people couldn’t access it anyway.
This was a major benefit of the current world.
Although one couldn’t escape taxes, for the vast majority of people, you enjoyed absolute fairness in trading.
Opening a shop or company didn’t require seeking official stamps; anything could be sold without any official restrictions.
With the rise of Intelligent Life, such a free ecosystem emerged naturally, and commerce flourished.
With a large sum of Faith Points in his account, Yang Fan did not hesitate to buy 8 million more Blood Clotting Flower seeds, filling all the cultivated farmland.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: 1 million square kilometers”
“Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the Divine Kingdom grow 10% faster)”
“SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, already hidden.)”
“Believers: Tier 1 Being (34), Mortal (250,000)”
“Techniques: Federal Body Refinement Technique, Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Minor Success)”
“Faith Points: 53.42 million (Provides 7.5 Faith Points daily)”
“Buildings: Moon Well X400, Sun Spring X400, B-rank Building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1”
“Assets: Blood Clotting Flower seedlings (X8 million, D-rank Spirit Plant)... soul nourishing wood (thousand-year) (X1000, C-rank Spirit Plant)”
Since Planting the Blood Clotting Flower, the believers only needed to patrol regularly to prevent destruction by other creatures, spending the rest of their time reproducing and cultivating.
Because of this, the population and the number of Tier 1 Beings in the Divine Kingdom could grow steadily.

Even though the believers practiced the Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique and consumed more and more meat, thanks to the supply of five adult Tai Sui and the continuously produced blood pills, the believers’ food supply remained more than sufficient.
In these 200 years, more population should have been produced, but the living environment limited their development.
Simply put, the population density was too high.
The more people there were, the more crowded the living space became.
Coupled with activities like Cultivation, where one could constantly feel the process of becoming stronger, the desire for reproduction naturally decreased.
Nowadays, outside the tribe, as long as the land was flat, it was basically planted with Blood Clotting Flowers.
If not for this, his believers probably would have started expanding the scale of the tribe long ago, rather than being crowded into the five main cities.
Yang Fan was not anxious about this.
Although a large population could increase the probability of geniuses being born, with the Evolution Talent, this population base of 250,000 was sufficient for the time being.
Human development is about survival of the fittest.
People with good talent and high comprehension were more likely to survive and had a higher probability of having offspring.
Through generations of reproduction, it was still a positive effect for the entire civilization.
Compared to the advantages of the population itself, the resource income that the Blood Clotting Flower could bring was more important.
On the other hand, because of the existence of blood pills, in these 200 years, the number of Tier 1 Being believers had increased significantly, but there were still no Tier 2 beings.
In his exchanges with those geniuses, Yang Fan also found the reason.
Like those descendants of big families with backgrounds, they would all buy pills produced in Cultivation Divine Kingdoms.
One pill could help believers strengthen their muscles and cleanse marrow, significantly improving their aptitude, but the price was quite expensive.
By comparison, blood pills like those produced in batches by the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool were actually inferior, with high quantity but insufficient quality.
Yang Fan was not anxious about this; currently, a large amount of funds still needed to be invested in the Divine Kingdom.
Sharpening the knife doesn’t delay the woodchopping; as long as there were sufficient resources, plus the Evolution Talent, wouldn’t it be easy to surpass others?
After communicating with these family geniuses during this period, Yang Fan’s understanding of Divine Kingdom development had completely changed.
Previously, Yang Fan would consider ecological stability, biodiversity, the sustainable development of the Divine Kingdom, and self-sufficiency.
But after coming into contact with these geniuses, Yang Fan discovered they were on a completely different path.
Excess land was used to plant Spirit Plants, water was used to raise Spirit Beasts, and mountains and skies were used to raise Monster Beasts.
Everyone knew how to do these things, but the sole purpose of these family geniuses doing them was to earn Faith Points.
They would sell them every once in a while, completely unconcerned about whether it affected the ecology.
The resources obtained were all invested in the Cultivation of believers; strength was always ranked first.
What if the ecological balance is destroyed?
Buy some resources and put them in; as long as those beasts don’t starve to death, it’s fine.
What if low-level Monster Beasts die in large numbers?
That’s because the Monster Beasts have poor adaptability; replace them with a batch of adaptable ones at a suitable price.
What if Spirit Plants get sick?
Sell them quickly at a low price and buy other seeds.
Having less trouble and not wasting believers’ time was more important.
In short, all resources in the Divine Kingdom served the strength of the believers.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Luo Rou is Pregnant
paragraphs: After reaching this level, Yang Fan gradually realized that the way the wealthy played was truly different from ordinary people.
Unlike ordinary people, they had no survival worries; their families provided monthly subsidies, and every bit earned from investments in their divine kingdoms counted.
Ninety-nine percent of their energy was focused on strengthening their believers.
These families who possessed gods relied on monopolizing trade and gaining information advantages to earn vast resources.
Their descendants, meanwhile, relied on the support of their elders to quickly improve their strength and become the new generation of gods.
The strong remain strong, and it is always those ordinary Divine Beings who are exploited.
Yang Fan did not feel indignant about this.
The strong were merely utilizing the rules, not breaking them.
Those so-called heretics who wanted to overthrow the privileged class were merely opportunists looking for a shortcut.
If they succeeded, they would become the new privileged class; if they failed, most of those who died were just mindless pawns following the crowd.
Yang Fan was now a second-tier genius of the Luo Family and could be considered to have entered this system of the privileged, so the development path of his divine kingdom had undergone new changes.

“100,000 Bodhi Precious Snakes, 50,000 Dark Night Vultures, 200,000 Spirit Fish Babies, 80,000 Great Rocs, 80,000 Peregrine Falcons, Water Lotus Seeds... 1,000 pieces of thousand-year soul nourishing wood.”
Yang Fan directly put his resources on a massive clearance sale.
He no longer cared about the ecology of his divine kingdom, considering more the growth rate of these assets.

For example, with the Bodhi Precious Snakes, Yang Fan would determine the environment that would yield the highest reproduction rate based on the amount of food around Snake Valley and the population density.
Once the number of these low-level demonic beasts was reduced to a certain level, Yang Fan could feel that the overall pressure on his divine kingdom had eased significantly.
Subsequently, Yang Fan spent another 60 million Faith Points to purchase 100 Moon Wells and Sun Springs respectively, leaving only emergency funds.
After completing the task, Yang Fan entered the Virtual World and sent a location invitation to Zhang Pang.
The Virtual World was much more interesting than reality; people in modern society, apart from sleeping, spent most of their time in the Virtual World.
Within just a few breaths, Zhang Pang arrived at the location.
“My Lord Main God, for what reason have you summoned this lowly one?” Zhang Pang put on an act of worship.
Yang Fan was speechless at this; the nicknames this kid came up with for him were becoming more and more numerous.
“Alright, let’s talk business. I know of an investment for a divine kingdom that currently has high returns and low risk. You and Uncle Zhang should both consider giving it a try.”
“What kind of investment?” Zhang Pang’s face lit up with joy.
The quality of information Yang Fan could access now was far higher than his own.
What is the easiest money to make in this world?
Information asymmetry, of course!

“Blood Clotting Flower. Go search for it yourself and discuss it with Uncle Zhang when you get home. The excess profits will only last for about a year, and you should be able to harvest two or three crops. Goodbye.” Yang Fan explained.
Zhang Pang nodded subconsciously, his attention now entirely focused on the shopping mall.
“Damn, such huge profits!” Zhang Pang did not dare to delay.
He immediately returned to reality and pulled his father, Zhang Wanshan, out of the Virtual World.

“Dad, that’s the situation. Should we engage in Planting the Blood Clotting Flower? Isn’t the rate of return a bit too high?” Zhang Pang swallowed his saliva, looking at the high rate of return, and found it hard to believe.
If it hadn’t been his brother Yang Fan who said it, Zhang Pang would have thought he had encountered a scam.

Zhang Wanshan took a deep breath: “I saw a few words on the God Forum. It should be related to high-grade hemostatic powder. These are frontline supplies; I’m afraid the war against the alien races is not looking optimistic.”
“In other words, this is war profiteering?”
“Exactly.”
“How did Brother Yang know such important information?” Zhang Pang was shocked.
“He is a genius of the Luo Family now, so it’s normal for him to have many sources of information.”
“Then should we cultivate it?”

“Of course! Why wouldn’t we do an investment that is essentially picking up money? I’ll mortgage the house and the grain shop in a while, and go get some high-interest loans. After finishing this deal, we’ll go buy a house in the county center.” Zhang Wanshan slammed the table, a look of greed flashing in his eyes.
“Doing it on such a large scale, is there any risk?” Zhang Pang swallowed his saliva.
After all, he was still a high school senior and couldn’t quite gauge the situation for a moment.
“What do you know? How can we ordinary people climb up without taking risks? By the way, you haven’t told me how much profit we are going to share with Little Yang for this investment.”
“He didn’t say.”
Luo Rou had gone out with her mother, Sun Rong, this morning and didn’t return until noon.
Feeling the door being pushed open, Yang Fan logged out of the Virtual World.
At this moment, Luo Rou was in a good state, and a smile could not be hidden from the corners of her mouth.
Perhaps because of the abundance of Water of Life, her health had improved significantly during this period, and her face was no longer as gaunt as it had been at the beginning.
Yang Fan stood up, took her right hand, and transferred this month’s 5 million Faith Points to her.
Luo Rou did not refuse this time, but looked up and said with a serious expression: “Husband, I went to the hospital for a check-up today. It’s a boy.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was stunned, feeling both joyful and sentimental in his heart.
The theoretical lifespan of a Divine Being is 500 years.
Many people only have offspring after the age of 100 or even 200.
Someone like Yang Fan, at 20-something, could definitely be considered to have married and had children early.
“By the time the child grows up, I feel like he could call me ‘big brother’.” Yang Fan grumbled inwardly.
Luo Rou hugged Yang Fan and asked: “Husband, what do you think would be a good name for our child?”
After interacting during this period, Luo Rou discovered that Yang Fan was not as unbearable as she had imagined, and the relationship between the two had become much more harmonious.
“I don’t have a talent for naming things. You can just decide for yourself.” Yang Fan said.
Luo Rou gave a soft acknowledgement, then said: “Grandfather wants to see you. It’s in the Virtual World, and I’ve sent you the address.”

“Alright, then I’ll go there first. You should rest well. If the Faith Points are not enough, you can tell me. Since you are pregnant, you cannot have less Water of Life, so as not to affect the fetus.”
“Rest assured, Husband, I know what I’m doing.”
Yang Fan nodded and immediately put on the virtual helmet.
Luo Chengfeng was a First-Order God.
Yang Fan dared not keep him waiting too long.
Tapping the coordinates, Yang Fan felt his consciousness pulled by a powerful suction force, instantly crossing space to arrive in the distant starry sky.
Just after arriving, he felt an extremely thick smell of blood.
“This is! A divine kingdom war!” Yang Fan’s eyes widened like copper bells.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness was at an altitude of hundreds of thousands of meters, yet he could clearly feel everything happening on the ground.
A Goblin, standing fully a hundred meters tall, held a giant axe and let out terrifying roars, while in front of it was a human flying on a sword.
With a flash of sword light, the Goblin’s head was severed directly, and its body fell backward with a thunderous sound.
“Cultivation path. Is the strength of this believer at the Foundation Establishment or Golden Core stage?” Yang Fan swallowed his saliva.
He could feel the powerful strength possessed by the believer below; I’m afraid that this one person alone could sweep through his own divine kingdom.
“Little Yang, you’ve arrived.” Luo Chengfeng’s voice appeared behind him.

It’s in the Virtual World, and I’ve sent you the address.”
“Alright, then I’ll go there first.
You should rest well.
If the Faith Points are not enough, you can tell me.
Since you are pregnant, you cannot have less Water of Life, so as not to affect the fetus.”
“Rest assured, Husband, I know what I’m doing.”
Yang Fan nodded and immediately put on the virtual helmet.
Luo Chengfeng was a First-Order God.
Yang Fan dared not keep him waiting too long.
Tapping the coordinates, Yang Fan felt his consciousness pulled by a powerful suction force, instantly crossing space to arrive in the distant starry sky.
Just after arriving, he felt an extremely thick smell of blood.
“This is!
A divine kingdom war!” Yang Fan’s eyes widened like copper bells.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness was at an altitude of hundreds of thousands of meters, yet he could clearly feel everything happening on the ground.
A Goblin, standing fully a hundred meters tall, held a giant axe and let out terrifying roars, while in front of it was a human flying on a sword.
With a flash of sword light, the Goblin’s head was severed directly, and its body fell backward with a thunderous sound.
“Cultivation path.
Is the strength of this believer at the Foundation Establishment or Golden Core stage?” Yang Fan swallowed his saliva.
He could feel the powerful strength possessed by the believer below; I’m afraid that this one person alone could sweep through his own divine kingdom.
“Little Yang, you’ve arrived.” Luo Chengfeng’s voice appeared behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Investment in Cultivation Techniques
paragraphs: “Greetings, Grandfather. Where are we?” Yang Fan bowed hurriedly.
Although it was but a drop in the ocean, Yang Fan had witnessed the terrifying power of gods today; even a single follower possessed such strength.

“We are inside the Divine Kingdom of a Goblin demigod. I’ve been representing the Luo Family here for land reclamation, which the authorities call a Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle. We have already won this small-scale conflict, and now we are doing the cleanup work. This place will become a resource point for the Luo Family. Once you break through to become a demigod, you will naturally reach this level,” Luo Chengfeng explained.
At this moment, Luo Chengfeng looked very happy.
Besides the smooth progress of his work, he must have also learned the news of his granddaughter’s pregnancy.

“There is nothing here that requires your attention. I will take you to a frontline supply point so we can have a good chat.” Luo Chengfeng grabbed Yang Fan’s right hand, and their figures crossed space to arrive in a pavilion.

“Have some tea. You and Rou are quite fast. However, since she is already pregnant, you two must exercise restraint during this period. If you hurt my little great-grandchild, I won’t let you off, kid.” As he spoke, Luo Chengfeng personally poured a cup of tea for Yang Fan.
“I understand, Grandfather.” Yang Fan looked embarrassed.
“I have been very busy lately and haven’t had time to guide the development of your Divine Kingdom. Have you encountered any problems?”
“With the resources from the Luo Family, the Divine Kingdom is developing quite well now.”
“Have you established the development path for your Divine Kingdom?” Luo Chengfeng asked again.
Yang Fan’s expression was a bit conflicted: “I am still hesitating between Cultivation and martial arts.”
After this period of systematic study, Yang Fan already had a general direction in his mind.
Whether it was Cultivation or martial arts, the source of strength lay in the followers themselves; the difference was whether to choose body tempering or Dantian Cultivation.
Yang Fan had his own thoughts on this, but he did not say them out loud.

Luo Chengfeng nodded and analyzed: “Once you become a demigod, you will have the opportunity to participate in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle. Some are against alien races, while others are internal conflicts. Only strong power can protect you. The Cultivation path, in the ancient era, was similar to the immortal Cultivation novels in storybooks. Followers have better tacit understanding and are suitable for various large-scale formations, making them more offensive. The martial arts path focuses on the strength of the followers’ physical bodies and emphasizes defense, which will significantly increase your survivability. The former requires various methods for spiritual roots and countless heavenly treasures. The latter takes longer to temper the physical body. Both have their pros and cons.”
“Thank you for your guidance, Grandfather.”

“Since you haven’t made a choice yet, you can let your followers choose for themselves. Which development path is more suitable for your Divine Kingdom may have already been determined from the day of awakening. Go to the mall and buy a transmission tower, and put the Cultivation and martial arts techniques suitable for both into it. Over time, as a god, you will naturally know which direction is more suitable for development.”

“I have prepared some resources for you. Although they are not of high value, they have the advantage of being comprehensive, so you won’t need to replace them before breaking through to become a demigod.” Luo Chengfeng took out two cards and placed them on the table.
Yang Fan glanced at them roughly; they contained dozens of techniques, movement skills, and combat skills, and there was a set for both Cultivation and martial arts.
The price of techniques and martial arts skills in the mall is not cheap, yet the other party gave so many at once.
Yang Fan sighed that as expected of a powerful god, he was generous to his descendants.
“Thank you, Grandfather.” Yang Fan said gratefully.
Nowadays, his funds were basically all used for Divine Kingdom investment, so how could he have spare money to buy extra techniques and martial arts skills?
With Luo Chengfeng’s help this time, the development of his followers would naturally be much faster.

“I don’t have the ability to help Rou solve her Divine Kingdom problems, so I can only do my best to extend her lifespan. With the connection of my great-grandchild, I will treat you as my own grandson in the future; this is all I should do. You are currently in the critical period of your third year of high school, and all resources and energy should be used to develop your own Divine Kingdom. Don’t worry about the Water of Life for Rou; I have gained quite a lot from this land reclamation.” Luo Chengfeng reminded.
Hearing this, Yang Fan understood a bit more; it seemed that Luo Rou had told her grandfather about him transferring funds.
Perhaps it was because his granddaughter was pregnant, or perhaps he felt that he could be trusted, which was why Luo Chengfeng had increased his investment in him.

“Improve your strength well. When you have time, participate in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle. With the strength you showed in the last competition, entering the top 1000 in the family ranking should be no problem. Why haven’t you participated even once?” Luo Chengfeng asked in confusion.
Yang Fan looked confused.
He naturally knew about the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle; after all, the Federal Government had listed it as a separate section.
It was just that Yang Fan had been busy with Divine Kingdom investment during this time.

Apart from attending classes and browsing exchange groups, his consciousness had been observing the growth of the Blood Clotting Flower, frequently sending down the Divine Decree to have his followers hunt surrounding monsters.
He simply had no time to study anything else.
The Blood Clotting Flower was a D-rank Spirit Plant after all, and its attraction to monsters was not low.
Yang Fan did not want this treasure for making money to be destroyed by those beasts.
If he wasn’t worried about the desertification of the Divine Kingdom’s ecosystem, he would have wanted to pack up all the monsters and sell them all.

Seeing Yang Fan’s clueless expression, Luo Chengfeng explained: “The Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle is executed by the highest Intelligent Life of the Federal Government. The army that a Divine Being can send to battle is ten thousand people, and the followers participate in the war through consciousness projection, so even if they all die, there will be no losses. It is of great benefit to honing the overall combat ability. In addition, my Luo Family also has ranking rewards; you can check it yourself when you go back. You have an ordinary background, and the information you can access is inherently weaker than others. Therefore, you should communicate more with your peers instead of developing in isolation; that is something only a fool would do.”
“I will start studying it as soon as I go back.” Yang Fan said hurriedly.
“Go on. If you encounter any problems that you cannot solve, you can leave me a message in the Virtual World.”
“Yes.”
Returning to reality, Yang Fan manifested the two inheritance cards that Luo Chengfeng had given him.

“C-rank technique: Five Elements Cultivation Technique; movement technique: Light Body Art; combat technique: Green Origin Sword Art, Clarity Needle Technique, Concentration Technique... Pre-requisite methods suitable for the Cultivation path, sold as a complete set, priced at 50 million Faith Points. Recommended to be used with a C-rank transmission tower.”

“C-rank technique: Vajra Indestructible Technique; combat technique: Mountain Shaking Fist, Iron Arm Technique... Pre-requisite methods suitable for the martial arts path, sold as a complete set, priced at 50 million Faith Points. Recommended to be used with a C-rank transmission tower.”
The total value of these two sets of inheritances was as high as 100 million Faith Points, which was definitely a huge investment for a Divine Being.
Only a god like Luo Chengfeng could take them out without batting an eye.
Otherwise, even if Yang Fan wanted to buy these two sets of inheritance methods, he would hesitate again and again.
Yang Fan opened the mall and entered “C-rank transmission tower”.

“C-rank transmission tower, can hold 100 C-rank and below techniques and martial arts skills, priced at 150,000 Faith Points. Merchant note: This building has no investment value. Unlike bestowing inheritance through the Divine Decree, this building allows followers to choose for themselves, making it easier to pick a Cultivation path that suits them. Once sold, no returns are accepted. It is not recommended for ordinary people to purchase. The customer service of this merchant has been handed over to an Intelligent Life, and refunds are not accepted.”

chapters.title: Chapter 44: So Bold
paragraphs: Looking at the introduction behind the transmission tower, Yang Fan couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
150,000 Faith Points isn’t actually expensive, but for ordinary people, it is definitely a significant investment.
The important thing is that this type of building has no output; aside from wealthy family heirs, ordinary people simply wouldn’t buy it.
It’s no wonder this merchant doesn’t provide customer service; they were probably annoyed by all the regretful buyers.
Yang Fan didn’t care about this; 150,000 Faith Points meant nothing to him now.
With a wave of his hand, Yang Fan bought five transmission towers and deployed them into the major cities.
He then loaded two sets of legacies and issued a Divine Decree.
“All believers may study the techniques within and choose the path they are most adept at cultivating.”
The believers in the Divine Kingdom are no different from people.
Everyone has their specialties, and each person’s strengths differ.
Using the transmission tower to let the believers choose for themselves is, in the long run, more valuable than issuing a Divine Decree to grant enlightenment directly.
Regarding the development route of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan had long since made up his mind: it would be a combination of Cultivation and martial arts.
While browsing the God Forum during this period, Yang Fan discovered that he wasn’t the only one in the world with this idea; in fact, quite a few gods were taking this path of integration.

If the believers in his Divine Kingdom included both cultivators who could fly into the sky and burrow into the earth with unparalleled offensive power, and martial artists who had achieved sainthood through their physical bodies with invincible defense, then the army composed of them would be even stronger—absolutely invincible among their peers.
However, such a choice requires more time and resources.
Because development is too slow, it is even possible to be left behind by others.
But Yang Fan is different.
With his Evolution Talent, time is the least scarce resource in the Divine Kingdom, making comprehensive development the best choice.
However, some things are better done quietly; there is no need to speak of them.
After finishing all this, Yang Fan noticed that the believers in his Divine Kingdom had already started selecting techniques, and some had even switched their Cultivation methods.
There were those practicing the Five Elements Cultivation Technique and those practicing the Vajra Indestructible Technique.
Sensing the changes within the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan muttered to himself, “It seems my Divine Kingdom is better suited for the path of Cultivation.”

He could feel that the number of people practicing the Five Elements Cultivation Technique was far greater than those practicing the Vajra Indestructible Technique, which meant that the believers in his Divine Kingdom were more gifted in the aspects of Cultivation.
Yang Fan didn’t mind this; after all, with a massive population base, some martial arts geniuses would always be born.
Furthermore, Yang Fan had ambitions.
If he were to break through to become a demigod in the future and his Divine Kingdom had sufficient area and population, he might even be able to establish a nation centered on machinery.
A mechanical path capable of keeping pace with Cultivation and martial arts could hardly be simple.
One must know that the entire Virtual World is currently running on the Intelligent Life of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom!
However, the investment for the mechanical path far exceeds that of Cultivation and martial arts.
From the snippets of information on the God Forum, Yang Fan knew that he currently had no qualifications to explore it.
Afterward, Yang Fan entered the Virtual World and began to research the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
His life had been very fulfilling lately, and added to the fact that the geniuses in the chat group rarely discussed this, he hadn’t gotten around to trying it.
If not for Luo Chengfeng’s reminder today, Yang Fan still wouldn’t have been prepared to participate in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle in the near future.
Yang Fan clicked on the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle section with his right hand.
“Federal Citizen: Yang Fan; Identity: Divine Being; Current Points: 0; Current Win Rate: 0.”
“Yang County Divine Being Ranking, expand?”
“Expand.” Yang Fan tapped lightly.
“No. 1, Li Mingyuan, Points: 64,624, Win Rate: 64.2%.”
“No. 2, Yang Yuanhao, Points: 63,122, Win Rate: 63.4%.”
Yang Fan scrolled down the ranking list continuously, but discovered that he didn’t recognize a single person.
“No. 10,000, XXX, Points: 10,240, Win Rate: 51.1%.”
Yang Fan was full of confusion: “Who are all these people? I’ve at least entered the inner circle of Yang County geniuses now, so how come I don’t recognize anyone?”
One must know that this ranking list displays a total of 10,000 people.
He himself was one thing, but what about Luo Bing and Li Tianheng?
Could it be that they, like him, hadn’t participated in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle?
Feeling that being open to learning and not ashamed to ask questions were good virtues, Yang Fan opened the Genius Exchange Group.
“Everyone, I just went to check out the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle; why don’t I see any of your names there? ‘Dog head for self-preservation’.” Yang Fan typed the message and sent it out.
In just a moment, notification sounds came from the group.
“So bold, what do you mean?”
“It’s this chatterbox again. Why so many questions? And is this something that should be asked in the group?”
“Hahaha, if I didn’t know you a little, I would have thought you were mocking our two group owners!”
“Brother Yang, some things shouldn’t be said by me, but I think it would be better for you to speak less.”
“Thanks for livening up the atmosphere, but these words are too aggressive; hurry up and retract them.”
Looking at the dozen or so messages that appeared instantly, Yang Fan was stunned, but heeded the advice and retracted his question.
Just then, Li Shuhao sent a private message: “Brother Yang, what you said is too easily misunderstood.”
“Give me your coordinates, let’s meet and talk.”
Yang Fan had just sent the coordinates to the other party when Li Shuhao teleported over.
“Why are you asking about the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle?” Li Shuhao asked.
“I was just curious. After all, Luo Bing and Li Tianheng are so strong, so why didn’t I see their names?” Yang Fan explained.
“Do you know how large the population of Yang County is? Not less than 1 billion, and 90% of them are Divine Beings.”
“We haven’t even had our Divine Kingdoms awakened for half a year, yet some Divine Beings have already lived for over 400 years.”

“We are geniuses, that’s true, but that also requires time to develop. The Divine Kingdoms of those old fogies have already evolved for thousands of generations; how can you compare with them?” Li Shuhao rolled his eyes dramatically.
“So that’s how it is.” Yang Fan’s expression was a bit awkward.
He had been immersed in communicating with those talented classmates during this time, and had forgotten how small and young this circle was.
They were only twenty years old, and their Divine Kingdoms had not even been developing for a year.

“In the history of Yang County No. 1 Middle School, very few people have been able to break into the top 10,000; it takes years to see such a monster emerge. Once successful, one can directly take the special admission route, and have a chance to enter the two top universities in the Federation.”
“I heard from a friend that Luo Bing is working in this direction. You suddenly blurted out such a sentence in the group; aren’t you afraid of drawing hatred?”
Li Shuhao complained frantically; he didn’t know whether to say Yang Fan had low emotional intelligence or low IQ.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan immediately typed a line: “I am inexperienced, I meant no harm, please don’t blame me, experts.”
Just then, Luo Mingxuan suddenly popped up.
“Country bumpkin, don’t embarrass my Luo Family. I didn’t see your name in the top 1,000 of our family’s internal ranking list, you piece of trash.”
Seeing this sentence, even though Yang Fan had a very good temper, his face couldn’t help but darken.
This was no longer just being sarcastic; it was a direct insult to his face.
“Just you wait!” Yang Fan’s eyes turned cold.

“We haven’t even had our Divine Kingdoms awakened for half a year, yet some Divine Beings have already lived for over 400 years.”
“We are geniuses, that’s true, but that also requires time to develop.
The Divine Kingdoms of those old fogies have already evolved for thousands of generations; how can you compare with them?” Li Shuhao rolled his eyes dramatically.
“So that’s how it is.” Yang Fan’s expression was a bit awkward.
He had been immersed in communicating with those talented classmates during this time, and had forgotten how small and young this circle was.
They were only twenty years old, and their Divine Kingdoms had not even been developing for a year.
“In the history of Yang County No.
1 Middle School, very few people have been able to break into the top 10,000; it takes years to see such a monster emerge.
Once successful, one can directly take the special admission route, and have a chance to enter the two top universities in the Federation.”
“I heard from a friend that Luo Bing is working in this direction.
You suddenly blurted out such a sentence in the group; aren’t you afraid of drawing hatred?”
Li Shuhao complained frantically; he didn’t know whether to say Yang Fan had low emotional intelligence or low IQ.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan immediately typed a line: “I am inexperienced, I meant no harm, please don’t blame me, experts.”
Just then, Luo Mingxuan suddenly popped up.
“Country bumpkin, don’t embarrass my Luo Family.
I didn’t see your name in the top 1,000 of our family’s internal ranking list, you piece of trash.”
Seeing this sentence, even though Yang Fan had a very good temper, his face couldn’t help but darken.
This was no longer just being sarcastic; it was a direct insult to his face.
“Just you wait!” Yang Fan’s eyes turned cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 45: First Participation in the Simulation Battle
paragraphs: “Brother Yang, don’t pay attention to that asshole. I heard from a friend that Luo Mingxuan’s talent isn’t that great. Relying on the unlimited support of his parents, he’s still at the bottom among your Luo Family Second-Class Geniuses. He’s the real trash.” Li Shuhao sneered.
“It’s fine.”

“Major companies all have detailed information on the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle to rank internally, which is meant to encourage young people to improve their believers’ strength as soon as possible. There are also quite a few rewards included, so you can look into it.”
“Thanks for the reminder. I’ll be heading off first.”
“Do you want to hang out at Tianxiang Renjian later?”
“No, I’m not in the mood.”
Leaving those words behind, Yang Fan’s consciousness vanished right on the spot.
At this moment, Yang Fan had already arrived at the Luo Family garrison in the Virtual World and found Zhan Yunxiao.
“Elder Zhan, I wonder if you are familiar with the Family’s internal Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle?” Yang Fan asked.
“This is the detailed leaderboard.” Zhan Yunxiao raised his hand, and a display screen appeared.
“Luo Family Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle Leaderboard.
1st place, Luo Hen, First-Class Genius, points 1420, win rate 74%.
2nd place, Luo Bing, First-Class Genius, points 1350, win rate 82%.
142nd place, Luo Mingxuan, Second-Class Genius, points 542, win rate 71%.
2041st place, Luo Wan, Third-Class Genius, points 121, win rate 64%.
2042nd place, Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, points 0, win rate 0%.”

“This ranking only tallies students who haven’t graduated from high school yet. Aside from Yang County, there are also Luo Family geniuses studying in the city. Among them, there are 2 First-Class Geniuses, 212 Second-Class Geniuses, and 1,828 Third-Class Geniuses.”
“Once you graduate from high school, even if your status is still a Divine Being, you won’t be included in the tally.”
“The Luo Family has set up ranking rewards, advancing every 100 places ranges from the lowest 100,000 Faith Points to 10 billion Faith Points for first place.”

“Young Master Yang, you can participate more in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle before graduating. If you can enter the top 100, that’s quite a substantial income.” Zhan Yunxiao said what he knew.
Zhan Yunxiao was only a Guest Elder.
If not for the subsidy given to him by the Luo Family, he wouldn’t have been a guide for a high school student.
Moreover, he had many Divine Kingdom investment matters to handle and needed to keep an eye on them constantly.
Unless Yang Fan actively inquired, he wouldn’t remind him.
Back then, his willingness to hand over his insights on developing the Divine Kingdom to Yang Fan was already due to the fact that the other party, like himself, had the status of an ordinary person.
Of course, if Yang Fan weren’t a Genius with a different surname, the Luo Family wouldn’t have assigned such a Guest Elder to him.
The subsidy given by the Luo Family was low, so there were fewer things the other party was willing to do, and naturally, he wouldn’t put his heart into everything.
When all was said and done, it was still about cutting costs.
Even a live-in son-in-law was ultimately an outsider.
Yang Fan didn’t know that other guides were far more responsible than Zhan Yunxiao, and even if he knew, he wouldn’t complain.
After all, having a demigod powerhouse available to consult at any time was already very good.
People always need to learn to be content.
The rewards provided by the Luo Family for the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle were similarly generous.
Entering the top 2,000 granted a reward of 100,000 Faith Points, 1,900th place got 500,000, and reaching 1,000th place yielded 10 million.
Breaking into the top 100 would award 100 million, and breaking into the top 10 would be 1 billion.
Especially the reward for first place—that was a full 10 billion.
As for the 10 billion reward, Yang Fan didn’t dare to expect too much right now, but he still had some confidence in getting the 100 million reward for the top 100.
As for the 1 billion reward for breaking into the top ten, Yang Fan was confident he could get it before the College Entrance Examination.

Returning to reality, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom and directly issued a Divine Decree, selecting the ten thousand people with the strongest strength from the five major cities.
The Cultivation Techniques and legacies given by Luo Chengfeng had only been introduced into the Divine Kingdom not long ago, and not many believers had studied them.
However, the Marrow Cleansing Technique he loaded some time ago had already been cultivated to the Minor Achievement Realm by quite a few believers.
Aside from the 34 First-Tier beings, the physical bodies of the remaining Mortals were more than twice as strong as when they first participated in the school assessment.
Yang Fan was confident that this ten thousand elite force would be more than enough to deal with his previous fifty thousand soldiers.
Wearing armor, donning iron helmets, and holding weapons, the ten thousand elite troops were fully equipped and ready to go.
Connecting to the Virtual World, the consciousness of these ten thousand believers plunged together with him into the space of the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
“Identity: Divine Being, number of believers: 10,000, meets the requirements of the simulation battle. Do you wish to start matching?”
The voice of the Intelligent Life came from Yang Fan’s mind.
“Start.”
At this moment, the physical bodies of these ten thousand believers were still sitting cross-legged in the Divine Kingdom, and only their consciousness descended here.
Even if the entire army perished, there would be no real loss.

According to the introduction of the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, the matching method was comprehensively evaluated based on win rates and points, and the target audience included all members of the Human Race under the Federal Government.
Only the rankings were divided by region.
In other words, the opponents encountered could be in Yang County, in the city, or possibly on other planets.
“Matching started. Matching successful. Randomizing battle scenario. Scenario generated: forest. Battle begins.”
As the voice of the Intelligent Life fell, the soldiers instantly appeared in a dense forest with towering trees.
And at a position about one thousand meters ahead were several hundred Barbarians who weren’t even wearing clothes.

Seeing this scene, Yang Fan couldn’t help but complain inwardly: “Is this a newbie who tried to start a simulation battle right after Awakening their Divine Kingdom? What kind of matching mechanism is this?”
Yang Fan waved his hand, and a First-Tier being led a team of a dozen people to charge straight over and wipe out the opponent completely.
“All believers are dead. Battle ends. Federal citizen Yang Fan, points 1, win rate 100%. Do you wish to continue the simulation battle?”
“Continue.”
“Generating scenario... Gobi desert. Battle begins.”
“Federal citizen Yang Fan, points 2, win rate 100%.”
For thirty matches in a row, Yang Fan’s soldiers easily resolved the opponents.
“Matching starts. Random scenario: volcano. Battle begins.”
The scene shifted, and even Yang Fan in the Void Realm could feel the intense heat radiating from the ground.
His believers were already starting to sweat at this moment.

“As expected of Advanced Intelligent Life, the simulated scenarios and sensations are actually this realistic. The soldiers can maintain their absolute Peak condition at the start of every battle.” Yang Fan sighed inwardly.
At this time, Yang Fan’s opponent was much stronger.
Although the ten thousand people were all Mortals, the weapons they wore and held all emitted waves of cold light.

“F*ck, which wealthy Family’s local tyrant is this opponent? All ten thousand people are equipped with a complete set of F-grade weapons. This probably costs two to three hundred million Faith Points, right?” Yang Fan’s face twitched.
A bit more solemnity appeared on Yang Fan’s face.

It was true that his subordinates were stronger, but in the Early Stage of Divine Kingdom development, weapons had a huge impact, especially since the opponent was entirely equipped with F-grade weapons.
If he were careless, he might capsize in the gutter.
The two armies charged and killed each other, and the metallic clashing of weapons was endless.
Although the opponent was well-equipped, their comprehension of the Formation was insufficient, and their losses during every charge were greater than Yang Fan’s.
As time dragged on, being outnumbered, the last enemy was beheaded by Yang Fan’s army.
“Battle victory. Points increased by 40. Current points: 70. Win rate: 100%. Do you wish to continue matching?”
As Yang Fan’s voice fell, the consciousness of the soldiers who had just died condensed once again, and the lost weapons also returned to their hands.
Their state reached its Peak once more.
“Random scenario — city. Battle begins.”
