chapters.title: Chapter 46: Purchasing Marrow Cleansing Pill
paragraphs: This time, Tier 1 entities had already appeared in the opponent’s army, but their equipment was very poor, consisting entirely of ordinary iron weapons.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan’s pressure was actually not as great as just a moment ago.

Matching consecutively, perhaps because his win rate had consistently been 100%, the opponents he encountered began to noticeably strengthen, and with each victory, the points Yang Fan obtained increased by tens at a time.
“Points 362, do you wish to continue matching?”
“Continue.” Yang Fan’s tone was firm.
“The random environment has been generated as a grassland, battle begins.”
As Intelligent Life finished speaking, Yang Fan’s ten thousand elite soldiers arrived at an open space.
Looking at the opponent’s lineup, Yang Fan’s expression gradually grew solemn.
Two Tier 2 entities, 100 Tier 1 entities, and just like the wealthy person he had just encountered, this person was similarly equipped entirely with F-grade weapons.
“Troublesome.” Yang Fan gave a bitter laugh in his heart.
Not only were the soldiers of higher quality, but their equipment was also better; how was he supposed to fight this?
In the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, there was no such thing as admitting defeat.
Anyway, there was no loss upon dying in battle, so Yang Fan could only bite the bullet and go up.
If he were to encounter such a team during the No.
1 High School exam competition, Yang Fan would never hesitate and would definitely turn around and run.
“Shield soldiers forward, flank from the left and right wings, archers prepare.”
“The enemy’s vanguard poses too great a threat, everyone hold your ground for me.”
“Raise the spears in your hands, throw them out.”
Having practiced the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array for a long time, Yang Fan’s troop had tacit cooperation, relying on the Formation during every clash to reduce losses to a minimum.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan’s expression was somewhat surprised; this result was much better than he had imagined.
Yang Fan held his breath and did not choose to descend a Divine Decree.

After all, under the effect of his Evolution Talent, the generals currently at the core of the Formation had a comprehension of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array that was no longer inferior to his own.
Yang Fan certainly didn’t want an incompetent general to exhaust the three armies to death.
The opposing God was also covered in sweat at this moment.

“What’s going on? I thought it was a free win, but I didn’t expect this guy’s comprehension of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to be so deep. This is troublesome.” On the second floor of a luxurious villa on another planet, a man wearing a virtual helmet was frowning deeply.
The armies of both sides fought relentlessly: 9,000 people, 6,000 people, 3,000 people, 500 people.
In the final wave of battle, due to the gap in weapons and strength, Yang Fan’s army could no longer hold on and fell to the ground.
“Battle failed, points minus 1, current points 361, win rate 97.2%, continue matching?”
“Do not continue.” Yang Fan shook his head and exited the Virtual World.
Yang Fan opened the rankings for the Luo Family’s Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
“324th place, Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, points 361, win rate 97.2%”
Regarding this result, his inner heart didn’t fluctuate much.
“If the soldiers could all be equipped with F-grade weapons, defeating that person just now should be very easy.” Yang Fan muttered to himself.
This Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle also made Yang Fan understand his own strengths and weaknesses.

Under his Evolution Talent, his believers’ comprehension of the Formation far surpassed that of their peers, but because he hadn’t invested too many treasures to improve Aptitude, their strength was still somewhat lacking compared to the geniuses of those large families.

Moreover, weapons were equally important during the Early Stage of the Divine Kingdom’s development, but Yang Fan was simply unwilling to spend hundreds of millions of Faith Points to equip his believers.
For him right now, there were simply too many places that required spending money.
Yang Fan’s ranking this time surged directly from 2,000 to over 300th place, cumulatively obtaining close to 100 million Faith Points.
These funds had already been automatically transferred from the Luo Family’s corporate account into his Divine Kingdom.
Especially after breaking into the top 1,000, advancing every hundred places would reward a subsidy of over 10 million Faith Points.
Yang Fan expressed that money from these large families was indeed easy to earn.
“Faith Points: 112.67 million (providing 8.1 Faith Points daily)”
“Funds have become abundant, what is most suitable to use this money for?” Yang Fan fell into contemplation.
Right at this moment, prompt sounds suddenly kept coming from inside his wrist watch.
“Old Yang, that trash Luo Mingxuan is starting to run his mouth blindly again, hurry up and look at the group chat.” Li Shuhao kept sending messages.
Hearing this, Yang Fan furrowed his brows, a trace of disgust flashing across the depths of his eyes.
Inside the Genius Exchange Group.

“I’m dying of laughter. I thought this Yang Fan had some talent and took so much investment from my Luo Family, thinking his strength would advance by leaps and bounds, but I didn’t expect him to only have a little over 300 points.”
“With this talent, if he weren’t a matrilocal son-in-law, I’m afraid he would barely qualify as a Third-Class Genius of my Luo Family.”
“Our group’s review process in the future still needs to be stricter; we can’t just let any tom, dick, and harry in.”
Out of the more than one hundred people in the entire group, only Luo Mingxuan was constantly running his mouth.
The others were not fools; whether they agreed with Luo Mingxuan’s words or felt he went too far, none of them spoke in the group at the moment.
It’s none of my business, hang it high; there was no need to get involved in other people’s fights over unfounded matters.
“We don’t have any deep blood feud, don’t provoke me.” Yang Fan sent a message.
“You finally reacted, I thought you had no temper at all.”
“So what if I provoke you?”
“If you have the ability, let’s apply for the Divine Kingdom Battlefield and fight a real, hard battle. If I don’t kill all your believers, my last name isn’t Luo.”
Watching the other party get more and more spirited, completely acting like a second-generation rich kid style, Yang Fan didn’t want to deal with him anymore and directly closed the chat group.
On the other side, seeing that Yang Fan didn’t respond to him, Luo Mingxuan felt even more contempt in his heart.
“Country bumpkin, daring to snatch my woman, once you graduate from university, I will send troops to raid your Divine Kingdom.” Luo Mingxuan spat.
If not for the fact that students’ Divine Kingdoms were protected by federal law, Luo Mingxuan would have loved to locate the Divine Kingdom coordinates right now and directly resolve the opponent.
In the Real World, Yang Fan took a deep breath: “This time’s Faith Points will no longer be used to purchase fixed assets. First, let the believers’ strength grow strong; the current me is too weak.”
Luo Mingxuan’s sarcasm also made Yang Fan understand a principle: always keeping a low profile will only result in people stepping on your head to shit.
Yang Fan opened the Divine Shop and found the Medicinal Pill he had looked at many times before.
“Marrow Cleansing Pill X1, selling price 10,000 Faith Points. Hailing from the Cultivation God-Kingdom of a Tier 3 God, it can significantly improve the Aptitude of Mortal believers.”
“Merchant’s note: Taking it for the first time has the most obvious effect; the effect will decrease significantly in the later stages, and continuous consumption is not recommended.”
This kind of Medicinal Pill was recommended in the group by Tie Feng from the Blacksmith Association, and it gained recognition from quite a few people.
Yang Fan took a deep breath.
This time he decided to play big, directly spending 100 million to purchase 10,000 Marrow Cleansing Pills.
Those 10,000 elite troops were currently the strongest and best-Aptitude Geniuses in the Divine Kingdom, perfectly matching these Medicinal Pills.

After the believers’ strength increased, breaking into the top one hundred of the Luo Family’s Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle should be possible, and by then, he might be able to obtain over another 100 million Faith Points.
Yang Fan decided to take a gamble; even if he couldn’t break into the top one hundred, his ranking had to surpass Luo Mingxuan, otherwise this fly buzzing every day was simply too annoying.

After the Marrow Cleansing Pills arrived in his account, Yang Fan immediately loaded them into the Divine Kingdom and descended a Divine Decree, having the 10,000 people who participated in the battle today consume them.

Under Yang Fan’s observation, after those believers consumed the Marrow Cleansing Pills, their entire bodies began to twitch in pain, their skin cracked and oozed wisps of fresh blood, and their bones emitted creaking sounds.
Although it looked terrifying, Yang Fan, as a God, could feel that these people’s Aptitude was changing at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Especially after breaking into the top 1,000, advancing every hundred places would reward a subsidy of over 10 million Faith Points.
Yang Fan expressed that money from these large families was indeed easy to earn.
“Faith Points: 112.67 million (providing 8.1 Faith Points daily)”
“Funds have become abundant, what is most suitable to use this money for?” Yang Fan fell into contemplation.
Right at this moment, prompt sounds suddenly kept coming from inside his wrist watch.
“Old Yang, that trash Luo Mingxuan is starting to run his mouth blindly again, hurry up and look at the group chat.” Li Shuhao kept sending messages.
Hearing this, Yang Fan furrowed his brows, a trace of disgust flashing across the depths of his eyes.
Inside the Genius Exchange Group.
“I’m dying of laughter.

I thought this Yang Fan had some talent and took so much investment from my Luo Family, thinking his strength would advance by leaps and bounds, but I didn’t expect him to only have a little over 300 points.”
“With this talent, if he weren’t a matrilocal son-in-law, I’m afraid he would barely qualify as a Third-Class Genius of my Luo Family.”
“Our group’s review process in the future still needs to be stricter; we can’t just let any tom, dick, and harry in.”
Out of the more than one hundred people in the entire group, only Luo Mingxuan was constantly running his mouth.
The others were not fools; whether they agreed with Luo Mingxuan’s words or felt he went too far, none of them spoke in the group at the moment.
It’s none of my business, hang it high; there was no need to get involved in other people’s fights over unfounded matters.
“We don’t have any deep blood feud, don’t provoke me.” Yang Fan sent a message.
“You finally reacted, I thought you had no temper at all.”
“So what if I provoke you?”
“If you have the ability, let’s apply for the Divine Kingdom Battlefield and fight a real, hard battle.
If I don’t kill all your believers, my last name isn’t Luo.”
Watching the other party get more and more spirited, completely acting like a second-generation rich kid style, Yang Fan didn’t want to deal with him anymore and directly closed the chat group.
On the other side, seeing that Yang Fan didn’t respond to him, Luo Mingxuan felt even more contempt in his heart.
“Country bumpkin, daring to snatch my woman, once you graduate from university, I will send troops to raid your Divine Kingdom.” Luo Mingxuan spat.
If not for the fact that students’ Divine Kingdoms were protected by federal law, Luo Mingxuan would have loved to locate the Divine Kingdom coordinates right now and directly resolve the opponent.
In the Real World, Yang Fan took a deep breath: “This time’s Faith Points will no longer be used to purchase fixed assets.
First, let the believers’ strength grow strong; the current me is too weak.”
Luo Mingxuan’s sarcasm also made Yang Fan understand a principle: always keeping a low profile will only result in people stepping on your head to shit.
Yang Fan opened the Divine Shop and found the Medicinal Pill he had looked at many times before.
“Marrow Cleansing Pill X1, selling price 10,000 Faith Points.
Hailing from the Cultivation God-Kingdom of a Tier 3 God, it can significantly improve the Aptitude of Mortal believers.”
“Merchant’s note: Taking it for the first time has the most obvious effect; the effect will decrease significantly in the later stages, and continuous consumption is not recommended.”
This kind of Medicinal Pill was recommended in the group by Tie Feng from the Blacksmith Association, and it gained recognition from quite a few people.
Yang Fan took a deep breath.
This time he decided to play big, directly spending 100 million to purchase 10,000 Marrow Cleansing Pills.
Those 10,000 elite troops were currently the strongest and best-Aptitude Geniuses in the Divine Kingdom, perfectly matching these Medicinal Pills.

After the believers’ strength increased, breaking into the top one hundred of the Luo Family’s Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle should be possible, and by then, he might be able to obtain over another 100 million Faith Points.
Yang Fan decided to take a gamble; even if he couldn’t break into the top one hundred, his ranking had to surpass Luo Mingxuan, otherwise this fly buzzing every day was simply too annoying.

After the Marrow Cleansing Pills arrived in his account, Yang Fan immediately loaded them into the Divine Kingdom and descended a Divine Decree, having the 10,000 people who participated in the battle today consume them.

Under Yang Fan’s observation, after those believers consumed the Marrow Cleansing Pills, their entire bodies began to twitch in pain, their skin cracked and oozed wisps of fresh blood, and their bones emitted creaking sounds.
Although it looked terrifying, Yang Fan, as a God, could feel that these people’s Aptitude was changing at a speed visible to the naked eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Fully Automatic Concentrator
paragraphs: “The worse the Aptitude, the better the effect of the Marrow Cleansing Pill. The Aptitude of this batch of people has been improved by at least ten times.” Yang Fan was extremely shocked.
At this moment, he finally understood why Luo Bing had already given birth to third-order beings during the First High School entrance examination; this was simply smashed out with money.
A full month had passed inside the Divine Kingdom before these soldiers awoke from the powerful medicinal strength, but to Yang Fan’s perception, it was merely the span of a few breaths.

“This pill can greatly improve your Aptitude. Aside from working hard to Cultivate, all of you enjoy priority mating rights with all females within the clan to give birth to descendants with better Aptitude.” Yang Fan specially descended a Divine Decree.
“We faithfully obey our God’s command.” Those soldiers each had flushed complexions and fanatical faces.
With an SSS-rank Talent, one day in the Real World meant ten years passed in the Divine Kingdom.
The next afternoon, Yang Fan suddenly felt his body undergo a change, and a warm current surged toward his limbs and bones.
This situation had not appeared for the first time, and Yang Fan understood that second-order beings had appeared within his Divine Kingdom.

After adapting to the bodily changes, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom and discovered that among the batch of soldiers who took the Marrow Cleansing Pill, not only did two second-order beings appear, but there were also over a hundred more first-order beings.
This was the advantage of high Aptitude.
In ten years, the strength of these ten thousand people was growing in a blowout and explosive manner.
Not only that, but their descendants were also noticeably more robust than other infants.
However, soon after, Yang Fan discovered a new problem: the Taisui meat and blood pills were being consumed much too quickly.

It was not just the believers who took the Marrow Cleansing Pill that had a massive consumption of meat; due to loading various Cultivation Techniques and Martial Skills, the appetite of ordinary believers also greatly increased.
The amount of meat that used to supply 5 people could not even fill one person now, especially the believers who cultivated the Vajra Indestructible Technique—they were simply super big eaters.
Right now, it could barely be supplied, but if their strength improved further or the population increased, the food would soon exceed income.
Besides this, Yang Fan also discovered that the quality of this Taisui meat seemed to no longer match the current situation.
The believers took longer and longer to eat.
To maintain the energy consumption of Cultivation, they had to eat for over two hours every day, and the time spent going to the toilet increased correspondingly.
“Higher-quality food is a must.” Yang Fan thought to himself.
Opening the Divine Shop, Yang Fan began to search for a solution.

“Fully Automatic Concentrator, a special building produced from the Mechanical Divine Kingdom of a Fifth-Order God, capable of greatly concentrating the nutrients of low-grade meat. Selling price: 100 million Faith Points.”
Seeing this building, Yang Fan’s eyes couldn’t help but light up.

“Merchant’s notes: Putting in Yao Beast corpses allows for automatic decomposition, and the condensed food is automatically vacuum-packaged with a shelf life of up to 3,000 years. Tip: The Fully Automatic Concentrator is equipped with a specialized automatic cutting plant. Putting in organisms similar to Taisui can automatically convert them into finished packaged food. The automatic cutting plant can automatically adjust its footprint, and can match up to 100 adult Taisui at most. It is very suitable for the Divine Kingdom development of Divine Beings. With one Fully Automatic Concentrator, you will never have to worry about food.”
Except for being expensive, this Fully Automatic Concentrator was simply tailor-made for Yang Fan.
But at this moment he had no funds to buy it.
Once the Blood Clotting Flower harvest was completed, or he broke into the top one hundred of the Luo Family leaderboard, he would immediately buy this building at that time.

In the future, the population of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom would continue to grow, and coupled with the strengthening of the believers, the consumption of food would definitely increase exponentially.
He had to solve the rear supply problem once and for all.
More than ten days later, the Blood Clotting Flowers inside the Divine Kingdom all matured, and Yang Fan put them up for sale online at the first instance.
“Sale successful, revenue of 240 million Faith Points. After tax, the net income is 211.2 million. The Faith Points have arrived in the account.”
Once the funds arrived, Yang Fan immediately bought 8 million Blood Clotting Flower seeds, the Fully Automatic Concentrator, and 15 adult Taisui.
This income directly spent more than half.

Pouring his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom, because the footprint of the Fully Automatic Concentrator was too large, it was completely impossible to place it inside the main city of the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan chose a mountain range closest to the major main cities, moved it, and placed the Fully Automatic Concentrator on it.
As expected of a special building produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom of a Fifth-Order God, it completely did not require external power input.
The moment it was placed on the surface of the Divine Kingdom, the huge Mechanical monster began to spin.
Thousands of tracks began to transmit meat, huge gravity rods swung ceaselessly, temperatures alternated between hot and cold, and electric lights flickered constantly.

Food weighing as much as a hundred catties went in and was compressed to only the size of a palm, followed by assembly line packaging, and the finished packaged meat automatically stacked into the commodity area.
Yang Fan had already put the five Taisui in the Divine Kingdom and the fifteen Taisui he had just purchased all into the automatic cutting plant of the Fully Automatic Concentrator.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan’s expression couldn’t help but become strange.
There was no help for it; the city on one side was still a barbaric building piled up with huge stones, and the clothing worn by the believers was also crudely made.
Yet this Fully Automatic Concentrator was just like a high-tech product of the future.
Comparing the two, the feeling it gave people was naturally very abrupt.
“The things in this Mechanical Divine Kingdom are truly awesome. Could those high-energy frozen foods my dad bought before be food concentrated by a similar machine?” Yang Fan couldn’t help guessing.
Shaking his head to think no more about it, at this moment he began to check the Divine Kingdom information.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources inside the Divine Kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique Talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden.)
Believers: Second-order beings (25), First-order beings (644), Mortals (330,000)

Methods: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Federal Body Refinement Technique, Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Minor Achievement)...
Faith Points: 10.67 million (Providing 27.2 Faith Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well X500, Sun Spring X500, B-Rank building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1 (Soaking 10 Taisui, load rate 100%), special building Fully Automatic Concentrator X1 (Cutting plant loaded with 20 Taisui, load rate 20%), C-Rank transmission tower X5
Assets: Blood Clotting Flower seeds (X8 million, D-Rank Spirit Plant), Taisui X30, Bodhi Precious Snake...”
In nearly two hundred years of the Divine Kingdom, the strength of the believers had undergone heaven-defying changes.
25 second-order beings and over 600 first-order beings—such explosive growth was basically credited to the investment of those ten thousand Marrow Cleansing Pills.
Now, the Faith Points he could provide solely relying on believers daily had also reached double digits.
According to what Li Qingying said, when this data reached 1,000, the Divine Kingdom would usher in a massive change.
The upper limit of the area would increase to ten million square kilometers, and his life level would greatly improve, reaching the demigod Realm.
There was still a long way for Yang Fan to go before reaching demigod, but he had already seen the dawn.
“If it’s just for the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, there’s no rush to buy weapons for the time being.” Yang Fan muttered.
With the strength of his believers today, if everyone was equipped with F-Rank weapons, squeezing into the top one hundred of the Luo Family rankings would be effortless.
But there was no need to do so.
Compared to external forces, the believers’ own strength was more important.
Anyway, before high school graduation, the rewards for the Luo Family rankings would not be canceled.
Moreover, Yang Fan was confident that with his current strength, even with inadequate equipment, he might still secure a reward within the top hundred.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Ranking 80
paragraphs: Virtual World, Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle space.
“Federal Citizen: Yang Fan; Identity: Divine Being; Points: 361; Win Rate: 97.2%. Participate in matchmaking?”
“Yes.” Yang Fan clicked confirm.
“Random Scenario — — Grassland, battle begins.”
The opponent possessed one Tier 2 being and ten ranked beings, half of which were equipped with a full set of F-grade weapons.
Seeing such a lineup, Yang Fan felt no pressure at all, as the difference in combat power itself was too vast.
“Kill.”
The sound of clashing armor and galloping horses resounded across the grassland, and as the soldiers of both sides engaged in battle, it quickly turned into a one-sided massacre.

Now, for every 15 people in the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array of Yang Fan’s believers, there was a ranked being stationed to oversee it, increasing the overall operational efficiency and strength of the Formation several times over, easily securing victory.
“Battle ended, points + 10, current points 371, win rate 97.5%, continue matchmaking?”
“Continue.”
Twenty matches in a row, and Yang Fan won all of them.
“Battle ended, points + 30, current points 831, win rate 99.1%, continue matchmaking?”
With Yang Fan’s current points, the opponents he was matched with already made him feel strenuous; in the battle just then, half of his soldiers had even died in combat.
“Continue.”
Yang Fan also wanted to see how many points he could ultimately obtain in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle with his current combat power.
The higher the points, the stronger the opponents encountered in each matchmaking would be.
Although Yang Fan was only five or six hundred points away from Luo Bing and the others, the gap between them was not small.
“Randomly generating scenario — — Valley, battle begins.”
As the voice of the Intelligent Life sounded, an inexplicable pressure appeared directly in front of the army.
Looking at the opponent’s lineup, Yang Fan couldn’t help but curse outright: “Damn it, what kind of thing is this matchmaking?”
There wasn’t a single Mortal among the army before his eyes; they were all ranked beings, and not even low-ranked ones.
Being inside the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle space, Yang Fan could clearly sense the opponent’s specific information.
“Tier 5 Being × 3, Tier 4 being × 10, Tier 3 being x2000, Tier 2 being...”
Besides that, the equipment on the opponent was also entirely high-grade goods, not even E-grade; at least D-grade or C-grade was possible.
Yang Fan currently even had the feeling of just stepping out of the beginner village only to encounter a world boss.
The opponent’s army rushed over like an arrow released from a string, so fast that before his own soldiers could set up a defensive Formation, they were completely slaughtered.
“Battle failed, points - 1, current points 830, win rate 94.2%, continue matchmaking?”
Hearing the prompt tone, Yang Fan only felt his eyelids twitch wildly.

“I protest, the opponent matched just now had too huge a gap with me, this isn’t right, is it?” Yang Fan questioned loudly, not caring whether this Intelligent Life would answer him or not; he was mainly venting his dissatisfaction.
His believers had just been slaughtered by others like mowing grass, and Yang Fan had watched to the point of almost developing psychological trauma.

“Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle matchmaking is judged based on points and win rate. That participant just now was very close to you.” The Mechanical synthetic voice of the Intelligent Life came from the space.
Yang Fan was left speechless.

His strength had surged greatly, breaking through to an elite monster, and he was preparing to farm battle records in the beginner village, only to end up running into a world boss climbing the ranks in the beginner village?

Yang Fan was clear in his heart that the person he encountered just now was definitely a Prodigy figure from a major place, and most likely participating in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle for the first time.
“Monster.” Yang Fan uttered his own evaluation.
If he continued matchmaking, Yang Fan was confident his points could rise a bit more, but there was no need, because he knew his score had definitely entered the Luo Family’s top one hundred.
Yang Fan returned to reality and checked the Luo Family’s Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle leaderboard.
“80th place, Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, points 830, win rate 94.2%.”
Unlike when he originally signed the investment contract, the Luo Family’s rewards for geniuses within the clan were automatically distributed through Intelligent Life.
The moment Yang Fan’s score met the standard, funds from the Luo Family were received within his Divine Kingdom.
“Faith Points income 132,000,000.”
“Faith Points: 142,670,000.”
Yang Fan was still immersed in the joy of his skyrocketing assets, not knowing that the Luo Family geniuses had all blown up in an uproar because of this.
So much time had passed since the Divine Kingdom Awakening, and although the simulation battle rankings usually fluctuated, they wouldn’t fluctuate too much.
When Yang Fan charged from 2,000th place to 300th place the first time, not many people cared; after all, that was his first time participating in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
As a Second-Class Genius, this score could only be considered medium-low.
But rising from 300th place to 80th place, the significance this represented was huge.
The Genius Exchange Group had blown up in an uproar at this moment.
“Brother Yang is awesome, he actually rushed to 80th place on the Luo Family leaderboard, you held back the last time you participated in the simulation battle, right.”
“Strong, chat more when you have time. @Yang Fan.”
“With this strength, don’t be so polite when speaking in the group usually. You definitely have the combat power of the top fifty in Yang County No. 1 Middle School.”
“Is there moisture in your Luo Family’s leaderboard? Just 80th place, how is that top-fifty combat power in the grade?”
“What the hell do you know? Our Luo Family has quite a few top geniuses who were sent to the city for cultivation since childhood, and they are basically all in the top hundred.”
Li Shuhao looked at the chat content in the group, his entire person shocked beyond measure.
He was still ranked past 300th in the Li Family, yet how did Yang Fan rush to 80th place?
Are we really classmates?
After the shock, Li Shuhao seemed to think of something and directly edited a message.
“My brother is awesome, who was running their mouth a while ago? @Luo Mingxuan.”
After sending this sentence, Li Shuhao directly closed the chat group, crossed his legs in the room, looking like a villain who had achieved his ambition.
In the Luo Family villa, Luo Mingxuan was frantically slapping the table with his hands.
“Li Shuhao, a collateral branch member of the Li Family like you dares to hit me while I’m down. Just wait for me on the midterm exam.” Luo Mingxuan’s eyes were red.
Ever since Li Shuhao sent that message, the entire group tacitly quieted down.
Luo Mingxuan understood in his heart that everyone not speaking was because they didn’t want to openly offend him; they were probably sending messages to each other in private to mock him right now.
At this moment, he truly hated Yang Fan.
In his view, Yang Fan’s first participation in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle was completely holding back.
Playing the pig to eat the tiger made him misjudge, which was why he lost such a big Face.
With Yang Fan’s win rate being so high, he probably ended the simulation battle directly upon failing once.
If he continued to participate, his points might even be higher.
At this moment, Luo Mingxuan’s heart was filled with both jealousy and hatred, along with a trace of helplessness.
If Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were not protected by the laws of the Federal Government, he would even want to have his parents step in to teach him a lesson.
Luo Mingxuan took a deep breath and forcefully made himself calm down.

“I can’t rush. When mother comes back from pioneering, she can still provide me with quite a bit of resources. By then, my Divine Kingdom will welcome another wave of explosive growth, and I won’t necessarily be weaker than him.” Luo Mingxuan cheered himself on.
Not just the younger generation, Yang Fan’s sudden emergence this time even attracted the attention of the Luo Family Elders.
At this moment, Luo Chengfeng had already returned to the Luo Family headquarters and was attending a Family council.

“Number 01 Intelligent Life reminder: The clan’s outer-surname Genius Yang Fan participated in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle for the second time, his points increased significantly, and his current Family ranking is 80.” The prompt voice of the Intelligent Life came from inside the council hall.
Originally, this Family council was to discuss resource allocation after this pioneering, but unexpectedly a dark horse that startled the Intelligent Life appeared.

Looking at the opponent’s lineup, Yang Fan couldn’t help but curse outright: “Damn it, what kind of thing is this matchmaking?”
There wasn’t a single Mortal among the army before his eyes; they were all ranked beings, and not even low-ranked ones.
Being inside the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle space, Yang Fan could clearly sense the opponent’s specific information.
“Tier 5 Being × 3, Tier 4 being × 10, Tier 3 being x2000, Tier 2 being...”
Besides that, the equipment on the opponent was also entirely high-grade goods, not even E-grade; at least D-grade or C-grade was possible.
Yang Fan currently even had the feeling of just stepping out of the beginner village only to encounter a world boss.
The opponent’s army rushed over like an arrow released from a string, so fast that before his own soldiers could set up a defensive Formation, they were completely slaughtered.
“Battle failed, points - 1, current points 830, win rate 94.2%, continue matchmaking?”
Hearing the prompt tone, Yang Fan only felt his eyelids twitch wildly.

“I protest, the opponent matched just now had too huge a gap with me, this isn’t right, is it?” Yang Fan questioned loudly, not caring whether this Intelligent Life would answer him or not; he was mainly venting his dissatisfaction.
His believers had just been slaughtered by others like mowing grass, and Yang Fan had watched to the point of almost developing psychological trauma.
“Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle matchmaking is judged based on points and win rate.
That participant just now was very close to you.” The Mechanical synthetic voice of the Intelligent Life came from the space.
Yang Fan was left speechless.

His strength had surged greatly, breaking through to an elite monster, and he was preparing to farm battle records in the beginner village, only to end up running into a world boss climbing the ranks in the beginner village?

Yang Fan was clear in his heart that the person he encountered just now was definitely a Prodigy figure from a major place, and most likely participating in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle for the first time.
“Monster.” Yang Fan uttered his own evaluation.
If he continued matchmaking, Yang Fan was confident his points could rise a bit more, but there was no need, because he knew his score had definitely entered the Luo Family’s top one hundred.
Yang Fan returned to reality and checked the Luo Family’s Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle leaderboard.
“80th place, Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, points 830, win rate 94.2%.”
Unlike when he originally signed the investment contract, the Luo Family’s rewards for geniuses within the clan were automatically distributed through Intelligent Life.
The moment Yang Fan’s score met the standard, funds from the Luo Family were received within his Divine Kingdom.
“Faith Points income 132,000,000.”
“Faith Points: 142,670,000.”
Yang Fan was still immersed in the joy of his skyrocketing assets, not knowing that the Luo Family geniuses had all blown up in an uproar because of this.
So much time had passed since the Divine Kingdom Awakening, and although the simulation battle rankings usually fluctuated, they wouldn’t fluctuate too much.
When Yang Fan charged from 2,000th place to 300th place the first time, not many people cared; after all, that was his first time participating in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
As a Second-Class Genius, this score could only be considered medium-low.
But rising from 300th place to 80th place, the significance this represented was huge.
The Genius Exchange Group had blown up in an uproar at this moment.
“Brother Yang is awesome, he actually rushed to 80th place on the Luo Family leaderboard, you held back the last time you participated in the simulation battle, right.”
“Strong, chat more when you have time. @Yang Fan.”
“With this strength, don’t be so polite when speaking in the group usually.
You definitely have the combat power of the top fifty in Yang County No.
1 Middle School.”
“Is there moisture in your Luo Family’s leaderboard?
Just 80th place, how is that top-fifty combat power in the grade?”
“What the hell do you know?
Our Luo Family has quite a few top geniuses who were sent to the city for cultivation since childhood, and they are basically all in the top hundred.”
Li Shuhao looked at the chat content in the group, his entire person shocked beyond measure.
He was still ranked past 300th in the Li Family, yet how did Yang Fan rush to 80th place?
Are we really classmates?
After the shock, Li Shuhao seemed to think of something and directly edited a message.
“My brother is awesome, who was running their mouth a while ago? @Luo Mingxuan.”
After sending this sentence, Li Shuhao directly closed the chat group, crossed his legs in the room, looking like a villain who had achieved his ambition.
In the Luo Family villa, Luo Mingxuan was frantically slapping the table with his hands.
“Li Shuhao, a collateral branch member of the Li Family like you dares to hit me while I’m down.
Just wait for me on the midterm exam.” Luo Mingxuan’s eyes were red.
Ever since Li Shuhao sent that message, the entire group tacitly quieted down.
Luo Mingxuan understood in his heart that everyone not speaking was because they didn’t want to openly offend him; they were probably sending messages to each other in private to mock him right now.
At this moment, he truly hated Yang Fan.
In his view, Yang Fan’s first participation in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle was completely holding back.
Playing the pig to eat the tiger made him misjudge, which was why he lost such a big Face.
With Yang Fan’s win rate being so high, he probably ended the simulation battle directly upon failing once.
If he continued to participate, his points might even be higher.
At this moment, Luo Mingxuan’s heart was filled with both jealousy and hatred, along with a trace of helplessness.
If Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were not protected by the laws of the Federal Government, he would even want to have his parents step in to teach him a lesson.
Luo Mingxuan took a deep breath and forcefully made himself calm down.
“I can’t rush.
When mother comes back from pioneering, she can still provide me with quite a bit of resources.
By then, my Divine Kingdom will welcome another wave of explosive growth, and I won’t necessarily be weaker than him.” Luo Mingxuan cheered himself on.
Not just the younger generation, Yang Fan’s sudden emergence this time even attracted the attention of the Luo Family Elders.
At this moment, Luo Chengfeng had already returned to the Luo Family headquarters and was attending a Family council.

“Number 01 Intelligent Life reminder: The clan’s outer-surname Genius Yang Fan participated in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle for the second time, his points increased significantly, and his current Family ranking is 80.” The prompt voice of the Intelligent Life came from inside the council hall.
Originally, this Family council was to discuss resource allocation after this pioneering, but unexpectedly a dark horse that startled the Intelligent Life appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Luo Family Adds Investment
paragraphs: Hearing the prompt tone, Luo Chengfeng doubted for a moment whether his ears had malfunctioned, and specifically went to check the information.
“Good lad, I really didn’t misjudge you.” Luo Chengfeng was overjoyed and stood up directly in front of everyone.
“Fifteenth Elder, when I wanted to raise Yang Fan’s treatment back then, you didn’t agree. What do you have to say now?”
Luo Chengfeng pointed at the old man sitting beside him and questioned.

The contract treatment signed between Yang Fan and the Luo Family back then indeed exceeded that of ordinary second-class geniuses, and this was a decision Luo Chengfeng made by overcoming all dissenting opinions.
At that time, quite a few people opposed it, but thinking of the situation of his granddaughter Luo Rou, they gave him Face.
Now it seemed, this had instead recruited a true Genius for the Luo Family.

Ordinary people without resources would experience a wave of explosive growth in strength in the short term after receiving investment from a major Family; the greater the magnitude, the stronger the plasticity of the Divine Kingdom represented.
Now, it had only been two months since the Luo Family and Yang Fan signed the investment contract, and the Divine Kingdom had developed for about sixty years.
Being able to break into the top 80 in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle made him truly a dark horse worth noting.
“Indeed not bad. I watched the video of the Yang County No. 1 Middle School examination back then, and now it seems I underestimated his potential.”

“I remember the initial funds given by the Family were only 100 million plus a Class B building, right? Can the improvement in strength be this huge? Chengfeng, you wouldn’t have given him the ‘immortal nurturing tower’ inside your own Divine Kingdom, would you?” Another Elder revealed a look of suspicion.

Hearing this, Luo Chengfeng couldn’t help spitting and said, “Do you think I’m a fool? The immortal nurturing tower is my core building and the capital for establishing myself. He is my granddaughter’s husband, not my ancestor.”
Hearing this, the Elder who had just spoken also felt it made sense, and awkwardly waved his hand.
Indeed, the core building within the Divine Kingdom was too important.
Unless one’s Lifespan was nearing its end, even biological children couldn’t possibly be given it, let alone an outsider.
“Everyone, although Yang Fan has a different surname, he is now considered a member of the Luo Family. Moreover, my granddaughter is already pregnant. I think the Luo Family can increase investment.”
After all, Yang Fan was his granddaughter’s husband.
Since he had talent, Luo Chengfeng naturally wanted to seize the opportunity to pull some investment for him.
At this moment, it was precisely the Family council, and running into the Intelligent Life broadcasting the news, it was truly a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
“What suggestions does Elder Chengfeng have?” Luo Hai, the head of the Luo Family sitting in the main seat, asked.
“I think with Yang Fan’s speed of progress, he is not inferior to a First-Class Genius. The Family can set up another quota for a First-Class Genius.” Luo Chengfeng took a deep breath.

“Holy crap, Luo Chengfeng, you are too shameless. Judging by Yang Fan’s current performance, he is probably one hundred thousand miles away from a First-Class Genius. Even though he is your grandson-in-law, you can’t be this partial.”

“That’s right, a First-Class Genius is of great importance, and strategic resources must be invested in each of them. Not to mention that the potential he currently displays is not enough, just based on his surname being Yang? That alone won’t do.”
“Simply absurd! The Family Head asked you to give opinions, not to let you daydream!”
The Luo Family gods at the scene all started complaining one by one.
The Family’s resources were only this much.
With an extra First-Class Genius, everyone else’s resources would have to be reduced, so naturally, people were unwilling.

“Alright, Elder Chengfeng, we’ve known each other for thousands of years, stop playing that game of asking an exorbitant price and paying back on the spot. Yang Fan’s performance is indeed not bad. Allocate 500 million to him from the Family accounts. If there is a more dazzling performance in the future, the Luo Family will naturally add investment. The Family needs fresh blood; even if he doesn’t have the surname Luo, as long as he shows sufficient value, we won’t be stingy.” Luo Hai stated his decision.
Hearing this, Luo Chengfeng sat back in his seat, but the corners of his mouth simply couldn’t be suppressed.
“500 million in investment is enough for this kid to develop for a period of time.” Luo Chengfeng was in a great mood.
Luo Hai continued, “To return to the main topic, the achievements of the Family’s pioneering this time are quite significant. Let’s discuss the resource allocation.”
Hearing this, all the Elders present turned solemn in expression.
The new resource points involved quite a lot of interests, and this was the main purpose of today’s meeting.
A Genius who was still a Divine Being was not yet worth this group of gods investing too much attention.
After all, his surname was Yang, not Luo.
After receiving the Luo Family’s resource reward, Yang Fan had been browsing the Divine Shop and God Forum, researching what his Divine Kingdom needed most right now.
Recently, accompanied by her mother Sun Rong, Luo Rou frequently went to the hospital for prenatal checkups.
Although her body had not improved, her spirit was noticeably better, perhaps because she had expectations for the future.
Luo Rou pushed open the door and said in a somewhat anxious tone, “Husband, Grandpa wants us to go to the Luo Family station in the Virtual World to find him together.”
“Alright.”
Yang Fan nodded, took out the helmet from the bedside table, and put it on Luo Rou first.
Then, the consciousness of the two entered the Virtual World together.
“I’ll ask Grandpa to send me the coordinates, and we’ll go directly to his studio,” Luo Rou said.
Ever since her Divine Kingdom was damaged, Luo Rou rarely entered the Virtual World, let alone visited the Luo Family station, so as to avoid bumping into people she knew before.
Now she was just a useless person.
If she met acquaintances, she wouldn’t even dare to step forward to greet them, increasing awkwardness in vain.
Relying on the coordinates, the couple Yang Fan directly teleported in front of Luo Chengfeng.
“Little Yang, you really gave this old man a huge surprise this time. At today’s Family council, the looks those old fellows gave me were full of envy.” Luo Chengfeng laughed loudly.
Hearing this, Luo Rou was somewhat dazed and had no idea what her husband had done to make Grandpa so happy.
Luo Rou looked at Yang Fan with doubt on her Face, seemingly waiting for an explanation.
Looking at his own biological granddaughter, Luo Chengfeng couldn’t help sighing in his heart again.
If Luo Rou’s Divine Kingdom hadn’t been damaged, the two of them truly would have been a match made in heaven.
“I wonder what Grandpa is referring to?” Yang Fan had a guess in his heart, but dared not be certain.

“You kid probably don’t know what an amazing thing you’ve done. In less than three months of joining the Luo Family, your Family ranking in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle has already risen to the 80th place. Even I misjudged you.” Luo Chengfeng was full of gratification.
Hearing this, Luo Rou’s eyes were filled with shock.
“8... 80th place!”
As a direct descendant of the Luo Family, Luo Rou was most clear about the gold content of the Family’s simulation battle leaderboard.
Back then, she had barely squeezed into the top 100 before the College Entrance Examination, and her husband had already surpassed her best achievement now.
You must know that the senior high school midterm examinations hadn’t even started yet, so the gap can be imagined.

Luo Chengfeng continued, “Alright, the timing of your participation in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle this time was good. The Family’s Intelligent Life publicly broadcasted it, and even Lord Family Head remembered your name. This time I fought for a direct investment of 500 million Faith Points for you. The Family Head has already signed, and your Divine Kingdom will be able to receive it in a moment.”
“Thank you, Grandpa.” Yang Fan was overjoyed in his heart.
This was the benefit of having someone behind you.
If there weren’t a First-Order God like Luo Chengfeng behind him, the Luo Family might not have gone out of their way and given him such a huge reward.

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Ancient Spirit Tree
paragraphs: “During this Family reclamation, I encountered a seedling of an Ancient Spirit Tree within an Alien Divine Kingdom. Although it is only a thousand years old, this item is quite rare, so I’ll use it as a little extra and give it to you together.”
Luo Chengfeng took out a card loaded with the Ancient Spirit Tree and placed it into Yang Fan’s hands.
“Grandfather, can you really bring yourself to give away a thousand-year-old Ancient Spirit Tree seedling?” Luo Rou rolled her eyes.
“How long has it been since you got married, and already your elbows are turning outward?” Luo Chengfeng blew into his beard.
“Grandfather is a god, yet you aren’t more generous with your gifts.”

“Little Yang is still only a Divine Being, and cannot even fully utilize ordinary B-Rank buildings. Resources must match the Divine Kingdom itself, otherwise harboring great treasures will only attract unwanted attention.”
“Then this thousand-year-old Ancient Spirit Tree is too useless. The little spirits born from it only have Mortal strength and provide no help at all.” Luo Rou stuck out her tongue.

“What do you know? For the Divine Kingdom of a Divine Being, even an Ancient Spirit Tree seedling can drastically improve the ecological environment and enhance the life aura of the Divine Kingdom. Moreover, this thing requires no continuous investment at all. As time passes, the value of both the nurtured Elf Race and the Ancient Spirit Tree itself will become higher and higher. Besides, if it were a hundred-thousand-year or even million-year-old Ancient Spirit Tree, how could it possibly fall into your grandfather’s hands?” Luo Chengfeng explained.
Luo Rou wanted to argue further, but Yang Fan pulled her back slightly.
“Thank you, Grandfather. I really like this Ancient Spirit Tree.”
Regardless of the value of the Ancient Spirit Tree, it was a free gift anyway, and Yang Fan wasn’t greedy.

Watching Yang Fan’s actions, Luo Chengfeng grew even more satisfied with him: “The value of a thousand-year-old Ancient Spirit Tree seedling is between one and three hundred million Faith Points. You can choose to sell it, but I strongly suggest placing it into your Divine Kingdom to cultivate it, seeing as you are still young. Depending on the richness of vitality within your Divine Kingdom, elf lives will be born on the tree every once in a while. This race is a long-lived species and one of the few other racial retainers that can be cultivated; they can even help you participate in a Divine Kingdom War. Of course, you can also choose to sell the elves. On the market, the value of an Adult Elf is around one million Faith Points, and they are in short supply—even rarer than the Water of Life. You simply don’t understand the mysteries behind this.”
“Grandfather, you old scoundrel, what nonsense are you talking about?” Luo Rou glared fiercely at him.
Seeing this, Luo Chengfeng could only awkwardly pinch his own nose.

“Ahem, work hard to improve your strength. As long as you display enough potential, I guarantee that the investments you can obtain will not be inferior to those of the direct descendants of the Luo Family.” Luo Chengfeng changed the subject and began to encourage Yang Fan.
After finishing the serious business, Yang Fan accompanied Luo Rou and Luo Chengfeng to chat about everyday Family matters for a while before returning to reality.
“Husband, I didn’t expect your talent to be so good. Being with me has really delayed you,” Luo Rou apologized after taking off her helmet.
For gods, under the witness of federal law, a husband and wife constitute a community of interests that transcends direct blood relatives, and divorce is rarely ever heard of.
Therefore, when choosing their other half, everyone is extremely cautious—either matching in social standing and status, or complementing each other with Divine Kingdom resources.

Given the potential Yang Fan was currently displaying, if Luo Rou hadn’t been ambushed by aliens, coupled with having a grandfather who is a First-Order God, the two of them would have been quite well-matched.
But the current her was simply a burden.
As a First-Order God, Luo Chengfeng had made great contributions in this reclamation; under normal circumstances, how could the help he gave Yang Fan be of such low value?
Wasn’t it because he had to stabilize his injuries and purchase a large amount of the Water of Life, which left him financially strapped?
Luo Rou was well aware of this, but deep down she did not wish for her grandfather to do so.
After the child is born, every additional year she lived would require a non-trivial amount of resources.
Luo Rou did not want her existence to drag down the entire Family; it would be better to invest the limited resources into Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
The stronger he became in the future, the brighter their child’s prospects would be.
“What nonsense are you talking about? Trust me, it won’t be long before I have the ability to help you repair your Divine Kingdom,” Yang Fan said, gently flicking Luo Rou’s forehead.
“Having this thought is enough. Don’t put too much pressure on yourself; the development of a Divine Kingdom must still proceed step by step.”
“I understand.”
“The doctor told me to go for a walk every day, and this afternoon I’m going shopping at the mall with my mother. Is there anything you need to buy?”
“Isn’t it fine to just place an order directly in the Divine Shop if you want to buy something?” Yang Fan looked puzzled.
After all, in this era, the network was already capable of transmitting physical items; who would go offline to shop?
“How could you possibly understand the joy of a woman going shopping? I’m leaving.” Luo Rou snorted.
Yang Fan shook his head and cast his gaze into the Divine Shop.
The rewards from the Luo Family had already arrived in his account, and now the Faith Points within his Divine Kingdom had broken through 600 million.
This was the first time Yang Fan had ever had this much capital.
Before making any purchases, Yang Fan decided to first study the Ancient Spirit Tree seedling that Luo Chengfeng had given him.
Yang Fan opened the search bar and entered the four large characters: Ancient Spirit Tree.
“Ancient Spirit Tree: Can be classified as a special life building.

According to value, it can be classified into: Ancient Spirit Tree seedling (thousand years), adult Ancient Spirit Tree (one hundred thousand years), elf holy tree (one million years), and the legendary Elf Divine Tree (the probability of birth is extremely low; according to data, such buildings have only appeared within the Divine Kingdoms of a very few High-tier Gods).
Depending on the richness of vitality in their environment, Ancient Spirit Trees of different Ranks will nurture lives of the Elf Race every once in a while.
They are divided into little spirits, Adult Elf, Elf Kings, and the legendary Elf Emperor.
The Elf Race is a long-lived species; the longer they survive, the stronger their strength.

Due to racial differences, they cannot steadily produce Faith Points like believers, but they are gentle in nature and only need to absorb the life energy roaming in the air as food, allowing them to grow slowly without any investment of resources.
Not only will the Elf Race not destroy the Divine Kingdom’s ecology, but their existence can also greatly increase the growth rate of vegetation.
If the quantity is sufficient, the ecological environment of the Divine Kingdom will be extremely stable.
If other gods attack the Divine Kingdom, the Elf Race will also join the battle to protect their home.
Tips: The growth of the Ancient Spirit Tree and the Elf Race is closely related to the richness of vitality within the Divine Kingdom.
If you intend to cultivate them, you can purchase buildings such as the Moon Well that can enhance the vitality richness of the Divine Kingdom and place them around it.”
Looking at the detailed information listed for him by the Intelligent Life, Yang Fan became even more satisfied with this gift.
What does the development of the Elf Race need the most?
It is time.
Doesn’t this match perfectly with his Evolution Talent!
Without needing any investment, the strength of the Elf Race will grow stronger and stronger.
Perhaps in the short term, this Ancient Spirit Tree cannot bring him benefits, and the strength of the nurtured elves cannot grow explosively like believers.
But as his Divine Kingdom develops and evolves for one hundred thousand years, one million years, or even longer, he will be fully capable of evolving a powerful Elf Kingdom.
